verses.en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.fr: Paroles de Jérémie, fils de Hilkija, l''un des sacrificateurs d''Anathoth, dans le pays de Benjamin.
verses.am: በብንያም አገር በዓናቶት ከነበሩ ካህናት የሆነ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ የኤርምያስ ቃል።

verses.en: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel lui fut adressée au temps de Josias, fils d''Amon, roi de Juda, la treizième année de son règne,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሞጽ ልጅ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን በመንግሥቱ በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣለት።

verses.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.fr: et au temps de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, jusqu''à la fin de la onzième année de Sédécias, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, jusqu''à l''époque où Jérusalem fut emmenée en captivité, au cinquième mois.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን፥ እስከ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ እስከ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ፍጻሜ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም እስከ ተማረከችበት እስከ አምስተኛው ወር ድረስ መጣ።

verses.en: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.fr: Avant que je t''eusse formé dans le ventre de ta mère, je te connaissais, et avant que tu fusses sorti de son sein, je t''avais consacré, je t''avais établi prophète des nations.
verses.am: በሆድ ሳልሠራህ አውቄሃለሁ፥ ከማኅፀንም ሳትወጣ ቀድሼሃለሁ፥ ለአሕዛብም ነቢይ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.fr: Je répondis: Ah! Seigneur Eternel! voici, je ne sais point parler, car je suis un enfant.
verses.am: እኔም። ወዮ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ እነሆ፥ ብላቴና ነኝና እናገር ዘንድ አላውቅም አልሁ።

verses.en: But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: Ne dis pas: Je suis un enfant. Car tu iras vers tous ceux auprès de qui je t''enverrai, et tu diras tout ce que je t''ordonnerai.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንዲህ አለኝ። ወደምሰድድህ ሁሉ ዘንድ ትሄዳለህና፥ የማዝዝህንም ሁሉ ትናገራለህና። ብላቴና ነኝ አትበል።

verses.en: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ne les crains point, car je suis avec toi pour te délivrer, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እኔ አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ከፊታቸው አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.fr: Puis l''Eternel étendit sa main, et toucha ma bouche; et l''Eternel me dit: Voici, je mets mes paroles dans ta bouche.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እጁን ዘርግቶ አፌን ዳሰሰ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። እነሆ፥ ቃሌን በአፍህ ውስጥ አኑሬአለሁ፤

verses.en: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.fr: Regarde, je t''établis aujourd''hui sur les nations et sur les royaumes, pour que tu arraches et que tu abattes, pour que tu ruines et que tu détruises, pour que tu bâtisses et que tu plantes.
verses.am: እነሆ። ትነቅልና ታፈርስ ዘንድ፥ ታጠፋና ትገለብጥ ዘንድ፥ ትሠራና ትተክል ዘንድ በአሕዛብና በመንግሥታት ላይ ዛሬ አድርጌሃለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots: Que vois-tu, Jérémie? Je répondis: Je vois une branche d''amandier.
verses.am: ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ኤርምያስ ሆይ፥ ምን ታያለህ? እያለ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እኔም። የለውዝ በትር አያለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: Tu as bien vu; car je veille sur ma parole, pour l''exécuter.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። እፈጽመው ዘንድ በቃሌ እተጋለሁና መልካም አይተሃል አለኝ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée une seconde fois, en ces mots: Que vois-tu? Je répondis: Je vois une chaudière bouillante, du côté du septentrion.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ምን ታያለህ? እያለ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እኔም። የሚፈላ አፍላል አያለሁ፥ ፊቱም ከሰሜን ወገን ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: Then the Lord said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: C''est du septentrion que la calamité se répandra sur tous les habitants du pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ከሰሜን ወገን ክፉ ነገር በምድሪቱ በተቀመጡ ሁሉ ላይ ይገለጣል።

verses.en: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the Lord; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.fr: Car voici, je vais appeler tous les peuples des royaumes du septentrion, dit l''Eternel; ils viendront, et placeront chacun leur siège à l''entrée des portes de Jérusalem, contre ses murailles tout alentour, et contre toutes les villes de Juda.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በሰሜን ያሉትን የመንግሥታትን ወገኖች ሁሉ እጠራለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ይመጣሉ እያንዳንዳቸውም በኢየሩሳሌም በር መግቢያ በዙሪያዋ በቅጥርዋ ሁሉ ላይ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ዙፋናቸውን ያስቀምጣሉ።

verses.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.fr: Je prononcerai mes jugements contre eux, à cause de toute leur méchanceté, parce qu''ils m''ont abandonné et ont offert de l''encens à d''autres dieux, et parce qu''ils se sont prosternés devant l''ouvrage de leurs mains.
verses.am: ስለ ክፋታቸውም ሁሉ፥ እኔን ስለ ተው ለሌሎችም አማልክት ስላጠኑ ለእጃቸውም ሥራ ስለ ሰገዱ፥ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
verses.fr: Et toi, ceins tes reins, lève-toi, et dis-leur tout ce que je t''ordonnerai. Ne tremble pas en leur présence, de peur que je ne te fasse trembler devant eux.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ወገብህን ታጠቅ፥ ተነሥም፥ ያዘዝሁህም ሁሉ ንገራቸው፤ በፊታቸው እንዳላስፈራህ አትፍራቸው።

verses.en: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.fr: Voici, je t''établis en ce jour sur tout le pays comme une ville forte, une colonne de fer et un mur d''airain, contre les rois de Juda, contre ses chefs, contre ses sacrificateurs, et contre le peuple du pays.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ በይሁዳም ነገሥታት በአለቆችዋና በካህናትዋ ላይ በምድሪቱም ሕዝብ ላይ እንደ ተመሸገ ከተማ እንደ ብረትም ዓምድ እንደ ናስም ቅጥር ዛሬ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the Lord, to deliver thee.
verses.fr: Ils te feront la guerre, mais ils ne te vaincront pas; car je suis avec toi pour te délivrer, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ይዋጋሉ፥ ነገር ግን አድንህ ዘንድ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ድል አይነሡህም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.fr: Va, et crie aux oreilles de Jérusalem: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Je me souviens de ton amour lorsque tu étais jeune, De ton affection lorsque tu étais fiancée, Quand tu me suivais au désert, Dans une terre inculte.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ጆሮ ጩኽ፥ እንዲህም በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የብላቴንነትሽን ምሕረት የታጨሽበትንም ፍቅር፥ በምድረ በዳ ዘር ባልተዘራበት ምድር እንደ ተከተልሽኝ አስቤአለሁ።

verses.en: Israel was holiness unto the Lord, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Israël était consacré à l''Eternel, Il était les prémices de son revenu; Tous ceux qui en mangeaient se rendaient coupables, Et le malheur fondait sur eux, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እስራኤል ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነበረ፥ የቡቃያውም በkWraት ነበረ፤ የበሉት እንደ በደለኞች ይቈጠራሉ፥ ክፉም ነገር ያገኛቸዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear ye the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
verses.fr: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, maison de Jacob, Et vous toutes, familles de la maison d''Israël!
verses.am: የያዕቆብ ቤት የእስራኤልም ቤት ወገኖች ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Quelle iniquité vos pères ont-ils trouvée en moi, Pour s''éloigner de moi, Et pour aller après des choses de néant et n''être eux-mêmes que néant?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁ ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቁ፥ ከንቱነትንም የተከተሉ፥ ከንቱም የሆኑ ምን ክፋት አግኝተውብኝ ነው?

verses.en: Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
verses.fr: Ils n''ont pas dit: Où est l''Eternel, Qui nous a fait monter du pays d''Egypte, Qui nous a conduits dans le désert, Dans une terre aride et pleine de fosses, Dans une terre où règnent la sécheresse et l''ombre de la mort, Dans une terre par où personne ne passe, Et où n''habite aucun homme?
verses.am: እነርሱም። ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣን፥ በምድረ በዳም በባድማ gWdጓድም ባለበት ምድር፥ በውኃ ጥምና በሞት ጥላ ምድር፥ ማንም በማያልፍበትና ማንም በማይቀመጥበት ምድር የመራን እግዚአብሔር ወዴት አለ? አላሉም።

verses.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
verses.fr: Je vous ai fait venir dans un pays semblable à un verger, Pour que vous en mangiez les fruits et les meilleures productions; Mais vous êtes venus, et vous avez souillé mon pays, Et vous avez fait de mon héritage une abomination.
verses.am: ፍሬዋንና በረከትዋንም ትበሉ ዘንድ ወደ ፍሬያማ ምድር አገባኋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን በገባችሁ ጊዜ ምድሬን አረከሳችሁ፥ ርስቴንም አጐሳቈላችሁ።

verses.en: The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs n''ont pas dit: Où est l''Eternel? Les dépositaires de la loi ne m''ont pas connu, Les pasteurs m''ont été infidèles, Les prophètes ont prophétisé par Baal, Et sont allés après ceux qui ne sont d''aucun secours.
verses.am: ካህናቱም። እግዚአብሔር ወዴት አለ? አላሉም፥ ባለ ኦሪቶችም አላወቁኝም፤ ገዢዎችም ዐመፁብኝ፥ ነቢያትም በበኣል ትንቢት ተናገሩ፥ የማይረባንም ነገር ተከተሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the Lord, and with your children's children will I plead.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je veux encore contester avec vous, dit l''Eternel, Je veux contester avec les enfants de vos enfants.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር እከራከራለሁ፥ ከልጆቻችሁም ልጆች ጋር እከራከራለሁ።

verses.en: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
verses.fr: Passez aux îles de Kittim, et regardez! Envoyez quelqu''un à Kédar, observez bien, Et regardez s''il y a rien de semblable!
verses.am: ወደ ኪቲም ደሴቶች እለፉና ተመልከቱ፥ ወደ ቄዳርም ላኩና እጅግ መርምሩ፥ እንደዚህም ያለ ነገር ህኖ እንደ ሆነ እዩ።

verses.en: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
verses.fr: Y a-t-il une nation qui change ses dieux, Quoiqu''ils ne soient pas des Dieux? Et mon peuple a changé sa gloire contre ce qui n''est d''aucun secours!
verses.am: በውኑ አማልክት ያልሆኑትን አማልክቱን የለወጣቸው አንድ ሕዝብ አለን? ነገር ግን ሕዝቤ ክብሩን ለማይረባ ነገር ለወጠ።

verses.en: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Cieux, soyez étonnés de cela; Frémissez d''épouvante et d''horreur! dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ በዚህ ተደነቁ፥ እጅግም ደንግጡና ተንጥቀጡ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verses.fr: Car mon peuple a commis un double péché: Ils m''ont abandonné, moi qui suis une source d''eau vive, Pour se creuser des citernes, des citernes crevassées, Qui ne retiennent pas l''eau.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሁለቱን ክፉ ነገሮች አድርገዋልና፤ እኔን የሕያውን ውኃ ምንጭ ትተውኛል፥ የተቀደዱትንም gWdጓዶች፥ ውኃውን ይይዙ ዘንድ የማይችሉትን gWdጓዶች፥ ለራሳቸው ቆፍረዋል።

verses.en: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
verses.fr: Israël est-il un esclave acheté, ou né dans la maison? Pourquoi donc devient-il une proie?
verses.am: በውኑ እስራኤል ባሪያ ነውን? ወይስ የቤት ውላጅ ነውን? ስለምን ብዝበዛ ሆነ?

verses.en: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
verses.fr: Contre lui les lionceaux rugissent, poussent leurs cris, Et ils ravagent son pays; Ses villes sont brûlées, il n''y a plus d''habitants.
verses.am: የአንበሳ ደቦሎች በእርሱ ላይ አገሡ፥ ድምፃቸውንም ሰጡ፤ ምድሩንም ባድማ አደረጉ፥ ከተሞቹም ተቃጠሉ የሚቀመጥባቸውም የለም።

verses.en: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
verses.fr: Même les enfants de Noph et de Tachpanès Te briseront le sommet de la tête.
verses.am: የሜምፎስና የጣፍናስ ልጆች አስነወሩሽ አላገጡብሽም።

verses.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, when he led thee by the way?
verses.fr: Cela ne t''arrive-t-il pas Parce que tu as abandonné l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Lorsqu''il te dirigeait dans la bonne voie?
verses.am: ይህ ሁሉ የሆነብሽ እኔን ስለ ተውሽ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር አምላክሽ።

verses.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
verses.fr: Et maintenant, qu''as-tu à faire d''aller en Egypte, Pour boire l''eau du Nil? Qu''as-tu à faire d''aller en Assyrie, Pour boire l''eau du fleuve?
verses.am: አሁንስ የሺሖርን ውኃ ትጠጪ ዘንድ በግብጽ መንገድ ምን ጉዳይ አለሽ? የኤፍራጥስንም ውኃ ትጠጪ ዘንድ በአሦር መንገድ ምን ጉዳይ አለሽ?

verses.en: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.fr: Ta méchanceté te châtiera, et ton infidélité te punira, Tu sauras et tu verras que c''est une chose mauvaise et amère D''abandonner l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Et de n''avoir de moi aucune crainte, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ክፋትሽ ይገሥጽሻል ክዳትሽም ይዘልፍሻል፤ አምላክሽንም እግዚአብሔርን የተውሽ እኔንም መፍራት የሌለብሽ ክፉና መራራ ነገር እንደ ሆነ እወቂ፥ ተመልከቺ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
verses.fr: Tu as dès longtemps brisé ton joug, Rompu tes liens, Et tu as dit: Je ne veux plus être dans la servitude! Mais sur toute colline élevée Et sous tout arbre vert Tu t''es courbée comme une prostituée.
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ቀንበርሽን ሰብሬአለሁ እስራትሽንም ቈርጫለሁ፤ አንቺም። አላገለግልም አልሽ፥ ነገር ግን ከፍ ባለው ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ከለምለምም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ለማመንዘር ተጋደምሽ።

verses.en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
verses.fr: Je t''avais plantée comme une vigne excellente Et du meilleur plant; Comment as-tu changé, Dégénéré en une vigne étrangère?
verses.am: እኔ የተመረጠች ወይን ፍጹምም እውነተኛ ዘር አድርጌ ተክዬሽ ነበር፤ አንቺ ግን ክፉ የእንግዳ ወይን ግንድ ሆነሽ እንዴት ተለወጥሽብኝ?

verses.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord God.
verses.fr: Quand tu te laverais avec du nitre, Quand tu emploierais beaucoup de potasse, Ton iniquité resterait marquée devant moi, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእንዶድ ብትታጠቢም፥ ለራስሽም ሳሙና ብታበዢ፥ በእኔ ፊት በኃጢአትሽ ረክሰሻል ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
verses.fr: Comment dirais-tu: Je ne me suis point souillée, Je ne suis point allée après les Baals? Regarde tes pas dans la vallée, Reconnais ce que tu as fait, Dromadaire à la course légère et vagabonde!
verses.am: አንቺስ። አልረከስሁም በአሊምንም አልተከተልሁም እንዴት ትያለሽ? በቈላ ያለውን መንገድሽን ተመልከቺ፥ ያደረግሽውንም እወቂ፤ በመንገድም ላይ እንደ ተለቀቀች እንደ ፈጣን ግመል ሆነሻል፤

verses.en: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.fr: Anesse sauvage, habituée au désert, Haletante dans l''ardeur de sa passion, Qui l''empêchera de satisfaire son désir? Tous ceux qui la cherchent n''ont pas à se fatiguer; Ils la trouvent pendant son mois.
verses.am: በምኞትዋ ነፋስን እንደምታሸትት፥ በምድረ በዳ እንደ ለመደች እንደ ሜዳ አህያ ነሽ፤ ከምኞትዋ የሚመልሳት ማን ነው? የሚሹአት ሁሉ አይደክሙም፥ በወራትዋ ያገኙአታል።

verses.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
verses.fr: Ne t''expose pas à avoir les pieds nus, Ne dessèche pas ton gosier! Mais tu dis: C''est en vain, non! Car j''aime les dieux étrangers, je veux aller après eux.
verses.am: እግርሽን ከሸካራ መንገድ gWroሮሽንም ከውኃ ጥም ከልክዪ፤ አንቺ ግን። እጨክናለሁ፥ እንግዶችን ወድጄአለሁና፥ እከተላቸዋለሁም አልሽ።

verses.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets.
verses.fr: Comme un voleur est confus lorsqu''il est surpris, Ainsi seront confus ceux de la maison d''Israël, Eux, leurs rois, leurs chefs, Leurs sacrificateurs et leurs prophètes.
verses.am: ሌባ በተያዘ ጊዜ እንደሚያፍር እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ቤት፥ እነርሱና ንጉሦቻቸውም አለቆቻቸውም ካህናቶቻቸውም ነቢያቶቻቸውም ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
verses.fr: Ils disent au bois: Tu es mon père! Et à la pierre: Tu m''as donné la vie! Car ils me tournent le dos, ils ne me regardent pas. Et quand ils sont dans le malheur, ils disent: Lève-toi, sauve-nous!
verses.am: ግንዱን።አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤ ድንጋዮንም። አንተ ወለድኸኝ ይላሉ፤ ፊታቸውንም ሳይሆን ጀርባቸውን ሰጡኝ፥ በመከራቸው ጊዜ ግን። ተነሥተህ አድነን ይላሉ።

verses.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.
verses.fr: Où donc sont tes dieux que tu t''es faits? Qu''ils se lèvent, s''ils peuvent te sauver au temps du malheur! Car tu as autant de dieux que de villes, ô Juda!
verses.am: ለአንተ የሠራሃቸው አማልክትህ ወዴት ናቸው? ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ አማልክትህ እንደ ከተሞችህ KWTር እንዲሁ ናቸውና ይነሡ በመከራህም ጊዜ ያድኑህ።

verses.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Pourquoi contesteriez-vous avec moi? Vous m''avez tous été infidèles, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር የምትከራከሩ ለምንድር ነው? ሁላችሁ ዐምፃችሁብኛል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
verses.fr: En vain ai-je frappé vos enfants; Ils n''ont point eu égard à la correction; Votre glaive a dévoré vos prophètes, Comme un lion destructeur.
verses.am: ልጆቻችሁን በከንቱ ቀሥፌአቸዋለሁ፤ ተግሣጽን አልተቀበሉም፤ ሰይፋችሁ እንደሚሰብር አንበሳ ነቢያቶቻችሁን በልቶአል።

verses.en: O generation, see ye the word of the Lord. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
verses.fr: Hommes de cette génération, considérez la parole de l''Eternel! Ai-je été pour Israël un désert, Ou un pays d''épaisses ténèbres? Pourquoi mon peuple dit-il: Nous sommes libres, Nous ne voulons pas retourner à toi?
verses.am: ትውልድ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ተመልከቱ። በውኑ ለእስራኤል ምድረ በዳ ወይስ የጨለመች ምድር ሆንሁባትን? ሕዝቤስ ስለ ምን። እኛ ፈርጥጠናል፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ወደ አንተ አንመለስም ይላል?

verses.en: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.fr: La jeune fille oublie-t-elle ses ornements, La fiancée sa ceinture? Et mon peuple m''a oublié Depuis des jours sans nombre.
verses.am: በውኑ ቆንጆ ጌጥዋን ወይስ ሙሽራ ዝርግፍ ጌጥዋን ትረሳለችን? ሕዝቤ ግን የማይቈጠር ወራት ረስቶኛል።

verses.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
verses.fr: Comme tu es habile dans tes voies pour chercher ce que tu aimes! C''est même au crime que tu les exerces.
verses.am: ፍቅርን ለመሻት መንገድሽን እንዴት ታቀኛለሽ! ስለዚህ ለክፉዎች ሴቶች እንኳ መንገድሽን አስተምረሻል።

verses.en: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
verses.fr: Jusque sur les pans de ton habit se trouve Le sang de pauvres innocents, Que tu n''as pas surpris faisant effraction.
verses.am: በእጆችሽም የንጹሐን ድሆች ደም ተገኝቶአል፤ በእነዚህ ሁሉ ላይ በግልጥ አገኘሁት እንጂ በስውር ፈልጌ አላገኘሁትም።

verses.en: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
verses.fr: Malgré cela, tu dis: Oui, je suis innocente! Certainement sa colère s''est détournée de moi! Voici, je vais contester avec toi, Parce que tu dis: Je n''ai point péché.
verses.am: አንቺ ግን። ንጹሕ ነኝ፤ በእውነት KWTaው ከእኔ ተመልሶአል አልሽ። እነሆ። ኃጢአት አልሠራሁም ብለሻልና በፍርድ እከስስሻለሁ።

verses.en: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
verses.fr: Pourquoi tant d''empressement à changer ton chemin? C''est de l''Egypte que viendra ta honte, Comme elle est venue de l''Assyrie.
verses.am: መንገድሽን ትለውጪ ዘንድ ለምን እጅግ ትሮጫለሽ? አሦር እንዳሳፈረሽ ግብጽ ያሳፍርሻል።

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the Lord hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
verses.fr: De là aussi tu sortiras, les mains sur la tête; Car l''Eternel rejette ceux en qui tu te confies, Et tu ne réussiras pas auprès d''eux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሄር የታመንሽባቸውን ጥሎአልና፥ በእነርሱም አይከናወንልሽምና እጅሽን በራስሽ ላይ አድርገሽ ከዚያ ደግሞ ትወጫለሽ። a

verses.en: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Il dit: Lorsqu''un homme répudie sa femme, Qu''elle le quitte et devient la femme d''un autre, Cet homme retourne-t-il encore vers elle? Le pays même ne serait-il pas souillé? Et toi, tu t''es prostituée à de nombreux amants, Et tu reviendrais à moi! dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሰው ዘንድ። ሰው ሚስቱን ቢፈታ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ ሄዳ ሌላ ወንድ ብታገባ፥ በውኑ ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ትመለሳለችን? ያች ሴት እጅግ የረከሰች አይደለችምን? ይባላል። አንቺ ከብዙ ውሽሞች ጋር አመንዝረሻል፥ ወደ እኔም ትመለሻለሽን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
verses.fr: Lève tes yeux vers les hauteurs, et regarde! Où ne t''es-tu pas prostituée! Tu te tenais sur les chemins, comme l''Arabe dans le désert, Et tu as souillé le pays par tes prostitutions et par ta méchanceté.
verses.am: ዓይንሽን አንሥተሽ ወደ ወናዎች ኮረብቶች ተመልከቺ፤ ያልተጋደምሽበት ስፍራ ወዴት አለ? ዓረባዊ በምድረ በዳ እንደሚቀመጥ አንቺ በመንገድ ላይ ተቀምጠሽ ትጠብቂያቸው ነበር፤ በግልሙትናሽና በኃጢአትሽ ምድሪቱን አረከስሽ።

verses.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.fr: Aussi les pluies ont-elles été retenues, Et la pluie du printemps a-t-elle manqué; Mais tu as eu le front d''une femme prostituée, Tu n''as pas voulu avoir honte.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ካፊያ ተከለከለ፥ የኋለኛውም ዝናብ ጠፋ፤ የጋለሞታም ሴት ፊት ነበረብሽ፥ ታፍሪም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለሻል።

verses.en: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
verses.fr: Maintenant, n''est-ce pas? tu cries vers moi: Mon père! Tu as été l''ami de ma jeunesse!
verses.am: አሁንም። አንተ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የብላቴንነቴ ወዳጅ ነህ ብለሽ አልጮኽሽልኝምን? ለዘላለም ይቈጣልን?

verses.en: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
verses.fr: Gardera-t-il à toujours sa colère? La conservera-t-il à jamais? Et voici, tu as dit, tu as fait des choses criminelles, tu les as consommées.
verses.am: እስከ ፍጻሜስ ድረስ ይጠብቀዋልን? እነሆ፥ እንዲህ ብለሽ ተናገርሽ፥ እንደ ተቻለሽም መጠን ክፉን ነገር አደረግሽ።

verses.en: The Lord said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit, au temps du roi Josias: As-tu vu ce qu''a fait l''infidèle Israël? Elle est allée sur toute montagne élevée et sous tout arbre vert, et là elle s''est prostituée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በንጉሡ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን እንዲህ አለኝ። ከዳተኛይቱ እስራኤል ያደረገችውን አየህን? ወደ ረዘመው ተራራ ሁሉ ከለመለመ ዛፍም ሁሉ በታች ሄደች በዚያም ጋለሞተች።

verses.en: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.fr: Je disais: Après avoir fait toutes ces choses, elle reviendra à moi. Mais elle n''est pas revenue. Et sa soeur, la perfide Juda, en a été témoin.
verses.am: ይህንም ሁሉ ካደረገች በኋላ። ወደ እኔ ትመለሳለች ብዬ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አልተመለሰችም፤ አታላይ እኅትዋም ይሁዳ አየች።

verses.en: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.fr: Quoique j''eusse répudié l''infidèle Israël à cause de tous ses adultères, et que je lui eusse donné sa lettre de divorce, j''ai vu que la perfide Juda, sa soeur, n''a point eu de crainte, et qu''elle est allée se prostituer pareillement.
verses.am: ከዳተኛይቱም እስራኤል ስላመነዘረች ስለዚህ ፈትቻታለሁ የፍችዋንም ወረቀት ሰጥቻታለሁ፤ አታላይ እኅትዋ ይሁዳ ግን እንዳልፈራች እርስዋም ደግሞ ሄዳ እንደ ጋለሞተች አየሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
verses.fr: Par sa criante impudicité Israël a souillé le pays, elle a commis un adultère avec la pierre et le bois.
verses.am: በግልሙትናዋም በመቅለልዋም ምድሪቱ ረከሰች፤ እርስዋም ከድንጋይና ከግንድ ጋር አመነዘረች።

verses.en: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Malgré tout cela, la perfide Juda, sa soeur, n''est pas revenue à moi de tout son coeur; c''est avec fausseté qu''elle l''a fait, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚህም ሁሉ አታላይቱ ይሁዳ በሐሰት እንጂ በፍጹም ልብዋ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሰችም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: L''infidèle Israël paraît innocente En comparaison de la perfide Juda.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ከአታላይቱ ከይሁዳ ይልቅ ከዳተኛይቱ እስራኤል ጸደቀች።

verses.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the Lord; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the Lord, and I will not keep anger for ever.
verses.fr: Va, crie ces paroles vers le septentrion, et dis: Reviens, infidèle Israël! dit l''Eternel. Je ne jetterai pas sur vous un regard sévère; Car je suis miséricordieux, dit l''Eternel, Je ne garde pas ma colère à toujours.
verses.am: ሂድና ይህን ቃል ወደ ሰሜን ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በል። ከዳተናይቱ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ተመለሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ መሐሪ ነኝና፥ ለዘላለምም አልቈጣምና በእናንተ ላይ ፊቴን አላደርግም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the Lord thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Reconnais seulement ton iniquité, Reconnais que tu as été infidèle à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Que tu as dirigé çà et là tes pas vers les dieux étrangers, Sous tout arbre vert, Et que tu n''as pas écouté ma voix, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በአምላክሽ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ እንዳመፅሽ፥ መንገድሽንም ከለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ለእንግዶች እንደ ዘረጋሽ፥ ቃሌንም እንዳልሰማሽ ኃጢአትሽን ብቻ እወቂ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the Lord; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
verses.fr: Revenez, enfants rebelles, dit l''Eternel; Car je suis votre maître. Je vous prendrai, un d''une ville, deux d''une famille, Et je vous ramènerai dans Sion.
verses.am: ከዳተኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ እኔ ባላችሁ ነኝና ተመለሱ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንዱንም ከአንዲት ከተማ ሁለቱንም ከአንድ ወገን እወስዳችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ጽዮንም አመጣችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.fr: Je vous donnerai des bergers selon mon coeur, Et ils vous paîtront avec intelligence et avec sagesse.
verses.am: እንደ ልቤም በግ ጠባቆችን እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ በእውቀትና በማስተዋልም ይጠብቁአችኋል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the Lord, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the Lord: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
verses.fr: Lorsque vous aurez multiplié et fructifié dans le pays, En ces jours-là, dit l''Eternel, On ne parlera plus de l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel; Elle ne viendra plus à la pensée; On ne se la rappellera plus, on ne s''apercevra plus de son absence, Et l''on n''en fera point une autre.
verses.am: በበዛችሁም ጊዜ በምድርም ላይ በረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያ ዘመን። የእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ብለው ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይጠሩም፤ ልብ አያደርጉትም፥ አያስቡትምም፥ አይሹትምም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም አይደረግም።

verses.en: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the Lord, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, on appellera Jérusalem le trône de l''Eternel; Toutes les nations s''assembleront à Jérusalem, au nom de l''Eternel, Et elles ne suivront plus les penchants de leur mauvais coeur.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ኢየሩሳሌምን የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ብለው ይጠሩአታል፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ወደ እርስዋ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ክፉውን እልከኛ ልባቸውን ተከትለው አይሄዱም።

verses.en: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
verses.fr: En ces jours, La maison de Juda marchera avec la maison d''Israël; Elles viendront ensemble du pays du septentrion Au pays dont j''ai donné la possession à vos pères.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን የይሁዳ ቤት ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ይሄዳል፤ በአንድም ሆነው ከሰሜን ምድር ርስት አድርጌ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
verses.fr: Je disais: Comment te mettrai-je parmi mes enfants, Et te donnerai-je un pays de délices, Un héritage, le plus bel ornement des nations? Je disais: Tu m''appelleras: Mon père! Et tu ne te détourneras pas de moi.
verses.am: እኔ ግን። ከወንዶች ልጆች ጋር እንዴት አደርግሻለሁ? ያማረችውንስ ምድር የከበረችውን የአሕዛብን ሠራዊት ርስት እንዴት እሰጥሻለሁ? ብዬ ነበር። ደግሞ። አባቴ ብለሽ ትጠሪኛለሽ እኔንም ከመከተል አትመለሽም ብዬ ነበር።

verses.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais, comme une femme est infidèle à son amant, Ainsi vous m''avez été infidèles, maison d''Israël, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ሚስት ባልዋን እንደምታታታልል እንዲሁ አታለላችሁኝ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.fr: Une voix se fait entendre sur les lieux élevés; Ce sont les pleurs, les supplications des enfants d''Israël; Car ils ont perverti leur voie, Ils ont oublié l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች መንገዳቸውን አጣምመዋልና፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ረስተዋልና በወናዎች ኮረብቶች ላይ የልመናቸውና ልቅሶአቸው ድምፅ ተሰማ።

verses.en: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Revenez, enfants rebelles, Je pardonnerai vos infidélités. -Nous voici, nous allons à toi, Car tu es l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: ከዳተኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ፥ ከዳተኛነታችሁንም እፈውሳለሁ። እነሆ፥ አንተ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነህና ወደ አንተ እንመጣለን።

verses.en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.fr: Oui, le bruit qui vient des collines et des montagnes n''est que mensonge; Oui, c''est en l''Eternel, notre Dieu, qu''est le salut d''Israël.
verses.am: በእውነት የኮረብቶችና የተራሮች ፍጅት ከንቱ ናት፤ በእውነት የእስራኤል መዳን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.fr: Les idoles ont dévoré le produit du travail de nos pères, Dès notre jeunesse, Leurs brebis et leurs boeufs, leurs fils et leurs filles.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከትንሽነታችን ጀምሮ የአባቶቻችን ድካም፥ በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም፥ እፍረት በልቶባቸዋል።

verses.en: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Nous avons notre honte pour couche, Et notre ignominie pour couverture; Car nous avons péché contre l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Nous et nos pères, dès notre jeunesse jusqu''à ce jour, Et nous n''avons pas écouté la voix de l''Eternel, notre Dieu. -
verses.am: ከትንሽነታችን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እኛና አባቶቻችን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና፥ የአምላካችንንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማንምና በእፍረታችን እንጋደም፥ ውርደታችንም ይክደነን።

verses.en: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the Lord, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
verses.fr: Israël, si tu reviens, si tu reviens à moi, dit l''Eternel, Si tu ôtes tes abominations de devant moi, Tu ne seras plus errant.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ብትመለስ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመለስ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ርkWsvትህንም ከፊቴ ብታስወግድ፥ ባትናወጥም፥

verses.en: And thou shalt swear, The Lord liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
verses.fr: Si tu jures: L''Eternel est vivant! Avec vérité, avec droiture et avec justice, Alors les nations seront bénies en lui, Et se glorifieront en lui.
verses.am: ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብለህም በእውነትና በቅንነት በጽድቅም ብትምል፥ አሕዛብ በእርሱ ይባረካሉ በእርሱም ይመካሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel aux hommes de Juda et de Jérusalem: Défrichez-vous un champ nouveau, Et ne semez pas parmi les épines.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለይሁዳና ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላልና። ጥጋቱን እርሻ እረሱ በእሾህም ላይ አትዝሩ።

verses.en: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.fr: Circoncisez-vous pour l''Eternel, circoncisez vos coeurs, Hommes de Juda et habitants de Jérusalem, De peur que ma colère n''éclate comme un feu, Et ne s''enflamme, sans qu''on puisse l''éteindre, A cause de la méchanceté de vos actions.
verses.am: እናንተም የይሁዳ ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ስለ ሥራችሁ ክፋት KWTaዬ እንደ እሳት እንዳይወጣ የሚያጠፋውም ሳይኖር እንዳያቃጥል፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገረዙ፥ የልባችሁንም ሸለፈት አስወግዱ።

verses.en: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
verses.fr: Annoncez en Juda, publiez à Jérusalem, Et dites: Sonnez de la trompette dans le pays! Criez à pleine voix, et dites: Rassemblez-vous, et allons dans les villes fortes!
verses.am: በይሁዳ ዘንድ ተናገሩ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ አውሩና። በአገሪቱ ላይ መለከት ንፉ በሉ፤ ጮኻችሁም። ሁላችሁ ተሰብሰቡ ወደ ተመሸጉትም ከተሞች እንግባ በሉ።

verses.en: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.fr: Elevez une bannière vers Sion, Fuyez, ne vous arrêtez pas! Car je fais venir du septentrion le malheur Et un grand désastre.
verses.am: ከሰሜን ክፉ ነገርንና ጽኑ ጥፋትን አመጣለሁና ወደ ጽዮን ዓላማን አንሡ፤ ሽሹ፥ አትዘግዩ።

verses.en: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.fr: Le lion s''élance de son taillis, Le destructeur des nations est en marche, il a quitté son lieu, Pour ravager ton pays; Tes villes seront ruinées, il n''y aura plus d''habitants.
verses.am: አንበሳ ከጭፍቅ ዱር ወጥቶአል፥ አሕዛብንም የሚዘርፍ ተነሥቶአል፤ ምድርሽን ባድማ ያደርግ ዘንድ ከስፍራው ወጥቶአል፥ ከተሞችሽም ሰው የሌለባቸው ፍርስራሾች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the Lord is not turned back from us.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi couvrez-vous de sacs, pleurez et gémissez; Car la colère ardente de l''Eternel ne se détourne pas de nous.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ KWTa ከእኛ ዘንድ አልተመለሰምና ማቅ ልበሱ፥ አልቅሱም ዋይም በሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the Lord, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel, Le roi et les chefs perdront courage, Les sacrificateurs seront étonnés, Et les prophètes stupéfaits.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የንጉሡና የመኳንንቱ ልብ ይጠፋል፥ ካህናቱም ይደነቃሉ ነቢያቱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
verses.fr: Je dis: Ah! Seigneur Eternel! Tu as donc trompé ce peuple et Jérusalem, en disant: Vous aurez la paix! Et cependant l''épée menace leur vie.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ፥ አንተ ሰይፍ እስከ ነፍስ ድረስ በደረሰ ጊዜ። ሰላም ይሆንላችኋል ብለህ ይህን ሕዝብና ኢየሩሳሌምን እጅግ አታለልህ አልሁ።

verses.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, il sera dit à ce peuple et à Jérusalem: Un vent brûlant souffle des lieux élevés du désert Sur le chemin de la fille de mon peuple, Non pour vanner ni pour nettoyer le grain.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ ለዚህ ሕዝብና ለኢየሩሳሌም። ለማበጠር ወይም ለማጥራት ሳይሆን የሚያቃጥል ነፋስ በምድረ በዳ ካሉ ከወናዎች ኮረብቶች ወደ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ይመጣል፤

verses.en: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
verses.fr: C''est un vent impétueux qui vient de là jusqu''à moi. Maintenant, je prononcerai leur sentence.
verses.am: ስለ እኔ ጽኑ የሆነ ነፋስ ከእነዚህ ይመጣል ይባላል። አሁንም እኔ ደግሞ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
verses.fr: Voici, le destructeur s''avance comme les nuées; Ses chars sont comme un tourbillon, Ses chevaux sont plus légers que les aigles. -Malheur à nous, car nous sommes détruits! -
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ ደመና ይወጣል፥ ሰረገሎቹም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ፤ ፈረሶቹም ከንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ናቸው። ጠፍተናልና ወዮልን።

verses.en: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
verses.fr: Purifie ton coeur du mal, Jérusalem, Afin que tu sois sauvée! Jusques à quand garderas-tu dans ton coeur tes pensées iniques?
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ትድኚ ዘንድ ልብሽን ከክፉ ነገር እጠቢ። ክፉ አሳብ የሚኖርብሽ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?

verses.en: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
verses.fr: Car une voix qui part de Dan annonce la calamité, Elle la publie depuis la montagne d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: የተናጋሪ ድምፅ ከዳን ዘንድ ይናገራልና፥ ከኤፍሬምም ኮረብቶች መከራን ያወራልና።

verses.en: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
verses.fr: Dites-le aux nations, faites-le connaître à Jérusalem: Des assiégeants viennent d''une terre lointaine; Ils poussent des cris contre les villes de Juda.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብ አሰሙና። እነሆ፥ ጠባቂዎች ከሩቅ አገር ይመጣሉ፤ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ላይ ይጮኻሉ ብላችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አውሩ።

verses.en: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Comme ceux qui gardent un champ, ils entourent Jérusalem, Car elle s''est révoltée contre moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ዓመፀኛ ሆናለችና በዙሪያዋ ከብበው እንደ እርሻ ጠባቂዎች ሆነውባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
verses.fr: C''est là le produit de tes voies et de tes actions, C''est là le produit de ta méchanceté; Certes cela est amer, cela pénètre jusqu''à ton coeur.
verses.am: መንገድሽና ሥራሽ ይህን አድርጎብሻል፤ ይህ ክፋትሽ መራር ነው፥ ወደ ልብሽም ደርሶአል።

verses.en: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.fr: Mes entrailles! mes entrailles: je souffre au dedans de mon coeur, Le coeur me bat, je ne puis me taire; Car tu entends, mon âme, le son de la trompette, Le cri de guerre.
verses.am: አንጀቴ! አንጀቴ! ልቤ በጣም ታምሞአል፥ በውስጤም ልቤ ታውኮብኛል፤ ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ የመለከትን ድምፅና የሰልፍን ውካታ ሰምተሻልና ዝም እል ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.en: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
verses.fr: On annonce ruine sur ruine, Car tout le pays est ravagé; Mes tentes sont ravagées tout à coup, Mes pavillons en un instant.
verses.am: መከራ በመከራ ላይ ተጠርቶአል፤ ምድርም ሁሉ ተበዝብዛለችና፤ በድንገትም ድንኳኔ በቅጽበት ዓይንም መጋረጃዎቼ ጠፉ።

verses.en: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.fr: Jusques à quand verrai-je la bannière, Et entendrai-je le son de la trompette? -
verses.am: ዓላማውን የምመለከት፥ የመለከቱንስ ድምፅ የምሰማ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.fr: Certainement mon peuple est fou, il ne me connaît pas; Ce sont des enfants insensés, dépourvus d''intelligence; Ils sont habiles pour faire le mal, Mais ils ne savent pas faire le bien. -
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሰንፈዋልና አላወቁኝም፤ ሰነፎች ልጆች ናቸው፥ ማስተዋልም የላቸውም፤ ክፉ ነገርን ለማድረግ ብልሃተኞች ናቸው፥ በጎ ነገርን ማድረግ ግን አያውቁም።

verses.en: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.fr: Je regarde la terre, et voici, elle est informe et vide; Les cieux, et leur lumière a disparu.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ባዶ ነበረች አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ሰማያትንም አየሁ፥ ብርሃንም አልነበረባቸውም።

verses.en: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.fr: Je regarde les montagnes, et voici, elles sont ébranlées; Et toutes les collines chancellent.
verses.am: ተራሮችን አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ተንቀጠቀጡ፥ ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ተናወጡ።

verses.en: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.fr: Je regarde, et voici, il n''y a point d''homme; Et tous les oiseaux des cieux ont pris la fuite.
verses.am: አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሰው አልነበረም፥ የሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ ሸሽተው ነበር።

verses.en: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the Lord, and by his fierce anger.
verses.fr: Je regarde, et voici, le Carmel est un désert; Et toutes ses villes sont détruites, devant l''Eternel, Devant son ardente colère.
verses.am: አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ፍሬያማ እርሻ ምድረ በዳ ሆነች፥ ከተሞችም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከጽኑ KWTaው የተነሣ ፈርሰው ነበር።

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Tout le pays sera dévasté; Mais je ne ferai pas une entière destruction.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ምድር ሁሉ ባድማ ትሆናለች፥ ነገር ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋትም።

verses.en: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black; because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.fr: A cause de cela, le pays est en deuil, Et les cieux en haut sont obscurcis; Car je l''ai dit, je l''ai résolu, Et je ne m''en repens pas, je ne me rétracterai pas.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምድር ታለቅሳለች፥ በላይም ሰማይ ይጠKWraል፤ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ አስቤአለሁም፤ አልጸጸትም ከእርሱም አልመለስም።

verses.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.fr: Au bruit des cavaliers et des archers, toutes les villes sont en fuite; On entre dans les bois, on monte sur les rochers; Toutes les villes sont abandonnées, il n''y a plus d''habitants.
verses.am: ከፈረሰኞችና ከቀስተኞች ድምፅ የተነሣ ከተማ ሁሉ ሸሽታለች፤ ወደ ችፍግ ዱርም ይገባሉ በቋጥኝ ላይም ይወጣሉ፤ ከተማ ሁሉ ተለቅቃለች የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው የለም።

verses.en: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
verses.fr: Et toi, dévastée, que vas-tu faire? Tu te revêtiras de cramoisi, tu te pareras d''ornements d''or, Tu mettras du fard à tes yeux; Mais c''est en vain que tu t''embelliras; Tes amants te méprisent, Ils en veulent à ta vie.
verses.am: አንቺም የተበዘበዝሽ ሆይ፥ ምን ታደርጊአለሽ? ቀይ በለበስሽ ጊዜ፥ በወርቅ አንባርም ባጌጥሽ ጊዜ፥ ዓይንሽንም በkWl በተኳልሽ ጊዜ፥ በከንቱ ታጌጫለሽ፤ ውሽሞችሽ አቃለሉሽ፥ ነፍስሽን ይሹአታል።

verses.en: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.fr: Car j''entends des cris comme ceux d''une femme en travail, Des cris d''angoisse comme dans un premier enfantement. C''est la voix de la fille de Sion; elle soupire, elle étend les mains: Malheureuse que je suis! je succombe sous les meurtriers!
verses.am: እንደምታምጥ የበkWrዋንም እንደምትወልድ ሴት ድምፅ ሰምቻለሁና፤ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ድምፅ በድካም ይሰልላል፥ እጆችዋንም ትዘረጋለችና። ተገድለው ከሞቱት የተነሣ ነፍሴ ዝላለችና ወዮልኝ! አለች።

verses.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.fr: Parcourez les rues de Jérusalem, Regardez, informez-vous, cherchez dans les places, S''il s''y trouve un homme, s''il y en a un Qui pratique la justice, qui s''attache à la vérité, Et je pardonne à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም መንገድ እየተመላለሳችሁ ሩጡ፥ ተመልከቱም፥ እወቁም፥ በአደባባይዋም ፈልጉ፤ ፍርድን የሚያደርገውን እውነትንም የሚሻውን ሰው ታገኙ እንደሆነ ይቅር እላታለሁ።

verses.en: And though they say, The Lord liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.fr: Même quand ils disent: L''Eternel est vivant! C''est faussement qu''ils jurent.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ቢሉ የሚምሉት በሐሰት ነው።

verses.en: O Lord, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.fr: Eternel, tes yeux n''aperçoivent-ils pas la vérité? Tu les frappes, et ils ne sentent rien; Tu les consumes, et ils ne veulent pas recevoir instruction; Ils prennent un visage plus dur que le roc, Ils refusent de se convertir.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዓይንህ እውነትን የምትመለከት አይደለችምን? አንተ ቀሥፈሃቸዋል ነገር ግን አላዘኑም፥ ቀጥቅጠሃቸውማል ነገር ግን ተግሣጽን እንቢ አሉ፤ ፊታቸውን ከድንጋይ ይልቅ አጠንክረዋል፤ ይመለሱ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

verses.en: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the Lord, nor the judgment of their God.
verses.fr: Je disais: Ce ne sont que les petits; Ils agissent en insensés, parce qu''ils ne connaissent pas la voie de l''Eternel, La loi de leur Dieu.
verses.am: እኔም። የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድና የአምላካቸውን ሕግ አላወቁምና እነዚህ በእውነት ድሆችና ሰነፎች ናቸው፤

verses.en: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the Lord, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.fr: J''irai vers les grands, et je leur parlerai; Car eux, ils connaissent la voie de l''Eternel, La loi de leur Dieu; Mais ils ont tous aussi brisé le joug, Rompu les liens.
verses.am: ወደ ታላላቆቹ እሄዳለሁ እናገራቸውማለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገንድና የአምላካቸውን ሕግ ያውቃሉና አልሁ። እነዚህ ግን ቀንበሩን በአንድነት ሰብረዋል፥ እስራቱንም ቈርጠዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi le lion de la forêt les tue, Le loup du désert les détruit, La panthère est aux aguets devant leurs villes; Tous ceux qui en sortiront seront déchirés; Car leurs transgressions sont nombreuses, Leurs infidélités se sont multipliées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኃጢአታቸው በዝቶአልና፥ የክዳታቸውም ብዛት ጸንቶአልና ስለዚህ አንበሳ ከዱር ወጥቶ ይሰብራቸዋል፥ የበረሀም ተkWla ያጠፋቸዋል፥ ነብርም በከተሞቻቸው ላይ ይተጋል፥ ከዚያም የሚወጣ ሁሉ ይነጠቃል።

verses.en: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
verses.fr: Pourquoi te pardonnerais-je? Tes enfants m''ont abandonné, Et ils jurent par des dieux qui n''existent pas. J''ai reçu leurs serments, et ils se livrent à l''adultère, Ils sont en foule dans la maison de la prostituée.
verses.am: በእነዚህ ነገሮች ይቅር የምልሽ እንዴት አድርጌ ነው? ልጆችሽ ትተውኛል አማልክትም ባልሆኑ ምለዋል፤ ካጠገብኋቸውም በኋላ አመነዘሩ በጋለሞቶቹም ቤት ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
verses.fr: Semblables à des chevaux bien nourris, qui courent çà et là, Ils hennissent chacun après la femme de son prochain.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀለቡ ፈረሶች ሆኑ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም ከባልንጀሮቻቸው ሚስቶች ኋላ አሽካኩ።

verses.en: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.fr: Ne châtierais-je pas ces choses-là, dit l''Eternel, Ne me vengerais-je pas d''une pareille nation?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.en: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the Lord's.
verses.fr: Montez sur ses murailles, et abattez, Mais ne détruisez pas entièrement! Enlevez ses ceps Qui n''appartiennent point à l''Eternel!
verses.am: ወደ ቅጥርዋ ወጥታችሁ አፍርሱ፥ ነገር ግን ፈጽማችሁ አታጥፉ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር አይደሉምና ቅርንጫፍዋን ውሰዱ።

verses.en: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Car la maison d''Israël et la maison de Juda m''ont été infidèles, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤትና የይሁዳ ቤት በእኔ ላይ እጅግ ወንጅለዋል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: They have belied the Lord, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.fr: Ils renient l''Eternel, ils disent: Il n''existe pas! Et le malheur ne viendra pas sur nous, Nous ne verrons ni l''épée ni la famine.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እርሱ አይደለም፥ ክፉ ነገርም አይመጣብንም ሰይፍንና ራብንም አናይም፤ ነቢያትም ነፋስ ይሆናሉ፥

verses.en: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.fr: Les prophètes ne sont que du vent, Et personne ne parle en eux. Qu''il leur soit fait ainsi!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ የለም፥ እንዲህም ይደረግባቸዋል ብለው እግዚአብሔርን ክደዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées: Parce que vous avez dit cela, Voici, je veux que ma parole dans ta bouche soit du feu, Et ce peuple du bois, et que ce feu les consume.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ቃል ተናግራችኋልና እነሆ፥ በአፍህ ውስጥ ቃሌን እሳት ይህንም ሕዝብ እንጨት አደርጋለሁ፥ ትበላቸውማለች።

verses.en: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the Lord: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.fr: Voici, je fais venir de loin une nation contre vous, maison d''Israël, Dit l''Eternel; C''est une nation forte, c''est une nation ancienne, Une nation dont tu ne connais pas la langue, Et dont tu ne comprendras point les paroles.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሕዝብን ከሩቅ አመጣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ኃያል ጥንታዊ ሕዝብ ነው፥ ቋንቋቸውንም የማታውቀው የሚናገሩትንም የማታስተውለው ሕዝብ ነው።

verses.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.fr: Son carquois est comme un sépulcre ouvert; Ils sont tous des héros.
verses.am: የፍላጻቸውም ሰገባ እንደ ተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ ሁሉም ኃያላን ናቸው።

verses.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.fr: Elle dévorera ta moisson et ton pain, Elle dévorera tes fils et tes filles, Elle dévorera tes brebis et tes boeufs, Elle dévorera ta vigne et ton figuier; Elle détruira par l''épée tes villes fortes dans lesquelles tu te confies.
verses.am: መከርህንና እንጀራህን ይበላሉ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህንም ይበሉአቸዋል፤ በጎችህንና ላሞችህንም ይበላሉ፤ ወይንህንና በለስህንም ይበላሉ፤ የምትታመናቸውን የተመሸጉ ከተሞችን በሰይፍ ይደበድባሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless in those days, saith the Lord, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.fr: Mais en ces jours, dit l''Eternel, Je ne vous détruirai pas entièrement.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዚያ ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ፈጽሜ አላጠፋችሁም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the Lord our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not your's.
verses.fr: Si vous dites alors: Pourquoi l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous fait-il tout cela? Tu leur répondras: Comme vous m''avez abandonné, Et que vous avez servi des dieux étrangers dans votre pays, Ainsi vous servirez des étrangers dans un pays qui n''est pas le vôtre.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ስለምን አደረገብን? ብትሉ፥ አንተ። እንደ ተዋችሁኝ በአገራችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት እንዳመለካችሁ፥ እንዲሁ ለእናንተ ባልሆነ አገር ለሌሎች ሰዎች ትገዛላችሁ ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.fr: Annoncez ceci à la maison de Jacob, Publiez-le en Juda, et dites:
verses.am: ይህን በያዕቆብ ቤት አውሩ፥ በይሁዳም አሰሙ።

verses.en: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.fr: Ecoutez ceci, peuple insensé, et qui n''as point de coeur! Ils ont des yeux et ne voient point, Ils ont des oreilles et n''entendent point.
verses.am: እናንተ ሰነፎች ልበ ቢሶች፥ ዓይን እያላችሁ የማታዩ፥ ጆሮም እያላችሁ የማትሰሙ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.en: Fear ye not me? saith the Lord: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.fr: Ne me craindrez-vous pas, dit l''Eternel, Ne tremblerez-vous pas devant moi? C''est moi qui ai donné à la mer le sable pour limite, Limite éternelle qu''elle ne doit pas franchir; Ses flots s''agitent, mais ils sont impuissants; Ils mugissent, mais ils ne la franchissent pas.
verses.am: በውኑ እኔን አትፈሩምን? ከፊቴስ አትደነግጡምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እንዳያልፍ አሸዋን በዘላለም ትእዛዝ ለባሕር ዳርቻ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ሞገዱም ቢናወጥ አያሸንፍም፥ ቢጮኽም አያልፍበትም።

verses.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.fr: Ce peuple a un coeur indocile et rebelle; Ils se révoltent, et s''en vont.
verses.am: ለዚህ ሕዝብ ግን የሸፈተና ያመፀ ልብ አላቸው፤ ዐምፀዋል ሄደውማል።

verses.en: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the Lord our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.fr: Ils ne disent pas dans leur coeur: Craignons l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Qui donne la pluie en son temps, La pluie de la première et de l''arrière saison, Et qui nous réserve les semaines destinées à la moisson.
verses.am: በልባቸውም። የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን ዝናብ በጊዜው የሚሰጠውን፥ ለመከርም የተመደቡትን ወራት የሚጠብቅልንን አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንፍራ አላሉም።

verses.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
verses.fr: C''est à cause de vos iniquités que ces dispensations n''ont pas lieu, Ce sont vos péchés qui vous privent de ces biens.
verses.am: በደላችሁ እነዚህን አስቀርታለች፥ ኃጢአታችሁም መልካምን ነገር ከለከለቻችሁ።

verses.en: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.fr: Car il se trouve parmi mon peuple des méchants; Ils épient comme l''oiseleur qui dresse des pièges, Ils tendent des filets, et prennent des hommes.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ መካከል ክፉዎች ሰዎች ተገኝተዋል፤ እንደ አጥማጆችም ያደባሉ፥ ወጥመድንም ይዘረጋሉ ሰዎችንም ያጠምዳሉ።

verses.en: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.fr: Comme une cage est remplie d''oiseaux, Leurs maisons sont remplies de fraude; C''est ainsi qu''ils deviennent puissants et riches.
verses.am: ቀፎ ወፎችን እንደሚሞላ፥ እንዲሁ ቤታቸው ሽንገላን ሞልታለች፤እንዲሁም ከብረዋል ባለ ጠጎችም ሆነዋል።

verses.en: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.fr: Ils s''engraissent, ils sont brillants d''embonpoint; Ils dépassent toute mesure dans le mal, Ils ne défendent pas la cause, la cause de l''orphelin, et ils prospèrent; Ils ne font pas droit aux indigents.
verses.am: ወፍረዋል ሰብተውማል፥ ክፋታቸውንም ያለ ልክ አብዝተዋል፤ የድሀ አደጎች ነገር መልካም እንዲሆን አልተምዋገቱላቸውም፥ የችግረኞችንም ፍርድ አልፈረዱላቸውም።

verses.en: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.fr: Ne châtierais-je pas ces choses-là, dit l''Eternel, Ne me vengerais-je pas d''une pareille nation?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.fr: Des choses horribles, abominables, Se font dans le pays.
verses.am: የምታስደንቅና የምታስደነግጥ ነገር በምድር ላይ ሆናለች፤

verses.en: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.fr: Les prophètes prophétisent avec fausseté, Les sacrificateurs dominent sous leur conduite, Et mon peuple prend plaisir à cela. Que ferez-vous à la fin?
verses.am: ነቢያት በሐሰት ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ካህናትም በእነዚህ እጅ ይገዛሉ፥ ሕዝቤም እንዲህ ያለውን ነገር ይወድዳሉ፤ በፍጻሜውስ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.en: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.fr: Fuyez, enfants de Benjamin, du milieu de Jérusalem, Sonnez de la trompette à Tekoa, Elevez un signal à Beth-Hakkérem! Car on voit venir du septentrion le malheur Et un grand désastre.
verses.am: እናንተ የብንያም ልጆች፥ ክፉ ነገር ታላቅም ጥፋት ከሰሜን ይጐበኛልና ከኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ በቴቁሔ መለከቱን ንፉ፥ በቤትሐካሪም ላይ ምልክት አንሡ።

verses.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
verses.fr: La belle et la délicate, Je la détruis, la fille de Sion!
verses.am: የተዋበችውንና የተሰባቀለችውን የጽዮንን ልጅ አጐሰቍላለሁ።

verses.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.fr: Vers elle marchent des bergers avec leurs troupeaux; Ils dressent des tentes autour d''elle, Ils broutent chacun sa part. -
verses.am: እረኞችና መንጐቻቸው ወደ እርስዋ ይመጣሉ፥ በዙሪያዋም ድንኳኖቻቸውን ይተክሉባታል፥ እያንዳንዱም በስፍራው መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.en: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.fr: Préparez-vous à l''attaquer! Allons! montons en plein midi!... Malheureusement pour nous, le jour baisse, Les ombres du soir s''allongent.
verses.am: በእርስዋ ላይ ሰልፍ አዘጋጁ ተነሡ፥ በቀትርም እንውጣ። ቀኑ መሽቶአልና፥ የማታውም ጥላ ረዝሞአልና ወዮልን።

verses.en: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.fr: Allons! montons de nuit! Détruisons ses palais! -
verses.am: ተነሡ በሌሊትም እንውጣ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም እናፍርስ።

verses.en: For thus hath the Lord of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Abattez les arbres, Elevez des terrasses contre Jérusalem! C''est la ville qui doit être châtiée; Il n''y a qu''oppression au milieu d''elle.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ዛፎችዋን ቍረጡ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ አፈርን ደልድሉ፤ ይህች ከተማ የምትቀሠፍ ናት፤ መካከልዋ ሁሉ ግፍ ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
verses.fr: Comme un puits fait jaillir ses eaux, Ainsi elle fait jaillir sa méchanceté; Il n''est bruit en son sein que de violence et de ruine; Sans cesse à mes regards s''offrent la douleur et les plaies.
verses.am: በጕድጓድ ውኃ እንደሚፈልቅ፥ እንዲሁ ክፋትዋ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ይፈልቃል፤ ግፍና ቅሚያ በእርስዋ ዘንድ ይሰማል፥ ደዌና ቍስልም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አለ።

verses.en: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.fr: Reçois instruction, Jérusalem, De peur que je ne m''éloigne de toi, Que je ne fasse de toi un désert, Un pays inhabité!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ነፍሴ ከአንቺ እንዳትለይ፥ አንቺንም ባድማና ወና እንዳላደርግሽ፥ ተግሣጽን ተቀበዪ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: On grappillera comme une vigne les restes d''Israël. Portes-y de nouveau la main, Comme le vendangeur sur les ceps.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰው ወይኑን እንደሚቃርም፥ እንዲሁ ከእስራኤል የቀሩትን ፈጽሞ ይቃርሙአቸዋል፤ እጅህንም እንደ ለቃሚ ወደ እንቅብ ዘርጋ።

verses.en: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the Lord is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.fr: A qui m''adresser, et qui prendre à témoin pour qu''on écoute? Voici, leur oreille est incirconcise, Et ils sont incapables d''être attentifs; Voici, la parole de l''Eternel est pour eux un opprobre, Ils n''y trouvent aucun plaisir.
verses.am: ይሰሙኝስ ዘንድ ለማን እናገራለሁ? ለማንስ አስጠነቅቃለሁ? እነሆ፥ ጆሮአቸው ያልተገረዘች ናት ለመስማትም አይችሉም፤ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ለስድብ ሆኖባቸዋል፥ ደስም አያሰኛቸውም።

verses.en: Therefore I am full of the fury of the Lord; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.fr: Je suis plein de la fureur de l''Eternel, je ne puis la contenir. Répands-la sur l''enfant dans la rue, Et sur les assemblées des jeunes gens. Car l''homme et la femme seront pris, Le vieillard et celui qui est chargé de jours.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ተሞልቻለሁ፤ ከመታገሥ ደክሜአለሁ፤ በሜዳ በሕፃናት ላይ በጕልማሶችም ጉባዔ ላይ በአንድነት አፍስሰው፤ ባል ከሚስቱ ጋር ሽማግሌውም ከጎበዙ ጋር ይያያዛልና።

verses.en: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Leurs maisons passeront à d''autres, Les champs et les femmes aussi, Quand j''étendrai ma main sur les habitants du pays, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እጄን በምድር በሚኖሩ ላይ እዘረጋለሁና ቤቶቻቸው እርሻዎቻቸውም ሴቶቻቸውም በአንድነት ለሌሎች ይሆናሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.fr: Car depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand, Tous sont avides de gain; Depuis le prophète jusqu''au sacrificateur, Tous usent de tromperie.
verses.am: ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ስስትን ያስባሉና፥ ከነቢዩም ጀምሮ እስከ ካህኑ ድረስ ሁሉ በተንኰል ያደርጋሉና።

verses.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.fr: Ils pansent à la légère la plaie de la fille de mon peuple: Paix! paix! disent-ils; Et il n''y a point de paix;
verses.am: የሕዝቤንም ስብራት በጥቂቱ ይፈውሳሉ፤ ሰላም ሳይሆን። ሰላም ሰላም ይላሉ።

verses.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils seront confus, car ils commettent des abominations; Ils ne rougissent pas, ils ne connaissent pas la honte; C''est pourquoi ils tomberont avec ceux qui tombent, Ils seront renversés quand je les châtierai, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ርኩስን ነገር ስለ ሠሩ አፍረዋልን? ምንም አላፈሩም፥ እፍረትንም አላወቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከሚወድቁ ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ በጐበኘኋቸው ጊዜ ይዋረዳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Placez-vous sur les chemins, regardez, Et demandez quels sont les anciens sentiers, Quelle est la bonne voie; marchez-y, Et vous trouverez le repos de vos âmes! Mais ils répondent: Nous n''y marcherons pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመንገድ ላይ ቁሙ ተመልከቱም፥ የቀደመችውንም መንገድ ጠይቁ፤ መልካሚቱ መንገድ ወዴት እንደ ሆነች እወቁ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ሂዱ፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን። አንሄድባትም አሉ።

verses.en: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.fr: J''ai mis près de vous des sentinelles: Soyez attentifs au son de la trompette! Mais ils répondent: Nous n''y serons pas attentifs.
verses.am: እኔም። የመለከቱን ድምፅ አድምጡ ብዬ ጠባቆችን ሾምሁባችሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን። አናደምጥም አሉ።

verses.en: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi écoutez, nations! Sachez ce qui leur arrivera, assemblée des peuples!
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ስሙ፤ ማኅበር ሆይ፥ እነዚያ የሚያገኛቸውን እወቁ።

verses.en: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.fr: Ecoute, terre! Voici, je fais venir sur ce peuple le malheur, Fruit de ses pensées; Car ils n''ont point été attentifs à mes paroles, Ils ont méprisé ma loi.
verses.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ ስሚ፤ እነሆ፥ ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ሕጌንም ስለ ጣሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ የአሳባቸውን ፍሬ ክፉን ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.fr: Qu''ai-je besoin de l''encens qui vient de Séba, Du roseau aromatique d''un pays lointain? Vos holocaustes ne me plaisent point, Et vos sacrifices ne me sont point agréables.
verses.am: ስለ ምንስ ከሳባ ዕጣንን፥ ከሩቅም አገር ቀረፋን ታቀርቡልኛላችሁ? የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን አልቀበለውም ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je mettrai devant ce peuple des pierres d''achoppement, Contre lesquelles se heurteront ensemble pères et fils, Voisins et amis, et ils périront.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት ዕንቅፋቶችን አደርጋለሁ፤ አባቶችና ልጆች በአንድነት ይሰናከሉባቸዋል፥ ጎረቤትና ባልንጀራም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, un peuple vient du pays du septentrion, Une grande nation se lève des extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን አገር ይመጣል፥ ታላቅ ሕዝብም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣል።

verses.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.fr: Ils portent l''arc et le javelot; Ils sont cruels, sans miséricorde; Leur voix mugit comme la mer; Ils sont montés sur des chevaux, Prêts à combattre comme un seul homme, Contre toi, fille de Sion!
verses.am: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው፥ ምሕረትንም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል፥ በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.fr: Au bruit de leur approche, Nos mains s''affaiblissent, L''angoisse nous saisit, Comme la douleur d''une femme qui accouche.
verses.am: ወሬውን ሰምተናል፥ እጃችን ደክማለች፤ ምጥ ወላድን ሴት እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞናል።

verses.en: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
verses.fr: Ne sortez pas dans les champs, N''allez pas sur les chemins; Car là est le glaive de l''ennemi, Et l''épouvante règne à l''entour!
verses.am: የጠላት ሰይፍና ድንጋጤ ከብበዋችኋልና ወደ ሜዳ አትውጡ በምንገድም ላይ አትሂዱ።

verses.en: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.fr: Fille de mon peuple, couvre-toi d''un sac et roule-toi dans la cendre, Prends le deuil comme pour un fils unique, Verse des larmes, des larmes amères! Car le dévastateur vient sur nous à l''improviste.
verses.am: የሕዝቤ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማቅ ልበሺ በአመድም ውስጥ ተንከባለዪ፤ አጥፊ በላያችን በድንገት ይመጣብናልና ለአንድያ ልጅ እንደሚደረግ ልቅሶ፥ መራራ ልቅሶ አልቅሺ።

verses.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.fr: Je t''avais établi en observation parmi mon peuple, Comme une forteresse, Pour que tu connusses et sondasses leur voie.
verses.am: መንገዳቸውን እንድታውቅና እንድትፈትን በሕዝቤ መካከል ፈታኝ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
verses.fr: Ils sont tous des rebelles, des calomniateurs, De l''airain et du fer; Ils sont tous corrompus.
verses.am: እነርሱ ሁሉ እጅግ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው፤ በጠማማነት ይሄዳሉ፤ ናስና ብረት ናቸው፤ ሁሉ ርኵሰትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.fr: Le soufflet est brûlant, Le plomb est consumé par le feu; C''est en vain qu''on épure, Les scories ne se détachent pas.
verses.am: ወናፍ አናፋ እርሳሱም በእሳት ቀለጠ፤ አንጥረኛውም መልሶ በከንቱ ያቀልጠዋል፤ ኃጢአተኞች አልተወገዱም።

verses.en: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the Lord hath rejected them.
verses.fr: On les appelle de l''argent méprisable, Car l''Eternel les a rejetés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጥሎአቸዋልና የተጣለ ብር ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል።

verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Stand in the gate of the Lord's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the Lord, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the Lord.
verses.fr: Place-toi à la porte de la maison de l''Eternel, Et là publie cette parole, Et dis: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, Vous tous, hommes de Juda, qui entrez par ces portes, Pour vous prosterner devant l''Eternel!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር ቁም፥ ይህንም ቃል እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገር። እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ በእነዚህ በሮች የምትገቡ ከይሁዳ ያላችሁ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Réformez vos voies et vos oeuvres, Et je vous laisserai demeurer dans ce lieu.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን አሳምሩ በዚህም ስፍራ አሳድራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, are these.
verses.fr: Ne vous livrez pas à des espérances trompeuses, en disant: C''est ici le temple de l''Eternel, le temple de l''Eternel, Le temple de l''Eternel!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ይህ ነው እያላችሁ በሐሰት ቃል አትታመኑ።

verses.en: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.fr: Si vous réformez vos voies et vos oeuvres, Si vous pratiquez la justice envers les uns et les autres,
verses.am: መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን ፈጽማችሁ ብታሳምሩ፥ በሰውና በጎረቤቱ መካከል ቅን ፍርድ ብትፈርዱ፥

verses.en: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.fr: Si vous n''opprimez pas l''étranger, l''orphelin et la veuve, Si vous ne répandez pas en ce lieu le sang innocent, Et si vous n''allez pas après d''autres dieux, pour votre malheur,
verses.am: መጻተኛውንና ድሀ አደጉን መበለቲቱንም ባትገፉ፥ በዚህም ስፍራ ንጹሕ ደምን ባታፈስሱ፥ ክፉም ሊሆንባችሁ እንግዶችን አማልክት ባትከተሉ፥

verses.en: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Alors je vous laisserai demeurer dans ce lieu, Dans le pays que j''ai donné à vos pères, D''éternité en éternité.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ለአባቶቻችሁ በሰጠኋቸው ምድር በዚህ ስፍራ አሳድራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.fr: Mais voici, vous vous livrez à des espérances trompeuses, Qui ne servent à rien.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በማትረቡበት በሐሰት ቃል ታምናችኋል።

verses.en: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
verses.fr: Quoi! dérober, tuer, commettre des adultères, Jurer faussement, offrir de l''encens à Baal, Aller après d''autres dieux que vous ne connaissez pas!...
verses.am: ትሰርቃላችሁ፥ ትገድላላችሁ፥ ታመነዝራላችሁ፥ በሐሰትም ትምላላችሁ፥ ለበኣልም ታጥናላችሁ፥ የማታውቋቸውንም እንግዶች አማልክት ትከተላላችሁ፤

verses.en: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.fr: Puis vous venez vous présenter devant moi, Dans cette maison sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué, Et vous dites: Nous sommes délivrés!... Et c''est afin de commettre toutes ces abominations!
verses.am: መጣችሁም፥ ስሜም በተጠራበት በዚህ ቤት በፊቴ ቆማችሁ። ይህን አስጸያፊ የሆነ ነገርን ሁሉ አላደረግንም አላችሁ።

verses.en: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Est-elle à vos yeux une caverne de voleurs, Cette maison sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué? Je le vois moi-même, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ይህስ ስሜ የተጠራበት ቤት በዓይናችሁ የሌቦች ዋሻ ሆኖአልን? እነሆ፥ እኔ አይቻለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.fr: Allez donc au lieu qui m''était consacré à Silo, Où j''avais fait autrefois résider mon nom. Et voyez comment je l''ai traité, A cause de la méchanceté de mon peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በቀድሞ ዘመን ስሜን ወዳሳደርሁበት በሴሎ ወደ ነበረው ስፍራዬ ሂዱ፥ ከሕዝቤም ከእስራኤል ክፋት የተነሣ ያደረግሁበትን እዩ።

verses.en: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the Lord, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.fr: Et maintenant, puisque vous avez commis toutes ces actions, Dit l''Eternel, Puisque je vous ai parlé dès le matin et que vous n''avez pas écouté, Puisque je vous ai appelés et que vous n''avez pas répondu,
verses.am: አሁንም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ስላደረጋችሁ፥ በማለዳም ተነሥቼ በተናገርኋችሁ ጊዜ ስላልሰማችሁ፥ በጠራኋችሁም ጊዜ ስላልመለሳችሁ፥

verses.en: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.fr: Je traiterai la maison sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué, Sur laquelle vous faites reposer votre confiance, Et le lieu que j''ai donné à vous et à vos pères, De la même manière que j''ai traité Silo;
verses.am: ስለዚህ በሴሎ እንዳደረግሁ እንዲሁ ስሜ በተጠራበት በምትታመኑበት ቤት ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠኋችሁ ስፍራ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.fr: Et je vous rejetterai loin de ma face, Comme j''ai rejeté tous vos frères, Toute la postérité d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምንም ዘር ሁሉ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁን ሁሉ እንደ ጣልሁ፥ እንዲሁ ከፊቴ እጥላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.fr: Et toi, n''intercède pas en faveur de ce peuple, N''élève pour eux ni supplications ni prières, Ne fais pas des instances auprès de moi; Car je ne t''écouterai pas.
verses.am: እንግዲህም አልሰማህምና ስለዚህ ሕዝብ አትጸልይ ስለ እነርሱም ልመናና ጸሎት አታድርግ፤ አትማልድላቸው።

verses.en: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.fr: Ne vois-tu pas ce qu''ils font dans les villes de Juda Et dans les rues de Jérusalem?
verses.am: እነርሱስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ውስጥና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ላይ የሚያደርጉትን አታይምን?

verses.en: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.fr: Les enfants ramassent du bois, Les pères allument le feu, Et les femmes pétrissent la pâte, Pour préparer des gâteaux à la reine du ciel, Et pour faire des libations à d''autres dieux, Afin de m''irriter.
verses.am: ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ፥ ለሰማይ ንግሥት እንጐቻ እንዲያደርጉ ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥ ቍርባን እንዲያፈስሱ ልጆች እንጨት ይሰበስባሉ፥ አባቶችም እሳት ያነድዳሉ፥ ሴቶችም ዱቄት ይለውሳሉ።

verses.en: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.fr: Est-ce moi qu''ils irritent? dit l''Eternel; N''est-ce pas eux-mêmes, A leur propre confusion?
verses.am: እኔን ያስቈጣሉን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለፊታቸውስ እፍረት አይደለምን?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel: Voici, ma colère et ma fureur se répandent sur ce lieu, Sur les hommes et sur les bêtes, Sur les arbres des champs et sur les fruits de la terre; Elle brûlera, et ne s''éteindra point.
verses.am: እንግዲህም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ቍጣዬና መዓቴ በዚህ ስፍራ ላይ፥ በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ፥ በዱር ዛፎችና በምድር ፍሬ ላይ ይፈስሳል፤ ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋምም።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
