verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Ajoutez vos holocaustes à vos sacrifices, Et mangez-en la chair!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን ጨምሩ፥ ሥጋውንም ብሉ።

verses.en: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.fr: Car je n''ai point parlé avec vos pères et je ne leur ai donné aucun ordre, Le jour où je les ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, Au sujet des holocaustes et des sacrifices.
verses.am: ከግብጽ ምድር ባወጣኋችሁ ቀን ስለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ስለ ሌላ መሥዋዕት ለአባቶቻችሁ አልተናገርሁምና፥ አላዘዝኋቸውምም።

verses.en: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.fr: Mais voici l''ordre que je leur ai donné: Ecoutez ma voix, Et je serai votre Dieu, Et vous serez mon peuple; Marchez dans toutes les voies que je vous prescris, Afin que vous soyez heureux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ቃሌን ስሙ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ፤ መልካምም ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ ባዘዝኋችሁ መንገድ ሁሉ ሂዱ ብዬ በዚህ ነገር አዘዝኋቸው።

verses.en: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.fr: Et ils n''ont point écouté, ils n''ont point prêté l''oreille; Ils ont suivi les conseils, les penchants de leur mauvais coeur, Ils ont été en arrière et non en avant.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በክፉ ልባቸው አሳብና እልከኝነት ሄዱ ወደ ፊትም ሳይሆን ወደ ኋላቸው ሄዱ እንጂ አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።

verses.en: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.fr: Depuis le jour où vos pères sont sortis du pays d''Egypte, Jusqu''à ce jour, Je vous ai envoyé tous mes serviteurs, les prophètes, Je les ai envoyés chaque jour, dès le matin.
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁ ከግብጽ ምድር ከወጡበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፥ በየዕለቱ እየማለድሁ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ልኬባችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.fr: Mais ils ne m''ont point écouté, ils n''ont point prêté l''oreille; Ils ont raidi leur cou, Ils ont fait le mal plus que leurs pères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ እንጂ አልሰሙኝም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም፤ አባቶቻቸውም ካደረጉት ይልቅ የባሰ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.fr: Si tu leur dis toutes ces choses, ils ne t''écouteront pas; Si tu cries vers eux, ils ne te répondront pas.
verses.am: በዚህም ቃል ሁሉ ትነግራቸዋለህ፥ ነገር ግን አይሰሙህም፤ ትጠራቸውማለህ፥ ነገር ግን አይመልሱልህም።

verses.en: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the Lord their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.fr: Alors dis-leur: C''est ici la nation qui n''écoute pas la voix de l''Eternel, son Dieu, Et qui ne veut pas recevoir instruction; La vérité a disparu, elle s''est retirée de leur bouche.
verses.am: አንተም። የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ያልሰማ፥ ተግሣጽንም ያልተቀበለ ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ እውነት ጠፍቶአል ከአፋቸውም ተቈርጦአል ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the Lord hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.fr: Coupe ta chevelure, et jette-la au loin; Monte sur les hauteurs, et prononce une complainte! Car l''Eternel rejette Et repousse la génération qui a provoqué sa fureur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የቍጣውን ትውልድ ጥሎአልና፥ ትቶታልምና ጠጕርሽን ቍረጪ፥ ጣዪውም፥ በወናዎች ኮረብቶችም ላይ አሙሺ።

verses.en: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the Lord: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.fr: Car les enfants de Juda ont fait ce qui est mal à mes yeux, Dit l''Eternel; Ils ont placé leurs abominations Dans la maison sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué, Afin de la souiller.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆች በፊቴ ክፉን ነገር ሠርተዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ያረክሱትም ዘንድ ስሜ በተጠራበት ቤት ርኵሰታቸውን አኑረዋል።

verses.en: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.fr: Ils ont bâti des hauts lieux à Topheth dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, Pour brûler au feu leurs fils et leurs filles: Ce que je n''avais point ordonné, Ce qui ne m''était point venu à la pensée.
verses.am: እኔም ያላዘዝሁትንና በልቤ ያላሰብሁትን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ያለችውን የቶፌትን መስገጃዎች ሠረተዋል።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où l''on ne dira plus Topheth et la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, Mais où l''on dira la vallée du carnage; Et l''on enterrera les morts à Topheth par défaut de place.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ስፍራ ከማጣት የተነሣ በቶፌት ይቀበራሉና የእርድ ሸለቆ ይባላል እንጂ ቶፌት ወይም የሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
verses.fr: Les cadavres de ce peuple seront la pâture Des oiseaux du ciel et des bêtes de la terre; Et il n''y aura personne pour les troubler.
verses.am: የዚህም ሕዝብ ሬሳ ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናል፥ የሚያስፈራራቸውም የለም።

verses.en: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.fr: Je ferai cesser dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem Les cris de réjouissance et les cris d''allégresse, Les chants du fiancé et les chants de la fiancée; Car le pays sera un désert.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ባድማ ትሆናለችና ከይሁዳ ከተሞችና ከኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: At that time, saith the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, dit l''Eternel, on tirera de leurs sépulcres les os des rois de Juda, les os de ses chefs, les os des sacrificateurs, les os des prophètes, et les os des habitants de Jérusalem.
verses.am: በዚያን ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የይሁዳን ነገሥታት አጥንትና የመኳንንቶቹን አጥንት፥ የካህናቱን አጥንትና የነቢያቱን አጥንት፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ሰዎች አጥንት ከመቃብራቸው ያወጣሉ።

verses.en: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.fr: On les étendra devant le soleil, devant la lune, et devant toute l''armée des cieux, qu''ils ont aimés, qu''ils ont servis, qu''ils ont suivis, qu''ils ont recherchés, et devant lesquels ils se sont prosternés; on ne les recueillera point, on ne les enterrera point, et ils seront comme du fumier sur la terre.
verses.am: በወደዱአቸውና ባመለኩአቸው፥ በተከተሉአቸውና በፈለጉአቸው፥ በሰገዱላቸውም በፀሐይና በጨረቃ በሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ፊት ይዘረጉአቸዋል፤ አያከማቹአቸውም አይቀብሩአቸውምም፥ በምድርም ፊት ላይ እንደ ጕድፍ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: La mort sera préférable à la vie pour tous ceux qui resteront de cette race méchante, dans tous les lieux où je les aurai chassés, dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: እኔም ባሳደድኋቸው ስፍራ ሁሉ የቀሩ፥ ከዚህች ክፉ ወገን የተረፉ ቅሬታዎች ሁሉ፥ ከሕይወት ይልቅ ሞትን ይመርጣሉ።

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.fr: Dis-leur: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Est-ce que l''on tombe sans se relever? Ou se détourne-t-on sans revenir?
verses.am: እንዲህም ትላቸዋለሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የወደቁ አይነሡምን? የሳተስ አይመለስምን?

verses.en: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.fr: Pourquoi donc ce peuple de Jérusalem s''abandonne-t-il A de perpétuels égarements? Ils persistent dans la tromperie, Ils refusent de se convertir.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ይህ የኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ዘወትር ስለ ምን ወደ ኋላው ይመለሳል? ተንኰልን ይዞአል ሊመለስም እንቢ ብሎአል።

verses.en: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.fr: Je suis attentif, et j''écoute: Ils ne parlent pas comme ils devraient; Aucun ne se repent de sa méchanceté, Et ne dit: Qu''ai-je fait? Tous reprennent leur course, Comme un cheval qui s''élance au combat.
verses.am: አደመጥሁ ሰማሁም፤ ቅንን ነገር አልተናገሩም፤ ማናቸውንም። ምን አድርጌአለሁ? ብሎ ከክፋቱ ንስሐ የገባ የለም፤ ወደ ሰልፍም እንደሚሮጥ ፈረስ እያንዳንዱ በየመንገዱ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the Lord.
verses.fr: Même la cigogne connaît dans les cieux sa saison; La tourterelle, l''hirondelle et la grue Observent le temps de leur arrivée; Mais mon peuple ne connaît pas la loi de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሽመላ በሰማይ ጊዜዋን አውቃለች፤ ዋኖስና ጨረባ ዋልያም የመምጣታቸውን ጊዜ ይጠብቃሉ፤ ሕዝቤ ግን የእግዚአብሔርን ፍርድ አላወቁም።

verses.en: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
verses.fr: Comment pouvez-vous dire: Nous sommes sages, La loi de l''Eternel est avec nous? C''est bien en vain que s''est mise à l''oeuvre La plume mensongère des scribes.
verses.am: እናንተስ። ጥበበኞች ነን የእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ ከእኛ ጋር ነው እንዴት ትላላችሁ? እነሆ፥ የጸሐፊ ብርዕ ሐሰተኛ ነው በሐሰትም አድርጎአል።

verses.en: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the Lord; and what wisdom is in them?
verses.fr: Les sages sont confondus, Ils sont consternés, ils sont pris; Voici, ils ont méprisé la parole de l''Eternel, Et quelle sagesse ont-ils?
verses.am: ጥበበኞች አፍረዋል ደንግጠውማል ተማርከውማል፤ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ጥለዋል፤ ምን ዓይነት ጥበብ አላቸው?

verses.en: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je donnerai leurs femmes à d''autres, Et leurs champs à ceux qui les déposséderont. Car depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand, Tous sont avides de gain; Depuis le prophète jusqu''au sacrificateur, Tous usent de tromperie.
verses.am: ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ስስትን ያስባሉና፥ ከነቢዩም ጀምሮ እስከ ካህኑ ድረስ ሁሉ በተንኰል ያደርጋሉና ስለዚህ ሚስቶቻቸውን ለሌሎች፥ እርሻቸውንም ለሚወርሱባቸው እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.fr: Ils pansent à la légère la plaie de la fille de mon peuple: Paix! paix! disent-ils. Et il n''y a point de paix.
verses.am: የሕዝቤንም ሴት ልጅ ስብራት በጥቂቱ ይፈውሳሉ፤ ሰላም ሳይሆን። ስለም ሰላም ይላሉ።

verses.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils seront confus, car ils commettent des abominations; Ils ne rougissent pas, ils ne connaissent pas la honte; C''est pourquoi ils tomberont avec ceux qui tombent, Ils seront renversés quand je les châtierai, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: አስጸያፊ ነገርን ስለ ሠሩ አፍረዋልን? ምንም አላፈሩም፥ እፍረትንም አላወቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከሚወድቁ ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ በጐበኘኋቸው ጊዜ ይዋረዳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር

verses.en: I will surely consume them, saith the Lord: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.fr: Je veux en finir avec eux, dit l''Eternel; Il n''y aura plus de raisins à la vigne, Plus de figues au figuier, Et les feuilles se flétriront; Ce que je leur avais donné leur échappera. -
verses.am: ፈጽሜ አጠፋችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በወይን ላይ ፍሬ፥ በበለስ ዛፍ ላይ በለስ አይሆንም፥ ቅጠልም ይረግፋል፤ የሚያልፉባቸውንም ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.en: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the Lord our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the Lord.
verses.fr: Pourquoi restons-nous assis? Rassemblez-vous, et allons dans les villes fortes, Pour y périr! Car l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous destine à la mort, Il nous fait boire des eaux empoisonnées, Parce que nous avons péché contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዝም ብለን ለም እንቀመጣለን? እግዚአብሔርን ስለ በደልን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አጥፍቶናልና፥ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጥቶናልና ተሰብስባችሁ ወደ ተመሸጉ ከተሞች እንግባ በዚያም እንጥፋ።

verses.en: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
verses.fr: Nous espérions la paix, et il n''arrive rien d''heureux; Un temps de guérison, et voici la terreur! -
verses.am: ሰላምን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ መልካምም አልተገኘም፤ መጠገንን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ እነሆም፥ ድንጋጤ ሆነ።

verses.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Le hennissement de ses chevaux se fait entendre du côté de Dan, Et au bruit de leur hennissement toute la terre tremble; Ils viennent, ils dévorent le pays et ce qu''il renferme, La ville et ceux qui l''habitent.
verses.am: የፈረሰኞቹ ድምጽ ከዳን ተሰማ፤ ከአርበኞች ፈረሶች ማሽካካት የተነሣ ምድር ሁሉ ተንቀጠቀጠች፤ መጡም ምድሪቱንና በእርስዋም ያለውን ሁሉ፥ ከተማይቱንና የተቀመጡባትንም በሉ።

verses.en: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Car j''envoie parmi vous des serpents, des basilics, Contre lesquels il n''y a point d''enchantement; Ils vous mordront, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አስማት የማይከለክላቸውን እባቦችንና እፉኝቶችን እሰድድባችኋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይነድፉአችኋል።

verses.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
verses.fr: Je voudrais soulager ma douleur; Mon coeur souffre au dedans de moi.
verses.am: ኅዘኔ የማይጽናና ነው፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደክሞአል።

verses.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the Lord in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
verses.fr: Voici les cris de la fille de mon peuple Retentissent sur la terre lointaine: L''Eternel n''est-il plus à Sion? N''a-t-elle plus son roi au milieu d''elle? -Pourquoi m''ont-ils irrité par leurs images taillées, Par des idoles étrangères? -
verses.am: እነሆ። እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን የለምን? ወይስ ንጉሥዋ በእርስዋ ዘንድ የለምን? የሚል የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ጩኸት ድምፅ ከሩቅ አገር ተሰማ። በተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውና በባዕድ ከንቱነትስ ያስቈጡኝ ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.fr: La moisson est passée, l''été est fini, Et nous ne sommes pas sauvés!
verses.am: መከሩ አልፎአል፥ በጋው ሄዶአል፥ እኛም አልዳንነም።

verses.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
verses.fr: Je suis brisé par la douleur de la fille de mon peuple, Je suis dans la tristesse, l''épouvante me saisit.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ስብራት እኔ ተሰብሬአለሁ ጠKWreማለሁ፤ አድናቆትም ይዞኛል።

verses.en: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verses.fr: N''y a-t-il point de baume en Galaad? N''y a-t-il point de médecin? Pourquoi donc la guérison de la fille de mon peuple ne s''opère-t-elle pas?
verses.am: በገለዓድ የሚቀባ መድኃኒት የለምን? ወይስ በዚያ ሐኪም የለምን? የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ፈውስ ስለ ምን አልሆነም?

verses.en: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.fr: Oh! si ma tête était remplie d''eau, Si mes yeux étaient une source de larmes, Je pleurerais jour et nuit Les morts de la fille de mon peuple!
verses.am: ተወግተው ስለ ሞቱ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ሰዎች ሌሊትና ቀን አለቅስ ዘንድ ራሴ ውኃ፥ ዓይኔም የእንባ ምንጭ በሆነልኝ!

verses.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.fr: Oh! si j''avais au désert une cabane de voyageurs, J''abandonnerais mon peuple, je m''en éloignerais! Car ce sont tous des adultères, C''est une troupe de perfides.
verses.am: ሁሉም አመንዝሮች፥ የአታላዮች ጉባኤ ናቸውና ሕዝቤን እተዋቸው ዘንድ ከእነርሱም እለይ ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ የመንገደኞች ማደሪያን ማን በሰጠኝ?

verses.en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils ont la langue tendue comme un arc et lancent le mensonge; Ce n''est pas par la vérité qu''ils sont puissants dans le pays; Car ils vont de méchanceté en méchanceté, Et ils ne me connaissent pas, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ምላሳቸውን ስለ ሐሰት እንደ ቀስት ገተሩ፤ በምድር በረቱ ነገር ግን ለእውነት አይደለም፤ ከክፋት ወደ ክፋት ይሄዳሉና እኔንም አላወቁምና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
verses.fr: Que chacun se tienne en garde contre son ami, Et qu''on ne se fie à aucun de ses frères; Car tout frère cherche à tromper, Et tout ami répand des calomnies.
verses.am: ወንድምም ሁሉ ያሰናክላልና፥ ባልንጀራም ሁሉ ያማልና እናንተ ሁሉ ከባልንጀሮቻችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፥ በወንድሞቻችሁም አትታመኑ።

verses.en: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.fr: Ils se jouent les uns des autres, Et ne disent point la vérité; Ils exercent leur langue à mentir, Ils s''étudient à faire le mal.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን ያታልላል በእውነትም አይናገርም፤ ሐሰትን መናገርንም ምላሳቸው ተምሮአል፥ ክፉንም ለማድረግ ይደክማሉ።

verses.en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ta demeure est au sein de la fausseté; C''est par fausseté qu''ils refusent de me connaître, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ማደሪያህ በሽንገላ መካከል ነው፥ ከሽንገላም የተነሣ እኔን ያውቁኝ ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici je les sonderai, je les éprouverai. Car comment agir à l''égard de la fille de mon peuple?
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ አቀልጣቸዋለሁ እፈትናቸውማለሁ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ክፋት ከዚህ ሌላ የማደርገው ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
verses.fr: Leur langue est un trait meurtrier, Ils ne disent que des mensonges; De la bouche ils parlent de paix à leur prochain, Et au fond du coeur ils lui dressent des pièges.
verses.am: ምላሳቸው የተሳለ ፍላጻ ነው፤ ሽንገላን ይናገራሉ ሰው ከባልንጀራው ጋር በሰላም ይናገራል፥ በልቡ ግን ያደባበታል።

verses.en: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.fr: Ne les châtierais-je pas pour ces choses-là, dit l''Eternel, Ne me vengerais-je pas d''une pareille nation?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለዚህ ነገር አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
verses.fr: Sur les montagnes je veux pleurer et gémir, Sur les plaines du désert je prononce une complainte; Car elles sont brûlées, personne n''y passe, On n''y entend plus la voix des troupeaux; Les oiseaux du ciel et les bêtes ont pris la fuite, ont disparu. -
verses.am: ለተራሮች ልቅሶን ለምድረ በዳ ማሰማርያዎችም ዋይታን አነሣለሁ፥ ሰው እንዳያልፍባቸው በእሳት ተቃጥለዋልና። ሰዎችም የከብቱን ድምፅ አይሰሙም፤ ከሰማይ ወፎች ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።

verses.en: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
verses.fr: Je ferai de Jérusalem un monceau de ruines, un repaire de chacals, Et je réduirai les villes de Juda en un désert sans habitants. -
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌምንም የፍርስራሽ ክምር የቀበሮም ማደሪያ አደርጋታለሁ፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ሰው የማይቀመጥባት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the Lord hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
verses.fr: Où est l''homme sage qui comprenne ces choses? Qu''il le dise, celui à qui la bouche de l''Eternel a parlé! Pourquoi le pays est-il détruit, Brûlé comme un désert où personne ne passe?
verses.am: ይህን የሚያስተውል ጠቢብ ሰው ማን ነው? ያወራስ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ለማን ተናገረ? ሰው እንዳያልፍባት ምድርስ ስለምን ጠፋች፥ እንደ ምድረ በዳስ ስለ ምን ተቃጠለች?

verses.en: And the Lord saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: C''est parce qu''ils ont abandonné ma loi, Que j''avais mise devant eux; Parce qu''ils n''ont point écouté ma voix, Et qu''ils ne l''ont point suivie;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለ። የሰጠኋቸውን ሕጌን ትተዋልና፥ ቃሌንም አልሰሙምና፥

verses.en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
verses.fr: Parce qu''ils ont suivi les penchants de leur coeur, Et qu''ils sont allés après les Baals, Comme leurs pères le leur ont appris.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የልባቸውን ምኞትና አባቶቻቸው ያስተማሩአቸውን በኣሊምን ተከትለዋልና

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je vais nourrir ce peuple d''absinthe, Et je lui ferai boire des eaux empoisonnées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ እሬትን አበላዋለሁ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጣዋለሁ።

verses.en: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.fr: Je les disperserai parmi des nations Que n''ont connues ni eux ni leurs pères, Et j''enverrai derrière eux l''épée, Jusqu''à ce que je les aie exterminés.
verses.am: እነርሱና አባቶቻቸውም ባላወቁአቸው አሕዛብ መካከል እበትናቸዋለሁ፥ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በስተ ኋላቸው ሰይፍን እሰድድባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Cherchez, appelez les pleureuses, et qu''elles viennent! Envoyez vers les femmes habiles, et qu''elles viennent!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲመጡ አልቃሾች ሴቶችን ጥሩ፤ እንዲመጡም ወደ ብልሃተኞች ሴቶች ላኩ፤

verses.en: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.fr: Qu''elles se hâtent de dire sur nous une complainte! Et que les larmes tombent de nos yeux, Que l''eau coule de nos paupières!
verses.am: ዓይኖቻችንም እንባ እንዲያፈስሱ የዓይናችንም ሽፋሽፍቶች ውኃን እንዲያፈልቁ ፈጥነው ለእኛ ልቅሶውን ይያዙ።

verses.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
verses.fr: Car des cris lamentables se font entendre de Sion: Eh quoi! nous sommes détruits! Nous sommes couverts de honte! Il nous faut abandonner le pays! On a renversé nos demeures! -
verses.am: በጽዮን። እንዴት ተበዘበዝን! ምድርንም ትተናልና፥ ቤቶቻችንንም አፍርሰዋልና እንዴት አፈርን! የሚል የልቅሶ ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.fr: Femmes, écoutez la parole de l''Eternel, Et que votre oreille saisisse ce que dit sa bouche! Apprenez à vos filles des chants lugubres, Enseignez-vous des complaintes les unes aux autres!
verses.am: እናንተ ሴቶች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ ጆሮአችሁም የአፉን ቃል ትቀበል፥ ለሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ልቅሶውን፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ለባልንጀሮቻችሁ ዋይታውን አስተምሩ።

verses.en: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
verses.fr: Car la mort est montée par nos fenêtres, Elle a pénétré dans nos palais; Elle extermine les enfants dans la rue, Les jeunes gens sur les places.
verses.am: ሕፃናቱን ከመንገድ ጕልማሶቹንም ከአደባባይ ያጠፉ ዘንድ ሞት ወደ መስኮታችን ደርሶአል ወደ አዳራሻችንም ውስጥ ገብቶአል።

verses.en: Speak, Thus saith the Lord, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
verses.fr: Dis: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Les cadavres des hommes tomberont Comme du fumier sur les champs, Comme tombe derrière le moissonneur une gerbe Que personne ne ramasse.
verses.am: የሰውም ሬሳ እንደ ጕድፍ በእርሻ ላይ፥ ማንምም እንደማይሰበስበው ከአጫጆች በኋላ እንደሚቀር ቃርሚያ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Que le sage ne se glorifie pas de sa sagesse, Que le fort ne se glorifie pas de sa force, Que le riche ne se glorifie pas de sa richesse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጠቢብ በጥበቡ አይመካ፥ ኃያልም በኃይሉ አይመካ፥ ባለ ጠጋም በብልጥግናው አይመካ፤

verses.en: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the Lord which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais que celui qui veut se glorifier se glorifie D''avoir de l''intelligence et de me connaître, De savoir que je suis l''Eternel, Qui exerce la bonté, le droit et la justice sur la terre; Car c''est à cela que je prends plaisir, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚመካው። ምሕረትንና ፍርድን ጽድቅንም በምድር ላይ የማደርግ እኔ እግዚአብሔር መሆኔን በማወቁና በማስተዋሉ በዚህ ይመካ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኙኝ እነዚህ ናቸውና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où je châtierai tous les circoncis qui ne le sont pas de coeur,

verses.en: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
verses.fr: L''Egypte, Juda, Edom, les enfants d''Ammon, Moab, Tous ceux qui se rasent les coins de la barbe, Ceux qui habitent dans le désert; Car toutes les nations sont incirconcises, Et toute la maison d''Israël a le coeur incirconcis.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያልተገረዙ ናቸውና፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ ልባቸው ያልተገረዘ ነውና የተገረዙትን ሁሉ፥ ግብጽንና ይሁዳን ኤዶምያስንም የአሞንንም ልጆች ሞዓብንም በምድረ በዳም የተቀመጡትን ጠጕራቸውን በዙሪያ የተላጩትን ሁሉ፥ ባለመገረዛቸው እነርሱን የምቀጣበት ዘመን እነሆ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear ye the word which the Lord speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
verses.fr: Ecoutez la parole que l''Eternel vous adresse, Maison d''Israël!
verses.am: እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ ላይ የተናገረውን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: N''imitez pas la voie des nations, Et ne craignez pas les signes du ciel, Parce que les nations les craignent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሕዛብን መንገድ አትማሩ ከሰማይ ምልክትም አትፍሩ፤ አሕዛብ ይፈሩታልና።

verses.en: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.fr: Car les coutumes des peuples ne sont que vanité. On coupe le bois dans la forêt; La main de l''ouvrier le travaille avec la hache;
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ልማድ ከንቱ ነውና፤ ዛፍ ከዱር ይቈረጣል፥ በሠራተኛም እንጅ በመጥረቢያ ይሠራል።

verses.en: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.fr: On l''embellit avec de l''argent et de l''or, On le fixe avec des clous et des marteaux, Pour qu''il ne branle pas.
verses.am: በብርና በወርቅ ያስጌጡታል፥ እንዳይናወጥም በችንካርና በመዶሻ ይቸነክሩታል።

verses.en: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
verses.fr: Ces dieux sont comme une colonne massive, et ils ne parlent point; On les porte, parce qu''ils ne peuvent marcher. Ne les craignez pas, car ils ne sauraient faire aucun mal, Et ils sont incapables de faire du bien.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀረጸ ዓምድ ናቸው እነርሱም አይናገሩም፤ መራመድም አይቻላቸውማን ይሸከሙአቸዋል። ክፉ መሥራትም አይቻላቸውምና፥ ደግምም መልካም ይሠሩ ዘንድ አይችሉምና አትፍሩአቸው።

verses.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O Lord; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
verses.fr: Nul n''est semblable à toi, ô Eternel! Tu es grand, et ton nom est grand par ta puissance.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ የለም፤ አንተ ታላቅ ነህ ስምህም በኃይል ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
verses.fr: Qui ne te craindrait, roi des nations? C''est à toi que la crainte est due; Car, parmi tous les sages des nations et dans tous leurs royaumes, Nul n''est semblable à toi.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በአሕዛብ ጥበበኞች ሁሉ መካከል በመንግሥታቸውም ሁሉ እንደ አንተ ያለ ስለሌለ፥ አንተን መፍራት ይገባልና አንተን የማይፈራ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
verses.fr: Tous ensemble, ils sont stupides et insensés; Leur science n''est que vanité, c''est du bois!
verses.am: በአንድ ጊዜ ሰንፈዋል፥ ደንቍረውማል፤ ጣዖታት የሚያስተምሩት የእንጨት ነገር ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
verses.fr: On apporte de Tarsis des lames d''argent, et d''Uphaz de l''or, L''ouvrier et la main de l''orfèvre les mettent en oeuvre; Les vêtements de ces dieux sont d''étoffes teintes en bleu et en pourpre, Tous sont l''ouvrage d''habiles artisans.
verses.am: የሠራተኛና የአንጥረኛ እጅ ሥራ የሆነ ከተርሴስ ጥፍጥፍ ብር ከአፌዝም ወርቅ ይመጣል፤ ልብሳቸውም ሰማያዊና ቀይ ግምጃ ነው፥ ሁሉም የብልሃተኞች ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: But the Lord is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel est Dieu en vérité, Il est un Dieu vivant et un roi éternel; La terre tremble devant sa colère, Et les nations ne supportent pas sa fureur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እውነተኛ አምላክ ነው፤ እርሱም ሕያው አምላክና የዘላለም ንጉሥ ነው፤ ከቍጣው የተነሣ ምድር ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ አሕዛብም መዓቱን አይችሉም።

verses.en: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.fr: Vous leur parlerez ainsi: Les dieux qui n''ont point fait les cieux et la terre Disparaîtront de la terre et de dessous les cieux.
verses.am: እናንተም። ሰማይንና ምድርን ያልፈጠሩ እነዚህ አማልክት ከምድር ላይ ከሰማይም በታች ይጠፋሉ ትሉአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.fr: Il a créé la terre par sa puissance, Il a fondé le monde par sa sagesse, Il a étendu les cieux par son intelligence.
verses.am: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.fr: A sa voix, les eaux mugissent dans les cieux; Il fait monter les nuages des extrémités de la terre, Il produit les éclairs et la pluie, Il tire le vent de ses trésors.
verses.am: ድምፁን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናቡም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፋስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.fr: Tout homme devient stupide par sa science, Tout orfèvre est honteux de son image taillée; Car ses idoles ne sont que mensonge, Il n''y a point en elles de souffle,
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።

verses.en: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.fr: Elles sont une chose de néant, une oeuvre de tromperie; Elles périront, quand viendra le châtiment.
verses.am: እነርሱ ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.fr: Celui qui est la part de Jacob n''est pas comme elles; Car c''est lui qui a tout formé, Et Israël est la tribu de son héritage. L''Eternel des armées est son nom.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፤ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነውና፤ ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.fr: Emporte du pays ce qui t''appartient, Toi qui es assise dans la détresse!
verses.am: በምሽግ ውስጥ የተቀመጥሽ ሆይ፥ ዕቃሽን ከመሬት ሰብስቢ፤

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, cette fois je vais lancer au loin les habitants du pays; Je vais les serrer de près, afin qu''on les atteigne. -
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩትን እስኪሰማቸው ድረስ በዚህ ጊዜ እወነጭፋቸዋለሁ፥ አስጨንቃቸውማለሁ።

verses.en: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous; but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.fr: Malheur à moi! je suis brisée! Ma plaie est douloureuse! Mais je dis: C''est une calamité qui m''arrive, Je la supporterai!
verses.am: ስለ ስብራቴ ወዮልኝ! ቍስሌም ክፉ ነው፥ እኔ ግን። በእውነት የመከራ ቍስሌ ነው እርሱንም መሸከም ይገባኛል አልሁ።

verses.en: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.fr: Ma tente est détruite, Tous mes cordages sont rompus; Mes fils m''ont quittée, ils ne sont plus; Je n''ai personne qui dresse de nouveau ma tente, Qui relève mes pavillons. -
verses.am: ድንኳኔ ተበዘበዘ አውታሬም ሁሉ ተቈረጠ፤ ልጆቼም ከእኔ ወጥተው አይገኙም፤ ድንኳኔንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሚዘረጋ መጋረጃዎችንም የሚያነሣ የለም።

verses.en: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the Lord: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.fr: Les bergers ont été stupides, Ils n''ont pas cherché l''Eternel; C''est pour cela qu''ils n''ont point prospéré, Et que tous leurs troupeaux se dispersent.
verses.am: እረኞች ሰንፈዋልና፥ እግዚአብሔርን አልጠየቁትምና አልተከናወነላቸውም፥ መንጎቻቸውም ሁሉ ተበትነዋል።

verses.en: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
verses.fr: Voici, une rumeur se fait entendre; C''est un grand tumulte qui vient du septentrion, Pour réduire les villes de Juda en un désert, En un repaire de chacals. -
verses.am: የወሬን ድምፅ ስሙ፤ እነሆም፥ የይሁዳን ከተሞች ባድማና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ ከሰሜን ምድር ጽኑ ሽብር መጥቶአል።

verses.en: O Lord, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.fr: Je le sais, ô Eternel! La voie de l''homme n''est pas en son pouvoir; Ce n''est pas à l''homme, quand il marche, A diriger ses pas.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሰው መንገድ ከራሱ እንዳይደለ አውቃለሁ፥ አካሄዱንም ለማቅናት ከሚራመድ ሰው አይደለም።

verses.en: O Lord, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
verses.fr: Châtie-moi, ô Eternel! mais avec équité, Et non dans ta colère, de peur que tu ne m''anéantisses.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቅጣኝ፤ ነገር ግን እንዳታዋርደኝ በመጠን ይሁን እንጂ በቍጣ አይሁን።

verses.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.fr: Répands ta fureur sur les nations qui ne te connaissent pas, Et sur les peuples qui n''invoquent pas ton nom! Car ils dévorent Jacob, ils le dévorent, ils le consument, Ils ravagent sa demeure.
verses.am: ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥ ውጠውትማልና፥ አጥፍተውትማልና፥ ማደሪያውንም አፍርሰዋልና በማያውቁህ አሕዛብ ስምህንም በማይጠሩ ወገኖች ላይ መዓትህን አፍስስ።

verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord saying,
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.fr: Ecoutez les paroles de cette alliance, Et parlez aux hommes de Juda et aux habitants de Jérusalem!
verses.am: የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ስማ፥ ለይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ተናገር፥

verses.en: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
verses.fr: Dis-leur: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Maudit soit l''homme qui n''écoute point les paroles de cette alliance,

verses.en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
verses.fr: Que j''ai prescrite à vos pères, Le jour où je les ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, De la fournaise de fer, en disant: Ecoutez ma voix, et faites tout ce que je vous ordonnerai; Alors vous serez mon peuple, Je serai votre Dieu,
verses.am: እንደዚህም በላቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከግብጽ አገር ከብረት ምድጃ ባወጣኋቸው ቀን ለአባቶቻችሁ ያዘዝሁትን የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል የማይሰማ ሰው ርጉም ይሁን፤ አልሁም። ቃሌን ስሙ፥ ያዘዝኋችሁንም ሁሉ አድርጉ፤ እንዲሁም እናንተ ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O Lord.
verses.fr: Et j''accomplirai le serment que j''ai fait à vos pères, De leur donner un pays où coulent le lait et le miel, Comme vous le voyez aujourd''hui. -Et je répondis: Amen, Eternel!
verses.am: ይህም ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድር እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችሁ የማልሁትን መሐላ አጸና ዘንድ ነው። እኔም። አቤቱ፥ አሜን ብዬ መለስሁለት።

verses.en: Then the Lord said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Publie toutes ces paroles dans les villes de Juda Et dans les rues de Jérusalem, en disant: Ecoutez les paroles de cette alliance, Et mettez-les en pratique!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ይህችን ቃል ሁሉ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በል። የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ስሙ አድርጉትም።

verses.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.fr: Car j''ai averti vos pères, Depuis le jour où je les ai fait monter du pays d''Egypte Jusqu''à ce jour, Je les ai avertis tous les matins, en disant: Ecoutez ma voix!
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁን ከግብጽ ምድር ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፥ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ እያስጠነቀቅሁ። ቃሌን ስሙ በማለት አስጠንቅቄአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do: but they did them not.
verses.fr: Mais ils n''ont pas écouté, ils n''ont pas prêté l''oreille, Ils ont suivi chacun les penchants de leur mauvais coeur; Alors j''ai accompli sur eux toutes les paroles de cette alliance, Que je leur avais ordonné d''observer et qu''ils n''ont point observée.
verses.am: እነርሱ ሁሉ ግን በክፉ ልባቸው እልከኝነት ሄዱ እንጂ አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም፤ ስለዚህ ያዘዝኋቸውን እነርሱም ያላደረጉትን የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ሁሉ አመጣሁባቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Il y a une conjuration entre les hommes de Juda Et les habitants de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። በይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩ ዘንድ አድማ ተገኝቶአል።

verses.en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.fr: Ils sont retournés aux iniquités de leurs premiers pères, Qui ont refusé d''écouter mes paroles, Et ils sont allés après d''autres dieux, pour les servir. La maison d''Israël et la maison de Juda ont violé mon alliance, Que j''avais faite avec leurs pères.
verses.am: ቃሌንም ይሰሙ ዘንድ እንቢ ወዳሉ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ኃጢአት ተመለሱ፥ ያመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ እንግዶችን አማልክት ተከተሉ፤ የእስራኤል ቤትና የይሁዳ ቤት ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን አፈረሱ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je vais faire venir sur eux des malheurs Dont ils ne pourront se délivrer. Ils crieront vers moi, Et je ne les écouterai pas.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሊያመልጡት የማይችሉትን ክፉ ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ወደ እኔም ይጮኻሉ፤ እኔም አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.fr: Les villes de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem Iront invoquer les dieux auxquels ils offrent de l''encens, Mais ils ne les sauveront pas au temps de leur malheur.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ ሄደው ወደሚያጥኑላቸው አማልክት ይጮኻሉ፤ ነገር ግን በመከራቸው ጊዜ ከቶ አያድኑአቸውም።

verses.en: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.fr: Car tu as autant de dieux que de villes, ô Juda! Et autant Jérusalem a de rues, Autant vous avez dressé d''autels aux idoles, D''autels pour offrir de l''encens à Baal...
verses.am: ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ አማልክትህ እንደ ከተሞችህ ቍጥር እንዲሁ ናቸው፤ እንደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መንገዶች ቍጥር ለነውረኛ ነገር መሠዊያ፥ እርሱም ለበኣል ታጥኑበት ዘንድ መሠዊያ፥ አድርጋችኋል።

verses.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.fr: Et toi, n''intercède pas en faveur de ce peuple, N''élève pour eux ni supplications ni prières; Car je ne les écouterai pas, Quand ils m''invoqueront à cause de leur malheur.
verses.am: አንተም ስለዚህ ሕዝብ አትጸልይ፤ ከመከራቸው የተነሣ ወደ እኔ በጮኹ ጊዜ አልሰማቸውምና ስለ እነርሱም ጩኸትና ልመና አታድርግ።

verses.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
verses.fr: Que ferait mon bien-aimé dans ma maison? Il s''y commet une foule de crimes. La chair sacrée disparaîtra devant toi. Quand tu fais le mal, c''est alors que tu triomphes!
verses.am: ወዳጄ በቤቴ ውስጥ ምን አላት? ስእለት ወይም የተቀደሰ ሥጋ ክፋትሽን ከአንቺ ያስወግዳልን? ወይስ በእነዚህ ታመልጫለሽን?

verses.en: The Lord called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.fr: Olivier verdoyant, remarquable par la beauté de son fruit, Tel est le nom que t''avait donné l''Eternel; Au bruit d''un grand fracas, il l''embrase par le feu, Et ses rameaux sont brisés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስምሽን።በመልካም ፍሬ የተዋበች የለመለመች የወይራ ዛፍ ብሎ ጠራው፤ በጽኑ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ጩኸት እሳትን አነደደባት፥ ቅርንጫፎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።

verses.en: For the Lord of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées, qui t''a planté, Appelle sur toi le malheur, A cause de la méchanceté de la maison d''Israël et de la maison de Juda, Qui ont agi pour m''irriter, en offrant de l''encens à Baal.
verses.am: ለበኣልም በማጠናቸው ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ለራሳቸው ስለ ሠሩአት ስለ እስራኤልና ስለ ይሁዳ ቤት ክፋት የተከለሽ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ክፉን ነገር ተናግሮብሻል።

verses.en: And the Lord hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.fr: L''Eternel m''en a informé, et je l''ai su; Alors tu m''as fait voir leurs oeuvres.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አስታወቀኝ እኔም አወቅሁ፤ ሥራቸውንም ገለጥህልኝ።

verses.en: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.fr: J''étais comme un agneau familier qu''on mène à la boucherie, Et j''ignorais les mauvais desseins qu''ils méditaient contre moi: Détruisons l''arbre avec son fruit! Retranchons-le de la terre des vivants, Et qu''on ne se souvienne plus de son nom! -
verses.am: እኔም ለመታረድ እንደሚነዳ እንደ የዋህ በግ ጠቦት ሆንሁ፤ እነርሱም። ዛፉን ከፍሬው ጋር እንቍረጥ፥ ስሙም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳይታሰብ ከሕያዋን ምድር እናጥፋው ብለው ምክርን እንዳሰቡብኝ አላወቅሁም ነበር።

verses.en: But, O Lord of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel des armées est un juste juge, Qui sonde les reins et les coeurs. Je verrai ta vengeance s''exercer contre eux, Car c''est à toi que je confie ma cause.
verses.am: ኵላሊትንና ልብን የምትፈትን በቅንም የምትፈርድ አቤቱ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክርክሬን ገልጬልሃለሁና በእነርሱ ላይ የሚሆን በቀልህን ለይ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the Lord, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel contre les gens d''Anathoth, Qui en veulent à ta vie, et qui disent: Ne prophétise pas au nom de l''Eternel, Ou tu mourras de notre main!
verses.am: ስለዚህም። በእጃችን እንዳትሞት በእግዚአብሔር ስም ትንቢት አትናገር ብለው ነፍስህን ስለሚሹ ስለ ዓናቶት ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።እነሆ፥ እቀጣቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici, je vais les châtier; Les jeunes hommes mourront par l''épée, Leurs fils et leurs filles mourront par la famine.
verses.am: ጎበዛዝቶቻቸው በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም በራብ ይሞታሉ፤ በምጐበኛቸውም ዓመት በዓናቶት ሰዎች ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁና ማንም ከእነርሱ የሚቀር የለም።

verses.en: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
verses.fr: Aucun d''eux n''échappera; Car je ferai venir le malheur sur les gens d''Anathoth, L''année où je les châtierai.

verses.en: Righteous art thou, O Lord, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
verses.fr: Tu es trop juste, Eternel, pour que je conteste avec toi; Je veux néanmoins t''adresser la parole sur tes jugements: Pourquoi la voie des méchants est-elle prospère? Pourquoi tous les perfides vivent-ils en paix?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከአንተ ጋር በተምዋገትሁ ጊዜ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፤ ነገር ግን ከአንተ ጋር ስለ ፍርድ ልናገር። የኃጢአተኞች መንገድ ስለምን ይቃናል? በደልንስ ለሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ስለምን ደኅንነት ይሆናል?

verses.en: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
verses.fr: Tu les as plantés, ils ont pris racine, Ils croissent, ils portent du fruit; Tu es près de leur bouche, Mais loin de leur coeur.
verses.am: ተክለሃቸዋል፤ ሥር ሰድደዋል፤ አድገዋል አፍርተውማል፤ በአፋቸው አንተ ቅርብ ነህ፥ ከልባቸው ግን ሩቅ ነህ።

verses.en: But thou, O Lord, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.fr: Et toi, Eternel, tu me connais, Tu me vois, tu sondes mon coeur qui est avec toi. Enlève-les comme des brebis qu''on doit égorger, Et prépare-les pour le jour du carnage!
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ አውቀኸኛል፤ አይተኸኛል፥ ልቤንም በፊትህ ፈትነሃል፤ እንደ በጎች ለመታረድ ጐትተህ ለያቸው፥ ለመታረድም ቀን አዘጋጃቸው።

verses.en: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.fr: Jusques à quand le pays sera-t-il dans le deuil, Et l''herbe de tous les champs sera-t-elle desséchée? A cause de la méchanceté des habitants, Les bêtes et les oiseaux périssent. Car ils disent: Il ne verra pas notre fin. -
verses.am: ምድሪቱ የምታለቅሰው፥ የአገሩ ሣርስ ሁሉ የሚደርቀው እስከ መቸ ነው? የተቀመጡባት ሰዎች። ፍጻሜያችንን አያይም ብለዋልና ስለ ክፋታቸው እንስሶችና ወፎች ጠፍተዋል።

verses.en: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.fr: Si tu cours avec des piétons et qu''ils te fatiguent, Comment pourras-tu lutter avec des chevaux? Et si tu ne te crois en sûreté que dans une contrée paisible, Que feras-tu sur les rives orgueilleuses du Jourdain?
verses.am: ከእግረኞች ጋር በሮጥህ ጊዜ እነርሱ ቢያደክሙህ፥ ከፈረሶች ጋር መታገል እንዴት ትችላለህ? በሰላምም ምድር ታምነህ ብትቀመጥ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት እንዴት ታደርጋለህ?

verses.en: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
verses.fr: Car tes frères eux-mêmes et la maison de ton père te trahissent, Ils crient eux-mêmes à pleine voix derrière toi. Ne les crois pas, quand ils te diront des paroles amicales.
verses.am: ወንድሞችህና የአባትህ ቤት እነርሱ ጭምር አታልለውሃልና፥ በኋላህም ጮኸዋልና፤ በመልካምም ቢናገሩህም አትታመናቸው።

verses.en: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.fr: J''ai abandonné ma maison, J''ai délaissé mon héritage, J''ai livré l''objet de mon amour aux mains de ses ennemis.
verses.am: ቤቴን ትቼአለሁ ርስቴንም ጥያለሁ፥ ነፍሴም የምትወድዳትን በጠላቶችዋ እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
verses.fr: Mon héritage a été pour moi comme un lion dans la forêt, Il a poussé contre moi ses rugissements; C''est pourquoi je l''ai pris en haine.
verses.am: ርስቴ በዱር እንዳለ አንበሳ ሆናብኛለች፤ ድምፅዋን አንሥታብኛለች፤ ስለዚህ ጠልቻታለሁ።

verses.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
verses.fr: Mon héritage a été pour moi un oiseau de proie, une hyène; Aussi les oiseaux de proie viendront de tous côtés contre lui. Allez, rassemblez tous les animaux des champs, Faites-les venir pour qu''ils le dévorent!
verses.am: ርስቴ እንደ ዝንጕርጕር አሞራ ሆነችብኝን? አሞሮችስ በዙሪያዋና በላይዋ ሆነዋልን? ሂዱ፥ የምድር አራዊትን ሁሉ ሰብስቡ፥ ይበሉም ዘንድ አምጡአቸው።

verses.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.fr: Des bergers nombreux ravagent ma vigne, Ils foulent mon champ; Ils réduisent le champ de mes délices En un désert, en une solitude.
verses.am: ብዙ እረኞች የወይኑን ቦታዬን አጥፍተዋል፥ እድል ፈንታዬንም ረግጠዋል፤ የአምሮቴን እድል ፈንታ ምድረ በዳ አድርገውታል።

verses.en: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
verses.fr: Ils le réduisent en un désert; Il est en deuil, il est désolé devant moi. Tout le pays est ravagé, Car nul n''y prend garde.
verses.am: ባድማ አድርገውታል፥ ፈርሶም ወደ እኔ ያለቅሳል፤ ምድር ሁሉ ባድማ ሆናለች በልቡም የሚያስባት የለም።

verses.en: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the Lord shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
verses.fr: Sur tous les lieux élevés du désert arrivent les dévastateurs, Car le glaive de l''Eternel dévore le pays d''un bout à l''autre; Il n''y a de paix pour aucun homme.
verses.am: በወናዎች ኮረብቶች ሁሉ ላይ በዝባዦች መጥተዋል፥ የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ይበላልና፤ ለሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ሰላም የለም።

verses.en: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils ont semé du froment, et ils moissonnent des épines, Ils se sont fatigués sans profit. Ayez honte de ce que vous récoltez, Par suite de la colère ardente de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስንዴን ዘሩ እሾህንም አጨዱ፤ ደከሙ፥ ምንም አልረባቸውም፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ከፍሬያችሁ ታፍራላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel sur tous mes méchants voisins, Qui attaquent l''héritage que j''ai donné à mon peuple d''Israël: Voici, je les arracherai de leur pays, Et j''arracherai la maison de Juda du milieu d''eux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቤ ለእስራኤል ያወረስሁትን ርስት ለሚነኩት ክፉዎች ጐረቤቶች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ከምድራቸው እነቅላቸዋለሁ፥ የይሁዳንም ቤት ከመካከላቸው እነቅለዋለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
verses.fr: Mais après que je les aurai arrachés, J''aurai de nouveau compassion d''eux, Et je les ramènerai chacun dans son héritage, Chacun dans son pays.
verses.am: ከነቀልኋቸውም በኋላ መልሼ እምራቸዋለሁ፥ እያንዳንዱንም ወደ ርስቱ እያንዳንዱንም ወደ ምድሩ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The Lord liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
verses.fr: Et s''ils apprennent les voies de mon peuple, S''ils jurent par mon nom, en disant: L''Eternel est vivant! Comme ils ont enseigné à mon peuple à jurer par Baal, Alors ils jouiront du bonheur au milieu de mon peuple.
verses.am: በበኣል ይምሉ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን እንዳስተማሩ በስሜ። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብለው ይምሉ ዘንድ የሕዝቤን መንገድ በትጋት ቢማሩ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በሕዝቤ መካከል ይመሠረታሉ።

verses.en: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais s''ils n''écoutent rien, Je détruirai une telle nation, Je la détruirai, je la ferai périr, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ባይሰሙኝ ግን ያንን ሕዝብ ፈጽሜ እነቅለዋለሁ አጠፋውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verses.fr: Ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel: Va, achète-toi une ceinture de lin, et mets-la sur tes reins; mais ne la trempe pas dans l''eau.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። ሂድ፥ ከተልባ እግር የተሠራችን መታጠቂያ ለአንተ ግዛ፥ ወገብህንም ታጠቅባት፤ በውኃውም ውስጥ አትንከራት።

verses.en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the Lord, and put it on my loins.
verses.fr: J''achetai la ceinture, selon la parole de l''Eternel, et je la mis sur mes reins.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል መታጠቂያን ገዛሁ ወገቤንም ታጠቅሁባት።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée une seconde fois, en ces mots:

verses.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.fr: Prends la ceinture que tu as achetée, et qui est sur tes reins; lève-toi, va vers l''Euphrate, et là, cache-la dans la fente d''un rocher.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም ጊዜ። የገዛሃትን በወገብህ ያለችውን መታጠቂያ ወስደህ ተነሥ፥ ወደ ኤፍራጥስም ሂድ፥ በዚያም በተሰነጠቀ ዓለት ውስጥ ሸሽጋት የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣልኝ።

verses.en: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
verses.fr: J''allai, et je la cachai près de l''Euphrate, comme l''Eternel me l''avait ordonné.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘኝ ሄድሁ በኤፍራጥስም አጠገብ ሸሸግኋት።

verses.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
verses.fr: Plusieurs jours après, l''Eternel me dit: Lève-toi, va vers l''Euphrate, et là, prends la ceinture que je t''avais ordonné d''y cacher.
verses.am: ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር። ተነሥተህ ወደ ኤፍራጥስ ሂድ፥ በዚያም ትሸሽጋት ዘንድ ያዘዝሁህን መታጠቂያ ከዚያ ውስጥ ውሰድ አለኝ።

verses.en: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.fr: J''allai vers l''Euphrate, je fouillai, et je pris la ceinture dans le lieu où je l''avais cachée; mais voici, la ceinture était gâtée, elle n''était plus bonne à rien.
verses.am: እኔም ወደ ኤፍራጥስ ሄድሁ ቆፈርሁም፥ ከሸሸግሁበትም ስፍራ መታጠቂያይቱን ወሰድሁ። እነሆም፥ መታጠቂያይቱ ተበላሽታ ነበር፥ ለምንም አልረባችም።

verses.en: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፤

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: C''est ainsi que je détruirai l''orgueil de Juda Et l''orgueil immense de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲሁ የይሁዳን ትዕቢት ታላቁንም የኢየሩሳሌምን ትዕቢት አበላሻለሁ።

verses.en: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
verses.fr: Ce méchant peuple, qui refuse d''écouter mes paroles, Qui suit les penchants de son coeur, Et qui va après d''autres dieux, Pour les servir et se prosterner devant eux, Qu''il devienne comme cette ceinture, Qui n''est plus bonne à rien!
verses.am: ቃሌን ይሰሙ ዘንድ እንቢ የሚሉ፥ በልባቸውም እልከኝነት የሚሄዱ፥ ያመልኩአቸውና ይሰግዱላቸው ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት የሚከተሉ እነዚህ ክፉ ሕዝብ አንዳች እንዳማትረባ እንደዚች መታጠቂያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the Lord; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
verses.fr: Car comme on attache la ceinture aux reins d''un homme, Ainsi je m''étais attaché toute la maison d''Israël Et toute la maison de Juda, dit l''Eternel, Afin qu''elles fussent mon peuple, Mon nom, ma louange, et ma gloire. Mais ils ne m''ont point écouté.
verses.am: መታጠቂያ በሰው ወገብ ላይ እንደምትጣበቅ፥ እንዲሁ ሕዝብና ስም ምስጋናና ክብር ይሆኑልኝ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ቤት ሁሉ የይሁዳንም ቤት ሁሉ ከእኔ ጋር አጣብቄአለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን አልሰሙም።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
verses.fr: Tu leur diras cette parole: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Tous les vases seront remplis de vin. Et ils te diront: Ne savons-nous pas Que tous les vases seront remplis de vin?
verses.am: ስለዚህ።የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ማድጋ ሁሉ የወይን ጠጅ ይሞላል ብለህ ትነግራቸዋለህ፤ እነርሱም። ማድጋ ሁሉ የወይን ጠጅ እንዲሞላ በውኑ እኛ አናውቅምን? ይሉሃል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.fr: Alors dis-leur: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je remplirai tous les habitants de ce pays, Les rois qui sont assis sur le trône de David, Les sacrificateurs, les prophètes, et tous les habitants de Jérusalem, Je les remplirai d''ivresse.
verses.am: አንተም እንዲህ ትላቸዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በዚህች ምድር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ፥ በዳዊት ዙፋን የሚቀመጡትን ነገሥታት ካህናቱንም ነቢያቱንም በኢየሩሳሌምም የተቀመጡትን ሁሉ በስካር እሞላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the Lord: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
verses.fr: Je les briserai les uns contre les autres, Les pères et les fils ensemble, dit l''Eternel; Je n''épargnerai pas, je n''aurai point de pitié, point de miséricorde, Rien ne m''empêchera de les détruire.
verses.am: ሰውንም በሰው ላይ፥ አባቶችንና ልጆችን በአንድ ላይ፥ እቀጠቅጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አጠፋቸዋለሁ እንጂ አልራራም፥ አላዝንም፥ አልምርም።

verses.en: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the Lord hath spoken.
verses.fr: Ecoutez et prêtez l''oreille! Ne soyez point orgueilleux! Car l''Eternel parle.
verses.am: ስሙ፥ አድምጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና አትታበዩ።

verses.en: Give glory to the Lord your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
verses.fr: Rendez gloire à l''Eternel, votre Dieu, Avant qu''il fasse venir les ténèbres, Avant que vos pieds heurtent contre les montagnes de la nuit; Vous attendrez la lumière, Et il la changera en ombre de la mort, Il la réduira en obscurité profonde.
verses.am: ሳትጨልም እግራችሁም በጨለመችው ተራራ ላይ ሳትሰናከል፥ በተስፋ የምትጠባበቁትን ብርሃን ለሞት ጥላና ለድቅድቅ ጨለማ ሳይለውጠው ለአምላካችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ስጡ።

verses.en: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the Lord's flock is carried away captive.
verses.fr: Si vous n''écoutez pas, Je pleurerai en secret, à cause de votre orgueil; Mes yeux fondront en larmes, Parce que le troupeau de l''Eternel sera emmené captif.
verses.am: ይህን ባትሰሙ ነፍሴ ስለ ትዕቢታችሁ በስውር ታለቅሳለች፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንጋ ተማርኮአልና ዓይኔ ታነባለች፥ እንባንም ታፈስሳለች።

verses.en: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
verses.fr: Dis au roi et à la reine: Asseyez-vous à terre! Car il est tombé de vos têtes, Le diadème qui vous servait d''ornement.
verses.am: ለንጉሡና ለንጉሥ እናት ለእቴጌይቱ። የክብራችሁ አክሊል ከራሳችሁ ወርዶአልና ተዋርዳችሁ ተቀመጡ በል።

verses.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.fr: Les villes du midi sont fermées, Il n''y a personne pour ouvrir; Tout Juda est emmené captif, Il est emmené tout entier captif.
verses.am: የደቡብ ከተሞች ተዘግተዋል፥ የሚከፍታቸውም የለም፤ ይሁዳ ሁሉ ተማርኮአል፥ ፈጽሞ ተማርኮአል።

verses.en: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
verses.fr: Lève tes yeux et regarde Ceux qui viennent du septentrion. Où est le troupeau qui t''avait été donné, Le troupeau qui faisait ta gloire?
verses.am: ዓይናችሁን አንሥታችሁ እነዚህን ከሰሜን የሚመጡትን ተመልከቱ፤ ለአንቺ የተሰጠ መንጋ፥ የተዋበ መንጋሽ፥ ወዴት አለ?

verses.en: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
verses.fr: Que diras-tu de ce qu''il te châtie? C''est toi-même qui leur as appris à te traiter en maîtres. Les douleurs ne te saisiront-elles pas, Comme elles saisissent une femme en travail?
verses.am: ወዳጆችሽ እንዲሆኑ ያስተማርሻቸውን በራስሽ ላይ አለቆች ባደረጋቸው ጊዜ ምን ትያለሽ? እንደ ወላድ ሴት ምጥ አይዝሽምን?

verses.en: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
verses.fr: Si tu dis en ton coeur: Pourquoi cela m''arrive-t-il? C''est à cause de la multitude de tes iniquités Que les pans de tes habits sont relevés, Et que tes talons sont violemment mis à nu.
verses.am: በልብሽም። እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ስለ ምን ደረሰብኝ? ብትዪ፥ ከኃጢአትሽ ብዛት የተነሣ የልብስሽ ዘርፍ ተገልጦአል ተረከዝሽም ተገፍፎአል።

verses.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verses.fr: Un Ethiopien peut-il changer sa peau, Et un léopard ses taches? De même, pourriez-vous faire le bien, Vous qui êtes accoutumés à faire le mal?
verses.am: በውኑ ኢትዮጵያዊ መልኩን ወይስ ነብር ዝንጕርጕርነትን ይለውጥ ዘንድ ይችላልን? በዚያን ጊዜ ክፋትን የለመዳችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ በጎ ለማድረግ ትችላላችሁ።

verses.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.fr: Je les disperserai, comme la paille emportée Par le vent du désert.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እንደሚያልፍ እብቅ በምድረ በዳ ነፋስ እበትናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the Lord; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
verses.fr: Voilà ton sort, la part que je te mesure, Dit l''Eternel, Parce que tu m''as oublié, Et que tu as mis ta confiance dans le mensonge.
verses.am: ረስተሽኛልና፥ በሐሰትም ታምነሻልና ዕጣሽ የለካሁልሽም እድል ፈንታ ይህ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
verses.fr: Je relèverai tes pans jusque sur ton visage, Afin qu''on voie ta honte.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የልብስሽን ዘርፍ በፊትሽ እገልጣለሁ እፍረትሽም ይታያል።

verses.en: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
verses.fr: J''ai vu tes adultères et tes hennissements, Tes criminelles prostitutions sur les collines et dans les champs, J''ai vu tes abominations. Malheur à toi, Jérusalem! Jusques à quand tarderas-tu à te purifier?
verses.am: አስጸያፊ ሥራሽን፥ ምንዝርናሽን፥ ማሽካካትሽን፥ የግልሙትናሽንም መዳራት በኮረብቶች ላይ በሜዳም አይቻለሁ። ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ወዮልሽ! ለመንጻት እንቢ ብለሻል፤ ይህስ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie par l''Eternel, à l''occasion de la sécheresse.
verses.am: ወደ ኤርምያስ ስለ ድርቅ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
verses.fr: Juda est dans le deuil, Ses villes sont désolées, tristes, abattues, Et les cris de Jérusalem s''élèvent.
verses.am: ይሁዳ አለቀሰች፥ ደጆችዋም ባዶ ሆኑ በምድርም ላይ ጨለሙ፤ የኢየሩሳሌም ጩኸት ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአል።

verses.en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
verses.fr: Les grands envoient les petits chercher de l''eau, Et les petits vont aux citernes, ne trouvent point d''eau, Et retournent avec leurs vases vides; Confus et honteux, ils se couvrent la tête.
verses.am: ታላላቆችም ብላቴኖቻቸውን ወደ ውኃ ሰደዱ፤ ወደ ጕድጓድ መጡ ውኃም አላገኙም፥ ዕቃቸውንም ባዶውን ይዘው ተመለሱ፤ አፈሩም ተዋረዱም ራሳቸውንም ተከናነቡ።

verses.en: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
verses.fr: La terre est saisie d''épouvante, Parce qu''il ne tombe point de pluie dans le pays, Et les laboureurs confus se couvrent la tête.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ አልዘነበምና መሬቱ ስንጥቅጥቅ ስለሆነ አራሾች አፈሩ ራሳቸውንም ተከናነቡ።

verses.en: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
verses.fr: Même la biche dans la campagne Met bas et abandonne sa portée, Parce qu''il n''y a point de verdure.
verses.am: ዋላ ደግሞ በምድረ በዳ ወለደች፥ ሣርም የለምና ግልገልዋን ተወች።

verses.en: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
verses.fr: Les ânes sauvages se tiennent sur les lieux élevés, Aspirant l''air comme des serpents; Leurs yeux languissent, parce qu''il n''y a point d''herbe.
verses.am: የሜዳ አህዮችም በወና ኮረብታ ላይ ቆመዋል፥ እንደ ቀበሮም ወደ ነፋስ አለከለኩ፤ ልምላሜም የለምና ዓይኖቻቸው ጠወለጉ።

verses.en: O Lord, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
verses.fr: Si nos iniquités témoignent contre nous, Agis à cause de ton nom, ô Eternel! Car nos infidélités sont nombreuses, Nous avons péché contre toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአታችን ብዙ ነውና፥ በአንተም ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና ኃጢአታችን ይመሰክርብናል ነገር ግን ስለ ስምህ ብለህ አድርግ።

verses.en: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
verses.fr: Toi qui es l''espérance d''Israël, Son sauveur au temps de la détresse, Pourquoi serais-tu comme un étranger dans le pays, Comme un voyageur qui y entre pour passer la nuit?
verses.am: አንተ የእስራኤል ተስፋ ሆይ በመከራም ጊዜ የምታድነው፥ በምድር እንደ እንግዳ፥ ወደ ማደሪያ ዘወር እንደሚል መንገደኛ ስለ ምን ትሆናለህ?

verses.en: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O Lord, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
verses.fr: Pourquoi serais-tu comme un homme stupéfait, Comme un héros incapable de nous secourir? Tu es pourtant au milieu de nous, ô Eternel, Et ton nom est invoqué sur nous: Ne nous abandonne pas!
verses.am: እንዳንቀላፋ ሰው ሰው፥ ያድንም ዘንድ እንደማይችል ኃያል ስለ ምን ትሆናለህ? አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ በመካከላችን ነህ እኛም በስምህ ተጠርተናል፤ አትተወን።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the Lord doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
verses.fr: Voici ce que l''Eternel dit de ce peuple: Ils aiment à courir çà et là, Ils ne savent retenir leurs pieds; L''Eternel n''a point d''attachement pour eux, Il se souvient maintenant de leurs crimes, Et il châtie leurs péchés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዚህ ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላል። መቅበዝበዝን ወድደዋል እግራቸውንም አልከለከሉም፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በእነርሱ ደስ አይለውም፥ በደላቸውንም አሁን ያስባል ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: N''intercède pas en faveur de ce peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ ስለ መልካም አትጸልይላቸው።

verses.en: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.fr: S''ils jeûnent, je n''écouterai pas leurs supplications; S''ils offrent des holocaustes et des offrandes, je ne les agréerai pas; Car je veux les détruire par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste.
verses.am: በጾሙ ጊዜ ጸሎታቸውን አልሰማም፤ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን ባቀረቡ ጊዜ አልቀበላቸውም፤ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም አጠፋቸዋለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
verses.fr: Je répondis: Ah! Seigneur Eternel! Voici, les prophètes leur disent: Vous ne verrez point d''épée, Vous n''aurez point de famine; Mais je vous donnerai dans ce lieu une paix assurée.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እነሆ፥ ነቢያት። በእውነት ሰላምን በዚህ ስፍራ እሰጣችኋለሁ እንጂ ሰይፍን አታዩም፥ ራብም አያገኛችሁም ይሉአቸዋል አልሁ።

verses.en: Then the Lord said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel me dit: C''est le mensonge que prophétisent en mon nom les prophètes; Je ne les ai point envoyés, je ne leur ai point donné d''ordre, Je ne leur ai point parlé; Ce sont des visions mensongères, de vaines prédictions, Des tromperies de leur coeur, qu''ils vous prophétisent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ነቢያቱ ውሸት በስሜ ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፤ አላክኋቸውም፥ አላዘዝኋቸውም፥ አልተናገርኋቸውም፤ የውሸቱን ራእይ ምዋርትንም ከንቱንም ነገር የልባቸውንም ሽንገላ ይሰብኩላችኋል።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel Sur les prophètes qui prophétisent en mon nom, Sans que je les aie envoyés, Et qui disent: Il n''y aura dans ce pays ni épée ni famine: Ces prophètes périront par l''épée et par la famine.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በስሜ ትንቢት ስለሚናገሩ ነቢያት። በዚህች አገር ሰይፍና ራብ አይሆንም ስለሚሉ ስላላክኋቸው ነቢያት እንዲህ ይላል። እነዚያ በሰይፍና በራብ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
verses.fr: Et ceux à qui ils prophétisent Seront étendus dans les rues de Jérusalem, Par la famine et par l''épée; Il n''y aura personne pour leur donner la sépulture, Ni à eux, ni à leurs femmes, ni à leurs fils, ni à leurs filles; Je répandrai sur eux leur méchanceté.
verses.am: ትንቢት የሚናገሩላቸውም ሰዎች ከራብና ከሰይፍ የተነሣ በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ይበተናሉ፤ ክፋታቸውንም አፈስስባቸዋለሁ እነርሱንና ሚስቶቻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም የሚቀብራቸው አይገኝም።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
verses.fr: Dis-leur cette parole: Les larmes coulent de mes yeux nuit et jour, Et elles ne s''arrêtent pas; Car la vierge, fille de mon peuple, a été frappée d''un grand coup, D''une plaie très douloureuse.
verses.am: እንደዚህም ብለህ ትነግራቸዋለህ። የወገኔ ልጅ ድንግሊቱ በታላቅ ስብራትና እጅግ ክፉ በሆነ ቍስል ተሰብራለችና ዓይኖቼ ሌሊትና ቀን ሳያቋርጡ እንባ ያፈሳሉ።

verses.en: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
verses.fr: Si je vais dans les champs, voici des hommes que le glaive a percés; Si j''entre dans la ville, voici des êtres que consume la faim; Le prophète même et le sacrificateur parcourent le pays, Sans savoir où ils vont.
verses.am: ወደ ሜዳ ብወጣ፥ እነሆ፥ በሰይፍ የሞቱ አሉ፤ ወደ ከተማም ብገባ፥ እነሆ፥ በራብ የከሱ አሉ፤ ነቢዩና ካህኑም ወደማያውቋት አገር ሄደዋልና።

verses.en: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
verses.fr: As-tu donc rejeté Juda, Et ton âme a-t-elle pris Sion en horreur? Pourquoi nous frappes-tu Sans qu''il y ait pour nous de guérison? Nous espérions la paix, et il n''arrive rien d''heureux, Un temps de guérison, et voici la terreur!
verses.am: በውኑ ይሁዳን ፈጽመህ ጥለኸዋልን? ነፍስህስ ጽዮንን ጠልታታለችን? ስለ ምን መታኸን? ፈውስስ ስለ ምን የለንም? ሰላምን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ መልካምም አልተገኘም፤ ፈውስን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ እነሆም፥ ድንጋጤ ሆነ።

verses.en: We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
verses.fr: Eternel, nous reconnaissons notre méchanceté, l''iniquité de nos pères; Car nous avons péché contre toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ላይ ኃጢአትን ሠርተናልና ክፋታችንንና የአባቶቻችንን በደል እናውቃለን።

verses.en: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
verses.fr: A cause de ton nom, ne méprise pas, Ne déshonore pas le trône de ta gloire! N''oublie pas, ne romps pas ton alliance avec nous!
verses.am: ስለ ስምህ ብለህ አትናቀን፥ የክብርህንም ዙፋን አታስነውር፤ ከእኛ ጋርም ያደረግኸውን ቃል ኪዳንህን አስብ እንጂ አታፍርስ።

verses.en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O Lord our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.
verses.fr: Parmi les idoles des nations, en est-il qui fassent pleuvoir? Ou est-ce le ciel qui donne la pluie? N''est-ce pas toi, Eternel, notre Dieu? Nous espérons en toi, Car c''est toi qui as fait toutes ces choses.
verses.am: በውኑ በአሕዛብ ጣዖታት መካከል ያዘንብ ዘንድ የሚችል ይገኛልን? ወይስ ሰማይ ዝናብ ማፍሰስ ይችላልን? አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ አንተ አይደለህምን? አንተ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ አድርገሃልና ስለዚህ አንተን በተስፋ እንጠባበቃለን።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Quand Moïse et Samuel se présenteraient devant moi, Je ne serais pas favorable à ce peuple. Chasse-le loin de ma face, qu''il s''en aille!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደዚህ አለኝ። ሙሴና ሳሙኤል በፊቴ ቢቆሙም፥ ልቤ ወደዚህ ሕዝብ አይዘነብልም፤ ከፊቴ ጣላቸው፤ ይውጡ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the Lord; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
verses.fr: Et s''ils te disent: Où irons-nous? Tu leur répondras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: A la mort ceux qui sont pour la mort, A l''épée ceux qui sont pour l''épée, A la famine ceux qui sont pour la famine, A la captivité ceux qui sont pour la captivité!
verses.am: እነርሱም። ወዴት እንውጣ ቢሉህ፥ አንተ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለሞት የሆነ ወደ ሞት፥ ለሰይፍም የሆነ ወደ ሰይፍ፥ ለራብም የሆነ ወደ ራብ፥ ለምርኮም የሆነ ወደ ምርኮ ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the Lord: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
verses.fr: J''enverrai contre eux quatre espèces de fléaux, dit l''Eternel, L''épée pour les tuer, Les chiens pour les traîner, Les oiseaux du ciel et les bêtes de la terre Pour les dévorer et les détruire.
verses.am: ሰይፍን ለመግደል ውሾችንም ለመጐተት የሰማያትንም ወፎች የምድርንም አራዊት ለመብላትና ለማጥፋት፥ አራቱን ዓይነት ጥፋት አዝዝባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Je les rendrai un objet d''effroi pour tous les royaumes de la terre, A cause de Manassé, fils d''Ezéchias, roi de Juda, Et de tout ce qu''il a fait dans Jérusalem.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ የሕዝቅያስ ልጅ ምናሴ በኢየሩሳሌም ስላደረገው ሁሉ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ መካከል ለመከራ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
verses.fr: Qui aura pitié de toi, Jérusalem, Qui te plaindra? Qui ira s''informer de ton état?
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ የሚራራልሽ ማን ነው? የሚያዝንልሽስ ማን ነው? ወይስ ስለ ደኅንነትሽ ይጠይቅ ዘንድ ፈቀቅ የሚል ማነ ነው?

verses.en: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the Lord, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
verses.fr: Tu m''as abandonné, dit l''Eternel, tu es allée en arrière; Mais j''étends ma main sur toi, et je te détruis, Je suis las d''avoir compassion.
verses.am: አንቺ እኔን ጥለሻል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ወደ ኋላሽም ተመልሰሻል፤ ስለዚህ እጄን በአንቺ ላይ ዘርግቼ አጥፍቼሻለሁ፤ ከይቅርታ ደክሜአለሁ።

verses.en: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people since they return not from their ways.
verses.fr: Je les vanne avec le vent aux portes du pays; Je prive d''enfants, je fais périr mon peuple, Qui ne s''est pas détourné de ses voies.
verses.am: በአገርም ደጆች ውስጥ በመንሽ አበጥሬአቸዋለሁ፤ የወላድ መካን አድርጌአቸዋለሁ፥ ሕዝቤንም አጥፍቼአለሁ፤ ከመንገዳቸውም አልተመለሱም።

verses.en: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
verses.fr: Ses veuves sont plus nombreuses que les grains de sable de la mer; J''amène sur eux, sur la mère du jeune homme, Le dévastateur en plein midi; Je fais soudain tomber sur elle l''angoisse et la terreur.
verses.am: መበለቶቻቸውም ከባሕር አሸዋ ይልቅ በዝተውብኛል፤ በብላቴኖች እናት ላይ በቀትር ጊዜ አጥፊውን አምጥቻለሁ፤ ጣርንና ድንጋጤን በድንገት አምጥቼባታለሁ።
