verses.en: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Celle qui avait enfanté sept fils est désolée, Elle rend l''âme; Son soleil se couche quand il est encore jour; Elle est confuse, couverte de honte. Ceux qui restent, je les livre à l''épée devant leurs ennemis, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰባት የወለደች ደክማለች፥ ነፍስዋንም አውጥታለች፤ ቀን ገና ሳለ ፀሐይዋ ገብታባታለች፤ አፍራለች ተዋርዳማለች፤ የተረፉትንም በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት ለሰይፍ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.
verses.fr: Malheur à moi, ma mère, de ce que tu m''as fait naître Homme de dispute et de querelle pour tout le pays! Je n''emprunte ni ne prête, Et cependant tous me maudissent.
verses.am: እናቴ ሆይ፥ ወዮልኝ! ለምድር ሁሉ የክርክርና የጥል ሰው የሆንሁትን ወለድሽኝ ለማንም አላበደርሁም፥ ማንም ለእኔ አላበደረም፥ ነገር ግን ሁሉ ይረግመኛል።

verses.en: The Lord said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Certes, tu auras un avenir heureux; Certes, je forcerai l''ennemi à t''adresser ses supplications, Au temps du malheur et au temps de la détresse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። በእውነት ለደኅንነትህ አጸናሃለሁ፤ በእውነት በመከራና በጭንቅ ጊዜ ጠላትህ እንዲለምንህ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
verses.fr: Le fer brisera-t-il le fer du septentrion et l''airain?
verses.am: በውኑ ብረትን፥ የሰሜንን ብረት፥ ናስንም የሚሰብር አለን?

verses.en: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
verses.fr: Je livre gratuitement au pillage tes biens et tes trésors, A cause de tous tes péchés, sur tout ton territoire.
verses.am: በዳርቻህ ሁሉ ስላለ ኃጢአትህ ሁሉ ባለጠግነትህንና መዝገብህን ለመበዝበዝ በከንቱ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.
verses.fr: Je te fais passer avec ton ennemi dans un pays que tu ne connais pas, Car le feu de ma colère s''est allumé, Il brûle sur vous.
verses.am: የምታቃጥላችሁ እሳት ከቍጣዬ ትነድዳለችና ከጠላቶችህ ጋር ወደማታውቀው ምድር አሳልፍሃለሁ።

verses.en: O Lord, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
verses.fr: Tu sais tout, ô Eternel, souviens-toi de moi, ne m''oublie pas, Venge-moi de mes persécuteurs! Ne m''enlève pas, tandis que tu te montres lent à la colère! Sache que je supporte l''opprobre à cause de toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ አስበኝ ጐብኘኝም የሚያሳድዱኝንም ተበቀላቸው እንጂ አትታገሣቸው፤ ስለ አንተ ስድብን እንደ ታገሥሁ እወቅ።

verses.en: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O Lord God of hosts.
verses.fr: J''ai recueilli tes paroles, et je les ai dévorées; Tes paroles ont fait la joie et l''allégresse de mon coeur; Car ton nom est invoqué sur moi, Eternel, Dieu des armées!
verses.am: ቃልህ ተገኝቶአል እኔም በልቼዋለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ በስምህ ተጠርቻለሁና ቃልህ ሐሤትና የልብ ደስታ ሆነኝ።

verses.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
verses.fr: Je ne me suis point assis dans l''assemblée des moqueurs, afin de m''y réjouir; Mais à cause de ta puissance, je me suis assis solitaire, Car tu me remplissais de fureur.
verses.am: በዋዘኞችና በደስተኞች ጉባኤ አልተቀመጥሁም፤ ቍጣን ሞልተህብኛልና በእጅህ ፊት ለብቻዬ ተቀመጥሁ።

verses.en: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
verses.fr: Pourquoi ma souffrance est-elle continuelle? Pourquoi ma plaie est-elle douloureuse, et ne veut-elle pas se guérir? Serais-tu pour moi comme une source trompeuse, Comme une eau dont on n''est pas sûr?
verses.am: ስለ ምን ሕመሜ አዘወተረኝ? ቍስሌስ ስለ ምን የማይፈወስ ሆነ? ስለ ምንስ። አልሽርም አለ? በውኑ እንደ ሐሰተኛ ምንጭ፥ እንዳልታመነች ውኃ ትሆነኛለህን?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Si tu te rattaches à moi, je te répondrai, et tu te tiendras devant moi; Si tu sépares ce qui est précieux de ce qui est vil, tu seras comme ma bouche. C''est à eux de revenir à toi, Mais ce n''est pas à toi de retourner vers eux.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ብትመለስ እመልስሃለሁ በፊቴም ትቆማለህ፤ የከበረውንም ከተዋረደው ብትለይ እንደ አፌ ትሆናለህ፤ እነርሱ ወደ አንተ ይመለሳሉ፥ አንተ ግን ወደ እነርሱ አትመለስም።

verses.en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je te rendrai pour ce peuple comme une forte muraille d''airain; Ils te feront la guerre, mais ils ne te vaincront pas; Car je serai avec toi pour te sauver et te délivrer, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለዚህም ሕዝብ የተመሸገ የናስ ቅጥር አደርግሃለሁ፤ ይዋጉሃል እኔ ግን ለማዳን ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አያሸንፉህም።

verses.en: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
verses.fr: Je te délivrerai de la main des méchants, Je te sauverai de la main des violents.
verses.am: ከክፉ ሰዎችም እጅ እታደግሃለሁ፥ ከጨካኞችም ጡጫ እቤዥሃለሁ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord came also unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.fr: Tu ne prendras point de femme, Et tu n''auras dans ce lieu ni fils ni filles.
verses.am: በዚህ ስፍራ ሚስት አታግባ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችም አይሁኑልህ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel sur les fils et les filles Qui naîtront en ce lieu, Sur leurs mères qui les auront enfantés, Et sur leurs pères qui les auront engendrés dans ce pays:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ስፍራ ስለ ተወለዱ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች፥ ስለወለዱአቸውም ስለ እናቶቻቸው፥ በዚህችም ምድር ስለ ወለዱአቸው ስለ አባቶቻቸው እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.fr: Ils mourront consumés par la maladie; On ne leur donnera ni larmes ni sépulture; Ils seront comme du fumier sur la terre; Ils périront par l''épée et par la famine; Et leurs cadavres serviront de pâture Aux oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes de la terre.
verses.am: በክፉ ሞት ይሞታሉ፤ አይለቀስላቸውም አይቀበሩምም፥ በመሬትም ላይ እንደ ጕድፍ ይሆናሉ፤ በሰይፍና በራብ ይጠፋሉ፥ ሬሳቸውም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the Lord, even lovingkindness and mercies.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: N''entre pas dans une maison de deuil, N''y va pas pleurer, te lamenter avec eux; Car j''ai retiré à ce peuple ma paix, dit l''Eternel, Ma bonté et ma miséricorde.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰላሜን፥ ቸርነትና ምሕረትን፥ ከዚህ ሕዝብ አስወግጄአለሁና ልቅሶ ወዳለበት ቤት አትግባ፥ ታለቅስም ታዝንም ዘንድ አትሂድ።

verses.en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
verses.fr: Grands et petits mourront dans ce pays; On ne leur donnera point de sépulture; On ne les pleurera point, On ne se fera point d''incision, Et l''on ne se rasera pas pour eux.
verses.am: ታላላቆችና ታናናሾች በዚህች ምድር ይሞታሉ፤ አይቀበሩም ሰዎችም አያለቅሱላቸውም ስለ እነርሱም ገላን አይነጩላቸውም ራስንም አይላጩላቸውም፤

verses.en: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
verses.fr: On ne rompra pas le pain dans le deuil Pour consoler quelqu''un au sujet d''un mort, Et l''on n''offrira pas la coupe de consolation Pour un père ou pour une mère.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ስለ ሞቱት ለማጽናናት የእዝን እንጀራ አይቈርሱላቸውም፥ ስለ አባታቸውና ስለ እናታቸውም የመጽናናት ጽዋ አያጠጡአቸውም።

verses.en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
verses.fr: N''entre pas non plus dans une maison de festin, Pour t''asseoir avec eux, Pour manger et pour boire.
verses.am: ትበላና ትጠጣ ዘንድ ከእነርሱ ጋር ለመቀመጥ ወደ ግብዣ ቤት አትግባ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je ferai cesser dans ce lieu, sous vos yeux et de vos jours, Les cris de réjouissance et les cris d''allégresse, Les chants du fiancé et les chants de la fiancée.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በዓይናችሁ ፊት በዘመናችሁም የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ ከዚህ ስፍራ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the Lord our God?
verses.fr: Lorsque tu annonceras à ce peuple toutes ces choses, Ils te diront: Pourquoi l''Eternel nous menace-t-il de tous ces grands malheurs? Quelle est notre iniquité? Quel péché avons-nous commis contre l''Eternel, notre Dieu?
verses.am: ለዚህም ሕዝብ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በተናገርህ ጊዜ። ይህን ሁሉ ታላቅ የሆነ ክፉ ነገርን ስለ ምን እግዚአብሔር ተናገረብን? በደላችንስ ምንድር ነው? በአምላካችንስ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ የሠራነው ኃጢአታችን ምንድር ነው? ቢሉህ፥

verses.en: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the Lord, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
verses.fr: Alors tu leur répondras: Vos pères m''ont abandonné, dit l''Eternel, Ils sont allés après d''autres dieux, Ils les ont servis et se sont prosternés devant eux; Ils m''ont abandonné, et n''ont point observé ma loi.
verses.am: አንተ እንዲህ ትላቸዋለህ። አባቶቻችሁ እኔን ስለ ተው ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት ተከተሉ አመለኩአቸውም ሰገዱላቸውም፥ እነርሱም ትተውኛል፥ ሕጌንም አልጠበቁም

verses.en: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
verses.fr: Et vous, vous avez fait le mal plus encore que vos pères; Et voici, vous suivez chacun les penchants de votre mauvais coeur, Pour ne point m''écouter.
verses.am: እናንተም ከአባቶቻችሁ ይልቅ ክፉ አድርጋችኋል፤ እነሆም፥ ሁላችሁ እንደ ክፉ ልባችሁ እልከኝነት ሄዳችኋል እኔንም አልሰማችሁም።

verses.en: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
verses.fr: Je vous transporterai de ce pays Dans un pays que vous n''avez point connu, Ni vous, ni vos pères; Et là, vous servirez les autres dieux jour et nuit, Car je ne vous accorderai point de grâce.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከዚህች ምድር እናንተና አባቶቻችሁ ወዳላወቃችኋት ምድር እጥላችኋለሁ፤ ምሕረትንም አላደርግላችሁምና በዚያ ሌሎችን አማልክት ቀንና ሌሊት ታመልካላችሁ።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où l''on ne dira plus: L''Eternel est vivant, Lui qui a fait monter du pays d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.fr: Mais on dira: L''Eternel est vivant, Lui qui a fait monter les enfants d''Israël du pays du septentrion Et de tous les pays où il les avait chassés! Je les ramènerai dans leur pays, Que j''avais donné à leurs pères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን።የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከሰሜን ምድር ካሳደዳቸውም ምድር ሁሉ ያወጣ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ይባላል፤ እኔም ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠኋት ወደ ምድራቸው እመልሳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.fr: Voici, j''envoie une multitude de pêcheurs, dit l''Eternel, et ils les pêcheront; Et après cela j''enverrai une multitude de chasseurs, et ils les chasseront De toutes les montagnes et de toutes les collines, Et des fentes des rochers.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ብዙ ዓሣ አጥማጆችን እሰድዳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እነርሱም ያጠምዱአቸዋል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ብዙ አዳኞችን እሰድዳለሁ፥ እነርሱም ከየተራራውና ከየኮረብታው ሁሉ ከየድንጋዩም ስንጣቂ ውስጥ ያድኑአቸዋል።

verses.en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
verses.fr: Car mes yeux sont attentifs à toutes leurs voies, Elles ne sont point cachées devant ma face, Et leur iniquité ne se dérobe point à mes regards.
verses.am: ዓይኔ በመንገዳቸው ሁሉ ላይ ነው፤ ከፊቴም አልተሰወሩም፥ ኃጢአታቸውም ከዓይኔ አልተሸሸገም።

verses.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
verses.fr: Je leur donnerai d''abord le double salaire de leur iniquité et de leur péché, Parce qu''ils ont profané mon pays, Parce qu''ils ont rempli mon héritage Des cadavres de leurs idoles et de leurs abominations.
verses.am: ምድሬንም በተጠሉ በጣዖቶቻቸው ሬሳዎች አርክሰዋልና፥ ርስቴንም አስጸያፊ በሆኑ ነገሮች ሞልተዋልና አስቀድሜ የበደላቸውንና የኃጢአታቸውን ዕዳ ሁለት እጥፍ እከፍላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: O Lord, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
verses.fr: Eternel, ma force et mon appui, mon refuge au jour de la détresse! Les nations viendront à toi des extrémités de la terre, Et elles diront: Nos pères n''ont hérité que le mensonge, De vaines idoles, qui ne servent à rien.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃይሌ፥ አምባዬ፥ በመከራም ቀን መጠጊያዬ ሆይ፥ ከምድር ዳርቻ አሕዛብ ወደ አንተ መጥተው። በእውነት አባቶቻችን ውሸትንና ከንቱን ነገር የማይረባቸውንም ወርሰዋል ይላሉ።

verses.en: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
verses.fr: L''homme peut-il se faire des dieux, Qui ne sont pas des dieux? -
verses.am: በውኑ ሰው አማልክት ያልሆኑትን ለራሱ አማልክትን አድርጎ ይሠራልን?

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, je leur fais connaître, cette fois, Je leur fais connaître ma puissance et ma force; Et ils sauront que mon nom est l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አስታውቃቸዋለሁ፥ በዚህች ጊዜ እጄንና ኃይሌን አስታውቃቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ስሜ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.fr: Le péché de Juda est écrit avec un burin de fer, Avec une pointe de diamant; Il est gravé sur la table de leur coeur, Et sur les cornes de vos autels.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ኃጢአት በብረት ብርዕና በተሾለ ዕብነ አልማዝ ተጽፎአል፤ በልባቸው ጽላትና በመሠዊያቸው ቀንዶች ተቀርጾአል።

verses.en: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.fr: Comme ils pensent à leurs enfants, ainsi pensent-ils à leurs autels Et à leurs idoles d''Astarté près des arbres verts, Sur les collines élevées.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውም ከለመለሙ ዛፎች በታችና በረዘሙት ኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉትን መሠዊያቸውንና የማምለኪያ ዐፀዳቸውን ያስባሉ።

verses.en: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.fr: Je livre au pillage ma montagne et ses champs, tes biens, tous tes trésors, Et tes hauts lieux, à cause de tes péchés, sur tout ton territoire.
verses.am: በሜዳ ያለው ተራራዬ ሆይ፥ ባለጠግነትህንና መዝገብህን ሁሉ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችህም ስለ ኃጢአት በድንበሮችህ ሁሉ ለመበዝበዝ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
verses.fr: Tu perdras par ta faute l''héritage que je t''avais donné; Je t''asservirai à ton ennemi dans un pays que tu ne connais pas; Car vous avez allumé le feu de ma colère, Et il brûlera toujours.
verses.am: አንተም የሰጠሁህን ርስት ትለቅቃለህ ለዘላለምም በማታውቃትም ምድር ለጠላቶቻችሁ ባሪያ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ለዘላለም የሚነድደውን እሳት በቍጣዬ አንድዳችኋልና።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Maudit soit l''homme qui se confie dans l''homme, Qui prend la chair pour son appui, Et qui détourne son coeur de l''Eternel!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በሰው የሚታመን ሥጋ ለባሹንም ክንዱ የሚያደርግ ልቡም ከእግዚአብሔር የሚመለስ ሰው ርጉም ነው።

verses.en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.fr: Il est comme un misérable dans le désert, Et il ne voit point arriver le bonheur; Il habite les lieux brûlés du désert, Une terre salée et sans habitants.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ቍጥቋጦ ይሆናል፥ መልካምም በመጣ ጊዜ አያይም፤ ሰውም በሌለበት፥ ጨው ባለበት ምድር በምድረ በዳ በደርቅ ስፍራ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''homme qui se confie dans l''Eternel, Et dont l''Eternel est l''espérance!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር የታመነ እምነቱም እግዚአብሔር የሆነ ሰው ቡሩክ ነው።

verses.en: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.fr: Il est comme un arbre planté près des eaux, Et qui étend ses racines vers le courant; Il n''aperçoit point la chaleur quand elle vient, Et son feuillage reste vert; Dans l''année de la sécheresse, il n''a point de crainte, Et il ne cesse de porter du fruit.
verses.am: በውኃ አጠገብ እንደ ተተከለ፥ በወንዝም ዳር ሥሩን እንደሚዘረጋ ሙቀትም ሲመጣ እንደማይፈራ ቅጠሉም እንደሚለመልም፥ በድርቅ ዓመትም እንደማይሠጋ ፍሬውንም እንደማያቋርጥ ዛፍ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verses.fr: Le coeur est tortueux par-dessus tout, et il est méchant: Qui peut le connaître?
verses.am: የሰው ልብ ከሁሉ ይልቅ ተንኰለኛ እጅግም ክፉ ነው፤ ማንስ ያውቀዋል?

verses.en: I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.fr: Moi, l''Eternel, j''éprouve le coeur, je sonde les reins, Pour rendre à chacun selon ses voies, Selon le fruit de ses oeuvres.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ሁሉ እንደ መንገዱ፥ እንደ ሥራው ፍሬ እሰጥ ዘንድ ልብን እመረምራለሁ ኵላሊትንም እፈትናለሁ።

verses.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verses.fr: Comme une perdrix qui couve des oeufs qu''elle n''a point pondus, Tel est celui qui acquiert des richesses injustement; Au milieu de ses jours il doit les quitter, Et à la fin il n''est qu''un insensé.
verses.am: ያልወለደችውን እንደምታቅፍ ቆቅ፥ እንዲሁ በቅን ሳይሆን ባለጠግነትን የሚሰበስብ ሰው ነው፤ በእኩሌታ ዘመኑ ይተወዋል፥ በፍጻሜውም ሰነፍ ይሆናል።

verses.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.fr: Il est un trône de gloire, élevé dès le commencement, C''est le lieu de notre sanctuaire.
verses.am: የመቅደሳችን ስፍራ ከጥንት ጀምሮ ክፍ ያለ የክብር ዙፋን ነው።

verses.en: O Lord, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living waters.
verses.fr: Toi qui es l''espérance d''Israël, ô Eternel! Tous ceux qui t''abandonnent seront confondus. -Ceux qui se détournent de moi seront inscrits sur la terre, Car ils abandonnent la source d''eau vive, l''Eternel.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የእስራኤል ተስፋ ሆይ፥ የሚተዉህ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፤ ከአንተም የሚለዩ የሕይወትን ውኃ ምንጭ እግዚአብሔርን ትተዋልና በምድር ላይ ይጻፋሉ።

verses.en: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
verses.fr: Guéris-moi, Eternel, et je serai guéri; Sauve-moi, et je serai sauvé; Car tu es ma gloire.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈውሰኝ እኔም እፈወሳለሁ፤ አድነኝ እኔም እድናለሁ፤ አንተ ምስጋናዬ ነህና።

verses.en: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the Lord? let it come now.
verses.fr: Voici, ils me disent: Où est la parole de l''Eternel? Qu''elle s''accomplisse donc!
verses.am: እነሆ። የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወዴት አለች? አሁን ትምጣ ይሉኛል።

verses.en: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
verses.fr: Et moi, pour t''obéir, je n''ai pas refusé d''être pasteur; Je n''ai pas non plus désiré le jour du malheur, tu le sais; Ce qui est sorti de mes lèvres a été découvert devant toi.
verses.am: እኔም አንተን ተከትዬ እረኛ ከመሆን አልቸኰልሁም፥ የመከራንም ቀን አልወደድሁም፤ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ ከከንፈሬ የወጣው በፊትህ ነበረ።

verses.en: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
verses.fr: Ne sois pas pour moi un sujet d''effroi, Toi, mon refuge au jour du malheur!
verses.am: ለማስፈራራት አትሁንብኝ፤ በመከራ ቀን አንተ መጠጊያዬ ነህ።

verses.en: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.fr: Que mes persécuteurs soient confus, et que je ne sois pas confus; Qu''ils tremblent, et que je ne tremble pas, moi! Fais venir sur eux le jour du malheur, Frappe-les d''une double plaie!
verses.am: አሳዳጆቼ ይፈሩ፥ እኔ ግን አልፈር፤ እነርሱ ይደንግጡ፥ እኔ ግን አልደንግጥ፤ ክፉንም ቀን አምጣባቸው፥ በሁለት እጥፍ ጥፋት አጥፋቸው።

verses.en: Thus said the Lord unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.fr: Ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel: Va, et tiens-toi à la porte des enfants du peuple, par laquelle entrent et sortent les rois de Juda, et à toutes les portes de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። ሂድ፥ የይሁዳም ነገሥታት በሚገቡበትና በሚወጡበት በሕዝቡ ልጆች በር በኢየሩሳሌምም በሮች ሁሉ ቁም፤

verses.en: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the Lord, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.fr: Tu leur diras: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, rois de Juda, et tout Juda, et vous tous, habitants de Jérusalem, qui entrez par ces portes!
verses.am: እንዲህም በላቸው። በእነዚህ በሮች የምትገቡ፥ እናንተ የይሁዳ ነገሥታት፥ ይሁዳም ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Prenez garde à vos âmes; Ne portez point de fardeau le jour du sabbat, Et n''en introduisez point par les portes de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፥ በሰንበትም ቀን ሸክም አትሸከሙ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሮች አታግቡ፥

verses.en: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.fr: Ne sortez de vos maisons aucun fardeau le jour du sabbat, Et ne faites aucun ouvrage; Mais sanctifiez le jour du sabbat, Comme je l''ai ordonné à vos pères.
verses.am: ከቤቶቻችሁም በሰንበት ቀን ሸክምን አታውጡ፥ ሥራንም ሁሉ አትሥሩበት፤ አባቶቻችሁንም እንዳዘዝሁ የሰንበትን ቀን ቀድሱ።

verses.en: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.fr: Ils n''ont pas écouté, ils n''ont pas prêté l''oreille; Ils ont raidi leur cou, Pour ne point écouter et ne point recevoir instruction.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውን አላዘነበሉም፥ እንዳይሰሙና እንዳይገሠጹም አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the Lord, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.fr: Si vous m''écoutez, dit l''Eternel, Si vous n''introduisez point de fardeau Par les portes de cette ville le jour du sabbat, Si vous sanctifiez le jour du sabbat, Et ne faites aucun ouvrage ce jour-là,
verses.am: እኔን ፈጽሞ ብትሰሙ፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በሰንበትም ቀን በዚህች ከተማ በሮች ሸክም ባታገቡ፥ የሰንበትንም ቀን ብትቀድሱ ሥራንም ሁሉ ባትሠሩበት፥

verses.en: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.fr: Alors entreront par les portes de cette ville Les rois et les princes assis sur le trône de David, Montés sur des chars et sur des chevaux, Eux et leurs princes, les hommes de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem, Et cette ville sera habitée à toujours.
verses.am: በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጡ ነገሥታትና መሳፍንት በሰረገሎችና በፈረሶች ላይ እየተቀመጡ በዚህች ከተማ በሮች ይገባሉ፤ እነርሱና መሳፍንቶቻቸው የይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚቀመጡ ይገባሉ፥ ይህችም ከተማ ለዘላለም የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: On viendra des villes de Juda et des environs de Jérusalem, Du pays de Benjamin, de la vallée, De la montagne et du midi, Pour amener des holocaustes et des victimes, Pour apporter des offrandes et de l''encens, Et pour offrir des sacrifices d''actions de grâces dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕትን የእህሉንም ቍርባን ዕጣኑንም የምስጋናውንም መሥዋዕት ይዘው ከይሁዳ ከተሞች ከኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ከብንያምም አገር ከቈላውም ከደጋውም ከደቡብም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.fr: Mais si vous n''écoutez pas quand je vous ordonne De sanctifier le jour du sabbat, De ne porter aucun fardeau, De ne point en introduire par les portes de Jérusalem le jour du sabbat, Alors j''allumerai un feu aux portes de la ville, Et il dévorera les palais de Jérusalem et ne s''éteindra point.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሰንበትን ቀን እንድትቀድሱ፥ በሰንበትም ቀን ሸክምን ተሸክማችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም በሮች እንዳትገቡ የነገርኋችሁን ባትሰሙኝ፥ በበሮችዋ ላይ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች፥ አትጠፋም።

verses.en: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል፥

verses.en: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, et descends dans la maison du potier; Là, je te ferai entendre mes paroles.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። ተነሥተህ ወደ ሸክላ ሠሪው ቤት ውረድ፥ በዚያም ቃሌን አሰማሃለሁ።

verses.en: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
verses.fr: Je descendis dans la maison du potier, Et voici, il travaillait sur un tour.
verses.am: ወደ ሸክላ ሠሪው ቤትም ወረድሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሥራውን በመንኰራኵር ላይ ይሠራ ነበር።

verses.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.fr: Le vase qu''il faisait ne réussit pas, Comme il arrive à l''argile dans la main du potier; Il en refit un autre vase, Tel qu''il trouva bon de le faire.
verses.am: ከጭቃም ይሠራው የነበረ ዕቃ በሸክላ ሠሪው እጅ ተበላሸ፥ ሸክላ ሠሪውም እንደ ወደደ መልሶ ሌላ ዕቃ አድርጎ ሠራው።

verses.en: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the Lord. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verses.fr: Ne puis-je pas agir envers vous comme ce potier, maison d''Israël? Dit l''Eternel. Voici, comme l''argile est dans la main du potier, Ainsi vous êtes dans ma main, maison d''Israël!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ይህ ሸክላ ሠሪ እንደሚሠራ በውኑ እኔ በእናንተ ዘንድ መሥራት አይቻለኝምን? እነሆ፥ ጭቃው በሸክላ ሠሪ እጅ እንዳለ፥ እንዲሁ እናንተ በእኔ እንጅ አላችሁ።

verses.en: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
verses.fr: Soudain je parle, sur une nation, sur un royaume, D''arracher, d''abattre et de détruire;
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝብ ስለ መንግሥትም እነቅል አፈርስም አጠፋም ዘንድ በተናገርሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.fr: Mais si cette nation, sur laquelle j''ai parlé, revient de sa méchanceté, Je me repens du mal que j''avais pensé lui faire.
verses.am: ይህ ስለ እርሱ የተናገርሁበት ሕዝብ ከክፋቱ ቢመለስ፥ እኔ አደርግበት ዘንድ ካሰብሁት ክፉ ነገር እጸጸታለሁ።

verses.en: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.fr: Et soudain je parle, sur une nation, sur un royaume, De bâtir et de planter;
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ስለ መንግሥትም እሠራውና እተክለው ዘንድ በተናገርሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.fr: Mais si cette nation fait ce qui est mal à mes yeux, Et n''écoute pas ma voix, Je me repens du bien que j''avais eu l''intention de lui faire.
verses.am: በፊቴ ክፉን ነገር ቢያደርግ ቃሌንም ባይሰማ፥ እኔ አደርግለት ዘንድ ስለ ተናገርሁት መልካም ነገር እጸጸታለሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
verses.fr: Parle maintenant aux hommes de Juda et aux habitants de Jérusalem, et dis: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je prépare contre vous un malheur, Je médite un projet contre vous. Revenez chacun de votre mauvaise voie, Réformez vos voies et vos oeuvres!
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚቀመጡ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር እፈጥርባችኋለሁ፥ አሳብንም አስብባችኋለሁ፤ አሁንም ሁላችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፥ መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁንም አቅኑ ብለህ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
verses.fr: Mais ils disent: C''est en vain! Car nous suivrons nos pensées, Nous agirons chacun selon les penchants de notre mauvais coeur.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን። እንጨክናለን፤ አሳባችንን ተከትለን እንሄዳለን ሁላችንም እንደ ክፉው ልባችን እልከኝነት እናደርጋለን አሉ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Interrogez les nations! Qui a jamais entendu pareilles choses? La vierge d''Israël a commis d''horribles excès.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአሕዛብ መካከል። እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ማን ሰምቶአል? ብላችሁ ጠይቁ። የእስራኤል ድንግል በጣም የሚያስደነግጠውን ነገር አድርጋለች።

verses.en: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
verses.fr: La neige du Liban abandonne-t-elle le rocher des champs? Ou voit-on tarir les eaux qui viennent de loin, fraîches et courantes?
verses.am: በውኑ የሊባኖስ በረዶ የምድረ በዳውን ድንጋይ ይተዋልን? ወይስ ከሩቅ የምትመጣው ቀዝቃዛይቱ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ትደርቃለችን?

verses.en: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
verses.fr: Cependant mon peuple m''a oublié, il offre de l''encens à des idoles; Il a été conduit à chanceler dans ses voies, à quitter les anciens sentiers, Pour suivre des sentiers, des chemins non frayés.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ግን ረስተውኛል ለከንቱ ነገርም ዐጥነዋል፤ ከመንገዱም ተሰናክለዋል ከቀድሞውም ጐዳና ርቀው ወዳልተሠራው ወደ ጠማማው መንገድ ፈቀቅ ብለዋል።

verses.en: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
verses.fr: Ils ont fait de leur pays, un objet de désolation, d''éternelle moquerie; Tous ceux qui y passent sont stupéfaits et secouent la tête.
verses.am: ምድራቸውን ለመደነቂያና ለዘላለም ማፍዋጫ አድርገዋል፤ የሚያልፍባት ሁሉ ይደነቃል፥ ራሱንም ያነቃንቃል።

verses.en: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.fr: Pareil au vent d''orient, je les disperserai devant l''ennemi; Je leur tournerai le dos, je ne les regarderai pas au jour de leur détresse.
verses.am: በጠላት ፊት እንደ ምሥራቅ ነፋስ እበትናቸዋለሁ፥ በጥፋታቸውም ቀን ጀርባዬን እንጂ ፊቴን አላሳያቸውም።

verses.en: Then said they, Come and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.fr: Et ils ont dit: Venez, complotons contre Jérémie! Car la loi ne périra pas faute de sacrificateurs, Ni le conseil faute de sages, ni la parole faute de prophètes. Venez, tuons-le avec la langue; Ne prenons pas garde à tous ses discours!
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሕግ ከካህን፥ ምክርም ከጠቢብ፥ ቃልም ከነቢይ አይጠፋምና ኑ፥ በኤርምያስ ላይ አሳብን እናስብ። ኑ፥ በምላስ እንምታው፥ ቃሉንም ሁሉ አናድምጥ አሉ።

verses.en: Give heed to me, O Lord, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.fr: Ecoute-moi, Eternel! Et entends la voix de mes adversaires!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አድምጠኝ፥ የክርክሬንም ቃል ስማ።

verses.en: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
verses.fr: Le mal sera-t-il rendu pour le bien? Car ils ont creusé une fosse pour m''ôter la vie. Souviens-t''en, je me suis tenu devant toi, Afin de parler en leur faveur, Et de détourner d''eux ta colère.
verses.am: ለነፍሴ ጕድጓድ ቈፍረዋልና በውኑ በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉ ይመለሳልን? ስለ እነርሱ በመልካም እናገር ዘንድ ቍጣህንም ከእነርሱ እመልስ ዘንድ በፊትህ እንደ ቆምሁ አስብ።

verses.en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi livre leurs enfants à la famine, Précipite-les par le glaive; Que leurs femmes soient privées d''enfants et deviennent veuves, Et que leurs maris soient enlevés par la peste; Que leurs jeunes gens soient frappés par l''épée dans le combat!
verses.am: ስለዚህ ልጆቻቸውን ለራብ ስጥ፥ ለሰይፍም እጅ አሳልፈህ ስጣቸው፥ ሚስቶቻቸውም የወላድ መካንና መበለቶች ይሁኑ፥ ወንዶቻቸውም በሞት ይጥፉ፥ ጕልማሶቻቸውም በሰልፍ ጊዜ በሰይፍ ይመቱ።

verses.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.fr: Qu''on entende des cris sortir de leurs maisons, Quand soudain tu feras fondre sur eux des bandes armées! Car ils ont creusé une fosse pour me prendre, Ils ont tendu des filets sous mes pieds.
verses.am: ሊይዙኝ ጕድጓድ ቆፍረዋልና፥ ለእግሮቼም ወጥመድ ሸሽገዋልና ድንገት በላያቸው ጭፍራ ባመጣህ ጊዜ ከቤታቸው ጩኸት ይሰማ።

verses.en: Yet, Lord, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
verses.fr: Et toi, Eternel, tu connais tous leurs complots pour me faire mourir; Ne pardonne pas leur iniquité, N''efface pas leur péché de devant toi! Qu''ils soient renversés en ta présence! Agis contre eux au temps de ta colère!
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ይገድሉኝ ዘንድ በላዬ የመከሩትን ምክር ሁሉ ታውቃለህ፤ በደላቸውን ይቅር አትበል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ከፊትህ አትደምስስ፤ በፊትህም ይውደቁ፥ በቍጣህ ጊዜ እንዲሁ አድርግባቸው።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
verses.fr: Ainsi a parlé l''Eternel: Va, achète d''un potier un vase de terre, et prends avec toi des anciens du peuple et des anciens des sacrificateurs.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ሂድ፥ ከሸክላ ሠሪ ገምቦ ግዛ፥ ከሕዝቡም ሽማግሌዎችና ከካህናት ሽማግሌዎች ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤

verses.en: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
verses.fr: Rends-toi dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, qui est à l''entrée de la porte de la poterie; et là, tu publieras les paroles que je te dirai.
verses.am: በካርሲት በር መግቢያ አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ ሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ሂድ፥ በዚያም የምነግርህን ቃል ተናገር፥

verses.en: And say, Hear ye the word of the Lord, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, rois de Juda, et vous, habitants de Jérusalem! Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je vais faire venir sur ce lieu un malheur Qui étourdira les oreilles de quiconque en entendra parler.
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። የይሁዳ ነገሥታትና በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሰማውን ሰው ጆሮ ጭው የሚያደርግ ክፉ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ስፍራ አመጣለሁ።

verses.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.fr: Ils m''ont abandonné, ils ont profané ce lieu, Ils y ont offert de l''encens à d''autres dieux, Que ne connaissaient ni eux, ni leurs pères, ni les rois de Juda, Et ils ont rempli ce lieu de sang innocent;
verses.am: ትተውኛልና፥ ይህንም ስፍራ እንግዳ አድርገውታልና፥ እነርሱና አባቶቻቸውም ለማያውቋቸው ለሌሎች አማልክት ዐጥነዋልና የይሁዳም ነገሥታት ይህን ስፍራ በንጹህ ደም ሞልተዋልና፥

verses.en: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
verses.fr: Ils ont bâti des hauts lieux à Baal, Pour brûler leurs enfants au feu en holocaustes à Baal: Ce que je n''avais ni ordonné ni prescrit, Ce qui ne m''était point venu à la pensée.
verses.am: እኔም ያላዘዝሁትን ያልተናገርሁትንም ወደ ልቤም ያልገባውን፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አድርገው ለበኣል ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ የበኣልን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ሠርተዋልና ስለዚህ፥

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où ce lieu ne sera plus appelé Topheth et vallée de Ben-Hinnom, Mais où on l''appellera vallée du carnage.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይህ ስፍራ የእርድ ሸለቆ ይባላል እንጂ ቶፌት ወይም የሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.fr: J''anéantirai dans ce lieu le conseil de Juda et de Jérusalem; Je les ferai tomber par l''épée devant leurs ennemis Et par la main de ceux qui en veulent à leur vie; Je donnerai leurs cadavres en pâture Aux oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes de la terre.
verses.am: በዚህም ስፍራ የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ምክር አፈርሳለሁ፥ በጠላቶቻቸውም ፊት በሰይፍና ነፍሳቸውን በሚሹት እጅ እጥላቸዋለሁ፥ ሬሳቸውንም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል አድርጌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.fr: Je ferai de cette ville un objet de désolation et de moquerie; Tous ceux qui passeront près d''elle Seront dans l''étonnement et siffleront sur toutes ses plaies.
verses.am: ይህችንም ከተማ ለመደነቂያና ለማፍዋጫ አደርጋታለሁ፤ የሚያልፍባትም ሁሉ ስለ ተደረገባት መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ይደነቃል ከንፈሩንም ይመጥጣል።

verses.en: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
verses.fr: Je leur ferai manger la chair de leurs fils et la chair de leurs filles, Et les uns mangeront la chair des autres, Au milieu de l''angoisse et de la détresse Où les réduiront leurs ennemis Et ceux qui en veulent à leur vie.
verses.am: የወንዶችና የሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም ሥጋ አበላቸዋለሁ፥ ሁሉም ጠላቶቻቸውንና ነፍሳቸውን የሚሹት በሚያስጨንቋቸው ጭንቀትና መከበብ የባልንጀሮቻቸውን ሥጋ ይበላሉ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.fr: Tu briseras ensuite le vase, sous les yeux des hommes qui seront allés avec toi.
verses.am: ገምቦውንም ከአንተ ጋር በሚሄዱ ሰዎች ፊት ትሰብራለህ፥

verses.en: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
verses.fr: Et tu leur diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: C''est ainsi que je briserai ce peuple et cette ville, Comme on brise un vase de potier, Sans qu''il puisse être rétabli. Et l''on enterrera les morts à Topheth par défaut de place pour enterrer.
verses.am: እንዲህም ትላቸዋለህ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የሸክላ ሠሪው ዕቃ እንደሚሰባበር ደግሞም ይጠገን ዘንድ እንደማይቻል፥ እንዲሁ ይህን ሕዝብና ይህችን ከተማ እሰብራለሁ፤ የሚቀብሩበትም ስፍራ ሌላ የለምና በቶፌት ይቀበራሉ።

verses.en: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the Lord, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que je ferai à ce lieu, dit l''Eternel, et à ses habitants, Et je rendrai cette ville semblable à Topheth.
verses.am: እንዲሁ በዚህ ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ አደርጋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ይህችንም ከተማ እንደ ቶፌት አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
verses.fr: Les maisons de Jérusalem et les maisons des rois de Juda Seront impures comme le lieu de Topheth, Toutes les maisons sur les toits desquelles on offrait de l''encens A toute l''armée des cieux, Et on faisait des libations à d''autres dieux.
verses.am: የረከሱትም የኢየሩሳሌም ቤቶችና የይሁዳ ነገሥታት ቤቶች፥ እነዚያ በሰገነታቸው ላይ ለሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ ያጠኑባቸው ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥን ቍርባን ያፈሰሱባቸው ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ እንደ ቶፌት ስፍራ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord's house; and said to all the people,
verses.fr: Jérémie revint de Topheth, où l''Eternel l''avait envoyé prophétiser. Puis il se tint dans le parvis de la maison de l''Eternel, et il dit à tout le peuple:
verses.am: ኤርምያስም እግዚአብሔር ትንቢት ሊናገር ወደዚያ ልኮት ከነበረው ስፍራ ከቶፌት መጣ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አደባባይ ቆሞ ለሕዝብ ሁሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je vais faire venir sur cette ville et sur toutes les villes qui dépendent d''elle tous les malheurs que je lui ai prédits, parce qu''ils ont raidi leur cou, pour ne point écouter mes paroles.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቃሌን እንዳይሰሙ አንገታቸውን አደንድነዋልና እነሆ፥ በዚህች ከተማና በመንደሮችዋ ሁሉ ላይ የተናገርሁባትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣለሁ።

verses.en: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.fr: Paschhur, fils d''Immer, sacrificateur et inspecteur en chef dans la maison de l''Eternel, entendit Jérémie qui prophétisait ces choses.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የተሾመው አለቃ የካህኑ የኢሜር ልጅ ጳስኮር ኤርምያስ በዚህ ነገር ትንቢት ሲናገር ሰማ።

verses.en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et Paschhur frappa Jérémie, le prophète, et le mit dans la prison qui était à la porte supérieure de Benjamin, dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጳስኮርም ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን መታው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በነበረው በላይኛው በብንያም በር ባለው በእግር ግንድ ውስጥ አኖረው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The Lord hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.
verses.fr: Mais le lendemain, Paschhur fit sortir Jérémie de prison. Et Jérémie lui dit: Ce n''est pas le nom de Paschhur que l''Eternel te donne, c''est celui de Magor-Missabib.
verses.am: በነጋውም ጳስኮር ኤርምያስን ከግንድ ውስጥ አወጣው። ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አለው። እግዚአብሔር ስምህን። ማጎርሚሳቢብ እንጂ ጳስኮር ብሎ አይጠራህም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je te livrerai à la terreur, toi et tous tes amis; ils tomberont par l''épée de leurs ennemis, et tes yeux le verront. Je livrerai aussi tout Juda entre les mains du roi de Babylone, qui les emmènera captifs à Babylone et les frappera de l''épée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ለራስህና ለወዳጆችህ ሁሉ ፍርሃት አደርግሃለሁ፤ እነርሱም በጠላቶቻቸው ሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ ዓይኖችህም ያያሉ፤ ይሁዳንም ሁሉ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እርሱም ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሳቸዋል በሰይፍም ይገድላቸዋል።

verses.en: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.fr: Je livrerai toutes les richesses de cette ville, tout le produit de son travail, tout ce qu''elle a de précieux, je livrerai tous les trésors des rois de Juda entre les mains de leurs ennemis, qui les pilleront, les enlèveront et les transporteront à Babylone.
verses.am: የዚህችንም ከተማ ባለጠግነት ሁሉ ጥሪትዋንም ሁሉ ክብርዋንም ሁሉ የይሁዳንም ነገሥታት መዝገብ ሁሉ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እነርሱም ይበዘብዙአቸዋል ይዘውም ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሱአቸዋል።

verses.en: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
verses.fr: Et toi, Paschhur, et tous ceux qui demeurent dans ta maison, vous irez en captivité; tu iras à Babylone, et là tu mourras, et là tu seras enterré, toi et tous tes amis auxquels tu as prophétisé le mensonge.
verses.am: አንተም፥ ጳስኮር ሆይ፥ በቤትህም የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ተማርካችሁ ትሄዳላችሁ፤ አንተም በሐሰትም ትንቢት የተናገርህላቸው ወዳጆችህ ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን ትገባላችሁ፥ በዚያም ትሞታላችሁ፥ በዚያም ትቀበራላችሁ።

verses.en: O Lord, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived; thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
verses.fr: Tu m''as persuadé, Eternel, et je me suis laissé persuader; Tu m''as saisi, tu m''as vaincu. Et je suis chaque jour un objet de raillerie, Tout le monde se moque de moi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አታለልኸኝ እኔም ተታለልሁ፥ ከእኔም በረታህ አሸነፍህም፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ መሳቂያ ሆኛለሁ፥ ሁሉም ያላግጡብኛል።

verses.en: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the Lord was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
verses.fr: Car toutes les fois que je parle, il faut que je crie, Que je crie à la violence et à l''oppression! Et la parole de l''Eternel est pour moi Un sujet d''opprobre et de risée chaque jour.
verses.am: በተናገርሁ ቍጥር እጮኻለሁ፤ ግፍና ጥፋት ብዬ እጮኻለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ቀኑን ሁሉ ስድብና ዋዛ ሆኖብኛልና።

verses.en: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
verses.fr: Si je dis: Je ne ferai plus mention de lui, Je ne parlerai plus en son nom, Il y a dans mon coeur comme un feu dévorant Qui est renfermé dans mes os. Je m''efforce de le contenir, et je ne le puis.
verses.am: እኔም። የእግዚአብሔርን ስም አላነሣም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም በስሙ አልናገርም ብል፥ በአጥንቶቼ ውስጥ እንደ ገባ እንደሚነድድ እሳት ያለ በልቤ ሆነብኝ፤ ደከምሁ፥ መሸከምም አልቻልሁም።

verses.en: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.fr: Car j''apprends les mauvais propos de plusieurs, L''épouvante qui règne à l''entour: Accusez-le, et nous l''accuserons! Tous ceux qui étaient en paix avec moi Observent si je chancelle: Peut-être se laissera-t-il surprendre, Et nous serons maîtres de lui, Nous tirerons vengeance de lui!
verses.am: የብዙ ሰዎችን ስድብ ሰምቻለሁ፥ ማስፈራራትም ከብቦኛል። መውደቄን የሚጠብቁ የሰላሜ ሰዎች ሁሉ። ምናልባት ይታለል እንደ ሆነ፥ እናሸንፈውም እንደ ሆነ፥ እርሱንም እንበቀል እንደ ሆነ፥ ክሰሱት እኛም እንከስሰዋለን ይላሉ።

verses.en: But the Lord is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel est avec moi comme un héros puissant; C''est pourquoi mes persécuteurs chancellent et n''auront pas le dessus; Ils seront remplis de confusion pour n''avoir pas réussi: Ce sera une honte éternelle qui ne s''oubliera pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንደ ኃያልና እንደ ጨካኝ ከእኔ ጋር ነው፤ ስለዚህ አሳዳጆቼ ይሰናከላሉ አያሸንፉም፤ አይከናወንላቸውምና በጽኑ እፍረት ያፍራሉ፥ ለዘላለምም በማይረሳ ጕስቍልና ይጐሰቍላሉ።

verses.en: But, O Lord of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées éprouve le juste, Il pénètre les reins et les coeurs. Je verrai ta vengeance s''exercer contre eux, Car c''est à toi que je confie ma cause.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጻድቅን የምትመረምር ኵላሊትንና ልብን የምትመለከት የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክርክሬን ገልጬልሃለሁና በቀልህን በላያቸው ለይ።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord, praise ye the Lord: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel, louez l''Eternel! Car il délivre l''âme du malheureux de la main des méchants.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ እግዚአብሔርንም አመስግኑ፤ የችግረኛውን ነፍስ ከክፉ አድራጊዎች እጅ አድኖአልና።

verses.en: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.fr: Maudit soit le jour où je suis né! Que le jour où ma mère m''a enfanté Ne soit pas béni!
verses.am: የተወለድሁባት ቀን የተረገመች ትሁን፤ እናቴ እኔን የወለደችባት ቀን የተባረከች አትሁን።

verses.en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
verses.fr: Maudit soit l''homme qui porta cette nouvelle à mon père: Il t''est né un enfant mâle, Et qui le combla de joie!
verses.am: ወንድ ልጅ ተወልዶልሃል ብሎ ለአባቴ የምሥራች ነግሮ ደስ ያሰኘው ሰው የተረገመ ይሁን።

verses.en: And let that man be as the cities which the Lord overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
verses.fr: Que cet homme soit comme les villes Que l''Eternel a détruites sans miséricorde! Qu''il entende des gémissements le matin, Et des cris de guerre à midi!
verses.am: ያም ሰው እግዚአብሔር ሳይጸጸት እንደ ገለበጣቸው ከተሞች ይሁን፥ በማለዳም ልቅሶን በቀትርም ጩኸትን ይስማ፤

verses.en: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
verses.fr: Que ne m''a-t-on fait mourir dans le sein de ma mère! Que ne m''a-t-elle servi de tombeau! Que n''est-elle restée éternellement enceinte!
verses.am: እናቴ መቃብር ትሆነኝ ዘንድ ማኅፀንዋም ዘወትር ይዞኝ ያቆይ ዘንድ በማኅፀን ውስጥ አልገደለኝምና።

verses.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.fr: Pourquoi suis-je sorti du sein maternel Pour voir la souffrance et la douleur, Et pour consumer mes jours dans la honte?
verses.am: ድካምንና ጣርን አይ ዘንድ ዘመኔም በእፍረት ታልቅ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ከማኅፀን ወጣሁ?

verses.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, lorsque le roi Sédécias lui envoya Paschhur, fils de Malkija, et Sophonie, fils de Maaséja, le sacrificateur, pour lui dire:
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Enquire, I pray thee, of the Lord for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the Lord will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.fr: Consulte pour nous l''Eternel; car Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, nous fait la guerre; peut-être l''Eternel fera-t-il en notre faveur quelqu''un de ses miracles, afin qu''il s''éloigne de nous.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ይወጋናልና ስለ እኛ፥ እባክህ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቅ፤ ከእኛም ይመለስ ዘንድ ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር እንደ ተአምራቱ ሁሉ ያደርግ ይሆናል ብሎ የመልክያን ልጅ ጳስኮርንና ካህኑን የመዕሤያን ልጅ ሶፎንያስ ወደ ኤርምያስ በላከ ጊዜ ነው።

verses.en: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.fr: Jérémie leur répondit: Vous direz à Sédécias:
verses.am: ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ሴዴቅያስን እንዲህ በሉት።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je vais détourner les armes de guerre qui sont dans vos mains, et avec lesquelles vous combattez en dehors des murailles le roi de Babylone et les Chaldéens qui vous assiègent, et je les rassemblerai au milieu de cette ville.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ በቅጥርም ውጭ የከበቡአችሁን ከለዳውያንን የምትወጉበትን በእጃችሁ ያለውን ዕቃ ጦራችሁን እመልሰዋለሁ፥ እነዚያንም ወደዚህች ከተማ ውስጥ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.fr: Puis je combattrai contre vous, la main étendue et le bras fort, avec colère, avec fureur, avec une grande irritation.
verses.am: እኔም በተዘረጋች እጅና በብርቱ ክንድ፥ በቍጣና በመዓት በታላቅም መቅሠፍት እወጋችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.fr: Je frapperai les habitants de cette ville, les hommes et les bêtes; ils mourront d''une peste affreuse.
verses.am: በዚህችም ከተማ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ሰዎችንና እንስሶችን እመታለሁ፥ በጽኑም ቸነፈር ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: And afterward, saith the Lord, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.fr: Après cela, dit l''Eternel, je livrerai Sédécias, roi de Juda, ses serviteurs, le peuple, et ceux qui dans cette ville échapperont à la peste, à l''épée et à la famine, je les livrerai entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, entre les mains de leurs ennemis, entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à leur vie; et Nebucadnetsar les frappera du tranchant de l''épée, il ne les épargnera pas, il n''aura point de pitié, point de compassion.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስን ከቸነፈርና ከሰይፍ ከራብም በዚህች ከተማ የቀሩትንም ባሪዎቹንና ሕዝቡን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ በጠላቶቻቸውና ነፍሳቸውንም በሚሹት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ እርሱም በሰይፍ ስለት ይመታቸዋል፤ አያዝንላቸውም፥ አይራራላቸውም፥ አይምራቸውም።

verses.en: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
verses.fr: Tu diras à ce peuple: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je mets devant vous le chemin de la vie et le chemin de la mort.
verses.am: ለዚህም ሕዝብ እንዲህ በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በፊታችሁ የሕይወትን መንገድና የሞትን መንገድ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.en: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.fr: Celui qui restera dans cette ville mourra par l''épée, par la famine ou par la peste; mais celui qui sortira pour se rendre aux Chaldéens qui vous assiègent aura la vie sauve, et sa vie sera son butin.
verses.am: በዚህች ከተማ ውስጥ የሚዘገይ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ይሞታል፤ ወጥቶ ወደ ከበቡአችሁ ወደ ከለዳውያን የሚገባ ግን በሕይወት ይኖራል፥ ነፍሱም ምርኮ ትሆንለታለች።

verses.en: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the Lord: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.fr: Car je dirige mes regards contre cette ville pour faire du mal et non du bien, dit l''Eternel; elle sera livrée entre les mains du roi de Babylone, qui la brûlera par le feu.
verses.am: ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፋ ፊቴን በዚህች ከተማ ላይ አድርጌአለሁና፤ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ትሰጣለች፥ እርሱም በእሳት ያቃጥላታል።

verses.en: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the Lord;
verses.fr: Et tu diras à la maison du roi de Juda: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel!
verses.am: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: O house of David, thus saith the Lord; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.fr: Maison de David! Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Rendez la justice dès le matin, Et délivrez l''opprimé des mains de l''oppresseur, De peur que ma colère n''éclate comme un feu, Et ne s''enflamme, sans qu''on puisse l''éteindre, A cause de la méchanceté de vos actions.
verses.am: የዳዊት ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ሥራችሁ ክፋት ቍጣዬ እንደ እሳት እንዳይወጣና ማንም ሳያጠፋው እንዳይነድድ፥ በማለዳ ፍርድን አድርጉ የተበዘበዘውንም ከአስጨናቂው እጅ አድኑ።

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the Lord; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.fr: Voici, j''en veux à toi, Ville assise dans la vallée, sur le rocher de la plaine, Dit l''Eternel, A vous qui dites: Qui descendra contre nous? Qui entrera dans nos demeures?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በሸለቆው ውስጥ በሜዳ ላይም ባለው አምባ የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ እኔ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፤ እናንተም። በእኛ ላይ የሚወርድ ወይም ወደ መኖሪያችን የሚገባ ማን ነው? የምትሉ ሆይ፥ እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ነኝ፤

verses.en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the Lord: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
verses.fr: Je vous châtierai selon le fruit de vos oeuvres, dit l''Eternel; Je mettrai le feu à votre forêt, Et il en dévorera tous les alentours.
verses.am: እንደ ሥራችሁም ፍሬ እቀጣችኋለሁ፤ በዱርዋም ውስጥ እሳትን አነድዳለሁ፥ በዙሪያዋም ያለውን ሁሉ ይበላል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Descends dans la maison du roi de Juda, et là prononce cette parole.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት ውረድ በዚያም ይህን ቃል ተናገር፥

verses.en: And say, Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ecoute la parole de l''Eternel, roi de Juda, qui es assis sur le trône de David, toi, tes serviteurs, et ton peuple, qui entrez par ces portes!
verses.am: እንዲህም በል። በዳዊት ዙፋን የምትቀመጥ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አንተና ባሪያዎችህ በእነዚህም በሮች የሚገባ ሕዝብህ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Pratiquez la justice et l''équité; délivrez l''opprimé des mains de l''oppresseur; ne maltraitez pas l''étranger, l''orphelin et la veuve; n''usez pas de violence, et ne répandez point de sang innocent dans ce lieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አድርጉ የተበዘበዘውንም ከአስጨናቂው እጅ አድኑ፤ መጻተኛውንና ድሀ አደጉን መበለቲቱንም አትበድሉ፥ አታምፁባቸውም፥ በዚህም ስፍራ ንጹሕ ደምን አታፍስሱ።

verses.en: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.fr: Car si vous agissez selon cette parole, les rois assis sur le trône de David entreront par les portes de cette maison, montés sur des chars et sur des chevaux, eux, leurs serviteurs et leur peuple.
verses.am: ይህንንም ነገር ብታደርጉ፥ በዳዊት ዙፋን የሚቀመጡ ነገሥታት፥ በሰረገሎችና በፈረሶች ላይ ተቀምጠው፥ በዚህ ቤት በሮች ይገባሉ፤ እርሱም ባሪያዎቹም ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.fr: Mais si vous n''écoutez pas ces paroles, je le jure par moi-même, dit l''Eternel, cette maison deviendra une ruine.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥ ይህ ቤት ወና እንዲሆን በራሴ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel sur la maison du roi de Juda: Tu es pour moi comme Galaad, comme le sommet du Liban; Mais certes, je ferai de toi un désert, Une ville sans habitants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት እንዲህ ይላልና። አንተ በእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ገለዓድና እንደ ሊባኖስ ራስ ነህ፥ ነገር ግን በእርግጥ ምድረ በዳ ማንም የማይቀመጥባቸውም ከተሞች አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.fr: Je prépare contre toi des destructeurs, Chacun avec ses armes; Ils abattront tes plus beaux cèdres, Et les jetteront au feu.
verses.am: መሣሪያም የሚይዙትን አጥፊዎች በአንተ ላይ አዘጋጃለሁ፥ የተመረጡትንም የዝግባ ዛፎችህን ይቈርጣሉ፥ በእሳትም ውስጥ ይጥሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this great city?
verses.fr: Des nations nombreuses passeront près de cette ville, Et elles se diront l''une à l''autre: Pourquoi l''Eternel a-t-il ainsi traité cette grande ville?
verses.am: ብዙ አሕዛብም በዚህች ከተማ አጠገብ ያልፋሉ፥ ሁሉም ባልንጀሮቻቸውን። እግዚአብሔር በዚህች ታላቅ ከተማ ለምን እንዲህ አደርገ? ይላሉ።

verses.en: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.fr: Et l''on répondra: Parce qu''ils ont abandonné L''alliance de l''Eternel, leur Dieu, Parce qu''ils se sont prosternés devant d''autres dieux et les ont servis.
verses.am: እነርሱም። የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ትተው ለሌሎች አማልክት ስለ ሰገዱ ስላመለኩአቸውም ነዋ ብለው ይመልሳሉ።

verses.en: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.fr: Ne pleurez point celui qui est mort, Et ne vous lamentez pas sur lui; Pleurez, pleurez celui qui s''en va, Car il ne reviendra plus, Il ne reverra plus le pays de sa naissance.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለስምና፥ የተወለደባትንም አገር አያይምና ለሚወጣ እጅግ አልቅሱ እንጂ ለሞተ አታልቅሱ አትዘኑለትም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel sur Schallum, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, Qui régnait à la place de Josias, son père, Et qui est sorti de ce lieu: Il n''y reviendra plus;
verses.am: በአባቱ በኢዮስያስ ፋንታ ስለ ነገሠው ከዚህም ስፍራ ስለ ወጣው ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ስለ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ ስለ ሰሎም እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.fr: Mais il mourra dans le lieu où on l''emmène captif, Et il ne verra plus ce pays.
verses.am: እንግዲህም ወደዚህ አይመለስም፥ በተማረከባት አገር ይሞታል እንጂ፤ ይህችንም አገር ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያይም።

verses.en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
verses.fr: Malheur à celui qui bâtit sa maison par l''injustice, Et ses chambres par l''iniquité; Qui fait travailler son prochain sans le payer, Sans lui donner son salaire;
verses.am: ቤቱን በግፍ ሰገነቱንም በዓመፅ ለሚሠራ፥ ባልንጀራውንም እንዲያው በከንቱ ለሚያሠራ፥ ዋጋውንም ለማይሰጠው፤

verses.en: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.fr: Qui dit: Je me bâtirai une maison vaste, Et des chambres spacieuses; Et qui s''y fait percer des fenêtres, La lambrisse de cèdre, Et la peint en couleur rouge!
verses.am: ለራሴ ሰፊ ቤት ትልቅም ሰገነት እሠራለሁ ለሚል፥ መስኮትንም ለሚያወጣ፥ በዝግባም ሥራ ለሚያሳጌጥ፥ በቀይ ቀለምም ለሚቀባው ወዮለት!

verses.en: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
verses.fr: Est-ce que tu règnes, parce que tu as de la passion pour le cèdre? Ton père ne mangeait-il pas, ne buvait-il pas? Mais il pratiquait la justice et l''équité, Et il fut heureux;
verses.am: በዝግባ እንጨት ስለምትወዳደር በውኑ ትነግሣለህን? በውኑ አባትህ አይበላምና አይጠጣም ነበርን? ፍርድንና ጽድቅንስ አያደርግም ነበርን? በዚያም ጊዜ መልካም ሆኖለት ነበር።

verses.en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Il jugeait la cause du pauvre et de l''indigent, Et il fut heureux. N''est-ce pas là me connaître? dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የድሀውንና የችግረኛውን ፍርድ ይፈርድ ነበር፥ በዚያም ጊዜ መልካም ሆኖ ነበር። ይህ እኔን ማወቅ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.fr: Mais tu n''as des yeux et un coeur Que pour te livrer à la cupidité, Pour répandre le sang innocent, Et pour exercer l''oppression et la violence.
verses.am: ዓይንህና ልብህ ግን ለስስት ንጹሕ ደምንም ለማፍሰስ ዓመፅንና ግፍንም ለመሥራት ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel sur Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda: On ne le pleurera pas, en disant: Hélas, mon frère! hélas, ma soeur! On ne le pleurera pas, en disant: Hélas, seigneur! hélas, sa majesté!
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ስለ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ ስለ ኢዮአቄም እንዲህ ይላል። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እያሉ አያለቅሱለትም፥ ወይም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! እያሉ አያለቅሱለትም።

verses.en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il aura la sépulture d''un âne, Il sera traîné et jeté hors des portes de Jérusalem.
verses.am: አህያም እንደሚቀበር ይቀበራል፥ ከኢየሩሳሌምም በር ወደ ውጭ ተጐትቶ ይጣላል።

verses.en: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.fr: Monte sur le Liban, et crie! Elève ta voix sur le Basan! Crie du haut d''Abarim! Car tous ceux qui t''aimaient sont brisés.
verses.am: ውሽሞችሽ ሁሉ ጠፍተዋልና ወደ ሊባኖስ ወጥተሽ ጩኺ፤ በባሳን ላይ ድምፅሽን አንሺ፤ በዓባሪምም ውስጥ ሆነሽ ጩኺ።

verses.en: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
verses.fr: Je t''ai parlé dans le temps de ta prospérité; Tu disais: Je n''écouterai pas. C''est ainsi que tu as agi dès ta jeunesse; Tu n''as pas écouté ma voix.
verses.am: በደኅንነትሽ ጊዜ ተናገርሁሽ፤ አንቺም። አልሰማም አልሽ። ከሕፃንነትሽ ጀምሮ ቃሌን አለመስማትሽ መንገድሽ ነው።

verses.en: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
verses.fr: Tous tes pasteurs seront la pâture du vent, Et ceux qui t''aiment iront en captivité; C''est alors que tu seras dans la honte, dans la confusion, A cause de toute ta méchanceté.
verses.am: በግ ጠባቂዎችሽን ሁሉ ነፋስ ይጠብቃቸዋል፥ ውሽሞችሽም ተማርከው ይሄዳሉ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ስለ ክፋትሽ ሁሉ ታፍሪያለሽ ትጐሳቈይማለሽ።

verses.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.fr: Toi qui habites sur le Liban, Qui as ton nid dans les cèdres, Combien tu gémiras quand les douleurs t''atteindront, Douleurs semblables à celles d''une femme en travail!
verses.am: አንቺ በሊባኖስ የምትቀመጪ፥ በዝግባ ዛፍም ውስጥ ጎጆሽን የምትሠሪ ሆይ፥ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ሕማም በያዘሽ ጊዜ እንዴት ታጓሪያለሽ!

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.fr: Je suis vivant! dit l''Eternel, Quand Jeconia, fils de Jojakim, roi de Juda, serait Un anneau à ma main droite, Je t''arracherais de là.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄም ልጅ ኢኮንያን የቀኝ እጄ ማኅተም ቢሆን ኖሮ እንኳ፥ ከዚያ እነቅልህ ነበር፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.fr: Je te livrerai entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à ta vie, Entre les mains de ceux devant qui tu trembles, Entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, Entre les mains des Chaldéens.
verses.am: ነፍስህንም ለሚሹት ለምትፈራቸውም እጅ፥ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር ለከለዳውያንም እጅ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.fr: Je te jetterai, toi et ta mère qui t''a enfanté, Dans un autre pays où vous n''êtes pas nés, Et là vous mourrez;
verses.am: አንተንም የወለደችህንም እናትህን ወዳልተወለዳችሁባት ወደ ሌላ አገር እጥላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያም ትሞታላችሁ።

verses.en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.fr: Mais dans le pays où ils auront le désir de retourner, Ils ne retourneront pas.
verses.am: ይመለሱባትም ዘንድ ነፍሳቸው ወደምትመኛት ወደዚያች ምድር አይመለሱም።

verses.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
verses.fr: Est-il donc un vase méprisé, brisé, ce Jeconia? Est-il un objet auquel on n''attache aucun prix? Pourquoi sont-ils jetés, lui et sa postérité, Lancés dans un pays qu''ils ne connaissent pas? -
verses.am: በውኑ ይህ ሰው ኢኮንያን የተናቀና የተሰበረ የሸክላ ዕቃ ነውን? ወይስ እርሱ ለአንዳች የማይረባ የሸክላ ዕቃ ነውን? እርሱና ዘሩስ በማያውቋት ምድር ስለ ምን ተጥለው ወደቁ?

verses.en: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Terre, terre, terre, Ecoute la parole de l''Eternel!
verses.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሚ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Inscrivez cet homme comme privé d''enfants, Comme un homme dont les jours ne seront pas prospères; Car nul de ses descendants ne réussira A s''asseoir sur le trône de David Et à régner sur Juda.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከዚህ ሰው ዘር የሚከናወን በዳዊትም ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመት በይሁዳም የሚነግሥ እንግዲህ አይገኝምና። መካን በዘመኑም የማይከናወንለት ሰው ብላችሁ ጻፉ።

verses.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Malheur aux pasteurs qui détruisent et dispersent Le troupeau de mon pâturage! dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የማሰማርያዬን በጎች ለሚያጠፉና ለሚበትኑ እረኞች ወዮላቸው! ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, Sur les pasteurs qui paissent mon peuple: Vous avez dispersé mes brebis, vous les avez chassées, Vous n''en avez pas pris soin; Voici, je vous châtierai à cause de la méchanceté de vos actions, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቤን ስለሚጠብቁ እረኞች እንዲህ ይላል። በጎቼን በትናችኋል አባርራችኋቸውማል አልጐበኛችኋቸውምም፤ እነሆ፥ የሥራችሁን ክፋት እጐበኝባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.fr: Et je rassemblerai le reste de mes brebis De tous les pays où je les ai chassées; Je les ramènerai dans leur pâturage; Elles seront fécondes et multiplieront.
verses.am: የመንጋዬም ቅሬታ ካባረርኋቸው ምድር ሁሉ ወደ በረታቸው ሰብሰቤ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ያፈራሉ ይበዙማል።

verses.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: J''établirai sur elles des pasteurs qui les paîtront; Elles n''auront plus de crainte, plus de terreur, Et il n''en manquera aucune, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሚጠብቋቸውን እረኞች አስነሣላቸዋለሁ፥ ዳግመኛም አይፈሩምና አይደነግጡም፥ ከእነሱም አንድ አይጐድልም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où je susciterai à David un germe juste; Il régnera en roi et prospérera, Il pratiquera la justice et l''équité dans le pays.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለዳዊት ጻድቅ ቍጥቋጥ የማስነሣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱም እንደ ንጉሥ ይነግሣል፥ ይከናወንለታልም፥ በምድርም ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, The Lord Our Righteousness.
verses.fr: En son temps, Juda sera sauvé, Israël aura la sécurité dans sa demeure; Et voici le nom dont on l''appellera: L''Eternel notre justice.
verses.am: በዘመኑም ይሁዳ ይድናል እስራኤልም ተዘልሎ ይቀመጣል፥ የሚጠራበትም ስም። እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችን ተብሎ ነው።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that they shall no more say, The Lord liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où l''on ne dira plus: L''Eternel est vivant, Lui qui a fait monter du pays d''Egypte les enfants d''Israël!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: But, The Lord liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.fr: Mais on dira: L''Eternel est vivant, Lui qui a fait monter et qui a ramené La postérité de la maison d''Israël du pays du septentrion Et de tous les pays où je les avais chassés! Et ils habiteront dans leur pays.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። የእስራኤልን ቤት ዘር ከሰሜን አገርና ካሰደድኋቸውም አገር ሁሉ ያወጣና የመራ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ይባላል፤ በምድራቸውም ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.fr: Sur les prophètes. Mon coeur est brisé au dedans de moi, Tous mes os tremblent; Je suis comme un homme ivre, Comme un homme pris de vin, A cause de l''Eternel et à cause de ses paroles saintes.
verses.am: ስለ ነቢያት፤ ልቤ በውስጤ ተሰብሮአል አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ ታውከዋል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር የተነሣ ከቅዱስ ቃሉም የተነሣ የወይን ጠጅ እንዳሸነፈው እንደ ሰካራም ሰው ሆኛለሁ።

verses.en: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.fr: Car le pays est rempli d''adultères; Le pays est en deuil à cause de la malédiction; Les plaines du désert sont desséchées. Ils courent au mal, Ils n''ont de la force que pour l''iniquité.
verses.am: ምድር ከአመንዝሮች ተሞልታለችና፥ ከመርገምም የተነሣ ምድር አልቅሳለች፤ የምድረ በዳ ማሰማርያ ደርቆአል፤ አካሄዳቸው ክፉ ነው፥ ብርታታቸውም ቅን አይደለም።

verses.en: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Prophètes et sacrificateurs sont corrompus; Même dans ma maison j''ai trouvé leur méchanceté, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነቢዩና ካህኑም ረክሰዋልና፥ በቤቴም ውስጥ ክፋታቸውን አግኝቻለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi leur chemin sera glissant et ténébreux, Ils seront poussés et ils tomberont; Car je ferai venir sur eux le malheur, L''année où je les châtierai, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ መንገዳቸው በጨለማ እንዳለች እንደ ድጥ ስፍራ ትሆንባቸዋለች፥ እነርሱም ፍግምግም ብለው ይወድቁባታል፤ እኔም በምጐበኛቸው ዓመት ክፉ ነገርን አመጣባቸዋለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.fr: Dans les prophètes de Samarie j''ai vu de l''extravagance; Ils ont prophétisé par Baal, Ils ont égaré mon peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: በሰማርያ ነቢያት ላይ ስንፍናን አይቻለሁ፤ በበኣል ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር፥ ሕዝቤንም እስራኤል ያስቱ ነበር።

verses.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness; they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.fr: Mais dans les prophètes de Jérusalem j''ai vu des choses horribles; Ils sont adultères, ils marchent dans le mensonge; Ils fortifient les mains des méchants, Afin qu''aucun ne revienne de sa méchanceté; Ils sont tous à mes yeux comme Sodome, Et les habitants de Jérusalem comme Gomorrhe.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ነቢያት ላይ የሚያስደነግጥን ነገር አይቻለሁ፤ ያመነዝራሉ በሐሰትም ይሄዳሉ፤ ማንም ከክፋቱ እንዳይመለስ የክፉ አድራጊዎችን እጅ ያበረታሉ፤ ሁሉም እንደ ሰዶም የሚኖሩባትም እንደ ገሞራ ሆኑብኝ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées sur les prophètes: Voici, je vais les nourrir d''absinthe, Et je leur ferai boire des eaux empoisonnées; Car c''est par les prophètes de Jérusalem Que l''impiété s''est répandue dans tout le pays.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌም ነቢያት ዘንድ ርኵሰት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ወጥቶአልና እሬትን አበላቸዋለሁ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: N''écoutez pas les paroles des prophètes qui vous prophétisent! Ils vous entraînent à des choses de néant; Ils disent les visions de leur coeur, Et non ce qui vient de la bouche de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ትንቢት የሚናገሩላችሁን የነቢያትን ቃል አትሰሙ፤ ከንቱነትን ያስተምሩአችኋል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ ሳይሆን ከገዛ ልባቸው የወጣውን ራእይ ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: They say still unto them that despise me, The Lord hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
