verses.fr: Ils disent à ceux qui me méprisent: L''Eternel a dit: Vous aurez la paix; Et ils disent à tous ceux qui suivent les penchants de leur coeur: Il ne vous arrivera aucun mal.
verses.am: ለሚንቁኝ ሁልጊዜ። እግዚአብሔር። ሰላም ይሆንላችኋል ብሎአል ይላሉ፤ በልቡም እልከኝነት ለሚሄድ ሁሉ። ክፉ ነገር አያገኛችሁም ይላሉ።

verses.en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the Lord, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
verses.fr: Qui donc a assisté au conseil de l''Eternel Pour voir, pour écouter sa parole? Qui a prêté l''oreille à sa parole, qui l''a entendue?
verses.am: ቃሉን ያይና ይሰማ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ምክር የቆመ ማን ነውና? ቃሉንስ ያደመጠ የሰማስ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Behold, a whirlwind of the Lord is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.fr: Voici, la tempête de l''Eternel, la fureur éclate, L''orage se précipite, Il fond sur la tête des méchants.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እርሱም ቍጣው፥ የሚያገለባብጥ ዐውሎ ነፍስ ወጥቶአል፤ የዓመፀኞችን ራስ ይገለባብጣል።

verses.en: The anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel ne se calmera pas, Jusqu''à ce qu''il ait accompli, exécuté les desseins de son coeur. Vous le comprendrez dans la suite des temps.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ የልቡን አሳብ ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ አይመለስም፤ በኋለኛው ዘመን ፈጽማችሁ ታስተውሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.fr: Je n''ai point envoyé ces prophètes, et ils ont couru; Je ne leur ai point parlé, et ils ont prophétisé.
verses.am: እኔ ሳልልካቸው እነዚህ ነቢያት ሮጡ፤ እኔም ሳልነግራቸው ትንቢትን ተናገሩ።

verses.en: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.fr: S''ils avaient assisté à mon conseil, Ils auraient dû faire entendre mes paroles à mon peuple, Et les faire revenir de leur mauvaise voie, De la méchanceté de leurs actions.
verses.am: በምክሬ ግን ቢቆሙ ኖሮ፥ ለሕዝቤ ቃሌን ባሰሙ ነበር፥ ከክፉም መንገዳቸው ከሥራቸውም ክፋት በመለሱአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Am I a God at hand, saith the Lord, and not a God afar off?
verses.fr: Ne suis-je un Dieu que de près, dit l''Eternel, Et ne suis-je pas aussi un Dieu de loin?
verses.am: እኔ የቅርብ አምላክ ነኝ እንጂ የሩቅ አምላክ አይደለሁም።

verses.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the Lord. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Quelqu''un se tiendra-t-il dans un lieu caché, Sans que je le voie? dit l''Eternel. Ne remplis-je pas, moi, les cieux et la terre? dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰው በስውር ቢሸሸግ፥ እኔ አላየውምን? ሰማይንና ምድርንስ የሞላሁ እኔ አይደለሁምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.fr: J''ai entendu ce que disent les prophètes Qui prophétisent en mon nom le mensonge, disant: J''ai eu un songe! j''ai eu un songe!
verses.am: አለምሁ አለምሁ እያሉ በስሜ ሐሰትን የሚናገሩትን የነቢያትን ነገር ሰምቻለሁ።

verses.en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.fr: Jusques à quand ces prophètes veulent-ils prophétiser le mensonge, Prophétiser la tromperie de leur coeur?
verses.am: ትንቢትን በሐሰት በሚናገሩ፥ የልባቸውንም ሽንገላ በሚናገሩ በነቢያት ልብ ይህ የሚሆነው እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.fr: Ils pensent faire oublier mon nom à mon peuple Par les songes que chacun d''eux raconte à son prochain, Comme leurs pères ont oublié mon nom pour Baal.
verses.am: አባቶቻቸው ስለ በኣል ስሜን እንደ ረሱ፥ እያንዳንዱ ለባልንጀራው በሚናገራት ሕልማቸው ሕዝቤ ስሜን ለማስረሳት ያስባሉ።

verses.en: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Que le prophète qui a eu un songe raconte ce songe, Et que celui qui a entendu ma parole rapporte fidèlement ma parole. Pourquoi mêler la paille au froment? dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሚያልም ነቢይ ሕልምን ይናገር፤ ቃሌም ያለበት ቃሌን በእውነት ይናገር። ገለባ ከስንዴ ጋር ምን አለው?

verses.en: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.fr: Ma parole n''est-elle pas comme un feu, dit l''Eternel, Et comme un marteau qui brise le roc?
verses.am: በውኑ ቃሌ እንደ እሳት፥ ድንጋዩንም እንደሚያደቅቅ መዶሻ አይደለችምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, dit l''Eternel, j''en veux aux prophètes Qui se dérobent mes paroles l''un à l''autre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ እያንዳንዱ ከባልንጀራው ዘንድ ቃሌን በሚሰርቁ ነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.fr: Voici, dit l''Eternel, j''en veux aux prophètes Qui prennent leur propre parole et la donnent pour ma parole.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከምላሳቸው ትንቢትን አውጥተው። እርሱ ይላል በሚሉ ነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the Lord, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici, dit l''Eternel, j''en veux à ceux qui prophétisent des songes faux, Qui les racontent, et qui égarent mon peuple Par leurs mensonges et par leur témérité; Je ne les ai point envoyés, je ne leur ai point donné d''ordre, Et ils ne sont d''aucune utilité à ce peuple, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሐሰትን በሚያልሙ በሚናገሩም በሐሰታቸውና በድፍረታቸውም ሕዝቤን በሚያስቱ በነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እኔም አልላክኋቸውም አላዘዝኋቸውምም ለእነዚህም ሕዝብ በማናቸውም አይረቡአቸውም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the Lord? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Si ce peuple, ou un prophète, ou un sacrificateur te demande: Quelle est la menace de l''Eternel? Tu leur diras quelle est cette menace: Je vous rejetterai, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ ወይም ነቢይ ወይም ካህን። የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ቢጠይቅህ፥ አንተ። ሸክሙ እናንተ ናችሁ፥ እጥላችሁማለህ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the Lord, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.fr: Et le prophète, le sacrificateur, ou celui du peuple Qui dira: Menace de l''Eternel, Je le châtierai, lui et sa maison.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም የሚለውን ነቢይንና ካህንን ሕዝቡንም ያን ሰውና ቤቱን እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the Lord answered? and, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.fr: Vous direz, chacun à son prochain, chacun à son frère: Qu''a répondu l''Eternel? Qu''a dit l''Eternel?
verses.am: አንዱም አንዱ ለባልንጀራው፥ አንዱም አንዱ ለወንድሙ እንዲህ ይበል። እግዚአብሔር የመለሰው ምንድር ነው? እግዚአብሔርስ ምን ነገር ተናገረ?

verses.en: And the burden of the Lord shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the Lord of hosts our God.
verses.fr: Mais vous ne direz plus: Menace de l''Eternel! Car la parole de chacun sera pour lui une menace; Vous tordez les paroles du Dieu vivant, De l''Eternel des armées, notre Dieu.
verses.am: ለሰው ሁሉ ቃል ሸክም ይሆንበታልና የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ይሆንበታልና የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብላችሁ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትጥሩ፤ የሠራዊትን ጌታ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን የሕያውን አምላክ ቃል ለውጣችኋልና።

verses.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the Lord answered thee? and, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.fr: Tu diras au prophète: Que t''a répondu l''Eternel? Qu''a dit l''Eternel?
verses.am: ለነቢዩ። እግዚአብሔር ምን መለሰልህ? እግዚአብሔርስ የተናገረው ምንድር ነው? ትላለህ።

verses.en: But since ye say, The burden of the Lord; therefore thus saith the Lord; Because ye say this word, The burden of the Lord, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the Lord;
verses.fr: Et si vous dites encore: Menace de l''Eternel! Alors ainsi parle l''Eternel: Parce que vous dites ce mot: Menace de l''Eternel! Quoique j''aie envoyé vers vous pour dire: Vous ne direz pas: Menace de l''Eternel!
verses.am: ነገር ግን። የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብትሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ። የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም አትበሉ ብዬ ልኬባችኋለሁና፥ እናንተም ይህን ቃል።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.fr: A cause de cela voici, je vous oublierai, Et je vous rejetterai, vous et la ville Que j''avais donnée à vous et à vos pères, Je vous rejetterai loin de ma face;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብላችኋልና ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ፈጽሜ እረሳችኋለሁ እናንተንም ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም የሰጠኋትን ከተማ ከፊቴ እጥላለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.fr: Je mettrai sur vous un opprobre éternel Et une honte éternelle, Qui ne s''oublieront pas.
verses.am: የዘላለምንም ስድብ ከቶም ተረስቶ የማይጠፋውን የዘላለምን እፍረት አመጣባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the Lord, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me fit voir deux paniers de figues posés devant le temple de l''Eternel, après que Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, eut emmené de Jérusalem et conduit à Babylone Jeconia, fils de Jojakim, roi de Juda, les chefs de Juda, les charpentiers et les serruriers.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንን የይሁዳንም አለቆች ጠራቢዎችንና ብረት ሠራተኞችን ከኢየሩሳሌም ማርኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ካፈለሳቸው በኋላ፥ እግዚአብሔር አሳየኝ፥ እነሆም፥ በእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ፊት ሁለት ቅርጫት በለስ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.en: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.fr: L''un des paniers contenait de très bonnes figues, comme les figues de la première récolte, et l''autre panier de très mauvaises figues, qu''on ne pouvait manger à cause de leur mauvaise qualité.
verses.am: በአንደኛይቱ ቅርጫት አስቀድሞ እንደ ደረሰ በለስ የሚመስል እጅግ መልካም በለስ ነበረባት፤ በሁለተኛይቱ ቅርጫት ከክፋቱ የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ የማይቻል እጅግ ክፉ በለስ ነበረባት።

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Que vois-tu, Jérémie? Je répondis: Des figues, Les bonnes figues sont très bonnes, et les mauvaises sont très mauvaises et ne peuvent être mangées à cause de leur mauvaise qualité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ኤርምያስ ሆይ፥ የምታየው ምንድር ነው? አለኝ። እኔም። በለስን አያለሁ፤ እጅግ መልካም የሆነ መልካም በለስ፥ ከክፋቱም የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ የማይቻል እጅግ ክፉ የሆነ ክፉ በለስ ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Comme tu distingues ces bonnes figues, ainsi je distinguerai, pour leur être favorable, les captifs de Juda, que j''ai envoyés de ce lieu dans le pays des Chaldéens.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንደዚህ እንደ መልካሙ በለስ፥ እንዲሁ ከዚህ ስፍራ ወደ ከለዳውያን ምድር የሰደድሁትን የይሁዳን ምርኮ ለበጐነት እመለከተዋለሁ።

verses.en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.fr: Je les regarderai d''un oeil favorable, et je les ramènerai dans ce pays; je les établirai et ne les détruirai plus, je les planterai et ne les arracherai plus.
verses.am: ዓይኔንም ለበጐነት በእነርሱ ላይ አደርጋለሁ ወደዚህችም ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እሠራቸዋለሁ እንጂ አላፈርሳቸውም፤ እተክላቸዋለሁ እንጂ አልነቅላቸውም።

verses.en: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the Lord: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.fr: Je leur donnerai un coeur pour qu''ils connaissent que je suis l''Eternel; ils seront mon peuple, et je serai leur Dieu, s''ils reviennent à moi de tout leur coeur.
verses.am: እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ የሚያውቅ ልብ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ በፍጹምም ልባቸው ወደ እኔ ይመለሳሉና ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the Lord, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.fr: Et comme les mauvaises figues qui ne peuvent être mangées à cause de leur mauvaise qualité, dit l''Eternel, ainsi ferai-je devenir Sédécias, roi de Juda, ses chefs, et le reste de Jérusalem, ceux qui sont restés dans ce pays et ceux qui habitent dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ከክፋቱ የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ እንደማይቻል እንደ ክፉው በለስ፥ እንዲሁ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስን አለቆቹንም በዚህችም አገር የሚቀሩትን የኢየሩሳሌም ቅሬታ በግብጽም አገር የሚቀመጡትን እጥላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.fr: Je les rendrai un objet d''effroi, de malheur, pour tous les royaumes de la terre, un sujet d''opprobre, de sarcasme, de raillerie, et de malédiction, dans tous les lieux où je les chasserai.
verses.am: በማሳድዳቸውም ስፍራ ሁሉ ለስድብና ለምሳሌ ለማላገጫና ለእርግማን ይሆኑ ዘንድ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ለመበተን አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.fr: J''enverrai parmi eux l''épée, la famine et la peste, jusqu''à ce qu''ils aient disparu du pays que j''avais donné à eux et à leurs pères.
verses.am: ለእነርሱና ለአባቶቻቸውም ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በመካከላቸው ሰይፍንና ራብን ቸነፈርንም እሰድዳለሁ።

verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.fr: La parole fut adressée à Jérémie sur tout le peuple de Juda, la quatrième année de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, -c''était la première année de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, -
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በመጀመሪያው ዓመት፥ ስለ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.fr: parole que Jérémie prononça devant tout le peuple de Juda et devant tous les habitants de Jérusalem, en disant:
verses.am: ይህንም ቃል ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና በኢየሩሳሌም ለተቀመጡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the Lord hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.fr: Depuis la treizième année de Josias, fils d''Amon, roi de Juda, il y a vingt-trois ans que la parole de l''Eternel m''a été adressée; je vous ai parlé, je vous ai parlé dès le matin, et vous n''avez pas écouté.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሞጽ ልጅ ከኢዮስያስ ከአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ባሉት በእነዚህ በሀያ ሦስቱ ዓመታት፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ መጣ፥ እኔም ማልጄ ተነሥቼ ተናገርኋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አልሰማችሁም።

verses.en: And the Lord hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vous a envoyé tous ses serviteurs, les prophètes, il les a envoyés dès le matin; et vous n''avez pas écouté, vous n''avez pas prêté l''oreille pour écouter.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ማልዶ ተነሥቶ ባሪያዎቹን ነቢያትን ወደ እናንተ ላከ፤ እናንተም አላደመጣችሁም ጆሮአችሁንም አላዘነበላችሁም።

verses.en: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.fr: Ils ont dit: Revenez chacun de votre mauvaise voie et de la méchanceté de vos actions, et vous resterez dans le pays que j''ai donné à vous et à vos pères, d''éternité en éternité;
verses.am: እርሱም። ሁላችሁ እናንተ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁና ከሥራችሁ ክፋት ተመለሱ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከዘላለም ወደ ዘላለም ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁ በሰጣችሁ ምድር ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.fr: n''allez pas après d''autres dieux, pour les servir et pour vous prosterner devant eux, ne m''irritez pas par l''ouvrage de vos mains, et je ne vous ferai aucun mal.
verses.am: ታመልኩአቸውም ትሰግዱላቸውም ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አትከተሉ፥ ክፉም እንዳላደርግባችሁ በእጃችሁ ሥራ አታስቈጡኝ አለ።

verses.en: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the Lord; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.fr: Mais vous ne m''avez pas écouté, dit l''Eternel, afin de m''irriter par l''ouvrage de vos mains, pour votre malheur.
verses.am: ለእናንተ ጕዳት እንዲሆን በእጃችሁ ሥራ ታስቈጡኝ ዘንድ አልሰማችሁኝም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Parce que vous n''avez point écouté mes paroles,
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቃሌን አልሰማችሁምና እነሆ፥

verses.en: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.fr: j''enverrai chercher tous les peuples du septentrion, dit l''Eternel, et j''enverrai auprès de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, mon serviteur; je le ferai venir contre ce pays et contre ses habitants, et contre toutes ces nations à l''entour, afin de les dévouer par interdit, et d''en faire un objet de désolation et de moquerie, des ruines éternelles.
verses.am: ልኬ የሰሜንን ወገኖች ሁሉ ባሪያዬንም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናብከደነዖርን እወስዳለሁ፥ በዚህችም ምድር በሚቀመጡባትም ሰዎች በዙሪያዋም ባሉ በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ ፈጽሜም አጠፋቸዋለሁ፥ ለመደነቂያና ለማፍዋጫም ለዘላለምም ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.fr: Je ferai cesser parmi eux les cris de réjouissance et les cris d''allégresse, les chants du fiancé et les chants de la fiancée, le bruit de la meule et la lumière de la lampe.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ፥ የወፍጮንም ድምፅ የመብራትንም ብርሃን አስቀራለሁ።

verses.en: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.fr: Tout ce pays deviendra une ruine, un désert, et ces nations seront asservies au roi de Babylone pendant soixante-dix ans.
verses.am: ይህችም ምድር ሁሉ ባድማና መደነቂያ ትሆናለች፤ እነዚህም አሕዛብ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሰባ ዓመት ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the Lord, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.fr: Mais lorsque ces soixante-dix ans seront accomplis, je châtierai le roi de Babylone et cette nation, dit l''Eternel, à cause de leurs iniquités; je punirai le pays des Chaldéens, et j''en ferai des ruines éternelles.
verses.am: ሰባው ዓመትም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥና ያንን ሕዝብ ስለ ኃጢአታቸው እቀጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የከለዳውያንንም ምድር ለዘላለም ባድማ አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.fr: Je ferai venir sur ce pays toutes les choses que j''ai annoncées sur lui, tout ce qui est écrit dans ce livre, ce que Jérémie a prophétisé sur toutes les nations.
verses.am: በእርስዋም ላይ የተናገርሁትን ቃሌን ሁሉ፥ ማለት ኤርምያስ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ትንቢት የተናገረውን በዚህች መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ፥ በዚያች ምድር አመጣለሁ።

verses.en: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.fr: Car des nations puissantes et de grands rois les asserviront, eux aussi, et je leur rendrai selon leurs oeuvres et selon l''ouvrage de leurs mains.
verses.am: ብዙ አሕዛብና ታላላቆች ነገሥታት እነርሱን ያስገዙአቸዋል፤ እኔም እንደ አደራረጋቸውና እንደ እጃቸው ሥራ እከፍላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.fr: Car ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Prends de ma main cette coupe remplie du vin de ma colère, Et fais-la boire à toutes les nations Vers lesquelles je t''enverrai.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። የዚህን ቍጣ የወይን ጠጅ ጽዋ ከእጄ ውሰድ አንተንም የምሰድድባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ አጠጣቸው።

verses.en: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.fr: Ils boiront, et ils chancelleront et seront comme fous, A la vue du glaive que j''enverrai au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ከምሰድድባቸውም ሰይፍ የተነሣ ይጠጣሉ ይወላገዱማል ያብዳሉም።

verses.en: Then took I the cup at the Lord's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the Lord had sent me:
verses.fr: Et je pris la coupe de la main de l''Eternel, Et je la fis boire à toutes les nations Vers lesquelles l''Eternel m''envoyait:
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም እጅ ጽዋውን ወሰድሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እኔን የሰደደባቸውን አሕዛብ ሁሉ አጠጣኋቸው።

verses.en: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.fr: A Jérusalem et aux villes de Juda, A ses rois et à ses chefs, Pour en faire une ruine, Un objet de désolation, de moquerie et de malédiction, Comme cela se voit aujourd''hui;
verses.am: ዛሬ እንደ ሆነው ሁሉ ባድማና መደነቂያ ማፍዋጫም እርግማንም አደርጋቸው ዘንድ ኢየሩሳሌምንና የይሁዳን ከተሞች ነገሥታትዋንም አለቆችዋንም አጠጣኋቸው።

verses.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.fr: A Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, A ses serviteurs, à ses chefs, et à tout son peuple;
verses.am: የግብጽንም ንጉሥ ፈርዖንን ባሪያዎቹንም አለቆቹንም ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.fr: A toute l''Arabie, à tous les rois du pays d''Uts, A tous les rois du pays des Philistins, A Askalon, à Gaza, à Ekron, et à ce qui reste d''Asdod;
verses.am: የተደባለቀውንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ የዖፅ ምድር ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የፍልስጥኤም ምድር ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ አስቀሎናንም ጋዛንም አቃሮንንም የአዞጦንንም ቅሬታ፥

verses.en: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.fr: A Edom, A Moab, et aux enfants d''Ammon;
verses.am: ኤዶምያስንም፥ ሞዓብንም፥ የአሞንም ልጆች፥

verses.en: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
verses.fr: A tous les rois de Tyr, à tous les rois de Sidon, Et aux rois des îles qui sont au delà de la mer;
verses.am: የጤሮስን ነገሥታትም ሁሉ፥ የሲዶናን ነገሥታት ሁሉ፥ በባህር ማዶ ያለች የደሴት ነገሥታትንም፥

verses.en: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
verses.fr: A Dedan, à Théma, à Buz, Et à tous ceux qui se rasent les coins de la barbe;
verses.am: ድዳንንም፥ ቴማንንም፥ ቡዝንም፥ ጠጕራቸውንም የሚቈርጡትን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.fr: A tous les rois d''Arabie, Et à tous les rois des Arabes qui habitent dans le désert;
verses.am: የዓረብ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ በምድረ በዳ የሚቀመጡ የድብልቅ ሕዝብ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.fr: A tous les rois de Zimri, A tous les rois d''Elam, Et à tous les rois de Médie;
verses.am: የዘምሪ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የኤላም ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.fr: A tous les rois du septentrion, Proches ou éloignés, Aux uns et aux autres, Et à tous les royaumes du monde Qui sont sur la face de la terre. Et le roi de Schéschac boira après eux.
verses.am: የሜዶን ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የቀረቡና የራቁ፥ አንዱ ከሌላው ጋር ያሉ የሰሜን ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ በምድር ፊት ላይ ያሉ የዓለም መንግሥታትንም ሁሉ አጠጣኋቸው፤ የሼሻክም ንጉሥ ከእነርሱ በኋላ ይጠጣል።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.fr: Tu leur diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Buvez, enivrez-vous, et vomissez, Et tombez sans vous relever, A la vue du glaive que j''enverrai au milieu de vous!
verses.am: አንተም። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመካከላችሁ ከምሰድደው ሰይፍ የተነሣ ጠጡ፥ ስከሩም፥ አስታውኩም ውደቁም፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አትነሡም በላቸው።

verses.en: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.fr: Et s''ils refusent de prendre de ta main la coupe pour boire, Dis-leur: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Vous boirez!
verses.am: ይጠጡም ዘንድ ጽዋውን ከእጅህ ለመቀበል እንቢ ቢሉ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፈጽማችሁ ትጠጣላችሁ በላቸው።

verses.en: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Car voici, dans la ville sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué Je commence à faire du mal; Et vous, vous resteriez impunis! Vous ne resterez pas impunis; Car j''appellerai le glaive sur tous les habitants de la terre, Dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ስሜ የተጠራባትን ከተማ አስጨንቃት ዘንድ እጀምራለሁ፤ በውኑ እናንተ ያልተቀጣችሁ ትሆናላችሁን? በምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ሰይፍን እጠራለሁና ያለ ቅጣት አትቀሩም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.fr: Et toi, tu leur prophétiseras toutes ces choses, Et tu leur diras: L''Eternel rugira d''en haut; De sa demeure sainte il fera retentir sa voix; Il rugira contre le lieu de sa résidence; Il poussera des cris, comme ceux qui foulent au pressoir, Contre tous les habitants de la terre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ትንቢት ትናገርባቸዋለህ፥ እንዲህም ትላቸዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር በላይ ሆኖ ይጮኻል፥ በቅዱስ ማደሪያውም ሆኖ ድምፁን ያሰማል፤ በበረቱ ላይ እጅግ ይጮኻል፥ ወይንም እንደሚጠምቁ በምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ይጮኻል።

verses.en: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the Lord hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Le bruit parvient jusqu''à l''extrémité de la terre; Car l''Eternel est en dispute avec les nations, Il entre en jugement contre toute chair; Il livre les méchants au glaive, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከአሕዛብ ጋር ክርክር አለውና ድምፅ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ይደርሳል፤ ከሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ጋር ይፋረዳል፥ ኃቲአተኞችንም ለሰይፍ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici, la calamité va de nation en nation, Et une grande tempête s''élève des extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ ይወጣል፥ ጽኑም ዐውሎ ነፍስ ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣል።

verses.en: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.fr: Ceux que tuera l''Eternel en ce jour seront étendus D''un bout à l''autre de la terre; Ils ne seront ni pleurés, ni recueillis, ni enterrés, Ils seront comme du fumier sur la terre.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ግዳዩች ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ይሆናሉ፤ አይለቀስላቸውም፤ በምድር ላይ እንደ gWdፍ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አይከማቹም አይቀበሩምም።

verses.en: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.fr: Gémissez, pasteurs, et criez! Roulez-vous dans la cendre, conducteurs de troupeaux! Car les jours sont venus où vous allez être égorgés. Je vous briserai, et vous tomberez comme un vase de prix.
verses.am: ትታረዱና ትበተኑ ዘንድ ቀናችሁ ደርሶአልና፥ እንደ ተወደደም የሸክላ ዕቃ ትወድቃላችሁና እናንተ እረኞች፥ አልቅሱ ጩኹም፤ እናንተ የመንጋ አውራዎች፥ በአመድ ውስጥ ተንከባለሉ።

verses.en: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.fr: Plus de refuge pour les pasteurs! Plus de salut pour les conducteurs de troupeaux!
verses.am: ሽሽትም ከእረኞች ማምለጥም ከመንጋ አውራዎች ይጠፋል።

verses.en: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.fr: On entend les cris des pasteurs, Les gémissements des conducteurs de troupeaux; Car l''Eternel ravage leur pâturage.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ማሰማርያቸውን አጥፍቶአልና የእረኞች ጩኸት ድምፅ የመንጋ አውራዎችም ልቅሶ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les habitations paisibles sont détruites Par la colère ardente de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ KWTa የተነሣ የሰላም በረት ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.fr: Il a abandonné sa demeure comme un lionceau sa tanière; Car leur pays est réduit en désert Par la fureur du destructeur Et par son ardente colère.
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ መደቡን ለቅቆአል፤ ከአስጨናቂውም ሰይፍና ከጽኑ ቍጣው የተነሣ ምድራቸው ባድማ ሆናለችና።

verses.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: Au commencement du règne de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, cette parole fut prononcée de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Stand in the court of the Lord's house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the Lord's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Tiens-toi dans le parvis de la maison de l''Eternel, et dis à ceux qui de toutes les villes de Juda viennent se prosterner dans la maison de l''Eternel toutes les paroles que je t''ordonne de leur dire; n''en retranche pas un mot.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ቁም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ውስጥ ይሰግዱ ዘንድ ለሚመጡት ለይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ትነግራቸው ዘንድ ያዘዝሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገራቸው፤ አንዲትም ቃል አትgWdል።

verses.en: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.fr: Peut-être écouteront-ils, et reviendront-ils chacun de leur mauvaise voie; alors je me repentirai du mal que j''avais pensé leur faire à cause de la méchanceté de leurs actions.
verses.am: ምናልባት ይሰሙ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ይመለሱ ይሆናል፤ እኔም ስለ ሥራቸው ክፋት ያሰብሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር እተዋለሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.fr: Tu leur diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Si vous ne m''écoutez pas quand je vous ordonne de suivre ma loi que j''ai mise devant vous,
verses.am: እንዲህም በላቸው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በፊታችሁ በሰጠኋት ሕጌ ትሄዱ ዘንድ ባትሰሙኝ፥

verses.en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.fr: d''écouter les paroles de mes serviteurs, les prophètes, que je vous envoie, que je vous ai envoyés dès le matin, et que vous n''avez pas écoutés,
verses.am: ያልሰማችሁትን በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ወደ እናንተ የላክኋቸውን የባሪያዎቼን የነቢያትን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥

verses.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.fr: alors je traiterai cette maison comme Silo, et je ferai de cette ville un objet de malédiction pour toutes les nations de la terre.
verses.am: ይህን ቤት እንደ ሴሎ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ይህችንም ከተማ ለምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ እርግማን አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs, les prophètes, et tout le peuple, entendirent Jérémie prononcer ces paroles dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህናቱም ነቢያቱም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ኤርምያስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይህን ቃል ሲናገር ሰሙ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.fr: Et comme Jérémie achevait de dire tout ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné de dire à tout le peuple, les sacrificateurs, les prophètes, et tout le peuple, se saisirent de lui, en disant: Tu mourras!
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ነገር ሁሉ በፈጸመ ጊዜ ካህናትና ነቢያት ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ሞትን ትሞታለህ።

verses.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Pourquoi prophétises-tu au nom de l''Eternel, en disant: Cette maison sera comme Silo, et cette ville sera dévastée, privée d''habitants? Tout le peuple s''attroupa autour de Jérémie dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ስም። ይህ ቤት እንደ ሴሎ ይሆናል፥ ይህችም ከተማ ባድማና ወና ትሆናለች ብለህ ስለ ምን ትንቢት ተናገርህ? ብለው ያዙት። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በኤርምያስ ላይ ተሰብስበው ነበር።

verses.en: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the Lord, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the Lord's house.
verses.fr: Lorsque les chefs de Juda eurent appris ces choses, ils montèrent de la maison du roi à la maison de l''Eternel, et s''assirent à l''entrée de la porte neuve de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የይሁዳም አለቆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከንጉሥ ቤት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጡ፥ በአዲሱም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ደጅ መግቢያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.fr: Alors les sacrificateurs et les prophètes parlèrent ainsi aux chefs et à tout le peuple: Cet homme mérite la mort; car il a prophétisé contre cette ville, comme vous l''avez entendu de vos oreilles.
verses.am: ካህናቱና ነቢያቱም ለአለቆቹና ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ። በጆሮአችሁ እንደ ሰማችሁ በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ትንቢት ተናግአልና ይህ ሰው ሞት የሚገባው ነው ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.fr: Jérémie dit à tous les chefs et à tout le peuple: L''Eternel m''a envoyé pour prophétiser contre cette maison et contre cette ville, toutes les choses que vous avez entendues.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ለአለቆችና ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ። በሰማችሁት ቃል ሁሉ በዚህች ቤትና በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ትንቢት እናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ልኮኛል።

verses.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the Lord your God; and the Lord will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.fr: Maintenant réformez vos voies et vos oeuvres, écoutez la voix de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et l''Eternel se repentira du mal qu''il a prononcé contre vous.
verses.am: አሁንም መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን አሳምሩ፥ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረባችሁን ክፉ ነገር ይተዋል።

verses.en: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
verses.fr: Pour moi, me voici entre vos mains; traitez-moi comme il vous semblera bon et juste.
verses.am: እኔ ግን፥ እነሆ፥ በእጃችሁ ነኝ፤ በዓይናችሁ መልካምና ቅን የመሰለውን አድርጉብኝ።

verses.en: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the Lord hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.fr: Seulement sachez que, si vous me faites mourir, vous vous chargez du sang innocent, vous, cette ville et ses habitants; car l''Eternel m''a véritablement envoyé vers vous pour prononcer à vos oreilles toutes ces paroles.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በጆሮአችሁ እናገር ዘንድ በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ወደ እናንተ ልኮኛልና ብትገድሉኝ ንጹሕ ደምን በራሳችሁና በዚህች ከተማ በሚኖሩባትም ላይ እንድታመጡ በእርግጥ እወቁ።

verses.en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Les chefs et tout le peuple dirent aux sacrificateurs et aux prophètes: Cet homme ne mérite point la mort; car c''est au nom de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, qu''il nous a parlé.
verses.am: አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ለካህናትና ለነቢያት። ይህ ሰው በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ተናግሮናልና ሞት አይገባውም አሉ።

verses.en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.fr: Et quelques-uns des anciens du pays se levèrent, et dirent à toute l''assemblée du peuple:
verses.am: ከአገሩ ሽማግሌዎችም ሰዎች ተነሥተው ለሕዝቡ ጉባኤ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.fr: Michée, de Moréscheth, prophétisait du temps d''Ezéchias, roi de Juda, et il disait à tout le peuple de Juda: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Sion sera labourée comme un champ, Jérusalem deviendra un monceau de pierres, Et la montagne de la maison une haute forêt.
verses.am: ሞሬታዊው ሚክያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ነቢይ ነበረ፤ ለይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጽዮን እንደ እርሻ ትታረሳለች፥ ኢየሩሳሌም የፍርስራሽ ክምር ትሆናለች፥ የቤቱም ተራራ እንደ ዱር ከፍታ ይሆናል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the Lord, and besought the Lord, and the Lord repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.fr: Ezéchias, roi de Juda, et tout Juda l''ont-ils fait mourir? Ezéchias ne craignit-il pas l''Eternel? N''implora-t-il pas l''Eternel? Alors l''Eternel se repentit du mal qu''il avait prononcé contre eux. Et nous, nous chargerions notre âme d''un si grand crime!
verses.am: በውኑ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ገደሉትን? በውኑ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈሩምን? ወደ እግዚአብሔርስ አልተማለሉምን? እግዚአብሔርስ የተናገረባቸውን ክፉ ነገር አይተውምን? እኛም በነፍሳችን ላይ ታላቅ ክፋት እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the Lord, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.fr: Il y eut aussi un homme qui prophétisait au nom de l''Eternel, Urie, fils de Schemaeja, de Kirjath-Jearim. Il prophétisa contre cette ville et contre ce pays entièrement les mêmes choses que Jérémie.
verses.am: ደግሞም በእግዚአብሔር ስም ትንቢት የተናገረ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም የቂርያትይዓሪም ሰው የሸማያ ልጅ ኦርዮ ይባል ነበር፤ በዚህችም ከተማ በዚህችም ምድር ላይ እንደ ኤርምያስ ቃል ሁሉ ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.en: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.fr: Le roi Jojakim, tous ses vaillants hommes, et tous ses chefs, entendirent ses paroles, et le roi chercha à le faire mourir. Urie, qui en fut informé, eut peur, prit la fuite, et alla en Egypte.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮአቄም ኃያላኑም ሁሉ አለቆቹም ሁሉ ቃሉን በሰሙ ጊዜ ንጉሡ ሊገድለው ፈለገ፤ ኦርዮም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ፈርቶ ሸሸ ወደ ግብጽም ገባ።

verses.en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
verses.fr: Le roi Jojakim envoya des gens en Egypte, Elnathan, fils d''Acbor, et des gens avec lui en Egypte.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮአቄም የዓክቦርን ልጅ ኤልናታንን ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎችን ሰዎች ወደ ግብጽ ላካቸው፤

verses.en: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.fr: Ils firent sortir d''Egypte Urie et l''amenèrent au roi Jojakim, qui le fit mourir par l''épée et jeta son cadavre sur les sépulcres des enfants du peuple.
verses.am: ከግብጽም ኦርዮን አውጥተው ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኢዮአቄም ይዘውት መጡ፤ እርሱም በሰይፍ ገደለው ሬሳውንም ክቡራን ባልሆኑ ሰዎች መቃብር ጣለው።

verses.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.fr: Cependant la main d''Achikam, fils de Schaphan, fut avec Jérémie, et empêcha qu''il ne fût livré au peuple pour être mis à mort.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሕዝቡ እጅ እንዳይሰጥና እንዳይገድሉት የሳፋን ልጅ የአኪቃም እጅ ከኤርምያስ ጋር ነበረች።

verses.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: Au commencement du règne de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, cette parole fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
verses.fr: Ainsi m''a parlé l''Eternel: Fais-toi des liens et des jougs, et mets-les sur ton cou.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። እስራትና ቀንበር ሥራ በአንገትህም ላይ አድርግ፤

verses.en: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
verses.fr: Envoie-les au roi d''Edom, au roi de Moab, au roi des enfants d''Ammon, au roi de Tyr et au roi de Sidon, par les envoyés qui sont venus à Jérusalem auprès de Sédécias, roi de Juda,
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥም ወደ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በመጡት መልእክተኞች እጅ ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ ወደ ሞዓብም ንጉሥ ወደ አሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ ወደ ጢሮስም ንጉሥ ወደ ሲዶናም ንጉሥ ላካቸው።

verses.en: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
verses.fr: et à qui tu donneras mes ordres pour leurs maîtres, en disant: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici ce que vous direz à vos maîtres:
verses.am: ለጌቶቻቸውም እንዲነግሩ እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለጌቶቻችሁ እንዲህ በሉ።

verses.en: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui ai fait la terre, les hommes et les animaux qui sont sur la terre, par ma grande puissance et par mon bras étendu, et je donne la terre à qui cela me plaît.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን በምድርም ፊት ላይ ያሉትን ሰዎችንና እንስሶችን በታላቅ ኃይሌና በተዘረጋችው ክንዴ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ ለዓይኔም መልካም ለሆነው እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.en: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.fr: Maintenant je livre tous ces pays entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, mon serviteur; je lui donne aussi les animaux des champs, pour qu''ils lui soient assujettis.
verses.am: አሁንም እነዚህን ምድሮች ሁሉ ለባሪያዬ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ፤ ይገዙለትም ዘንድ የምድረ በዳ አራዊትን ደግሞ ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.fr: Toutes les nations lui seront soumises, à lui, à son fils, et au fils de son fils, jusqu''à ce que le temps de son pays arrive, et que des nations puissantes et de grands rois l''asservissent.
verses.am: የገዛ ራሱም ምድር ጊዜ እስኪመጣ ድረስ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለእርሱና ለልጅ ለልጅ ልጁም ይገዛሉ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙ አሕዛብና ታላላቆች ነገሥታት እርሱን ያስገዙታል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the Lord, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.fr: Si une nation, si un royaume ne se soumet pas à lui, à Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, et ne livre pas son cou au joug du roi de Babylone, je châtierai cette nation par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste, dit l''Eternel, jusqu''à ce que je l''aie anéantie par sa main.
verses.am: ለባቢሎን ንጉሥም ለናቡከደነፆር የማይገዛውን፥ ከባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የማያደርገውን ሕዝብና መንግሥት፥ ያን ሕዝብ በእጁ እስካጠፋው ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም እቀጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.fr: Et vous, n''écoutez pas vos prophètes, vos devins, vos songeurs, vos astrologues, vos magiciens, qui vous disent: Vous ne serez point asservis au roi de Babylone!
verses.am: እናንተ ግን። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን ነቢያቶቻችሁንና ምዋርተኞቻችሁን፥ ሕልም አላሚዎቻችሁንና ቃላተኞቻችሁን መተተኞቻችሁንም አትስሙ፤

verses.en: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.fr: Car c''est le mensonge qu''ils vous prophétisent, afin que vous soyez éloignés de votre pays, afin que je vous chasse et que vous périssiez.
verses.am: ከምድራቸሁ እንዲያርቁአችሁ፥ እኔም እንዳሳድዳችሁ እናንተም እንድትጠፉ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገሩላችኋልና።

verses.en: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the Lord; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.fr: Mais la nation qui pliera son cou sous le joug du roi de Babylone, et qui lui sera soumise, je la laisserai dans son pays, dit l''Eternel, pour qu''elle le cultive et qu''elle y demeure.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የሚያደርገውንና የሚገዛለትን ሕዝብ በአገሩ ላይ እተወዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ያርሱአታል ይቀመጡባትማል።

verses.en: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.fr: J''ai dit entièrement les mêmes choses à Sédécias, roi de Juda: Pliez votre cou sous le joug du roi de Babylone, soumettez-vous à lui et à son peuple, et vous vivrez.
verses.am: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስም በዚህ ቃል ተናገርሁ። ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገታችሁን ዝቅ አድርጉ ለእርሱና ለሕዝቡም ተገዙላቸው በሕይወትም ኑሩ።

verses.en: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.fr: Pourquoi mourriez-vous, toi et ton peuple, par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste, comme l''Eternel l''a prononcé sur la nation qui ne se soumettra pas au roi de Babylone?
verses.am: ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይገዛ ዘንድ እንቢ ስላለ ሕዝብ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ፥ አንተና ሕዝብህ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለምን ትሞታላችሁ?

verses.en: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.fr: N''écoutez pas les paroles des prophètes qui vous disent: Vous ne serez point asservis au roi de Babylone! Car c''est le mensonge qu''ils vous prophétisent.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያትን ቃል አትስሙ።

verses.en: For I have not sent them, saith the Lord, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.fr: Je ne les ai point envoyés, dit l''Eternel, et ils prophétisent le mensonge en mon nom, afin que je vous chasse et que vous périssiez, vous et les prophètes qui vous prophétisent.
verses.am: እኔ አልላክኋቸውምና፤ ነገር ግን እኔ እንዳሳድዳችሁ፥ እናንተና ትንቢት የሚናገሩላችሁ ነቢያትም እንድትጠፉ በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገራሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the Lord's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.fr: J''ai dit aux sacrificateurs et à tout ce peuple: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: N''écoutez pas les paroles de vos prophètes qui vous prophétisent, disant: Voici, les ustensiles de la maison de l''Eternel seront bientôt rapportés de Babylone! Car c''est le mensonge qu''ils vous prophétisent.
verses.am: ለካህናትም ለዚህም ሕዝብ እንዲህ ብዬ ተናገርሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሐሰተኛውን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ በቅርብ ጊዜ ከባቢሎን ይመለሳል የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያቶቻችሁን ቃል አትስሙ።

verses.en: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.fr: Ne les écoutez pas, soumettez-vous au roi de Babylone, et vous vivrez. Pourquoi cette ville deviendrait-elle une ruine?
verses.am: እነርሱም አትስሙ፤ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ተገዙ በሕይወትም ኑሩ። ይህችስ ከተማ ስለ ምን ባድማ ትሆናለች?

verses.en: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the Lord be with them, let them now make intercession to the Lord of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.fr: S''ils sont prophètes et si la parole de l''Eternel est avec eux, qu''ils intercèdent auprès de l''Eternel des armées pour que les ustensiles qui restent dans la maison de l''Eternel, dans la maison du roi de Juda, et dans Jérusalem, ne s''en aillent point à Babylone.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ ቢገኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም የቀረችው ዕቃ ወደ ባቢሎን እንዳትሄድ ወደ ሠራዊት ጌታ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይማለሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées au sujet des colonnes, de la mer, des bases, et des autres ustensiles qui sont restés dans cette ville,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ስለ ቀረችው ዕቃ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.fr: qui n''ont pas été enlevés par Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, lorsqu''il emmena captifs de Jérusalem à Babylone Jeconia, fils de Jojakim, roi de Juda, et tous les grands de Juda et de Jérusalem,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ስለ ቀረችው ዕቃ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Yea, thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
verses.fr: ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël, au sujet des ustensiles qui restent dans la maison de l''Eternel, dans la maison du roi de Juda, et dans Jérusalem:
verses.am: ወደ ባቢሎን ትወሰዳለች እስከምጐበኛትም ቀን ድረስ በዚያ ትኖራለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አወጣታለሁ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ።

verses.en: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the Lord; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
verses.fr: Ils seront emportés à Babylone, et ils y resteront jusqu''au jour où je les chercherai, dit l''Eternel, où je les ferai remonter et revenir dans ce lieu.
verses.am: ወደ ባቢሎን ትወሰዳለች እስከምጐበኛትም ቀን ድረስ በዚያ ትኖራለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አወጣታለሁ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the Lord, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.fr: Dans la même année, au commencement du règne de Sédécias, roi de Juda, le cinquième mois de la quatrième année, Hanania, fils d''Azzur, prophète, de Gabaon, me dit dans la maison de l''Eternel, en présence des sacrificateurs et de tout le peuple:
verses.am: በዚያም ዓመት በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ በአራተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ነቢዩ የገባዖን ሰው የዓዙር ልጅ ሐናንያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በካህናትና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Je brise le joug du roi de Babylone!
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ይናገራል። የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር ሰብሬአለሁ።

verses.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the Lord's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
verses.fr: Encore deux années, et je fais revenir dans ce lieu tous les ustensiles de la maison de l''Eternel, que Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, a enlevés de ce lieu, et qu''il a emportés à Babylone.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ከዚህች ስፍራ ወደ ባቢሎን የወሰዳትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the Lord: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.fr: Et je ferai revenir dans ce lieu, dit l''Eternel, Jeconia, fils de Jojakim, roi de Juda, et tous les captifs de Juda, qui sont allés à Babylone; car je briserai le joug du roi de Babylone.
verses.am: ወደ ባቢሎንም የሄዱትን የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ ሁሉ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር እሰብራለሁና።

verses.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the Lord,
verses.fr: Jérémie, le prophète, répondit à Hanania, le prophète, en présence des sacrificateurs et de tout le peuple qui se tenaient dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም በካህናቱና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በቆሙት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ለነቢዩ ለሐናንያ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the Lord do so: the Lord perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the Lord's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
verses.fr: Jérémie, le prophète, dit: Amen! que l''Eternel fasse ainsi! que l''Eternel accomplisse les paroles que tu as prophétisées, et qu''il fasse revenir de Babylone en ce lieu les ustensiles de la maison de l''Eternel et tous les captifs!
verses.am: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ እንዲህ አለ። አሜን፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያድርግ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ምርኮውንም ሁሉ ከባቢሎን ወደዚህ ስፍራ በመመለስ እግዚአብሔር የተናገርኸውን ትንቢት ይፈጽም።

verses.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.fr: Seulement écoute cette parole que je prononce à tes oreilles et aux oreilles de tout le peuple:
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጆሮህና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ጆሮ የምናገረውን ይህን ቃል ስማ፤

verses.en: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.fr: Les prophètes qui ont paru avant moi et avant toi, dès les temps anciens, ont prophétisé contre des pays puissants et de grands royaumes la guerre, le malheur et la peste;
verses.am: ከጥንት ከእኔና ከአንተ በፊት የነበሩ ነቢያት በብዙ አገርና በታላላቅ መንግሥታት ላይ ስለ ሰልፍና ስለ ክፉ ነገር ስለ ቸነፈርም ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.
verses.fr: mais si un prophète prophétise la paix, c''est par l''accomplissement de ce qu''il prophétise qu''il sera reconnu comme véritablement envoyé par l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለ ሰላም የተናገረ ነቢይ፥ የነቢዩ ቃል በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት የሰደደው ነቢይ እንደ ሆነ ይታወቃል።

verses.en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
verses.fr: Alors Hanania, le prophète, enleva le joug de dessus le cou de Jérémie, le prophète, et il le brisa.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ወስዶ ሰበረው።

verses.en: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.fr: Et Hanania dit en présence de tout le peuple: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: C''est ainsi que, dans deux années, je briserai de dessus le cou de toutes les nations le joug de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone. Et Jérémie, le prophète, s''en alla.
verses.am: ሐናንያም በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲሁ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ የናቡከደነፆርን ቀንበር ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ አንገት እሰብራለሁ አለ። ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.en: Then the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: Après que Hanania, le prophète, eut brisé le joug de dessus le cou de Jérémie, le prophète, la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie, en ces mots:
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ከሰበረ በኋላ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
verses.fr: Va, et dis à Hanania: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Tu as brisé un joug de bois, et tu auras à sa place un joug de fer.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ ለሐናንያ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ የእንጨትን ቀንበር ሰብረሃል፥ እኔ ግን በእርሱ ፋንታ የብረትን ቀንበር እሠራለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Je mets un joug de fer sur le cou de toutes ces nations, pour qu''elles soient asservies à Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, et elles lui seront asservies; je lui donne aussi les animaux des champs.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር ይገዙለት ዘንድ የብረትን ቀንበር በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ አንገት ላይ አድርጌአለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይገዙለታል፥ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ደግሞ ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The Lord hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.fr: Et Jérémie, le prophète, dit à Hanania, le prophète: Ecoute, Hanania! L''Eternel ne t''a point envoyé, et tu inspires à ce peuple une fausse confiance.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ ነቢዩን ሐናንያን። ሐናንያ ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ይህ ሕዝብ በሐሰት እንዲታመን አድርገሃል እንጂ እግዚአብሔር አልላከህም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je te chasse de la terre; tu mourras cette année; car tes paroles sont une révolte contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከምድር ላይ እሰድድሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዓመፅን ተናግረሃልና በዚህ ዓመት ትሞታለህ አለው።

verses.en: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.fr: Et Hanania, le prophète, mourut cette année-là, dans le septième mois.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ በዚያው ዓመት በሰባተኛው ወር ሞተ።

verses.en: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.fr: Voici le contenu de la lettre que Jérémie, le prophète, envoya de Jérusalem au reste des anciens en captivité, aux sacrificateurs, aux prophètes, et à tout le peuple, que Nebucadnetsar avait emmenés captifs de Jérusalem à Babylone,
verses.am: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ወደ ተረፉት የምርኮ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ወደ ካህናቱም፥ ወደ ነቢያቱም፥ ናቡከደነፆር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ማርኮ ወዳፈለሰውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌም የላከው የደብዳቤው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.fr: après que le roi Jeconia, la reine, les eunuques, les chefs de Juda et de Jérusalem, les charpentiers et les serruriers, furent sortis de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው ንጉሡ ኢኮንያን እናቱም እቴጌይቱ ጃንደረቦቹም የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌምም አለቆች ጠራቢዎችና ብረት ሠራተኞችም ከኢየሩሳሌም ከወው በኋላ ነው።

verses.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.fr: Il la remit à Eleasa, fils de Schaphan, et à Guemaria, fils de Hilkija, envoyés à Babylone par Sédécias, roi de Juda, auprès de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone. Elle était ainsi conçue:
verses.am: ኤርምያስ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ባቢሎን በላካቸው በሳፋን ልጅ በኤልዓሣና በኬልቅያስ ልጅ በገማርያ እጅ ደብዳቤውን እንዲህ ሲል ላከው።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël, à tous les captifs que j''ai emmenés de Jérusalem à Babylone:
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ላስማረክኋቸው ምርኮኞች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.fr: Bâtissez des maisons, et habitez-les; plantez des jardins, et mangez-en les fruits.
verses.am: ቤት ሠርታችሁ ተቀመጡ፥ አታክልትም ተክላችሁ ፍሬዋን ብሉ፤

verses.en: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.fr: Prenez des femmes, et engendrez des fils et des filles; prenez des femmes pour vos fils, et donnez des maris à vos filles, afin qu''elles enfantent des fils et des filles; multipliez là où vous êtes, et ne diminuez pas.
verses.am: ተጋቡ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ውለዱ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁንም አጋቡ፥ እነርሱም ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆች ይውለዱ፤ ከዚያም ተባዙ ጥቂቶችም አትሁኑ።

verses.en: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the Lord for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.fr: Recherchez le bien de la ville où je vous ai menés en captivité, et priez l''Eternel en sa faveur, parce que votre bonheur dépend du sien.
verses.am: በእርስዋ ሰላም ሰላም ይሆንላችኋልና ወደ እርስዋ ላስማርክኋችሁ ከተማ ሰላምን ፈልጉ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Ne vous laissez pas tromper par vos prophètes qui sont au milieu de vous, et par vos devins, n''écoutez pas vos songeurs dont vous provoquez les songes!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በመካከላችሁ ያሉት ነቢያቶቻችሁና ምዋርተኞቻችሁ አያታልሉአችሁ፥ እናንተም የምታልሙትን ሕልም አትስሙ።

verses.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Car c''est le mensonge qu''ils vous prophétisent en mon nom. Je ne les ai point envoyés, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገሩላችኋልና፤ እኔም አልላክኋቸውም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.fr: Mais voici ce que dit l''Eternel: Dès que soixante-dix ans seront écoulés pour Babylone, je me souviendrai de vous, et j''accomplirai à votre égard ma bonne parole, en vous ramenant dans ce lieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰባው ዓመት በባቢሎን በተፈጸመ ጊዜ እጐበኛችኋለሁ፥ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳችሁ ዘንድ መልካሚቱን ቃሌን እፈጽምላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.fr: Car je connais les projets que j''ai formés sur vous, dit l''Eternel, projets de paix et non de malheur, afin de vous donner un avenir et de l''espérance.
verses.am: ለእናንተ የማስባትን አሳብ እኔ አውቃለሁ፤ ፍጻሜና ተስፋ እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሰላም አሳብ ነው እንጂ የክፉ ነገር አይደለም።

verses.en: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.fr: Vous m''invoquerez, et vous partirez; vous me prierez, et je vous exaucerai.
verses.am: እናንተም ትጠሩኛለችሁ፥ ሄዳችሁም ወደ እኔ ትጸልያላችሁ፥ እኔም እሰማችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.fr: Vous me chercherez, et vous me trouverez, si vous me cherchez de tout votre coeur.
verses.am: እናንተ ትሹኛላችሁ፥ በፍጹም ልባችሁም ከሻችሁኝ ታገኙኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And I will be found of you, saith the Lord: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the Lord; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.fr: Je me laisserai trouver par vous, dit l''Eternel, et je ramènerai vos captifs; je vous rassemblerai de toutes les nations et de tous les lieux où je vous ai chassés, dit l''Eternel, et je vous ramènerai dans le lieu d''où je vous ai fait aller en captivité.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ዘንድ እገኛለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ምርኮአችሁንም እመልሳለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ ዘንድ እናንተንም ካሳደድሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እናንተንም ለምርኮ ወዳፈለስሁበት ስፍራ እመልሳችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Because ye have said, The Lord hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.fr: Cependant vous dites: Dieu nous a suscité des prophètes à Babylone!
verses.am: እናንተም። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ነቢያትን አስነሥቶልናል ብላችኋልና፤

verses.en: Know that thus saith the Lord of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel sur le roi qui occupe le trône de David, sur tout le peuple qui habite cette ville, sur vos frères qui ne sont point allés avec vous en captivité;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዳዊት ዙፋን ስለ ተቀመጠ ንጉሥ ከእናንተም ጋር ስላልተማረኩት ወንድሞቻችሁ፥ በዚህች ከተማ ስለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.fr: ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici, j''enverrai parmi eux l''épée, la famine et la peste, et je les rendrai semblables à des figues affreuses qui ne peuvent être mangées à cause de leur mauvaise qualité.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሰይፍንና ራብን ቸነፈርንም እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፥ ከክፋቱም የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ እንደማይቻል እንደ ክፉ በለስ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.fr: Je les poursuivrai par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste, je les rendrai un objet d''effroi pour tous les royaumes de la terre, un sujet de malédiction, de désolation, de moquerie et d''opprobre, parmi toutes les nations où je les chasserai,
verses.am: በሰይፍም በራብም በቸነፈርም አሳዳድዳቸዋለሁ፥ ባሳደድሁባቸውም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ዘንድ ለጥላቻና ለመደነቂያ ለማፍዋጫም ለመሰደቢያም እንዲሆኑ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ዘንድ ለመበተን አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the Lord, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: parce qu''ils n''ont pas écouté mes paroles, dit l''Eternel, eux à qui j''ai envoyé mes serviteurs, les prophètes, à qui je les ai envoyés dès le matin; et ils n''ont pas écouté, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ወደ እነርሱ ሰድጃለሁና፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the Lord, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.fr: Mais vous, écoutez la parole de l''Eternel, vous tous, captifs, que j''ai envoyés de Jérusalem à Babylone!
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን የሰደድኋችሁ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël, sur Achab, fils de Kolaja, et sur Sédécias, fils de Maaséja, qui vous prophétisent le mensonge en mon nom: Voici, je les livre entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone; et il les fera mourir sous vos yeux.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ስለሚናገሩላችሁ ስለ ቆላያ ልጅ ስለ አክዓብና ስለ መዕሤያ ልጅ ስለ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ በዓይኖቻችሁም ፊት ይገድላቸዋል።

verses.en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.fr: On se servira d''eux comme d''un sujet de malédiction, parmi tous les captifs de Juda qui sont à Babylone; on dira: Que l''Eternel te traite comme Sédécias et comme Achab, que le roi de Babylone a fait rôtir au feu!
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የተነሣ በባቢሎን ያሉ የይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእሳት እንደ ጠበሳቸው እንደ ሴዴቅያስና እንደ አክዓብ እግዚአብሔር ያድርግህ የምትባል እርግማንን ያነሣሉ፤ እኔም አውቃለሁ ምስክርም ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Et cela arrivera parce qu''ils ont commis une infamie en Israël, se livrant à l''adultère avec les femmes de leur prochain, et parce qu''ils ont dit des mensonges en mon nom, quand je ne leur avais point donné d''ordre. Je le sais, et j''en suis témoin, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ዘንድ ስንፍና አድርገዋልና፥ ከባልንጀሮቻቸውም ሚስቶች ጋር አመንዝረዋልና፥ ያላዘዝኋቸውንም ቃል በስሜ በሐሰት ተናግረዋልና።

verses.en: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.fr: Tu diras à Schemaeja, Néchélamite:
verses.am: ለኔሔላማዊው ለሸማያ እንዲህ በል።

verses.en: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Tu as envoyé en ton nom à tout le peuple de Jérusalem, à Sophonie, fils de Maaséja, le sacrificateur, et à tous les sacrificateurs, une lettre ainsi conçue:
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ካህኑም ወደ መዕሤያ ልጅ ወደ ሶፎንያስ፥ ወደ ካህናቱም ሁሉ ደብዳቤዎችን በስምህ እንዲህ ስትል ልከሃል።

verses.en: The Lord hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the Lord, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.fr: L''Eternel t''a établi sacrificateur à la place de Jehojada, le sacrificateur, afin qu''il y ait dans la maison de l''Eternel des inspecteurs pour surveiller tout homme qui est fou et se donne pour prophète, et afin que tu le mettes en prison et dans les fers.
verses.am: እያበደ ትንቢት የሚናገርን ሰው ሁሉ በእግር ግንድና በዛንጅር ታኖረው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አለቃ እንድትሆን እግዚአብሔር በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ፋንታ ካህን አድርጎሃል።

verses.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.fr: Maintenant, pourquoi ne réprimes-tu pas Jérémie d''Anathoth, qui prophétise parmi vous,
verses.am: አሁንስ ትንቢት ተናጋሪውን የዓናቶቱን ሰው ኤርምያስን ስለ ምን አትዘልፈውም?

verses.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.fr: qui nous a même envoyé dire à Babylone: Elle sera longue, la captivité; bâtissez des maisons, et habitez-les; plantez des jardins, et mangez-en les fruits! -
verses.am: እርሱ። ምርኮው የረዘመው ነውና ቤት ሠርታችሁ ተቀመጡ፥ አታክልትንም ተክላችሁ ፍሬዋን ብሉ ብሎ ወደ እኛ ወደ ባቢሎን ልኮአልና።

verses.en: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.fr: Sophonie, le sacrificateur, lut cette lettre en présence de Jérémie, le prophète. -
verses.am: ካህኑም ሶፎንያስ ይህን ደብዳቤ በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ ጆሮ አነበበው።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.fr: Fais dire à tous les captifs: Ainsi parle l''Eternel sur Schemaeja, Néchélamite: Parce que Schemaeja vous prophétise, sans que je l''aie envoyé, et qu''il vous inspire une fausse confiance,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኔሔላማዊው ስለ ሸማያ እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ወደ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ላክ። እኔ ሳልልከው ሸማያ ትንቢት ተናግሮላችኋልና፥ በሐሰትም እንድትታመኑ አድርጎአችኋልና፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the Lord; because he hath taught rebellion against the Lord.
verses.fr: voici ce que dit l''Eternel: Je châtierai Schemaeja, Néchélamite, et sa postérité; nul des siens n''habitera au milieu de ce peuple, et il ne verra pas le bien que je ferai à mon peuple, dit l''Eternel; car ses paroles sont une révolte contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ኔሔላማዊውን ሸማያንና ዘሩን እቀጣለሁ፤ እኔም የማደርግላችሁን መልካሙን ነገር የሚያይ ሰው በመካከላችሁ አይኖርላችሁም

verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus speaketh the Lord God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Ecris dans un livre toutes les paroles que je t''ai dites.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የነገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ በመጽሐፍ ጻፍ።

verses.en: For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the Lord: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, où je ramènerai les captifs de mon peuple d''Israël et de Juda, dit l''Eternel; je les ramènerai dans le pays que j''ai donné à leurs pères, et ils le posséderont.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሕዝቤን የእስራኤልንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ የምመልስባት ዘመን ይመጣልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ እነርሱም ይገዙአታል።

verses.en: And these are the words that the Lord spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.fr: Ce sont ici les paroles que l''Eternel a prononcées sur Israël et sur Juda.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤልና ስለ ይሁዳ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Nous entendons des cris d''effroi; C''est l''épouvante, ce n''est pas la paix.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። የሚያስፈራ ድምፅ ሰምተናል፤ የፍርሃት ነው እንጂ የሰላም አይደለም።

verses.en: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.fr: Informez-vous, et regardez si un mâle enfante! Pourquoi vois-je tous les hommes les mains sur leurs reins, Comme une femme en travail? Pourquoi tous les visages sont-ils devenus pâles?
verses.am: ጠይቁ፥ ወንድ ይወልድ እንደ ሆነ ተመልከቱ፤ ስለ ምን ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ወላድ እጁን በወገቡ ላይ አድርጎ ፊቱም ሁሉ ወደ ጥቁረት ተለውጦ አየሁ?

verses.en: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble, but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.fr: Malheur! car ce jour est grand; Il n''y en a point eu de semblable. C''est un temps d''angoisse pour Jacob; Mais il en sera délivré.
verses.am: ወዮ! ያ ቀን ታላቅ ነውና፥ እርሱንም የሚመስል የለምና፤ ያ የያዕቆብ መከራ ዘመን ነው፥ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ይድናል።

verses.en: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel des armées, Je briserai son joug de dessus ton cou, Je romprai tes liens, Et des étrangers ne t''assujettiront plus.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ቀንበርን ከአንገትህ እሰብራለሁ፥ እስራትህንም እበጥሳለሁ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ለሌላ አትገዛም፤

verses.en: But they shall serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.fr: Ils serviront l''Eternel, leur Dieu, Et David, leur roi, que je leur susciterai.
verses.am: ለአምላካቸው ለእግዚአብሔርም ለማስነሣላቸው ለንጉሣቸው ለዳዊትም ይገዛሉ እንጂ ሌሎች አሕዛብ እንደ ገና አይገዙአቸውም።

verses.en: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.fr: Et toi, mon serviteur Jacob, ne crains pas, dit l''Eternel; Ne t''effraie pas, Israël! Car je te délivrerai de la terre lointaine, Je délivrerai ta postérité du pays où elle est captive; Jacob reviendra, il jouira du repos et de la tranquillité, Et il n''y aura personne pour le troubler.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አንተን ከሩቅ ዘርህንም ከምርኮ አገር አድናለሁና ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ ያዕቆብም ይመለሳል ያርፍማል ተዘልሎም ይቀመጣል፤ ማንም አያስፈራውም።

verses.en: For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet I will not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.fr: Car je suis avec toi, dit l''Eternel, pour te délivrer; J''anéantirai toutes les nations parmi lesquelles je t''ai dispersé, Mais toi, je ne t''anéantirai pas; Je te châtierai avec équité, Je ne puis pas te laisser impuni.
verses.am: አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንተንም የበተንሁባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁ፥ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም፤ በመጠን እቀጣሃለሁ፥ ያለ ቅጣትም ከቶ አልተውህም።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Ta blessure est grave, Ta plaie est douloureuse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስብራትህ የማይፈወስ ቍስልህም ክፉ ነው።

verses.en: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.fr: Nul ne défend ta cause, pour bander ta plaie; Tu n''as ni remède, ni moyen de guérison.
verses.am: ትጠገን ዘንድ ክርክርህን የሚፈርድልህ የለም፥ ቍስልህንም የሚፈውስ መድኃኒት የለህም።

verses.en: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui t''aimaient t''oublient, Aucun ne prend souci de toi; Car je t''ai frappée comme frappe un ennemi, Je t''ai châtiée avec violence, A cause de la multitude de tes iniquités, Du grand nombre de tes péchés.
verses.am: ውሽሞችህ ሁሉ ረስተውሃል አይፈልጉህምም፤ በደልህ ታላቅ ስለሆነ ኃጢአትህም ስለ በዛ፥ በጠላት ማቍሰልና በጨካኝ ቅጣት አቍስዬሃለሁና።
