verses.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.fr: Pourquoi te plaindre de ta blessure, De la douleur que cause ton mal? C''est à cause de la multitude de tes iniquités, Du grand nombre de tes péchés, Que je t''ai fait souffrir ces choses.
verses.am: ሕመምህ የማይፈወስ ሆኖአልና ስለ ስብራትህ ለምን ትጮኻለህ? በደልህ ታላቅ ስለሆነ ኃጢአትህም ስለ በዛ፥ ይህን አድርጌብሃለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.fr: Cependant, tous ceux qui te dévorent seront dévorés, Et tous tes ennemis, tous, iront en captivité; Ceux qui te dépouillent seront dépouillés, Et j''abandonnerai au pillage tous ceux qui te pillent.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሚውጡህ ሁሉ ይዋጣሉ፥ ጠላቶችህም ሁላቸው ይማረካሉ፤ የዘረፉህም ይዘረፋሉ፥ የበዘበዙህንም ሁሉ ለመበዝበዝ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.fr: Mais je te guérirai, je panserai tes plaies, Dit l''Eternel. Car ils t''appellent la repoussée, Cette Sion dont nul ne prend souci.
verses.am: እኔ ጤናህን እመልስልሃለሁ ቍስልህንም እፈውሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ማንም የማይሻት፥ የተጣለች ጽዮን ብለው ጠርተውሻልና።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je ramène les captifs des tentes de Jacob, J''ai compassion de ses demeures; La ville sera rebâtie sur ses ruines, Le palais sera rétabli comme il était.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የያዕቆብን ድንኳን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ለማደሪያውም እራራለሁ፤ ከተማይቱም በጉብታዋ ላይ ትሠራለች፥ አዳራሹም እንደ ዱሮው የሰው መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.fr: Du milieu d''eux s''élèveront des actions de grâces Et des cris de réjouissance; Je les multiplierai, et ils ne diminueront pas; Je les honorerai, et ils ne seront pas méprisés.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ የምስጋናና የዘፋኞች ድምፅ ይወጣል፤ እኔም አበዛቸዋለሁ አያንሱምም፥ እኔም አከብራቸዋለሁ ታናሽም አይሆኑም።

verses.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.fr: Ses fils seront comme autrefois, Son assemblée subsistera devant moi, Et je châtierai tous ses oppresseurs.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውም እንደ ቀድሞ ይሆናሉ፥ ማኅበራቸውም በፊቴ ጸንቶ ይኖራል፤ የሚያስጨንቋቸውንም ሁሉ እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Son chef sera tiré de son sein, Son dominateur sortira du milieu de lui; Je le ferai approcher, et il viendra vers moi; Car qui oserait de lui-même s''approcher de moi? Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: አለቃቸው ከእነርሱ ውስጥ ይሆናል፥ ገዥአቸውም ከመካከላቸው ይወጣል፤ እኔ አቀርበዋለሁ እርሱም ይቀርባል፤ ይህስ ባይሆን ወደ እኔ ለመቅረብ የሚደፍር ማን ነው? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.fr: Vous serez mon peuple, Et je serai votre Dieu.
verses.am: እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.fr: Voici, la tempête de l''Eternel, la fureur éclate, L''orage se précipite, Il fond sur la tête des méchants.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እርሱም ቍጣው፥ የሚያገለባብጥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ወጥቶአል፤ የዓመፀኞችንም ራስ ይገለባብጣል።

verses.en: The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he hath done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.fr: La colère ardente de l''Eternel ne se calmera pas, Jusqu''à ce qu''il ait accompli, exécuté les desseins de son coeur. Vous le comprendrez dans la suite des temps.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ የልቡን አሳብ ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ አይመለስም በኋለኛው ዘመን ታስተውሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: At the same time, saith the Lord, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, dit l''Eternel, Je serai le Dieu de toutes les familles d''Israël, Et ils seront mon peuple.
verses.am: በዚያን ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ለእስራኤል ወገኖች ሁሉ አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Il a trouvé grâce dans le désert, Le peuple de ceux qui ont échappé au glaive; Israël marche vers son lieu de repos.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤል ማረፊያ ሊሻ በሄደ ጊዜ ከሰይፍ የተረፈው ሕዝብ በምድረ በዳ ሞገስ አገኘ።

verses.en: The Lord hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.fr: De loin l''Eternel se montre à moi: Je t''aime d''un amour éternel; C''est pourquoi je te conserve ma bonté.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከሩቅ ተገለጠልኝ እንዲህም አለኝ። በዘላለም ፍቅር ወድጄሻለሁ፤ ስለዚህ በቸርነት ሳብሁሽ።

verses.en: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.fr: Je te rétablirai encore, et tu seras rétablie, Vierge d''Israël! Tu auras encore tes tambourins pour parure, Et tu sortiras au milieu des danses joyeuses.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ድንግል ሆይ፥ እንደ ገና እሠራሻለሁ አንቺም ትሠሪያለሽ፤ እንደ ገናም ከበሮሽን አንሥተሽ ከዘፋኞች ጋር ወደ ዘፈን ትወጫለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.fr: Tu planteras encore des vignes sur les montagnes de Samarie; Les planteurs planteront, et cueilleront les fruits.
verses.am: እንደ ገናም በሰማርያ ተራሮች ላይ የወይን ቦታዎችን ትተክሊአለሽ፤ አትክልተኞች ይተክላሉ በፍሬውም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Car le jour vient où les gardes crieront sur la montagne d''Ephraïm: Levez-vous, montons à Sion, vers l''Eternel, notre Dieu!
verses.am: በኤፍሬምም ተራሮች ላይ ያሉ ጠባቆች። ተነሡ፥ ወደ ጽዮን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንውጣ ብለው የሚጮኹበት ቀን ይመጣልና።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Poussez des cris de joie sur Jacob, Eclatez d''allégresse à la tête des nations! Elevez vos voix, chantez des louanges, et dites: Eternel, délivre ton peuple, le reste d''Israël!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ስለ ያዕቆብ ደስ ይበላችሁ ስለ አሕዛብም አለቆች እልል በሉ፤ አውሩ፥ አመስግኑ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ አድኖአል በሉ።

verses.en: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.fr: Voici, je les ramène du pays du septentrion, Je les rassemble des extrémités de la terre; Parmi eux sont l''aveugle et le boiteux, La femme enceinte et celle en travail; C''est une grande multitude, qui revient ici.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን አገር አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ በመካከላቸውም ዕውሩና አንካሳው ያረገዘችና የወለደችም በአንድነት፤ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ሆነው ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.fr: Ils viennent en pleurant, et je les conduis au milieu de leurs supplications; Je les mène vers des torrents d''eau, Par un chemin uni où ils ne chancellent pas; Car je suis un père pour Israël, Et Ephraïm est mon premier-né.
verses.am: በልቅሶ ወጡ እኔም በማጽናናት አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በወንዝ ዳር በቅን መንገድ አስኬዳቸዋለሁ፥ በእርሱም አይሰናከሉም፤ እኔ ለእስራኤል አባት ነኝና፥ ኤፍሬምም በኵሬ ነውና።

verses.en: Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.fr: Nations, écoutez la parole de l''Eternel, Et publiez-la dans les îles lointaines! Dites: Celui qui a dispersé Israël le rassemblera, Et il le gardera comme le berger garde son troupeau.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ በሩቅም ላሉ ደሴቶች አውሩና። እስራኤልን የበተነ እርሱ ይሰበስበዋል፥ እረኛም መንጋውን እንደሚጠብቅ ይጠብቀዋል በሉ።

verses.en: For the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel rachète Jacob, Il le délivre de la main d''un plus fort que lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ተቤዥቶታል፥ ከበረቱበትም እጅ አድኖታል።

verses.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the Lord, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.fr: Ils viendront, et pousseront des cris de joie sur les hauteurs de Sion; Ils accourront vers les biens de l''Eternel, Le blé, le moût, l''huile, Les brebis et les boeufs; Leur âme sera comme un jardin arrosé, Et ils ne seront plus dans la souffrance.
verses.am: ይመጣሉ በጽዮንም ተራራ እልል ይላሉ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጎነት፥ ወደ እህልና ወደ ወይን ጠጅ ወደ ዘይትም፥ ወደ በጎችና ወደ ላሞች ይሰበሰባሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውም እንደ ረካች ገነት ትሆናለች፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አያዝኑም።

verses.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.fr: Alors les jeunes filles se réjouiront à la danse, Les jeunes hommes et les vieillards se réjouiront aussi; Je changerai leur deuil en allégresse, et je les consolerai; Je leur donnerai de la joie après leurs chagrins.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ድንግሊቱ በዘፈን ደስ ይላታል፥ ጐበዛዝቱና ሽማግሌዎቹም በአንድ ላይ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ልቅሶአቸውንም ወደ ደስታ እመልሳለሁ፥ አጽናናቸውማለሁ፥ ከኅዘናቸውም ደስ አሰኛቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je rassasierai de graisse l''âme des sacrificateurs, Et mon peuple se rassasiera de mes biens, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የካህናቱንም ነፍስ በብዛት አረካታለሁ ሕዝቤም በጎነቴን ይጠግባል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: On entend des cris à Rama, Des lamentations, des larmes amères; Rachel pleure ses enfants; Elle refuse d''être consolée sur ses enfants, Car ils ne sont plus.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የዋይታና የመራራ ልቅሶ ድምፅ በራማ ተሰማ፤ ራሔል ስለ ልጆችዋ አለቀሰች፤ የሉምና ስለ ልጆችዋ መጽናናትን እንቢ አለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the Lord; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Retiens tes pleurs, Retiens les larmes de tes yeux; Car il y aura un salaire pour tes oeuvres, dit l''Eternel; Ils reviendront du pays de l''ennemi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ድምፅሽን ከልቅሶ ዓይንሽንም ከእንባ ከልክዪ፤ ለሥራሽ ዋጋ ይሆናልና፥ ከጠላትም ምድር ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: And there is hope in thine end, saith the Lord, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.fr: Il y a de l''espérance pour ton avenir, dit l''Eternel; Tes enfants reviendront dans leur territoire.
verses.am: ለፍጻሜሽም ተስፋ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ልጆችሽም ወደ ዳርቻቸው ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the Lord my God.
verses.fr: J''entends Ephraïm qui se lamente: Tu m''as châtié, et j''ai été châtié Comme un veau qui n''est pas dompté; Fais-moi revenir, et je reviendrai, Car tu es l''Eternel, mon Dieu.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም። ቀጣኸኝ እኔም እንዳልተገራ ወይፈን ተቀጣሁ፤ አንተ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ነህና መልሰኝ እኔም እመለሳለሁ።

verses.en: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.fr: Après m''être détourné, j''éprouve du repentir; Et après avoir reconnu mes fautes, je frappe sur ma cuisse; Je suis honteux et confus, Car je porte l''opprobre de ma jeunesse. -
verses.am: ከተመለስሁ በኋላ ተጸጸትሁ፥ ከተገሠጽሁም በኋላ ጭኔን ጸፋሁ፤ የብላቴንነቴንም ስድብ ተሸክሜአለሁና አፈርሁ፥ ተዋረድሁም ብሎ ሲያለቅስ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est-il donc pour moi un fils chéri, Un enfant qui fait mes délices? Car plus je parle de lui, plus encore son souvenir est en moi; Aussi mes entrailles sont émues en sa faveur: J''aurai pitié de lui, dit l''Eternel. -
verses.am: በእውነት ኤፍሬም ለእኔ የከበረ ልጅ ነውን? ወይስ የተወደደ ሕፃን ነውን? በእርሱ ላይ በተናገርሁ ቍጥር አስበዋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ አንጀቴ ታወከችለት ርኅራኄም እራራለታለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.fr: Dresse des signes, place des poteaux, Prends garde à la route, au chemin que tu as suivi... Reviens, vierge d''Israël, Reviens dans ces villes qui sont à toi!
verses.am: ለራስሽ የመንገድ ምልክት አድርጊ፥ መንገድንም የሚመሩ ዓምዶችን ትከዪ፥ ልብሽንም ወደ ሄድሽበት መንገድ ወደ ጥርጊያው አቅኚ፤ አንቺ የእስራኤል ድንግል ሆይ፥ ተመለሺ፥ ወደ እነዚህም ወደ ከተሞችሽ ተመለሺ።

verses.en: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.fr: Jusques à quand seras-tu errante, Fille égarée? Car l''Eternel crée une chose nouvelle sur la terre: La femme recherchera l''homme.
verses.am: አንቺ ከዳተኛ ልጅ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ትቅበዘበዣለሽ? እግዚአብሔር በምድር ላይ አዲስ ነገር ፈጥሮአልና ሴት ወንድን ትከብባለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The Lord bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici encore ce que l''on dira dans le pays de Juda et dans ses villes, Quand j''aurai ramené leurs captifs: Que l''Eternel te bénisse, demeure de la justice, Montagne sainte!
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠርዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ምርኮአቸውን በመለስሁ ጊዜ በይሁዳ አገር በከተሞችዋ። የጽድቅ ማደሪያ ሆይ፥ የቅድስና ተራራ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ የሚልን ነገር እንደ ገና ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.fr: Là s''établiront Juda et toutes ses villes, Les laboureurs et ceux qui conduisent les troupeaux.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በአገሩ ሁሉ ከገበሬዎችና መንጋን ይዘው ከሚዞሩ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ይገኛሉ።

verses.en: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.fr: Car je rafraîchirai l''âme altérée, Et je rassasierai toute âme languissante.
verses.am: የደከመችውን ነፍስ አርክቻለሁና፥ ያዘነችውንም ነፍስ ሁሉ አጥግቤአለሁና።

verses.en: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.fr: Là-dessus je me suis réveillé, et j''ai regardé; Mon sommeil m''avait été agréable.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ነቃሁ ተመለከትሁም፥ እንቅልፌም ጣፋጭ ሆነልኝ።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où j''ensemencerai la maison d''Israël et la maison de Juda D''une semence d''hommes et d''une semence de bêtes.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ቤትና የይሁዳን ቤት በሰው ዘርና በእንስሳ ዘር የምዘራበት ዘመን፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Et comme j''ai veillé sur eux Pour arracher, abattre, détruire, ruiner et faire du mal, Ainsi je veillerai sur eux pour bâtir et pour planter, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ አፈርሳቸውና ክፉ አድርግባቸው ዘንድ እንደ ተጋሁባቸው፥ እንዲሁ እሠራቸውና እተክላቸው ዘንድ እተጋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
verses.fr: En ces jours-là, on ne dira plus: Les pères ont mangé des raisins verts, Et les dents des enfants en ont été agacées.
verses.am: በዚያ ዘመን ሰው ዳግመኛ እንዲህ አይልም። አባቶች ጨርቋ የወይን ፍሬ በሉ፥ የልጆችም ጥርሶች ጠረሱ፤

verses.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.fr: Mais chacun mourra pour sa propre iniquité; Tout homme qui mangera des raisins verts, Ses dents en seront agacées.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ በደሉ ይሞታል፤ መራራውን የወይን ፍሬ የሚበላ ሁሉ ጥርሶቹ ይጠርሳሉ።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où je ferai avec la maison d''Israël et la maison de Juda Une alliance nouvelle,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ቃል ኪዳን የምገባበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the Lord:
verses.fr: Non comme l''alliance que je traitai avec leurs pères, Le jour où je les saisis par la main Pour les faire sortir du pays d''Egypte, Alliance qu''ils ont violée, Quoique je fusse leur maître, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከግብጽ አገር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝሁበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንደ ገባሁት ያለ ቃል ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልጸኑምና፥ እኔም ቸል አልኋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the Lord, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.fr: Mais voici l''alliance que je ferai avec la maison d''Israël, Après ces jours-là, dit l''Eternel: Je mettrai ma loi au dedans d''eux, Je l''écrirai dans leur coeur; Et je serai leur Dieu, Et ils seront mon peuple.
verses.am: ከእነዚያ ወራት በኋላ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር የምገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነውና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ሕጌን በልቡናቸው አኖራለሁ፥ በልባቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፤ እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the Lord: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.fr: Celui-ci n''enseignera plus son prochain, Ni celui-là son frère, en disant: Connaissez l''Eternel! Car tous me connaîtront, Depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand, dit l''Eternel; Car je pardonnerai leur iniquité, Et je ne me souviendrai plus de leur péché.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱ ሰው ባልንጀራውን፥ እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን። እግዚአብሔርን እወቅ ብሎ አያስተምርም፤ ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ያውቁኛልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። በደላቸውን እምራቸዋለሁና፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አላስብምና።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The Lord of hosts is his name:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, qui a fait le soleil pour éclairer le jour, Qui a destiné la lune et les étoiles à éclairer la nuit, Qui soulève la mer et fait mugir ses flots, Lui dont le nom est l''Eternel des armées:
verses.am: ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ የሚባል፥ ፀሐይን በቀን የጨረቃንና የከዋክብትን ሥርዓት በሌሊት ብርሃን አድርጎ የሚሰጥ፥ እንዲተምሙም የባሕርን ሞገዶች የሚያናውጥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.fr: Si ces lois viennent à cesser devant moi, dit l''Eternel, La race d''Israël aussi cessera pour toujours d''être une nation devant moi.
verses.am: ይህ ሕግ ከፊቴ ቢወገድ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ደግሞ የእስራኤል ዘር በፊቴ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ለዘላለም ይቀራል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Si les cieux en haut peuvent être mesurés, Si les fondements de la terre en bas peuvent être sondés, Alors je rejetterai toute la race d''Israël, A cause de tout ce qu''ils ont fait, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰማይ በላይ ቢከነዳ፥ የምድርም መሠረት በታች ቢመረመር፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ስላደረጉት ነገር ሁሉ የእስራኤልን ዘር ሁሉ እጥላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où la ville sera rebâtie à l''honneur de l''Eternel, Depuis la tour de Hananeel jusqu''à la porte de l''angle.
verses.am: ከሐናንኤል ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ ከተማ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሠራበት ዘመን፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.fr: Le cordeau s''étendra encore vis-à-vis, Jusqu''à la colline de Gareb, Et fera un circuit du côté de Goath.
verses.am: የተለካበትም ገመድ ወደ ጋሬብ ኮረብታ በቀጥታ ወደ ፊት ይሄዳል፥ ወደ ጎዓም ይዞራል።

verses.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the Lord; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.fr: Toute la vallée des cadavres et de la cendre, Et tous les champs jusqu''au torrent de Cédron, Jusqu''à l''angle de la porte des chevaux à l''orient, Seront consacrés à l''Eternel, Et ne seront plus à jamais ni renversés ni détruits.
verses.am: የሬሳም ሸለቆ ሁሉ የአመድም እርሻ ሁሉ እስከ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ድረስ በምሥራቅ በኩል እስካለው እስከ ፈረሰ በር ማዕዘን ድረስ ለእግዚአብሄር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ለዘላለም አይነቀልም አይፈርስምም።

verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, la dixième année de Sédécias, roi de Juda. -C''était la dix-huitième année de Nebucadnetsar.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ በአሥረኛው ዓመት፥ በናቡክደነፆር በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.
verses.fr: L''armée du roi de Babylone assiégeait alors Jérusalem; et Jérémie, le prophète, était enfermé dans la cour de la prison qui était dans la maison du roi de Juda.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምን ከብቦ ነበር፤ ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በነበረው በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ነበር።

verses.en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.fr: Sédécias, roi de Juda, l''avait fait enfermer, et lui avait dit: Pourquoi prophétises-tu, en disant: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je livre cette ville entre les mains du roi de Babylone, et il la prendra;
verses.am: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ብሎ አስጠብቆት ነበርና። ስለ ምን እንዲህ ብለህ ትንቢት ትናገራለህ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ እርሱም ይይዛታል፤

verses.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.fr: Sédécias, roi de Juda, n''échappera pas aux Chaldéens, mais il sera livré entre les mains du roi de Babylone, il lui parlera bouche à bouche, et ses yeux verront ses yeux;
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በእውነት በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል፥ አፍ ለአፍም ይናገረዋል፥ ዓይኑም ዓይኑን ያያል እንጂ ከከለዳውያን እጅ አያመልጥም፤

verses.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the Lord: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
verses.fr: le roi de Babylone emmènera Sédécias à Babylone, où il restera jusqu''à ce que je me souvienne de lui, dit l''Eternel; si vous vous battez contre les Chaldéens, vous n''aurez point de succès.
verses.am: እርሱም ሴዴቅያስን ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሰዋል፥ እኔም እስክጐበኘው ድረስ በዚያ ይኖራል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከከላዳውያን ጋር ብትዋጉ ምንም አትረቡም።

verses.en: And Jeremiah said, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Jérémie dit: La parole de l''Eternel m''a été adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አለ። የእግዚአብሄር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
verses.fr: Voici, Hanameel, fils de ton oncle Schallum, va venir auprès de toi pour te dire: Achète mon champ qui est à Anathoth, car tu as le droit de rachat pour l''acquérir.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የአጐትህ የሰሎም ልጅ አናምኤል ወደ አንተ መጥቶ። ትገዛው ዘንድ መቤዠቱ የአንተ ነውና በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን ግዛ ይልሃል።

verses.en: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the Lord, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et Hanameel, fils de mon oncle, vint auprès de moi, selon la parole de l''Eternel, dans la cour de la prison, et il me dit: Achète mon champ, qui est à Anathoth, dans le pays de Benjamin, car tu as le droit d''héritage et de rachat, achète-le! Je reconnus que c''était la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል የአጐቴ ልጅ አናምኤል እኔ ወዳለሁበት ወደ ግዞቱ ቤት አደባባይ መጥቶ። በብንያም አገር በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን፥ እባክህ፥ ግዛ፤ ርስቱ የአንተ ነውና፥ መቤዠቱም የአንተ ነውና፤ ለአንተ ግዛው አለኝ። ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ሆነ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.fr: J''achetai de Hanameel, fils de mon oncle, le champ qui est à Anathoth, et je lui pesai l''argent, dix-sept sicles d''argent.
verses.am: በዓናቶትም ያለውን እርሻ ከአጐቴ ልጅ ከአናምኤል ገዛሁ፥ አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብርም መዘንሁለት።

verses.en: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.fr: J''écrivis un contrat, que je cachetai, je pris des témoins, et je pesai l''argent dans une balance.
verses.am: በውሉም ወረቀት ላይ ፈረምሁ አተምሁትም፥ ምስክሮችንም ጠርቼ ብሩን በሚዛን መዘንሁለት።

verses.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.fr: Je pris ensuite le contrat d''acquisition, celui qui était cacheté, conformément à la loi et aux usages, et celui qui était ouvert;
verses.am: የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን የውል ወረቀት ወሰድሁ፤

verses.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.fr: et je remis le contrat d''acquisition à Baruc, fils de Nérija, fils de Machséja, en présence de Hanameel, fils de mon oncle, en présence des témoins qui avaient signé le contrat d''acquisition, et en présence de tous les juifs qui se trouvaient dans la cour de la prison.
verses.am: የአጐቴም ልጅ አናምኤል፥ የውሉንም ወረቀት የፈረሙ ምስክሮች፥ በግዞትም ቤት አደባባይ የተቀመጡ አይሁድ ሁሉ እያዩ የውሉን ወረቀት ለመሕሤያ ልጅ ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ ሰጠሁት።

verses.en: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.fr: Et je donnai devant eux cet ordre à Baruc:
verses.am: በፊታቸውም እንዲህ ብዬ ባሮክን አዘዝሁት።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Prends ces écrits, ce contrat d''acquisition, celui qui est cacheté et celui qui est ouvert, et mets-les dans un vase de terre, afin qu''ils se conservent longtemps.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ብዙ ቀን ይጠበቁ ዘንድ የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን ይህን የውል ወረከት ወስደህ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ አኑራቸው።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: On achètera encore des maisons, des champs et des vignes, dans ce pays.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰዎች በዚህች ምድር ቤትንና እርሻን የወይን ቦታንም እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: Après que j''eus remis le contrat d''acquisition à Baruc, fils de Nérija, j''adressai cette prière à l''Eternel:
verses.am: ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክም የውሉን ወረቀት ከሰጠሁት በኋላ፥ እንዲህ ብዬ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለይሁ።

verses.en: Ah Lord God! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.fr: Ah! Seigneur Eternel, Voici, tu as fait les cieux et la terre Par ta grande puissance et par ton bras étendu: Rien n''est étonnant de ta part.
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ ሰማይንና ምድርን በታላቅ ኃይልህና በተዘረጋች ክንድህ ፈጥረሃል፥ ከአንተም የሚያቅት ነገር የለም።

verses.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the Lord of hosts, is his name,
verses.fr: Tu fais miséricorde jusqu''à la millième génération, Et tu punis l''iniquité des pères dans le sein de leurs enfants après eux. Tu es le Dieu grand, le puissant, Dont le nom est l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ለብዙ ሺህ ምሕረት ታደርጋለህ፥ የአባቶችንም በደል ከእነርሱ በኋላ በልጆቻቸው ብብት ትመልሳለህ፤ ስምህ ታላቅና ኃያል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.fr: Tu es grand en conseil et puissant en action; Tu as les yeux ouverts sur toutes les voies des enfants des hommes, Pour rendre à chacun selon ses voies, Selon le fruit de ses oeuvres.
verses.am: በምክር ታላቅ በሥራም ብርቱ ነህ፤ ለሁሉም እንደ መንገዱና እንደ ሥራው ፍሬ ትሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይኖችህ በአዳም ልጆች መንገድ ሁሉ ተገልጠዋል።

verses.en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
verses.fr: Tu as fait des miracles et des prodiges dans le pays d''Egypte jusqu''à ce jour, Et en Israël et parmi les hommes, Et tu t''es fait un nom comme il l''est aujourd''hui.
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ምልክትንና ድንቅን ነገር በግብጽ ምድር ደግሞም በእስራኤልና በሌሎች ሰዎች መካከል አድርገሃል፥ እንደ ዛሬም ለአንተ ስም አድርገሃል።

verses.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.fr: Tu as fait sortir du pays d''Egypte ton peuple d''Israël, Avec des miracles et des prodiges, à main forte et à bras étendu, Et avec une grande terreur.
verses.am: በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር፥ በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በታላቅም ግርማ ሕዝብህን እስራኤልን ከግብጽ ምድር አወጣህ።

verses.en: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.fr: Tu leur as donné ce pays, Que tu avais juré à leurs pères de leur donner, Pays où coulent le lait et le miel.
verses.am: ትሰጣቸውም ዘንድ ለአባቶቻቸው የማልህላቸውን ምድር፥ ወተትና ማርንም የምታፈስሰውን ምድር፥ ሰጠሃቸው፤

verses.en: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.fr: Ils sont venus, et ils en ont pris possession. Mais ils n''ont point obéi à ta voix, Ils n''ont point observé ta loi, Ils n''ont pas fait tout ce que tu leur avais ordonné de faire. Et c''est alors que tu as fait fondre sur eux tous ces malheurs!
verses.am: እነርሱም ገብተው ወረሱአት፤ ነገር ግን ቃልህን አልሰሙም በሕግህም አልሄዱም፥ ያደረርም ዘንድ ካዘዝሃቸው ሁሉ ምንም አላደረጉም፤ ስለዚህ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣህባቸው።

verses.en: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
verses.fr: Voici, les terrasses s''élèvent contre la ville et la menacent; La ville sera livrée entre les mains des Chaldéens qui l''attaquent, Vaincue par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste. Ce que tu as dit est arrivé, et tu le vois.
verses.am: እነሆ የአፈር ድልድል፥ ሊይዙአትም እስከ ከተማይቱ ድረስ ቀርበዋል፤ ከሰይፍና ከራብ ከቸነፈርም የተነሣ ከተማይቱ ለሚዋጉአት ለከለዳውያን እጅ ተሰጥታለች፥ የተናገርኸውም ሆኖአል፤ እነሆም፥ አንተ ታየዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord God, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.fr: Néanmoins, Seigneur Eternel, tu m''as dit: Achète un champ pour de l''argent, prends des témoins... Et la ville est livrée entre les mains des Chaldéens!
verses.am: አንተም፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ። እርሻውን በብር ግዛ ምስክሮችንም ጥራ አልኸኝ፤ ከተማይቱ ግን ለከለዳውያን እጅ ተሰጥታለች።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.fr: Voici, je suis l''Eternel, le Dieu de toute chair. Y a-t-il rien qui soit étonnant de ma part?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ የሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je livre cette ville entre les mains des Chaldéens, Et entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, Et il la prendra.
verses.am: በውኑ እኔን የሚያቅተኝ ነገር አለን? ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ ለከለዳውያን እጅና ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እርሱም ይይዛታል።

verses.en: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.fr: Les Chaldéens qui attaquent cette ville vont entrer, Ils y mettront le feu, et ils la brûleront, Avec les maisons sur les toits desquelles on a offert de l''encens à Baal Et fait des libations à d''autres dieux, Afin de m''irriter.
verses.am: ይህችን ከተማ የሚወጉ ከለዳውያን መጥተው በእሳት ያነድዱአታል፥ ያስቈጡኝም ዘንድ በሰገነታቸው ላይ ለበኣል ካጠኑባቸው፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥን KWrባን ካፈሰሱባቸው ቤቶች ጋር ያቃጥሉአታል።

verses.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Car les enfants d''Israël et les enfants de Juda N''ont fait, dès leur jeunesse, que ce qui est mal à mes yeux; Les enfants d''Israël n''ont fait que m''irriter Par l''oeuvre de leurs mains, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች ከታናሽነታቸው ጀምሮ በፊቴ ክፉ ነገርን ብቻ አድርገዋልና፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እኔን በእጃቸው ሥራ ከማስቈጣት በቀር ሌላ ሥራ አላደረጉምና።

verses.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.fr: Car cette ville excite ma colère et ma fureur, Depuis le jour où on l''a bâtie jusqu''à ce jour; Aussi je veux l''ôter de devant ma face,
verses.am: ከፊቴ አስወግዳት ዘንድ ይህች ከተማ ከሠሩአት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቍጣዬንና መዓቴን ለማነሣሣት ሆናለችና፤

verses.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: A cause de tout le mal que les enfants d''Israël et les enfants de Juda Ont fait pour m''irriter, Eux, leurs rois, leurs chefs, leurs sacrificateurs et leurs prophètes, Les hommes de Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ይህም እኔን ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ፥ እነርሱና ነገሥታቶቻቸው አለቆቻቸውም ካህናቶቻቸውም ነቢያቶቻቸውም የይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚንኖሩ፥ ስላደረጉት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆችና ስለ ይሁዳ ልጆች ክፋት ሁሉ ነው።

verses.en: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.fr: Ils m''ont tourné le dos, ils ne m''ont pas regardé; On les a enseignés, on les a enseignés dès le matin; Mais ils n''ont pas écouté pour recevoir instruction.
verses.am: ፊታቸውንም ሳይሆን ጀርባቸውን ወደ እኔ መለሱ፤ እኔም በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ሳሰተምራቸው ተግሣጽን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ አልሰሙም።

verses.en: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.fr: Ils ont placé leurs abominations Dans la maison sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué, Afin de la souiller.
verses.am: ያረክሱትም ዘንድ ስሜ በተጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ ርkWsvታቸውን አኖሩ።

verses.en: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
verses.fr: Ils ont bâti des hauts lieux à Baal dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, Pour faire passer à Moloc leurs fils et leurs filles: Ce que je ne leur avais point ordonné; Et il ne m''était point venu à la pensée Qu''ils commettraient de telles horreurs Pour faire pécher Juda.
verses.am: ይሁዳን ወደ ኃጢአት እንዲያገቡት፥ ይህንን ርkWsvት ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ እኔ ያላዘዝሁትንና በልቤ ያላሰብሁትን ነገር፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለሞሎክ በእሳት ያሳልፉ ዘንድ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ያሉትን የበኣልን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ሠሩ።

verses.en: And now therefore thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.fr: Et maintenant, ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, Sur cette ville dont vous dites: Elle sera livrée entre les mains du roi de Babylone, Vaincue par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste:
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር አንተ ስለ እርስዋ። በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ተሰጥታለች ስለምትላት ከተማ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.fr: Voici, je les rassemblerai de tous les pays où je les ai chassés, Dans ma colère, dans ma fureur, et dans ma grande irritation; Je les ramènerai dans ce lieu, Et je les y ferai habiter en sûreté.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ በታላቅም መቅሠፍቴ እነርሱን ካሳደድሁባት አገር ሁሉ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ ተዘልለውም እንዲኖሩ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
verses.fr: Ils seront mon peuple, Et je serai leur Dieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.fr: Je leur donnerai un même coeur et une même voie, Afin qu''ils me craignent toujours, Pour leur bonheur et celui de leurs enfants après eux.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ከእነርሱም በኋላ ለልጆቻቸው መልካም ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ ለዘላለም እንዲፈሩኝ አንድ ልብና አንድ መንገድ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.fr: Je traiterai avec eux une alliance éternelle, Je ne me détournerai plus d''eux, Je leur ferai du bien, Et je mettrai ma crainte dans leur coeur, Afin qu''ils ne s''éloignent pas de moi.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ከማደርገው በጎነት አልመለስም ስል፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር የዘላለምን ቃል ኪዳን እገባለሁ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ ፈቀቅ እንዳይሉ መፈራቴን በልባቸው ውስጥ አኖራለሁ።

verses.en: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.fr: Je prendrai plaisir à leur faire du bien, Et je les planterai véritablement dans ce pays, De tout mon coeur et de toute mon âme.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም መልካምን በማድረግ ደስ ይለኛል በእውነትም በፍጹም ልቤና በፍጹም ነፍሴ በዚህች ምድር እተክላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: De même que j''ai fait venir sur ce peuple tous ces grands malheurs, De même je ferai venir sur eux tout le bien que je leur promets.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ይህን እጅግ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ እንዳመጣሁ፥ እንዲሁ የተናገርሁላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ አመጣላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.fr: On achètera des champs dans ce pays Dont vous dites: C''est un désert, sans hommes ni bêtes, Il est livré entre les mains des Chaldéens.
verses.am: እናንተም። ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንሰሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት፥ ለከለዳውያንም እጅ ተሰጥታለች በምትሉአት ምድር እርሻን ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: On achètera des champs pour de l''argent, On écrira des contrats, on les cachètera, on prendra des témoins, Dans le pays de Benjamin et aux environs de Jérusalem, Dans les villes de Juda, dans les villes de la montagne, Dans les villes de la plaine et dans les villes du midi; Car je ramènerai leurs captifs, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ምርኮኞቻቸውንም እመልሳለሁና በብንያም አገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች በደጋውም ባሉ ከተሞች በቈላውም ባሉ ከተሞች በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ ሰዎች እርሻውን በብር ይገዛሉ በውሉም ወረቀት ፈርመው ያትማሉ ምስክሮችንም ይጠራሉ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie une seconde fois, en ces mots, pendant qu''il était encore enfermé dans la cour de la prison:
verses.am: ኤርምያስ ገና በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ሳለ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሲል መጣለት።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord the maker thereof, the Lord that formed it, to establish it; the Lord is his name;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, qui fait ces choses, L''Eternel, qui les conçoit et les exécute, Lui, dont le nom est l''Eternel:
verses.am: ስሙ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ፥ ያደረገው እግዚአብሔር፥ ያጸናውም ዘንድ የሠራው እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and show thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.fr: Invoque-moi, et je te répondrai; Je t''annoncerai de grandes choses, des choses cachées, Que tu ne connais pas.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ጩኽ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ፤ አንተም የማታውቀውን ታላቅና ኃይለኛ ነገርን አሳይሃለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, Sur les maisons de cette ville Et sur les maisons des rois de Juda, Qui seront abattues par les terrasses et par l''épée,
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሄር ለአፈር ድልድልና ለምሽግ ስለ ፈረሱ ስለዚህች ከተማ ቤቶች፥ ስለ ይሁዳም ነገሥታት ቤቶች እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
verses.fr: Quand on s''avancera pour combattre les Chaldéens, Et qu''elles seront remplies des cadavres des hommes Que je frapperai dans ma colère et dans ma fureur, Et à cause de la méchanceté desquels je cacherai ma face à cette ville;
verses.am: ከለዳውያን ለመዋጋት መጥተዋል፤ ነገር ግን በKWTaዬና በመዓቴ በገደልኋቸው ሰዎች ሬሳዎች ሊሞሉአቸው ነው፥ ስለ ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ፊቴን ከዚህች ከተማ ሰውሬአለሁና።

verses.en: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.fr: Voici, je lui donnerai la guérison et la santé, je les guérirai, Et je leur ouvrirai une source abondante de paix et de fidélité.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ፈውስንና መድኃኒትን አመጣላታለሁ፥ እፈውሳቸውማለሁ፤ የሰላምንና የእውነትን ብዛት እገልጥላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
verses.fr: Je ramènerai les captifs de Juda et les captifs d''Israël, Et je les rétablirai comme autrefois.
verses.am: የይሁዳን ምርኮና የእስራኤልንም ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ቀድሞም እንደ ነበሩ አድርጌ እሠራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
verses.fr: Je les purifierai de toutes les iniquités qu''ils ont commises contre moi, Je leur pardonnerai toutes les iniquités par lesquelles ils m''ont offensé, Par lesquelles ils se sont révoltés contre moi.
verses.am: እኔንም ከበደሉበት ኃጢአት ሁሉ አነጻቸዋለሁ እኔንም የበደሉኝን ያመፀብኝንም ኃጢአታቸውን ሁሉ ይቅር እላለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
verses.fr: Cette ville sera pour moi un sujet de joie, de louange et de gloire, Parmi toutes les nations de la terre, Qui apprendront tout le bien que je leur ferai; Elles seront étonnées et émues de tout le bonheur Et de toute la prospérité que je leur accorderai.
verses.am: ይህችም ከተማ እኔ የምሠራላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ በሚሰሙ እኔም ስላመጣሁላቸው በጎነትና ሰላም ሁሉ በሚፈሩና በሚደነግጡ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ለደስታ ስም ለምስጋናም ለክብርም ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: On entendra encore dans ce lieu Dont vous dites: Il est désert, il n''y a plus d''hommes, plus de bêtes; On entendra dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem, Dévastées, privées d''hommes, d''habitants, de bêtes,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲ ይላል። እናንተ። ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት በምትሉአት በዚህች ስፍራ፥ የሚቀመጥባቸው በሌላ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባድማ በሆኑ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ፥

verses.en: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the Lord of hosts: for the Lord is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the Lord. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Les cris de réjouissance et les cris d''allégresse, Les chants du fiancé et les chants de la fiancée, La voix de ceux qui disent: Louez l''Eternel des armées, Car l''Eternel est bon, car sa miséricorde dure à toujours! La voix de ceux qui offrent des sacrifices d''actions de grâces Dans la maison de l''Eternel. Car je ramènerai les captifs du pays, je les rétablirai comme autrefois, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሐሤት ድምፅና የደስታ ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራ ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራ ድምፅ። እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና የሠራዊትን ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚሉ ድምፅ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት የሚያመጡት ድምፅ እንደ ገና ይሰማል። የምድርን ምርኮ ቀድሞ እንደ ነበረ አድርጌ እመልሳለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Il y aura encore dans ce lieu Qui est désert, sans hommes ni bêtes, Et dans toutes ses villes, Il y aura des demeures pour les bergers Faisant reposer leurs troupeaux.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ባድማ ሆኖ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባለው በዚህ ስፍራ በከተሞችም ሁሉ መንጎቻቸውን የሚያሳርፉት የእረኞች መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Dans les villes de la montagne, dans les villes de la plaine, Dans les villes du midi, Dans le pays de Benjamin et aux environs de Jérusalem, Et dans les villes de Juda, Les brebis passeront encore sous la main de celui qui les compte, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በደጋው ላይ ባሉ ከተሞች በቈላውም ባሉ ከተሞች በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ በብንያምም አገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች መንጎቹ በተቈጣጣሪው እጅ እንደ ገና ያልፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
verses.fr: Voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où j''accomplirai la bonne parole Que j''ai dite sur la maison d''Israël et sur la maison de Juda.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ስለ እስራኤል ቤትና ስለ ይሁዳ ቤት የተናገርሁትን መልካም ቃል የምፈጽምበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.fr: En ces jours et en ce temps-là, Je ferai éclore à David un germe de justice; Il pratiquera la justice et l''équité dans le pays.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን በዚያም ጊዜ ለዳዊት የጽድቅን ቍጥቋጥ አበቅልለታለሁ፤ እርሱም ፍርድንና ጽድቅን በምድር ያደርጋል።

verses.en: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The Lord our righteousness.
verses.fr: En ces jours-là, Juda sera sauvé, Jérusalem aura la sécurité dans sa demeure; Et voici comment on l''appellera: L''Eternel notre justice.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ይሁዳ ይድናል ኢየሩሳሌምም ተዘልላ ትቀመጣለች፤ የምትጠራበትም ስም። እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችን ተብሎ ነው።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: David ne manquera jamais d''un successeur Assis sur le trône de la maison d''Israël;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በእስራኤል ቤት ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጥ ሰው ከዳዊት ዘንድ አይታጣም፤

verses.en: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs, les Lévites, ne manqueront jamais devant moi de successeurs Pour offrir des holocaustes, brûler de l''encens avec les offrandes, Et faire des sacrifices tous les jours.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ የእህሉንም ቍርባን የሚያቃጥል ሁልጊዜም የሚሠዋ ሰው ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ዘንድ በእኔ ፊት አይታጣም።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Si vous pouvez rompre mon alliance avec le jour Et mon alliance avec la nuit, En sorte que le jour et la nuit ne soient plus en leur temps,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቀንና ሌሊት በወራቱ እንዳይሆን የቀን ቃል ኪዳኔንና የሌሊት ቃል ኪዳኔን ማፍረስ ብትችሉ፥

verses.en: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
verses.fr: Alors aussi mon alliance sera rompue avec David, mon serviteur, En sorte qu''il n''aura point de fils régnant sur son trône, Et mon alliance avec les Lévites, les sacrificateurs, qui font mon service.
verses.am: በዙፋኑ ላይ የሚነግሥ ልጅ እንዳይሆንለት ከባሪዬ ከዳዊት ጋር፥ ከአገልጋዮቼም ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ጋር ያለው ቃል ኪዳኔ ደግሞ ይፈርሳል።

verses.en: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
verses.fr: De même qu''on ne peut compter l''armée des cieux, Ni mesurer le sable de la mer, De même je multiplierai la postérité de David, mon serviteur, Et les Lévites qui font mon service.
verses.am: የሰማይን ሠራዊት መቍጠር የባሕርንም አሸዋ መስፈር እንደማይቻል፥ እንዲሁ የባሪያዬን የዳዊትን ዘርና የሚያገለግሉኝን ሌዋውያንን አበዛለሁ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the Lord hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
verses.fr: N''as-tu pas remarqué ce que disent ces gens: Les deux familles que l''Eternel avait choisies, il les a rejetées? Ainsi ils méprisent mon peuple, Au point de ne plus le regarder comme une nation.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ። እግዚአብሔር የመረጣቸውን ሁለቱን ወገን ጥሎአቸዋል ያለውን ነገር አትመለከትምን? እንዲሁ በፊታቸው ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ሕዝቤን አቃልለዋል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Si je n''ai pas fait mon alliance avec le jour et avec la nuit, Si je n''ai pas établi les lois des cieux et de la terre,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የቀንና የሌሊት ቃል ኪዳኔን የሰማይንና የምድርንም ሥርዓት ያላጸናሁ እንደሆነ፥

verses.en: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
verses.fr: Alors aussi je rejetterai la postérité de Jacob et de David, mon serviteur, Et je ne prendrai plus dans sa postérité ceux qui domineront Sur les descendants d''Abraham, d''Isaac et de Jacob. Car je ramènerai leurs captifs, et j''aurai pitié d''eux.
verses.am: እኔም ደግሞ በአብርሃምና በይስሐቅ በያዕቆብም ዘር ላይ ገዦች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ከዘሩ እንዳልወስድ፥ የያዕቆብንና የባሪያዬን የዳዊትን ዘር እጥላለሁ፤ ምርኮአቸውን እመልሳለሁና፥ እምራቸውማለሁና።

verses.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots, lorsque Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, avec toute son armée, et tous les royaumes des pays sous sa domination, et tous les peuples, faisaient la guerre à Jérusalem et à toutes les villes qui en dépendaient:
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ከእጁም ግዛት በታች ያሉ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ኢየሩሳሌምንና ከተሞችዋን ሁሉ ይወጉ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Va, et dis à Sédécias, roi de Juda, dis-lui: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je livre cette ville entre les mains du roi de Babylone, et il la brûlera par le feu.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሂድ ለይሁዳም ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ ተናገር እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ በእሳትም ያቃጥላታል፤

verses.en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
verses.fr: Et toi, tu n''échapperas pas à ses mains, mais tu seras pris et livré entre ses mains, tes yeux verront les yeux du roi de Babylone, et il te parlera bouche à bouche, et tu iras à Babylone.
verses.am: አንተም በእርግጥ ትያዛለህ በእጅም አልፈህ ትሰጣለህ እንጂ ከእጁ አታመልጥም፤ ዓይንህም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ዓይን ታያለች፥ እርሱም ከአንተ ጋር አፍ ለአፍ ይናገራል፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም ትገባለህ።

verses.en: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the Lord of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
verses.fr: Seulement écoute la parole de l''Eternel, Sédécias, roi de Juda! Ainsi parle l''Eternel sur toi: Tu ne mourras point par l''épée.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አንተ እንዲህ ይላል። በሰይፍ አትሞትም፥ በሰላም ትሞታለህ እንጂ፤

verses.en: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu mourras en paix; et comme on a brûlé des parfums pour tes pères, les anciens rois qui t''ont précédé, ainsi on en brûlera pour toi, et l''on te pleurera, en disant: Hélas, seigneur! Car j''ai prononcé cette parole, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከአንተ በፊት እንደ ነበሩ እንደ ዱሮ ነገሥታት እንደ አባቶችህ መቃጠል፥ እንዲሁ ያቃጥሉሃልና። ወየው! ጌታ ሆይ እያሉ ያለቅሱልሃል፤ እኔ ቃልን ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
verses.fr: Jérémie, le prophète, dit toutes ces paroles à Sédécias, roi de Juda, à Jérusalem.

verses.en: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
verses.fr: Et l''armée du roi de Babylone combattait contre Jérusalem et contre toutes les autres villes de Juda, contre Lakis et Azéka, car c''étaient des villes fortes qui restaient parmi les villes de Juda.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምንና የቀሩትን የይሁዳን ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ከተመሸጉት ከይሁዳ ከተሞች የተረፉትን ለኪሶንና ዓዜቃን በወጋ ጊዜ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ነገረው።

verses.en: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
verses.fr: La parole fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, après que le roi Sédécias eut fait un pacte avec tout le peuple de Jérusalem, pour publier la liberté,

verses.en: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.
verses.fr: afin que chacun renvoyât libres son esclave et sa servante, l''Hébreu et la femme de l''Hébreu, et que personne ne tînt plus dans la servitude le Juif, son frère.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ ዕብራዊ የሆነውን ወንድ ባሪያውንና ዕብራዊት የሆነች ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ፥ አይሁዳዊ ወንድሙንም ማንም እንዳይገዛ፥ ስለ አርነታቸው አዋጅ እንዲነገር ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ካደረገ በኋላ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
verses.fr: Tous les chefs et tout le peuple, qui étaient entrés dans le pacte, s''engagèrent à renvoyer libres chacun son esclave et sa servante, afin de ne plus les tenir dans la servitude; ils obéirent, et les renvoyèrent.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ ወንድ ባሪያውንና ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ማንም እንዳይገዛቸው ወደ ቃል ኪዳኑ የገቡ አለቆች ሁሉና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሰሙ አርነትም አወጡአቸው።

verses.en: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.fr: Mais ensuite ils changèrent d''avis; ils reprirent les esclaves et les servantes qu''ils avaient affranchis, et les forcèrent à redevenir esclaves et servantes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ ተመልሰው አርነት ያወጡአቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻቸውን አስመለሱ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም አድርገው ገዙአቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: Alors la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: J''ai fait une alliance avec vos pères, le jour où je les ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, de la maison de servitude; et je leur ai dit:
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁን ከባርነት ቤት ከግብጽ አገር ባወጣኋቸው ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዲህ ብዬ ቃል ኪዳን አደረግሁ።

verses.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.fr: Au bout de sept ans, chacun de vous renverra libre son frère hébreu qui se vend à lui; il te servira six années, puis tu le renverras libre de chez toi. Mais vos pères ne m''ont point écouté, ils n''ont point prêté l''oreille.
verses.am: ሰባት ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ የተሸጠላችሁን ስድስትም ዓመት የተገዛላችሁን ዕብራዊ ወንድማችሁን እያንዳንዳችሁ አርነት ታወጡታላችሁ፥ እያንዳንዱም ያወጣዋል፤ አባቶቻችሁ ግን አልሰሙኝም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።

verses.en: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.fr: Vous, vous aviez fait aujourd''hui un retour sur vous-mêmes, vous aviez fait ce qui est droit à mes yeux, en publiant la liberté chacun pour son prochain, vous aviez fait un pacte devant moi, dans la maison sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué.
verses.am: እናንተም ዛሬ ተመልሳችሁ ሰው ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን አርነት ለማውጣት አዋጅ በመንገር ለዓይኔ ደስ የሚያሰኝን ነገር አድርጋችሁ ነበር፥ በስሜም በሚጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom he had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.fr: Mais vous êtes revenus en arrière, et vous avez profané mon nom; vous avez repris chacun les esclaves et les servantes que vous aviez affranchis, rendus à eux-mêmes, et vous les avez forcés à redevenir vos esclaves et vos servantes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ተመልሳችሁ ስሜን አስነቀፋችሁ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፈቃዳቸው እንዲሄዱ አርነት ያወጣችኋቸውን ወንድና ሴት ባሪያዎቻችሁን አስመለሳችሁ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም እንዲሆኑላችሁ ገዛችኋቸው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the Lord, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Vous ne m''avez point obéi, en publiant la liberté chacun pour son frère, chacun pour son prochain. Voici, je publie contre vous, dit l''Eternel, la liberté de l''épée, de la peste et de la famine, et je vous rendrai un objet d''effroi pour tous les royaumes de la terre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰው ሁሉ ለወንድሙና ለባልንጀራው የአርነት አዋጅ ለመንገር እኔን አልሰማችሁም፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ለሰይፍና ለቸነፈር ለራብም የአርነት አዋጅ እናገርባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በምድርም መንግሥታት ሁሉ መካከል እንድትበተኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.fr: Je livrerai les hommes qui ont violé mon alliance, qui n''ont pas observé les conditions du pacte qu''ils avaient fait devant moi, en coupant un veau en deux et en passant entre ses morceaux;
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም የተላለፉትን ሰዎች፥ እንቦሳውንም ቈርጠው በቍራጩ መካከል ባለፉ ጊዜ በፊቴ ያደረጉትን የቃል ኪዳንን ቃል ያልፈጸሙትን፥

verses.en: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.fr: je livrerai les chefs de Juda et les chefs de Jérusalem, les eunuques, les sacrificateurs, et tout le peuple du pays, qui ont passé entre les morceaux du veau;
verses.am: የይሁዳን አለቆችና የኢየሩሳሌምን አለቆች ጃንደረቦችን ካህናትንም በእንቦሳም ቍራጭ መካከል ያለፉትን የአገሩን ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.fr: je les livrerai entre les mains de leurs ennemis, entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à leur vie, et leurs cadavres serviront de pâture aux oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes de la terre.
verses.am: ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ነፍሳቸውንም ለሚሹአት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ሬሳቸውም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
verses.fr: Je livrerai Sédécias, roi de Juda, et ses chefs, entre les mains de leurs ennemis, entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à leur vie, entre les mains de l''armée du roi de Babylone, qui s''est éloignée de vous.
verses.am: የይሁዳንም ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስንና አለቆቹን ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ነፍሳቸውንም ለሚሹአት እጅ ከእናንተም ለተመለሱት ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I will command, saith the Lord, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.fr: Voici, je donnerai mes ordres, dit l''Eternel, et je les ramènerai contre cette ville; ils l''attaqueront, ils la prendront, et la brûleront par le feu. Et je ferai des villes de Juda un désert sans habitants.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አዝዛለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ወደዚህችም ከተማ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እርስዋንም ይወጋሉ ይይዙአትማል በእሳትም ያቃጥሉአታል፤ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ሰው የሌለበት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, au temps de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, en ces mots:
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉስ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
verses.fr: Va à la maison des Récabites, et parle-leur; tu les conduiras à la maison de l''Eternel, dans une des chambres, et tu leur offriras du vin à boire.
verses.am: ወደ ሬካባውያን ቤት ሄደህ ተናገራቸው፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ከጓዳዎቹ ወደ አንዲቱ አግባቸው የወይን ጠጅም አጠጣቸው።

verses.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
verses.fr: Je pris Jaazania, fils de Jérémie, fils de Habazinia, ses frères, tous ses fils, et toute la maison des Récabites,
verses.am: የከባስንን ልጅ የኤርምያስን ልጅ ያእዛንያን ወንድሞቹንም ልጆቹንም ሁሉ የሬካባውያንን ወገን ሁሉ ወሰድኋቸው፤

verses.en: And I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
verses.fr: et je les conduisis à la maison de l''Eternel, dans la chambre des fils de Hanan, fils de Jigdalia, homme de Dieu, près de la chambre des chefs, au-dessus de la chambre de Maaséja, fils de Schallum, garde du seuil.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት በበረኛው በሰሎም ልጅ በመዕሤያ ጓዳ በላይ ባለው በአለቆች ጓዳ አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ጌዴልያ ልጅ ወደ ሐናን ልጆች ጓዳ አገባኋቸው።

verses.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
verses.fr: Je mis devant les fils de la maison des Récabites des coupes pleines de vin, et des calices, et je leur dis: Buvez du vin!
verses.am: በሬካባውያንም ልጆች ፊት የወይን ጠጅ የሞላባቸውን ማድጋዎችንና ጽዋዎችን አኑሬ። የወይኑን ጠጅ ጠጡ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
verses.fr: Mais ils répondirent: Nous ne buvons pas de vin; car Jonadab, fils de Récab, notre père, nous a donné cet ordre: Vous ne boirez jamais de vin, ni vous, ni vos fils;
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እንዲህ አሉ። የወይኑን ጠጅ አንጠጣም፥ አባታችን የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ እንዲህ ብሎ አዝዞናልና። እናንተና ልጆቻችሁ ለዘላለም የወይን ጠጅ አትጠጡ።

verses.en: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
verses.fr: et vous ne bâtirez point de maisons, vous ne sèmerez aucune semence, vous ne planterez point de vignes et vous n''en posséderez point; mais vous habiterez sous des tentes toute votre vie, afin que vous viviez longtemps dans le pays où vous êtes étrangers.
verses.am: በምትኖሩባት ምድር ላይ ብዙ ዘመን እንድትኖሩ፥ በዕድሜአችሁ ሙሉ በድንኳን ውስጥ ተቀመጡ እንጂ ቤትን አትሥሩ፥ ዘርንም አትዝሩ፥ ወይንም አትትከሉ፥ አንዳችም አይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
verses.fr: Nous obéissons à tout ce que nous a prescrit Jonadab, fils de Récab, notre père: nous ne buvons pas de vin pendant toute notre vie, nous, nos femmes, nos fils et nos filles;
verses.am: እኛም የአባታችንን የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብን ቃል ባዘዘን ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዘናል፤ እኛም ሚስቶቻችንም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም ዕድሜአችንን ሙሉ የወይን ጠጅ አልጠጣንም፤

verses.en: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
verses.fr: nous ne bâtissons point de maisons pour nos demeures, et nous ne possédons ni vignes, ni champs, ni terres ensemencées;
verses.am: የምንቀመጥበትንም ቤት አልሠራንም፤ የወይን ቦታና እርሻ ዘርም የለንም፤

verses.en: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.fr: nous habitons sous des tentes, et nous suivons et pratiquons tout ce que nous a prescrit Jonadab, notre père.
verses.am: በድንኳንም ውስጥ ተቀምጠናል፥ ታዝዘናል፥ አባታችንም ኢዮናዳብ ያዘዘንን ሁሉ አድርገናል።

verses.en: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Lorsque Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, est monté contre ce pays, nous avons dit: Allons, retirons-nous à Jérusalem, loin de l''armée des Chaldéens et de l''armée de Syrie. C''est ainsi que nous habitons à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደዚህች ምድር በመጣ ጊዜ። ኑ ከከለዳውያን ሠራዊትና ከሶርያ ሠራዊት ፊት የተነሣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንሂድ አልን፤ እንዲሁም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጥን።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: Alors la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Jérémie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Va, et dis aux hommes de Juda et aux habitants de Jérusalem: Ne recevrez-vous pas instruction, pour obéir à mes paroles? dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሂድና ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚቀመጡ ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ቃሌን ትሰሙ ዘንድ ተግሣጽን አትቀበሉምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
verses.fr: On a observé les paroles de Jonadab, fils de Récab, qui a ordonné à ses fils de ne pas boire du vin, et ils n''en ont point bu jusqu''à ce jour, parce qu''ils ont obéi à l''ordre de leur père. Et moi, je vous ai parlé, je vous ai parlé dès le matin, et vous ne m''avez pas écouté.
verses.am: የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ ልጆቹ የወይን ጠጅ እንዳይጠጡ ያዘዛቸው ቃል ተፈጸመ፤ ለአባታቸውም ትእዛዝ ታዝዘዋልና እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አይጠጡም፤ እኔም በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ተናግሬአችኋለሁ፤ ተናገርሁ፥ ሆኖም አልሰማችሁኝም።

verses.en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
verses.fr: Je vous ai envoyé tous mes serviteurs, les prophètes, je les ai envoyés dès le matin, pour vous dire: Revenez chacun de votre mauvaise voie, amendez vos actions, n''allez pas après d''autres dieux pour les servir, et vous resterez dans le pays que j''ai donné à vous et à vos pères. Mais vous n''avez pas prêté l''oreille, vous ne m''avez pas écouté.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እያንዳንዳችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፥ ሥራችሁንም አሳምሩ፥ ታመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አትከተሉ፥ ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠሁት ምድር ትቀመጣላችሁ እያልሁ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ልኬባችሁ ነበር፤ እናንተ ግን ጆሬአችሁን አላዘነበላችሁም እኔንም አልሰማችሁኝም።

verses.en: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
verses.fr: Oui, les fils de Jonadab, fils de Récab, observent l''ordre que leur a donné leur père, et ce peuple ne m''écoute pas!
verses.am: የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብ ልጆች አባታቸው ያዘዛቸውን ትእዛዝ ፈጽመዋልና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ ግን አልሰማኝምና፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je vais faire venir sur Juda et sur tous les habitants de Jérusalem tous les malheurs que j''ai annoncés sur eux, parce que je leur ai parlé et qu''ils n''ont pas écouté, parce que je les ai appelés et qu''ils n''ont pas répondu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በተናገርኋቸው ጊዜ አልሰሙምና፥ በጠራኋቸውም ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና የተናገርሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በይሁዳ ላይ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ ላይ አመጣባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
verses.fr: Et Jérémie dit à la maison des Récabites: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Parce que vous avez obéi aux ordres de Jonadab, votre père, parce que vous avez observé tous ses commandements et fait tout ce qu''il vous a prescrit;
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ሬካባውያንን እንዲህ አላቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለአባታችሁ ለኢዮናዳብ ትእዛዝ ታዝዛችኋልና፥ ትእዛዙንም ሁሉ ጠብቃችኋልና፥ ያዘዛችሁንም ፈጽማችኋልና፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
verses.fr: cause de cela, ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Jonadab, fils de Récab, ne manquera jamais de descendants qui se tiennent en ma présence.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በፊቴ የሚቆም ሰው ከሬካብ ልጅ ከኢዮናዳብ ወገን ለዘላለም አይታጣም።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: La quatrième année de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, cette parole fut adressée à Jérémie de la part de l''Eternel, en ces mots:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.en: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
verses.fr: Prends un livre, et tu y écriras toutes les paroles que je t''ai dites sur Israël et sur Juda, et sur toutes les nations, depuis le jour où je t''ai parlé, au temps de Josias, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: አንድ የመጽሐፍ ክርታስ ውሰድ፥ ለአንተም ከተናገርሁበት ቀን ከኢዮስያስ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ላይ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተናገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ጻፍበት።

verses.en: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
verses.fr: Quand la maison de Juda entendra tout le mal que je pense lui faire, peut-être reviendront-ils chacun de leur mauvaise voie; alors je pardonnerai leur iniquité et leur péché.
verses.am: ምናልባት የይሁዳ ቤት። እኔ አደርግባቸዋለሁ ያልሁትንና ያሰብሁትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ይሰሙ ይሆናል፥ ከክፋ መንገዳቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ እኔም በደላቸውንና ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር እል ዘንድ።

verses.en: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
verses.fr: Jérémie appela Baruc, fils de Nérija; et Baruc écrivit dans un livre, sous la dictée de Jérémie, toutes les paroles que l''Eternel avait dites à Jérémie.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም የኔርያን ልጀ ባሮክን ጠራ፥ ባሮክም እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ የተናገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ከኤርምያስ አፍ በመጽሐፉ ክርታስ ጻፈ።

verses.en: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the Lord:
verses.fr: Puis Jérémie donna cet ordre à Baruc: Je suis retenu, et je ne peux pas aller à la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ባሮክን እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው። እኔ ተግዤአለሁ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እገባ ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.en: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the Lord in the ears of the people in the Lord's house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
verses.fr: Tu iras toi-même, et tu liras dans le livre que tu as écrit sous ma dictée les paroles de l''Eternel, aux oreilles du peuple, dans la maison de l''Eternel, le jour du jeûne; tu les liras aussi aux oreilles de tous ceux de Juda qui seront venus de leurs villes.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ሂድ፥ ከአፌም የጻፍኸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በጾም ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሕዝቡ ጆር በክርታሱ አንብብ፤ ደግሞም ከከተሞቻቸው በሚወጡ በይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ አንብበው።

verses.en: It may be they will present their supplication before the Lord, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the Lord hath pronounced against this people.
verses.fr: Peut-être l''Eternel écoutera-t-il leurs supplications, et reviendront ils chacun de leur mauvaise voie; car grande est la colère, la fureur dont l''Eternel a menacé ce peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ የተናገረው ቍጣውና መዓቱ ታላቅ ነውና ምናልባት ጸሎታቸው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትወድቅ ይሆናል፥ ሁሉም ከክፉ መንገዱ ይመለስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the Lord in the Lord's house.
verses.fr: Baruc, fils de Nérija, fit tout ce que lui avait ordonné Jérémie, le prophète, et lut dans le livre les paroles de l''Eternel, dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የኔርያም ልጅ ባሮክ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በመጽሐፉ አነበበ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the Lord to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
verses.fr: La cinquième année de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda, le neuvième mois, on publia un jeûne devant l''Eternel pour tout le peuple de Jérusalem et pour tout le peuple venu des villes de Juda à Jérusalem.
