verses.am: ሰውነታችሁንም ታጠፉ ዘንድ በምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል መረገሚያና መሰደቢያ ትሆኑ ዘንድ፥ ለመቀመጥ በገባችሁባት በግብጽ ምድር ለሌሎች አማልክት በማጠናችሁ በእጃችሁ ሥራ ለምን ታስቈጡኛላችሁ?

verses.en: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.fr: Avez-vous oublié les crimes de vos pères, les crimes des rois de Juda, les crimes de leurs femmes, vos crimes et les crimes de vos femmes, commis dans le pays de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem?
verses.am: በውኑ በይሁዳ ምድርና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ያደረጉትን የአባቶቻችሁን ክፋት፥ የይሁዳንም ነገሥታት ክፋት፥ የሚስቶቻቸውንም ክፋት፥ የእናንተንም ክፋት፥ የሚስቶቻችሁንም ክፋት ረስታችሁታልን?

verses.en: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
verses.fr: Ils ne se sont point humiliés jusqu''à ce jour, ils n''ont point eu de crainte, ils n''ont point suivi ma loi et mes commandements, que j''ai mis devant vous et devant vos pères.
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አልተዋረዱም አልፈሩምም፥ በእናንተና በአባቶቻችሁም ፊት ባኖርሁት ሕጌና ሥርዓቴ አልሄዱም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je tourne ma face contre vous pour faire du mal, et pour exterminer tout Juda.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይሁዳን ሁሉ አጠፋ ዘንድ ፊቴን ለክፋት በላያችሁ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
verses.fr: Je prendrai les restes de Juda qui ont tourné le visage pour aller au pays d''Egypte, afin d''y demeurer; ils seront tous consumés, ils tomberont dans le pays d''Egypte; ils seront consumés par l''épée, par la famine, depuis le plus petit jusqu''au plus grand; ils périront par l''épée et par la famine; et ils seront un sujet d''exécration, d''épouvante, de malédiction et d''opprobre.
verses.am: ወደ ግብጽም ይገቡ ዘንድ በዚያም ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ፊታቸውን ያቀኑትን የይሁዳን ቅሬታ እወስዳለሁ፥ ሁሉም ይጠፋሉ፥ በግብጽም ምድር ይወድቃሉ፤ በሰይፍና በራብ ይጠፋሉ፤ ከታናሹም ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ ይሞታሉ፤ ለጥላቻና ለመደነቂያ ለመረገሚያና ለመሰደቢያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
verses.fr: Je châtierai ceux qui demeurent au pays d''Egypte, comme j''ai châtié Jérusalem, par l''épée, par la famine et par la peste.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌምንም እንደ ቀጣሁ፥ እንዲሁ በግብጽ ምድር የሚኖሩትን በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
verses.fr: Nul n''échappera, ne fuira, parmi les restes de Juda qui sont venus pour demeurer au pays d''Egypte, avec l''intention de retourner dans le pays de Juda, où ils ont le désir de retourner s''établir; car ils n''y retourneront pas, sinon quelques réchappés.
verses.am: በዚያ ለመቀመጥ ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ከሄዱ፥ ወደ ይሁዳ አገር ተመልሰው በዚያ ይቀመጡ ዘንድ ከሚወድዱ ከይሁዳ ቅሬታ ወገን የሚያመልጥና የሚቀር ወደዚያም የሚመለስ የለም፤ ከሚያመልጥም በቀር ማንም አይመለስም።

verses.en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
verses.fr: Tous les hommes qui savaient que leurs femmes offraient de l''encens à d''autres dieux, toutes les femmes qui se trouvaient là en grand nombre, et tout le peuple qui demeurait au pays d''Egypte, à Pathros, répondirent ainsi à Jérémie:
verses.am: ሚስቶቻቸውም ለሌሎች አማልክት ማጠናቸውን ያወቁ ሰዎች ሁሉ በዚያም የቆሙ ሴቶች ሁሉ፥ በግብጽ ምድር በጳትሮስ የተቀመጡ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ሆነው ለኤርምያስ መለሱለት እንዲህም አሉ።

verses.en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the Lord, we will not hearken unto thee.
verses.fr: Nous ne t''obéirons en rien de ce que tu nous as dit au nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የነገርኸንን ቃል አንሰማህም።

verses.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
verses.fr: Mais nous voulons agir comme l''a déclaré notre bouche, offrir de l''encens à la reine du ciel, et lui faire des libations, comme nous l''avons fait, nous et nos pères, nos rois et nos chefs, dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem. Alors nous avions du pain pour nous rassasier, nous étions heureux, et nous n''éprouvions point de malheur.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኛና አባቶቻችን ነገሥታቶቻችንም አለቆቻችንም በይሁዳ ከተሞች በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ እናደርገው እንደ ነበረ፥ ለሰማይ ንግሥት እናጥን ዘንድ የመጠጥንም KWrባን እናፈስስላት ዘንድ ከአፋችን የወጣውን ቃል ሁሉ በእርግጥ እናደርጋለን፤ በዚያን ጊዜም እንጀራ እንጠግብ ነበር፥ መልካምም ይሆንልን ክፉም አናይም ነበር።

verses.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
verses.fr: Et depuis que nous avons cessé d''offrir de l''encens à la reine du ciel et de lui faire des libations, nous avons manqué de tout, et nous avons été consumés par l''épée et par la famine...
verses.am: ለሰማይ ንግሥት ማጠንን ለእርስዋም የመጠጥን ቍርባን ማፍሰስን ከተውን ወዲህ ግን፥ እኛ በሁሉ ነገር ተቸግረናል፥ በሰይፍና በራብ አልቀናል።

verses.en: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
verses.fr: D''ailleurs, lorsque nous offrons de l''encens à la reine du ciel et que nous lui faisons des libations, est-ce sans la volonté de nos maris que nous lui préparons des gâteaux pour l''honorer et que nous lui faisons des libations?
verses.am: እኛስ ለሰማይ ንግሥት ባጠንንላት የመጠጥንም ቍርባን ባፈሰስንላት ጊዜ፥ በውኑ ያለ ባሎቻችን ምስልዋን ለማበጀት እንጐቻ አድርገንላት ኖሮአልን? የመጠጥንም ቍርባን አፍስሰንላት ኖሮአልን?

verses.en: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
verses.fr: Jérémie dit alors à tout le peuple, aux hommes, aux femmes, à tous ceux qui lui avaient fait cette réponse:
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ይህን ቃል ለመለሱለት ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ለወንዶቹና ለሴቶቹ ለሕዝቡም ሁሉ፥ መለሰላቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the Lord remember them, and came it not into his mind?
verses.fr: L''Eternel ne s''est-il pas rappelé, n''a-t-il pas eu à la pensée l''encens que vous avez brûlé dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem, vous et vos pères, vos rois et vos chefs, et le peuple du pays?
verses.am: እናንተና አባቶቻችሁ ነገሥታቶቻችሁም አለቆቻችሁም የምድርም ሕዝብ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ያጠናችሁትን ዕጣን እግዚአብሔር ያሰበው በልቡም ያኖረው አይደለምን?

verses.en: So that the Lord could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
verses.fr: L''Eternel n''a pas pu le supporter davantage, à cause de la méchanceté de vos actions, à cause des abominations que vous avez commises; et votre pays est devenu une ruine, un désert, un objet de malédiction, comme on le voit aujourd''hui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሥራችሁን ክፋትና ያደረጋችሁትን ርኵሰት ይታገሥ ዘንድ አልቻለም፤ ስለዚህ ምድራችሁ ባድማ መደነቂያም መረገሚያም ሆናለች ዛሬም እንደ ሆነ የሚኖርባት የለም።

verses.en: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
verses.fr: C''est parce que vous avez brûlé de l''encens et péché contre l''Eternel, parce que vous n''avez pas écouté la voix de l''Eternel, et que vous n''avez pas observé sa loi, ses ordonnances, et ses préceptes, c''est pour cela que ces malheurs vous sont arrivés, comme on le voit aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ስላጠናችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ስለ በደላችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ስላልሰማችሁ፥ በሕጉና በሥርዓቱም በምስክሩም ስላልሄዳችሁ፥ ስለዚህ ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ይህች ክፉ ነገር አግኝታችኋለች።

verses.en: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:
verses.fr: Jérémie dit encore à tout le peuple et à toutes les femmes: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, vous tous de Juda, qui êtes au pays d''Egypte!
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ለሴቶቹም ሁሉ እንዲህ አለ። በግብጽ ምድር የምትኖሩ ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Vous et vos femmes, vous avez déclaré de vos bouches et exécuté de vos mains ce que vous dites: Nous voulons accomplir les voeux que nous avons faits, offrir de l''encens à la reine du ciel, et lui faire des libations. Maintenant que vous avez accompli vos voeux, exécuté vos promesses,
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተና ሚስቶቻችሁ በአፋችሁ። ለሰማይ ንግሥት እናጥን ዘንድ የመጠጥንም ቍርባን እናፈስስላት ዘንድ የተሳልነውን ስእለታችንን በእርግጥ እንፈጽማለን አላችሁ በእጃችሁም አደረጋችሁት፤ እንግዲህ ስእለታችሁን አጽኑ ስእለታችሁንም ፈጽሙ።

verses.en: Therefore hear ye the word of the Lord, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the Lord, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord God liveth.
verses.fr: coutez la parole de l''Eternel, vous tous de Juda, qui demeurez au pays d''Egypte! Voici, je le jure par mon grand nom, dit l''Eternel, mon nom ne sera plus invoqué par la bouche d''aucun homme de Juda, et dans tout le pays d''Egypte aucun ne dira: Le Seigneur, l''Eternel est vivant!
verses.am: እናንተ በግብጽ ምድር የምትኖሩ ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ በግብጽ ምድር ሁሉ በሚኖር በይሁዳ ሰው ሁሉ አፍ ስሜ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ተብሎ እንዳይጠራ፥ እነሆ፥ በታላቅ ስሜ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
verses.fr: Voici, je veillerai sur eux pour faire du mal et non du bien; et tous les hommes de Juda qui sont dans le pays d''Egypte seront consumés par l''épée et par la famine, jusqu''à ce qu''ils soient anéantis.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፋት እተጋባቸዋለሁ፤ በግብጽም ምድር ያሉት የይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ ያልቃሉ።

verses.en: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or their's.
verses.fr: Ceux, en petit nombre, qui échapperont à l''épée, retourneront du pays d''Egypte au pays de Juda. Mais tout le reste de Juda, tous ceux qui sont venus au pays d''Egypte pour y demeurer, sauront si ce sera ma parole ou la leur qui s''accomplira.
verses.am: ከሰይፍም የሚያመልጡ ጥቂት ሰዎች ሆነው ከግብጽ ምድር ወደ ይሁዳ ምድር ይመለሳሉ፤ ሊቀመጡም ወደ ግብጽ ምድር የገቡት የይሁዳ ቅሬታ ሁሉ ከእኔ ወይም ከእነርሱ የማናችን ቃል እንዲጸና ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the Lord, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
verses.fr: Et voici, dit l''Eternel, un signe auquel vous connaîtrez que je vous châtierai dans ce lieu, afin que vous sachiez que mes paroles s''accompliront sur vous pour votre malheur.
verses.am: ቃሌም በላያችሁ ለክፋት እንዲጸና ታውቁ ዘንድ በዚህች ስፍራ እንድቀጣችሁ ምልክታችሁ ይህ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give Pharaohhophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je livrerai Pharaon Hophra, roi d''Egypte, entre les mains de ses ennemis, entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à sa vie, comme j''ai livré Sédécias, roi de Juda, entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, son ennemi, qui en voulait à sa vie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስን ጠላቱ ለሆነው ነፍሱንም ለፈለገው ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እንደ ሰጠሁት፥ እንዲሁ፥ እነሆ፥ የግብጹን ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ሖፍራን ለጠላቶቹ ነፍሱንም ለሚፈልጉ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole que Jérémie, le prophète, adressa à Baruc, fils de Nérija, lorsqu''il écrivit dans un livre ces paroles, sous la dictée de Jérémie, la quatrième année de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda. Il dit:
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት የኔርያ ልጅ ባሮክ እነዚህን ቃሎች ከኤርምያስ አፍ በመጽሐፍ በጻፋቸው ጊዜ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, sur toi, Baruc:
verses.am: ባሮክ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይልሃል።

verses.en: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the Lord hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
verses.fr: Tu dis: Malheur à moi! car l''Eternel ajoute le chagrin à ma douleur; je m''épuise en soupirant, et je ne trouve point de repos.
verses.am: አንተ። እግዚአብሔር በሕመሜ ላይ ኀዘንን ጨምሮብኛልና ወዮልኝ! በልቅሶዬ ጩኸት ደክሜአለሁ፥ ዕረፍትንም አላገኘሁም ብለሃል።

verses.en: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The Lord saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
verses.fr: Dis-lui: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, ce que j''ai bâti, je le détruirai; ce que j''ai planté, je l''arracherai, savoir tout ce pays.
verses.am: እንዲህ በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የሠራሁትን አፈርሳለሁ፥ የተከልሁትንም እነቅላለሁ፤ ይኸውም በምድር ሁሉ ነው።

verses.en: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the Lord: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.
verses.fr: Et toi, rechercherais-tu de grandes choses? Ne les recherche pas! Car voici, je vais faire venir le malheur sur toute chair, dit l''Eternel; et je te donnerai ta vie pour butin, dans tous les lieux où tu iras.
verses.am: ለራስህ ታላቅን ነገር ትፈልጋለህን? በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ፥ እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገርን አመጣለሁና አትፈልገው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን በሄድህበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ነፍስህን እንደ ምርኮ አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel qui fut adressée à Jérémie, le prophète, sur les nations.
verses.am: ስለ አሕዛብ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaohnecho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
verses.fr: Sur l''Egypte. Sur l''armée de Pharaon Neco, roi d''Egypte, qui était près du fleuve de l''Euphrate, à Carkemisch, et qui fut battue par Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, la quatrième année de Jojakim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda.
verses.am: ስለ ግብጽ፤ በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ በከርከሚሽ ስለ ነበረው፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ስለ መታው ስለ ግብጽ ንጉሥ ስለ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ ሠራዊት።

verses.en: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
verses.fr: Préparez le petit et le grand bouclier, Et marchez au combat!
verses.am: ጋሻ ጦር አዘጋጁ ወደ ሰልፍም ቅረቡ።

verses.en: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
verses.fr: Attelez les chevaux, Montez, cavaliers! Paraissez avec vos casques, Polissez vos lances, Revêtez la cuirasse!...
verses.am: ፈረሰኞች ሆይ፥ ፈረሶችን ለgWmuና ውጡ፥ ራስ ቍርንም ደፍታችሁ ቁሙ፤ ጦርንም ሰንግሉ ጥሩርንም ልበሱ።

verses.en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Que vois-je? Ils ont peur, ils reculent; Leurs vaillants hommes sont battus; Ils fuient sans se retourner... L''épouvante est de toutes parts, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፈርተው ወደ ኋላ ሲመለሱ፥ ኃያላኖቻቸውም ሲደበደቡ ወደ ኋላቸውም ሳይመለከቱ ፈጥነው ሲሸሹ ለምን አየሁ? በዚህና በዚያ ድንጋጤ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
verses.fr: Que le plus léger ne trouve aucun salut dans la fuite, Que le plus vaillant n''échappe pas! Au septentrion, sur les rives de l''Euphrate, Ils chancellent, ils tombent.
verses.am: ፈጣኑ አያመልጥም ኃያሉም አይድንም፤ በሰሜን በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ በኩል ተሰናክለው ወደቁ።

verses.en: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
verses.fr: Qui est celui qui s''avance comme le Nil, Et dont les eaux sont agitées comme les torrents?
verses.am: ይህ እንደ ግብጽ ወንዝ የሚነሣ፥ ውኃውም እንደ ወንዝ የሚናወጥ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.fr: C''est l''Egypte. Elle s''avance comme le Nil, Et ses eaux sont agitées comme les torrents. Elle dit: Je monterai, je couvrirai la terre, Je détruirai les villes et leurs habitants.
verses.am: ግብጽ እንደ ግብጽ ወንዝ ይነሳል ውኃውም እንደ ወንዙ ይናወጣል፤ እርሱም።እነሣለሁ ምድርንም ሁሉ እከድናለሁ፤ ከተሞችንና የሚኖሩባቸውን አጠፋለሁ ብሎአል።

verses.en: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.
verses.fr: Montez, chevaux! précipitez-vous, chars! Qu''ils se montrent, les vaillants hommes, Ceux d''Ethiopie et de Puth qui portent le bouclier, Et ceux de Lud qui manient et tendent l''arc!
verses.am: ፈረሶች ሆይ፥ ውጡ፤ ሰረገሎችም ሆይ፥ ንጐዱ፤ ጋሻም የሚያነግቡ የኢትዮጵያና የፋጥ ኃያላን፥ ቀስትንም ይዘው የሚስቡ የሉድ ኃያላን ይውጡ።

verses.en: For this is the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord God of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.fr: Ce jour est au Seigneur, à l''Eternel des armées; C''est un jour de vengeance, où il se venge de ses ennemis. L''épée dévore, elle se rassasie, Elle s''enivre de leur sang. Car il y a des victimes du Seigneur, de l''Eternel des armées, Au pays du septentrion, sur les rives de l''Euphrate.
verses.am: ያ ቀን ጠላቶቹን የሚበቀልበት የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር የበቀል ቀን ነው፤ ሰይፍ በልቶ ይጠግባል በደማቸውም ይሰክራል፥ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር በሰሜን ምድር በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ መሥዋዕት አለውና።

verses.en: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.
verses.fr: Monte en Galaad, prends du baume, Vierge, fille de l''Egypte! En vain tu multiplies les remèdes, Il n''y a point de guérison pour toi.
verses.am: ድንግሊቱ የግብጽ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ወደ ገለዓድ ውጪ የሚቀባንም መድኃኒት ውሰጂ፤ መድኃኒትን ያበዛሽው በከንቱ ነው፤ መዳን የለሽም።

verses.en: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.
verses.fr: Les nations apprennent ta honte, Et tes cris remplissent la terre, Car les guerriers chancellent l''un sur l''autre, Ils tombent tous ensemble.
verses.am: ኃያሉ በኃያሉ ላይ ተሰናክሎ ሁለቱ በአንድነት ወድቀዋልና አሕዛብ gWsKWlናሽን ሰምተዋል፥ ልቅሶሽም ምድርን ሞልቶአታል።

verses.en: The word that the Lord spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: La parole qui fut adressée par l''Eternel à Jérémie, le prophète, sur l''arrivée de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, qui voulait frapper le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር እንዲመጣና የግብጽን ምድር እንዲመታ እግዚአብሔር ለነቢዩ ለኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.
verses.fr: Annoncez-le en Egypte, Publiez-le à Migdol, Publiez-le à Noph et à Tachpanès! Dites: Lève-toi, prépare-toi, Car l''épée dévore autour de toi!
verses.am: በግብጽ ተናገሩ፥ በሚግዶልም አሰሙ፥ በሜምፎስና በጣፍናስ አሰሙ፤ ሰይፍ በዙሪያህ ያለውን በልቶአልና። ተነሥ ተዘጋጅም በሉ።

verses.en: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the Lord did drive them.
verses.fr: Pourquoi tes vaillants hommes sont-ils emportés? Ils ne tiennent pas ferme, car l''Eternel les renverse.
verses.am: ኃይለኞችህ ስለ ምን ተወገዱ? እግዚአብሔር ስላደከማቸው አልቆሙም።

verses.en: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
verses.fr: Il en fait chanceler un grand nombre; Ils tombent l''un sur l''autre, et ils disent: Allons, retournons vers notre peuple, Dans notre pays natal, Loin du glaive destructeur!
verses.am: ብዛታቸውም ተሰናከለ፥ ሰውም አንዱ በአንዱ ላይ ወደቀ፤ እነርሱም። ተነሡ፥ ከሚያስጨንቅ ሰይፍ ፊት ወደ ወገናችን ወደ ተወለድንባት ምድር እንመለስ አሉ።

verses.en: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
verses.fr: Là, on s''écrie: Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, Ce n''est qu''un bruit; il a laissé passer le moment.
verses.am: በዚያም የግብሥ ንጉሥ ፈርዖንን። ሰዓቱን የሚያሳልፍ gWrvኛ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
verses.fr: Je suis vivant! dit le roi, Dont l''Eternel des armées est le nom, Comme le Thabor parmi les montagnes, Comme le Carmel qui s''avance dans la mer, il viendra.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በተራሮች መካከል እንዳለ እንደ ታቦር፥ በባሕርም አጠገብ እንዳለ እንደ ቀርሜሎስ፥ እንዲሁ በእውነት ይመጣል፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተባለው ንጉሥ።

verses.en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
verses.fr: Fais ton bagage pour la captivité, Habitante, fille de L''Egypte! Car Noph deviendra un désert, Elle sera ravagée, elle n''aura plus d''habitants.
verses.am: አንቺ በግብጽ የምትቀመጪ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ሜምፎስ ባድማ ትሆናለችና፥ ትቃጠልማለችና፥ የሚቀመጥባትም አይገኝምና ለምርኮ የሚሆን ዕቃ አዘጋጂ።

verses.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
verses.fr: L''Egypte est une très belle génisse... Le destructeur vient du septentrion, il arrive...
verses.am: ግብጽ የተዋበች ጊደር ናት፤ ጥፋት ግን ይመጣል፥ ከሰሜን በኩል ይመጣባታል።

verses.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
verses.fr: Ses mercenaires aussi sont au milieu d''elle comme des veaux engraissés. Et eux aussi, ils tournent le dos, ils fuient tous sans résister. Car le jour de leur malheur fond sur eux, Le temps de leur châtiment.
verses.am: በእርስዋም ያሉ የተቀጠሩ ሠራተኞች እንደ ሰቡ ወይፈኖች ናቸው፤ የጥፋታቸው ቀንና የመጐብኘታቸው ጊዜ መጥቶባቸዋልና ተመለሱ፥ በአንድነትም ሸሹ፥ አልቆሙምም።

verses.en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
verses.fr: Sa voix se fait entendre comme celle du serpent; Car ils s''avancent avec une armée, Ils marchent contre elle avec des haches, Pareils à des bûcherons.
verses.am: ከሠራዊትም ጋር ይሄዳሉና ድምፅ እንደ እባብ ይተምማል፤ እንደ እንጨት ቈራጮችም በምሳር ይመጡባታል።

verses.en: They shall cut down her forest, saith the Lord, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
verses.fr: Ils abattent sa forêt, dit l''Eternel, Bien qu''elle soit impénétrable; Car ils sont plus nombreux que les sauterelles, On ne pourrait les compter.
verses.am: ይቈጠሩ ዘንድ የማይቻሉትን የዱርዋን ዛፎች ይቈርጣሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከአንበጣ ይልቅ በዝተዋልና ቍጥርም የላቸውምና።

verses.en: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
verses.fr: La fille de l''Egypte est confuse, Elle est livrée entre les mains du peuple du septentrion.
verses.am: የግብጽ ልጅ ታፍራለች፤ በሰሜን ሕዝብ እጅ አልፋ ትሰጣለች።

verses.en: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël, dit: Voici, je vais châtier Amon de No, Pharaon, l''Egypte, ses dieux et ses rois, Pharaon et ceux qui se confient en lui.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የኖእ አሞንን፥ ፈርዖንንም፥ ግብጽንም፥ አማልክቶችዋንና ነገሥታቶችዋንም፥ ፈርዖንና በእርሱም የሚታመኑትን እቀጣለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je les livrerai entre les mains de ceux qui en veulent à leur vie, Entre les mains de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, Et entre les mains de ses serviteurs; Et après cela, l''Egypte sera habitée comme aux jours d''autrefois, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነፍሳቸውንም በሚፈልጉ ሰዎች እጅ፥ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በናቡክደነፆር እጅ፥ በባሪያዎቹም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ አንደ ቀድሞው ዘመን የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆናለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.fr: Et toi, mon serviteur Jacob, ne crains pas; Ne t''effraie pas, Israël! Car je te délivrerai de la terre lointaine, Je délivrerai ta postérité du pays où elle est captive; Jacob reviendra, il jouira du repos et de la tranquillité, Et il n''y aura personne pour le troubler.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንተ ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ እነሆ፥ አንተን ከሩቅ ዘርህንም ከተማረከባት ምድር አድናለሁ፤ ያዕቆብም ተመልሶ ያርፋል ተዘልሎም ይቀመጣል፥ ማንም አያስፈራውምም።

verses.en: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the Lord: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
verses.fr: Toi, mon serviteur Jacob, ne crains pas! dit l''Eternel; Car je suis avec toi. J''anéantirai toutes les nations parmi lesquelles je t''ai dispersé, Mais toi, je ne t''anéantirai pas; Je te châtierai avec équité, Je ne puis pas te laisser impuni.
verses.am: አንተ ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንተንም ያሰደድሁባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁና፥ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም፤ በመጠን እቀጣሃለሁ፥ ያለ ቅጣትም አልተውህም።

verses.en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel qui fut adressée à Jérémie, le prophète, sur les Philistins, avant que Pharaon frappât Gaza.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም ጋዛን ሳይመታ ስለ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, des eaux s''élèvent du septentrion, Elles sont comme un torrent qui déborde; Elles inondent le pays et ce qu''il contient, Les villes et leurs habitants. Les hommes poussent des cris, Tous les habitants du pays se lamentent,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ውኃ ከሰሜን ይነሣል የሚያጥለቀልቅም ፈሳሽ ይሆናል፤ በአገሪቱና በመላዋ ሁሉ፥ በከተማይቱና በሚኖሩባት ላይ ይጐርፋል፤ ሰዎቹም ይጮኻሉ፥ በምድርም የሚሮሩ ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.fr: A cause du retentissement des sabots de ses puissants chevaux, Du bruit de ses chars et du fracas des roues; Les pères ne se tournent pas vers leurs enfants, Tant les mains sont affaiblies,
verses.am: ከኃይለኞች ፈረሶች ከኮቴያቸው መጠብጠብ ድምፅ፥ ከሰረገሎቹም መሸከርከር፥ ከመንኰራኵሮቹም መትመም የተነሣ አባቶች በእጃቸው ድካም ምክንያት ፊታቸውን መልሰው ወደ ልጆቻቸው አይመለከቱም።

verses.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the Lord will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.fr: Parce que le jour arrive où seront détruits tous les Philistins, Exterminés tous ceux qui servaient encore d''auxiliaires à Tyr et à Sidon; Car l''Eternel va détruire les Philistins, Les restes de l''île de Caphtor.
verses.am: ይህም የሚሆነው ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሁሉ ያጠፋ ዘንድ የቀሩትንም ረዳቶች ሁሉ ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ይቈርጥ ዘንድ ስለሚመጣው ቀን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር ፍልስጥኤማውያንና የከፍቶርን ደሴት ቅሬታ ያጠፋልና።

verses.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.fr: Gaza est devenue chauve, Askalon est dans le silence, le reste de leur plaine aussi. Jusques à quand te feras-tu des incisions? -
verses.am: ቡሀነት በጋዛ ላይ መጥቶአል፤ አስቀሎና ጠፋች፤ የዔናቅ ቅሬታዎች ሆይ! እስከ መቼ ድረስ ገላችሁን ትነጫላችሁ?

verses.en: O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.fr: Ah! épée de l''Eternel, quand te reposeras-tu? Rentre dans ton fourreau, Arrête, et sois tranquille! -
verses.am: አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ ሆይ፥ ዝም የማትለው እስከ መቼ ነው? ወደ ሰገባህ ግባ ጸጥ ብለህም ዕረፍ።

verses.en: How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
verses.fr: Comment te reposerais-tu? L''Eternel lui donne ses ordres, C''est contre Askalon et la côte de la mer qu''il la dirige.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአስቀሎናና በባሕር ዳር ላይ ትእዛዝ ሰጥቶአልና፥ በዚያም አዘጋጅቶታልና እንዴት ዝም ትላለህ?

verses.en: Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
verses.fr: Sur Moab. Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Malheur à Nebo, car elle est ravagée! Kirjathaïm est confuse, elle est prise; Misgab est confuse, elle est brisée.
verses.am: ስለ ሞዓብ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ናባው ጠፍታለችና ወዮላት! ቂርያታይም አፍራለች ተይዛማለች፤ ሚሥጋብ አፍራለች ደንግጣማለች።

verses.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.fr: Elle n''est plus, la gloire de Moab; A Hesbon, on médite sa perte: Allons, exterminons-le du milieu des nations! Toi aussi, Madmen, tu seras détruite; L''épée marche derrière toi.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሞዓብ ትምክሕት የለም፤ በሐሴቦን ላይ። ኑ ሕዝብ እንዳትሆን እናጥፋት ብለው ክፉ ነገር አስበውባታል። መድሜን ሆይ፥ አንቺ ደግሞ ትጠፊአለሽ ሰይፍም ያሳድድሻል።

verses.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
verses.fr: Des cris partent de Choronaïm; C''est un ravage, c''est une grande détresse.
verses.am: መፍረስና ታላቅ ጥፋት የሚል የጩኸት ቃል ከሖሮናይም ተሰማ።

verses.en: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.fr: Moab est brisé! Les petits font entendre leurs cris.
verses.am: ሞዓብ ጠፍታለች፥ ልጆችዋም ጩኸትን አሰምተዋል።

verses.en: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.fr: Car on répand des pleurs à la montée de Luchith, Et des cris de détresse retentissent à la descente de Choronaïm.
verses.am: በሉሒት ዓቀበት ልቅሶ እያለቀሱ ይወጣሉና፥ በሖሮናይምም ቍልቍለት የጥፋትንና የመባባትን ጩኸት ሰምተዋል።

verses.en: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Fuyez, sauvez votre vie, Et soyez comme un misérable dans le désert!
verses.am: ሸሽታችሁ ራሳችሁን አድኑ፤ በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ KWTቋጦ ሁኑ።

verses.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
verses.fr: Car, parce que tu t''es confié dans tes oeuvres et dans tes trésors, Toi aussi, tu seras pris, Et Kemosch s''en ira en captivité, Avec ses prêtres et avec ses chefs.
verses.am: በሥራሽና በመዝገብሽ ታምነሻልና አንቺ ደግሞ ትያዢያለሽ፤ ካሞሽም ከካህናቱና ከአለቆቹ ጋር በአንድነት ይማረካል።

verses.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.
verses.fr: Le dévastateur entrera dans chaque ville, Et aucune ville n''échappera; La vallée périra et la plaine sera détruite, Comme l''Eternel l''a dit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ፥ አጥፊ ወደ ከተማ ሁሉ ይመጣል አንዲትም ከተማ አትድንም፤ ሸለቆውም ይጠፋል ሜዳውም ይበላሻል።

verses.en: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
verses.fr: Donnez des ailes à Moab, Et qu''il parte au vol! Ses villes seront réduites en désert, Elles n''auront plus d''habitants.
verses.am: በርራ እንድትወጣ ለሞዓብ ክንፍ ስጡአት፤ ከተሞችዋም ባድማና ወና ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.fr: Maudit soit celui qui fait avec négligence l''oeuvre de l''Eternel, Maudit soit celui qui éloigne son épée du carnage!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ በቸልታ የሚያደግ ርጉም ይሁን፥ ሰይፉንም ከደም የሚከለክል ርጉም ይሁን።

verses.en: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.fr: Moab était tranquille depuis sa jeunesse, Il reposait sur sa lie, Il n''était pas vidé d''un vase dans un autre, Et il n''allait pas en captivité. Aussi son goût lui est resté, Et son odeur ne s''est pas changée.
verses.am: ሞዓብ ከታናሽነቱ ጀምሮ ቅምጥል ነበረ፥ በአምቡላውም ላይ ዐርፎአል፥ ከዕቃውም ወደ ዕቃ አልተገላበጠም፥ ወደ ምርኮም አልሄደም፤ ስለዚህ ቃናው በእርሱ ውስጥ ቀርቶአል፥ መዓዛውም አልተለወጠም።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où je lui enverrai des gens qui le transvaseront; Ils videront ses vases, Et feront sauter ses outres.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሚያገላብጡትን የምልክበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እነርሱም ያገላብጡታል፤ ጋኖቹንም ባዶ ያደርጋሉ፥ መስቴዎቹንም ይሰብራሉ።

verses.en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
verses.fr: Moab aura honte de Kemosch, Comme la maison d''Israël a eu honte De Béthel, qui la remplissait de confiance.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ቤት ይታመንባት ከነበረው ከቤቴል እንዳፈረ፥ እንዲሁ ሞዓብ ከካሞሽ ያፍራል።

verses.en: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
verses.fr: Comment pouvez-vous dire: Nous sommes de vaillants hommes, Des soldats prêts à combattre?
verses.am: እናንተ። እኛ ኃያላን በሰልፍም ጽኑዓን ነን እንዴት ትላላችሁ?

verses.en: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Moab est ravagé, ses villes montent en fumée, L''élite de sa jeunesse est égorgée, Dit le roi, dont l''Eternel des armées est le nom.
verses.am: ሞዓብ ፈርሶአል፥ ከተሞቹም ጠፍተዋል፥ የተመረጡትም ጕልማሶች ወደ መታረድ ወርደዋል፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ ንጉሥ።

verses.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.fr: La ruine de Moab est près d''arriver, Son malheur vient en grande hâte.
verses.am: የሞዓብ ጥፋት ሊመጣ ቀርቦአል መከራውም እጅግ ይፈጥናል።

verses.en: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
verses.fr: Lamentez-vous sur lui, vous tous qui l''environnez, Vous tous qui connaissez son nom! Dites: Comment ce sceptre puissant a-t-il été brisé, Ce bâton majestueux?
verses.am: በዙሪያው ያላችሁ ሁሉ ስሙንም የምታውቁ ሁሉ። ብርቱው በትር፥ የከበረው ሽመል፥ እንዴት ተሰበረ! ብላችሁ አልቅሱለት።

verses.en: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
verses.fr: Descends du séjour de la gloire, assieds-toi sur la terre desséchée, Habitante, fille de Dibon! Car le dévastateur de Moab monte contre toi, Il détruit tes forteresses.
verses.am: በዲቦን የምትኖሪ ሆይ፥ ሞዓብን የሚያጠፋ ወጥቶብሻልና፥ አምባሽንም ሰብሮአልና ከክብርሽ ውረጂ በጥማትም ተቀመጪ።

verses.en: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
verses.fr: Tiens-toi sur le chemin, et regarde, habitante d''Aroër! Interroge le fuyard, le réchappé, Demande: Qu''est-il arrivé? -
verses.am: በአሮዔር የምትኖሪ ሆይ፥ በመንገድ አጠገብ ቆመሽ ተመልከቺ፤ የሸሸውንና ያመለጠችውን። ምን ሆኖአል? ብለሽ ጠይቂ።

verses.en: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
verses.fr: Moab est confus, car il est brisé. Poussez des gémissements et des cris! Publiez sur l''Arnon Que Moab est ravagé!
verses.am: ሞዓብም ፈርሶአልና አፈረ፤ አልቅሱ ጩኹም፤ ሞዓብ እንደ ተዘረፈ በአርኖን አጠገብ አውሩ።

verses.en: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.fr: Le châtiment est venu sur le pays de la plaine, Sur Holon, sur Jahats, sur Méphaath,
verses.am: በሜዳ ላይ፥ በሖሎን፥ በያሳ፥ በሜፍዓት ላይ፥

verses.en: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Bethdiblathaim,
verses.fr: Sur Dibon, sur Nebo, sur Beth-Diblathaïm,
verses.am: በዲቦን፥ በናባው፥ በቤት ዲብላታይም ላይ፥

verses.en: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Bethgamul, and upon Bethmeon,
verses.fr: Sur Kirjathaïm, sur Beth-Gamul, sur Beth-Meon,
verses.am: በቂርያታይም፥ በቤትጋሙል፥

verses.en: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.fr: Sur Kerijoth, sur Botsra, Sur toutes les villes du pays de Moab, Eloignées et proches.
verses.am: በቤትምዖን ላይ፥ በቂርዮት፥ በባሶራ፥ በሞዓብም ምድር ከተሞች ሁሉ ቅርብና ሩቅ በሆኑ ላይ ፍርድ መጥቶአል።

verses.en: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: La force de Moab est abattue, Et son bras est brisé, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሞዓብ ቀንድ ተቈረጠ ክንዱም ተሰበረ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.fr: Enivrez-le, car il s''est élevé contre l''Eternel! Que Moab se roule dans son vomissement, Et qu''il devienne aussi un objet de raillerie!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርቶአልና አስክሩት፤ ሞዓብም በጥፋቱ ላይ ይንከባለላል፥ ደግሞም መሳቂያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
verses.fr: Israël n''a-t-il pas été pour toi un objet de raillerie? Avait-il donc été surpris parmi les voleurs, Pour que tu ne parles de lui qu''en secouant la tête?
verses.am: እስራኤል ለአንተ መሳቂያ አልሆነምን? ወይስ በሌቦች መካከል ተገኝቶአልን? ስለ እርሱ በተናገርህ ጊዜ ራስህን ትነቀንቃለህ።

verses.en: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
verses.fr: Abandonnez les villes, et demeurez dans les rochers, Habitants de Moab! Soyez comme les colombes, Qui font leur nid sur le flanc des cavernes!
verses.am: እናንተ በሞዓብ የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ከተሞችን ትታችሁ በዓለት ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፥ በገደል አፋፍም ቤትዋን እንደምትሠራ እንደ ርግብ ሁኑ።

verses.en: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.fr: Nous connaissons l''orgueil du superbe Moab, Sa hauteur, sa fierté, son arrogance, et son coeur altier.
verses.am: እጅግ እንደ ታበየ ስለ ሞዓብ ትዕቢት ስለ ትምክህቱም ስለ kWraቱም ስለ መጓደዱም ስለ ልቡም ትዕቢት ሰምተናል።

verses.en: I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
verses.fr: Je connais, dit l''Eternel, sa présomption et ses vains discours, Et ses oeuvres de néant.
verses.am: ቍጣው ምንም እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ፉከራው ምንም አልሠራም።

verses.en: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je gémis sur Moab, Je gémis sur tout Moab; On soupire pour les gens de Kir-Hérès.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ለሞዓብ አለቅሳለሁ ለሞዓብም ሁሉ እጮኻለሁ፤ ለቂርሔሬስ ሰዎች አለቅሳለሁ።

verses.en: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
verses.fr: Vigne de Sibma, je pleure sur toi plus que sur Jaezer; Tes rameaux allaient au delà de la mer, Ils s''étendaient jusqu''à la mer de Jaezer; Le dévastateur s''est jeté sur ta récolte et sur ta vendange.
verses.am: አንቺ የሴባማ ወይን ሆይ፥ ከኢያዜር ልቅሶ ይልቅ ለአንቺ አለቅሳለሁ፤ ቅርንጫፎችሽ ባሕርን ተሻግረዋል፥ ወደ ኢያዜርም ባሕር ደርሰዋል፤ አጥፊው በሰብልሽና በወይንሽ ላይ መጥቶአል።

verses.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab, and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.fr: La joie et l''allégresse ont disparu des campagnes Et du pays de Moab; J''ai fait tarir le vin dans les cuves; On ne foule plus gaîment au pressoir; Il y a des cris de guerre, et non des cris de joie.
verses.am: ሐሤትና ደስታ ከፍሬያማው እርሻና ከሞዓብ ምድር ጠፍተዋል፤ ጠጁን ከመጥመቂያው አጥፍቻለሁ፤ ጠማቂውም በእልልታ አይጠምቅም፥ እልልታቸውም እልልታ አይሆንም።

verses.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
verses.fr: Les cris de Hesbon retentissent jusqu''à Elealé, Et ils font entendre leur voix jusqu''à Jahats, Depuis Tsoar jusqu''à Choronaïm, Jusqu''à Eglath-Schelischija; Car les eaux de Nimrim sont aussi ravagées.
verses.am: ከሐሴቦን ጩኸት እስከ ኤልያሊና እስከ ያሀጽ ድረስ ድምፃቸውን ሰጥተዋል፤ ከዞዓር እስከ ሖሮናይምና እስከ ዔግላት ሺሊሺያ ድረስ ይደርሳል፤ የኔምሬም ውኃ ደግሞ ይደርቃል።

verses.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
verses.fr: Je veux en finir dans Moab, dit l''Eternel, Avec celui qui monte sur les hauts lieux, Et qui offre de l''encens à son dieu.
verses.am: በኮረብታው መስገጃ ላይ የሚሠዋውን ለአማልክቱም የሚያጥነውን ከሞዓብ አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
verses.fr: Aussi mon coeur gémit comme une flûte sur Moab, Mon coeur gémit comme une flûte sur les gens de Kir-Hérès, Parce que tous les biens qu''ils ont amassés sont perdus.
verses.am: ያተረፈው ትርፉ ጠፍቶበታልና፤ ስለዚህ ልቤ ለሞዓብ እንደ እንቢልታ ይጮኻል፥ ልቤም ለቂርሔሬስ ሰዎች እንደ እንቢልታ ይጮኻል።

verses.en: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.fr: Car toutes les têtes sont rasées, Toutes les barbes sont coupées; Sur toutes les mains il y a des incisions, Et sur les reins des sacs.
verses.am: ራስ ሁሉ መላጣ ጢምም ሁሉ የተላጨ ነውና፤ በእጅም ሁሉ ላይ ክትፋት በወገብም ላይ ማቅ አለና።

verses.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Sur tous les toits de Moab et dans ses places, Ce ne sont que lamentations, Parce que j''ai brisé Moab comme un vase qui n''a pas de prix, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሞዓብን እንደማይወደድ ዕቃ ሰብሬአለሁና በሞዓብ ሰገነት ሁሉ ላይ በአደባባዩም ላይ በሁሉም ቦታ ልቅሶ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
verses.fr: Comme il est brisé! Poussez des gémissements! Comme Moab tourne honteusement le dos! Moab devient un objet de raillerie et d''effroi Pour tous ceux qui l''environnent.
verses.am: እንዴት ተገለበጠ! በእፍረትም የተነሣ ሞዓብ ጀርባውን እንዴት መለሰ! ብላችሁ አልቅሱ። ሞዓብም በዙሪያው ላሉት ሁሉ መሳቂያና ድንጋጤ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, il vole comme l''aigle, Et il étend ses ailes sur Moab.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ እንደ ንስር ይበርራል ክንፉንም በሞዓብ ላይ ይዘረጋል።

verses.en: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.fr: Kerijoth est prise, Les forteresses sont emportées, Et le coeur des héros de Moab est en ce jour Comme le coeur d''une femme en travail.
verses.am: ከተሞቹ ተይዘዋል፥ አምባዎቹም ተወስደዋል፥ በዚያም ቀን የሞዓብ ኃያላን ልብ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ልብ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.
verses.fr: Moab sera exterminé, il cessera d''être un peuple, Car il s''est élevé contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሞዓብም በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርቶአልና ሕዝብ ከመሆን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: La terreur, la fosse, et le filet, Sont sur toi, habitant de Moab! Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሞዓብ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ፍርሃትና gWdጓድ ወጥመድም በአንተ ላይ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Celui qui fuit devant la terreur tombe dans la fosse, Et celui qui remonte de la fosse se prend au filet; Car je fais venir sur lui, sur Moab, L''année de son châtiment, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሞዓብ ላይ የመጐብኘትን ዓመት አመጣበታለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በፍርሃት የሸሸ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ ይወድቃል፥ ከgWdጓድም የወጣ በወጥመድ ይያዛል።

verses.en: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.fr: A l''ombre de Hesbon les fuyards s''arrêtent épuisés; Mais il sort un feu de Hesbon, Une flamme du milieu de Sihon; Elle dévore les flancs de Moab, Et le sommet de la tête des fils du tumulte.
verses.am: የሸሹ ደክመው ከሐሴቦን ጥላ በታች ቆመዋል፤ እሳት ከሐሴቦን ነበልባልም ከሴዎን ወጥቶአል የሞዓብንም ማዕዘን የሤትንም ልጆች አናት በልቶአል።

verses.en: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
verses.fr: Malheur à toi, Moab! Le peuple de Kemosch est perdu! Car tes fils sont emmenés captifs, Et tes filles captives.
verses.am: ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ ወዮልህ! የካሞሽ ወገን ጠፍቶአል፤ ወንዶች ልጆችህ ተማርከዋልና፥ ሴቶች ልጆችህም ወደ ምርኮ ሄደዋልና።

verses.en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.fr: Mais je ramènerai les captifs de Moab, dans la suite des temps, Dit l''Eternel. Tel est le jugement sur Moab.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የሞዓብን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። የሞዓብ ፍርድ እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.fr: Sur les enfants d''Ammon. Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Israël n''a-t-il point de fils? N''a-t-il point d''héritier? Pourquoi Malcom possède-t-il Gad, Et son peuple habite-t-il ses villes?
verses.am: ስለ አሞን ልጆች፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለእስራኤል ልጆች የሉትምን? ወይስ ወራሽ የለውምን? ስለ ምን ሚልኮም ጋድን ወረሰ? ሕዝቡስ በከተሞቹ ላይ ስለ ምን ተቀመጠ?

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où je ferai retentir le cri de guerre contre Rabbath des enfants d''Ammon; Elle deviendra un monceau de ruines, Et les villes de son ressort seront consumées par le feu; Alors Israël chassera ceux qui l''avaient chassé, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በአሞን ልጆች ከተማ በረባት ላይ የሰልፍ ውካታን የማሰማበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የፍርስራሽ ክምርም ትሆናለች፥ ሴቶች ልጆችዋም በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፥ እስራኤልም የወረሱትን ይወርሳል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
verses.fr: Pousse des gémissements, Hesbon, car Aï est ravagée! Poussez des cris, filles de Rabba, revêtez-vous de sacs, Lamentez-vous, et courez çà et là le long des murailles! Car Malcom s''en va en captivité, Avec ses prêtres et avec ses chefs.
verses.am: ሐሴቦን ሆይ፥ ጋይ ፈርሳለችና አልቅሺላት እናንተም የረባት ሴቶች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ሚልኮም ካህናቱና አለቆቹም በአንድነት ይማረካሉና ጩኹ፥ ማቅም ታጠቁ፥ አልቅሱም፥ በቅጥሮችም መካከል ተርዋርዋጡ።

verses.en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
verses.fr: Pourquoi te glorifies-tu de tes vallées? Ta vallée se fond, fille rebelle, Qui te confiais dans tes trésors: Qui viendra contre moi?
verses.am: ማን ይመጣብኛል ብለሽ በመዝገብሽ የታመንሽ አንቺ ከዳተኛ ልጅ ሆይ፥ በሸለቆችሽ፥ ውኃ በሚያረካቸው ሸለቆችሽ፥ ስለ ምን ትመኪያለሽ?

verses.en: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord God of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.fr: Voici, je fais venir sur toi la terreur, Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées, Elle viendra de tous tes alentours; Chacun de vous sera chassé devant soi, Et nul ne ralliera les fuyards.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዙሪያሽ ካሉት ሁሉ ዘንድ ፍርሃትን አመጣብሻለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፊታችሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ ትሰደዳላችሁ፥ የሚሸሹትንም የሚሰበስብ የለም።

verses.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais après cela, je ramènerai les captifs des enfants d''Ammon, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ የአሞንን ልጆች ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.fr: Sur Edom. Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: N''y a-t-il plus de sagesse dans Théman? La prudence a-t-elle disparu chez les hommes intelligents? Leur sagesse s''est-elle évanouie?
verses.am: ስለ ኤዶምያስ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውኑ በቴማን ጥበብ የለምን? ከብልሃተኞችስ ምክር ጠፍቶአልን?

verses.en: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
verses.fr: Fuyez, tournez le dos, retirez-vous dans les cavernes, Habitants de Dedan! Car je fais venir le malheur sur Esaü, Le temps de son châtiment.
verses.am: ጥበባቸውስ አልቆአልን? እናንተ በድዳን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የዔሳውን ጥፋት፥ የምጐበኝበትን ጊዜ፥ አመጣበታለሁና ሽሹ፥ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፥ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.fr: Si des vendangeurs viennent chez toi, Ne laissent-ils rien à grappiller? Si des voleurs viennent de nuit, Ils ne dévastent que ce qu''ils peuvent.
verses.am: ወይን ለቃሚዎች ቢመጡብህ፥ ቃርሚያውን አይተውልህምን? ሌቦችስ በሌሊት ቢመጡ፥ የሚያጠፉት እስኪበቃቸው ድረስ አይደለምን?

verses.en: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.fr: Mais moi, je dépouillerai Esaü, Je découvrirai ses retraites, Il ne pourra se cacher; Ses enfants, ses frères, ses voisins, périront, Et il ne sera plus.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ዔሳውን ዐራቈትሁት፥ የተሸሸጉትንም ስፍራዎች ገለጥሁ፥ ይሸሸግም ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ዘሩም ወንድሞቹም ጎረቤቶቹም ጠፍተዋል እርሱም የለም።

verses.en: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.fr: Laisse tes orphelins, je les ferai vivre, Et que tes veuves se confient en moi!
verses.am: ድሀ አደጎችህን ተው፥ እኔም በሕይወት አኖራቸዋለሁ፤ መበለቶችህም በእኔ ይታመኑ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, ceux qui ne devaient pas boire la coupe la boiront; Et toi, tu resterais impuni! Tu ne resteras pas impuni, Tu la boiras.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ጽዋውን ያልተገባቸው ሰዎች ጠጥተውታል፤ አንተም ሳትቀጣ ትቀራለህን? በእርግጥ ትጠጣለህ እንጂ ያለ ቅጣት አትቀርም።

verses.en: For I have sworn by myself, saith the Lord, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.fr: Car je le jure par moi-même, dit l''Eternel, Botsra sera un objet de désolation, d''opprobre, De dévastation et de malédiction, Et toutes ses villes deviendront des ruines éternelles.
verses.am: ባሶራ መደነቂያና መሰደቢያ መረገሚያም እንድትሆን በራሴ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከተሞችዋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ባድማ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: I have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.fr: J''ai appris de l''Eternel une nouvelle, Et un messager a été envoyé parmi les nations: Assemblez-vous, et marchez contre elle! Levez-vous pour la guerre!
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወሬ ሰምቻለሁ በአሕዛብም መካከል። ተሰብሰቡ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ኑ ለሰልፍም ተነሡ የሚል መልእክተኛ ተልኮአል።

verses.en: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
verses.fr: Car voici, je te rendrai petit parmi les nations, Méprisé parmi les hommes.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ የተጠቃህ፥ በሰዎችም ዘንድ የተናቅህ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ta présomption, l''orgueil de ton coeur t''a égaré, Toi qui habites le creux des rochers, Et qui occupes le sommet des collines. Quand tu placerais ton nid aussi haut que celui de l''aigle, Je t''en précipiterai, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዓለት ንቃቃት ውስጥ የምትቀመጥ፥ የተራራውን ከፍታ የምትይዝ ሆይ፥ ድፍረትህና የልብህ ኵራት አታልለውሃል። ቤትህን ምንም እንደ ንስር ከፍ ብታደርግ፥ ከዚያ አወርድሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.fr: Edom sera un objet de désolation; Tous ceux qui passeront près de lui Seront dans l''étonnement et siffleront sur toutes ses plaies.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም መደነቂያ ትሆናለች፥ የሚያልፍባትም ሁሉ ይደነቃል፥ ስለ መጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጭባታል።

verses.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.fr: Comme Sodome et Gomorrhe et les villes voisines, qui furent détruites, Dit l''Eternel, Il ne sera plus habité, Il ne sera le séjour d''aucun homme...
verses.am: ሰዶምና ገሞራ በእነርሱም አጠገብ የነበሩት ከተሞች እንደ ተገለበጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ በዚያ ሰው አይቀመጥም የሰው ልጅም አይኖርባትም።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.fr: Voici, tel qu''un lion, il monte des rives orgueilleuses du Jourdain Contre la demeure forte; Soudain j''en ferai fuir Edom, Et j''établirai sur elle celui que j''ai choisi. Car qui est semblable à moi? qui me donnera des ordres? Et quel est le chef qui me résistera?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi écoutez la résolution que l''Eternel a prise contre Edom, Et les desseins qu''il a conçus contre les habitants de Théman! Certainement on les traînera comme de faibles brebis, Certainement on ravagera leur demeure.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በኤዶምያስ ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በቴማንም በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትንንሾች ይጐተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.fr: Au bruit de leur chute, la terre tremble; Leur cri se fait entendre jusqu''à la mer Rouge...
verses.am: ከመውደቃቸው ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ የጩኸታቸውም ድምፅ በኤርትራ ባሕር ተሰማ።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.fr: Voici, comme l''aigle il s''avance, il vole, Il étend ses ailes sur Botsra, Et le coeur des héros d''Edom est en ce jour Comme le coeur d''une femme en travail.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ ንስር ወጥቶ ይበራል ክንፉንም በባሶራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ በዚያም ቀን የኤዶምያስ ኃያላን ልብ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ልብ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.fr: Sur Damas. Hamath et Arpad sont confuses, Car elles ont appris une mauvaise nouvelle, elles tremblent; C''est une mer en tourmente, Qui ne peut se calmer.
verses.am: ስለ ደማስቆ፤ ክፉ ወሬ ሰምተዋልና ሐማትና አርፋድ አፈሩ ቀለጡም፤ በባሕርም ላይ ኅዘን አለ፥ ታርፍም ዘንድ አትችልም።

verses.en: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.fr: Damas est défaillante, elle se tourne pour fuir, Et l''effroi s''empare d''elle; L''angoisse et les douleurs la saisissent, Comme une femme en travail. -
verses.am: ደማስቆ ደከመች ትሸሽም ዘንድ ዘወር አለች እንቅጥቅጥም ያዛት፥ እንደ ወላድም ሴት ጣርና ምጥ ያዛት።

verses.en: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.fr: Ah! elle n''est pas abandonnée, la ville glorieuse, La ville qui fait ma joie! -
verses.am: የተመሰገነችው ከተማ፥ የደስታዬ ከተማ፥ ሳትለቀቅ እንዴት ቀረች?

verses.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ses jeunes gens tomberont dans les rues, Et tous ses hommes de guerre périront en ce jour, Dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.fr: Je mettrai le feu aux murs de Damas, Et il dévorera les palais de Ben-Hadad.
verses.am: በደማስቆም ቅጥር ላይ እሳት አነድዳለሁ የወልደ አዴርንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።

verses.en: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the Lord; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.fr: Sur Kédar et les royaumes de Hatsor, que battit Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone. Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Levez-vous, montez contre Kédar, Et détruisez les fils de l''Orient!
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ስለ መታ ስለ ቄዳርና ስለ አሶር መንግሥታት፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ተነሡ ወደ ቄዳርም ውጡ፥ የምሥራቅንም ልጆች አጥፉ።

verses.en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.fr: On prendra leurs tentes et leurs troupeaux, On enlèvera leurs pavillons, tous leurs bagages et leurs chameaux, Et l''on jettera de toutes parts contre eux des cris d''épouvante.
verses.am: ድንኳናቸውንና መንጋቸውን ይወስዳሉ፤ መጋረጆቻቸውንና ዕቃቸውን ሁሉ ግመሎቻቸውንም ለራሳቸው ይወስዳሉ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋትን ጥሩባቸው።

verses.en: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the Lord; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.fr: Fuyez, fuyez de toutes vos forces, cherchez à l''écart une demeure, Habitants de Hatsor! dit l''Eternel; Car Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, a pris une résolution contre vous, Il a conçu un projet contre vous.
verses.am: እናንተ በአሶር የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ተማክሮባችኋልና፥ አሳብም አስቦባችኋልና ሽሹ ወደ ሩቅም ሂዱ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the Lord, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.fr: Levez-vous, montez contre une nation tranquille, En sécurité dans sa demeure, dit l''Eternel; Elle n''a ni portes, ni barres, Elle habite solitaire.
verses.am: ተነሡ፥ ዕርፊት ወዳለበት ተዘልሎም ወደ ተቀመጠው፥ ደጅና መወርወሪያ ወደሌለው ብቻውንም ወደ ተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ውጡ።

verses.en: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Leurs chameaux seront au pillage, Et la multitude de leurs troupeaux sera une proie; Je les disperserai à tous les vents, ceux qui se rasent les coins de la barbe, Et je ferai venir leur ruine de tous les côtés, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ግመሎቻቸው ይበዘበዛሉ የእንስሶቻቸውም ብዛት ይማረካል፤ ጠgWraቸውንም በዙሪያ የሚላጩትን ሰዎች ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከዳርቻቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋት አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
verses.fr: Hatsor sera le repaire des chacals, un désert pour toujours; Personne n''y habitera, aucun homme n''y séjournera.
verses.am: አሶርም የቀበሮ መኖሪያና የዘላለም ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ በዚያም ሰው አይኖርም፥ የሰው ልጅም አይቀመጥባትም።

verses.en: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel qui fut adressée à Jérémie, le prophète, sur Elam, au commencement du règne de Sédécias, roi de Juda, en ces mots:
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ስለ ኤላም ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici, je vais briser l''arc d''Elam, Sa principale force.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ዋና የኃይላቸው መሣሪያ የሆነውን የኤላምን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ።

verses.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.fr: Je ferai venir sur Elam quatre vents des quatre extrémités du ciel, Je les disperserai par tous ces vents, Et il n''y aura pas une nation Où n''arrivent des fugitifs d''Elam.
verses.am: ከአራቱም ከሰማይ ማዕዘናት አራቱን ነፋሳት በኤላም ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ወደ እነዚያም ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከኤላም የተሰደዱ ሰዎች የማይደርሱበት ሕዝብ አይገኝም።

verses.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the Lord; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.fr: Je ferai trembler les habitants d''Elam devant leurs ennemis Et devant ceux qui en veulent à leur vie, J''amènerai sur eux des malheurs, Mon ardente colère, dit l''Eternel, Et je les poursuivrai par l''épée, Jusqu''à ce que je les aie anéantis.
verses.am: በጠላቶቻቸውና ነፍሳቸውን በሚሹአት ፊት ኤላምን አስደነግጣለሁ፤ ክፉ ነገርን እርሱም ጽኑ ቍጣዬን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በኋላቸው ሰይፍ እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je placerai mon trône dans Elam, Et j''en détruirai le roi et les chefs, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዙፋኔንም በኤላም አኖራለሁ ከዚያም ንጉሡንና አለቆቹን አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais dans la suite des temps, je ramènerai les captifs d''Elam, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የኤላምን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.fr: La parole que l''Eternel prononça sur Babylone, sur le pays des Chaldéens, par Jérémie, le prophète:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ከለዳውያን ምድር ስለ ባቢሎን በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.fr: Annoncez-le parmi les nations, publiez-le, élevez une bannière! Publiez-le, ne cachez rien! Dites: Babylone est prise! Bel est confondu, Merodac est brisé! Ses idoles sont confondues, ses idoles sont brisées!
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል ተናገሩ አውሩም፥ ዓላማውንም አንሡ፤ አውሩ፥ አትደብቁ። ባቢሎን ተወሰደች፥ ቤል አፈረ፥ ሜሮዳክ ደነገጠ፤ ምስሎችዋ አፈሩ፥ ጣዖታትዋ ደነገጡ በሉ።

verses.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.fr: Car une nation monte contre elle du septentrion, Elle réduira son pays en désert, Il n''y aura plus d''habitants; Hommes et bêtes fuient, s''en vont.
verses.am: ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ወጥቶባታል ምድርዋንም ባድማ ያደርጋል፥ የሚቀመጥባትም አይገኝም፤ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።

verses.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God.
verses.fr: En ces jours, en ce temps-là, dit l''Eternel, Les enfants d''Israël et les enfants de Juda reviendront ensemble; Ils marcheront en pleurant, Et ils chercheront l''Eternel, leur Dieu.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት በዚያም ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ሆነው ይመጣሉ፥ እያለቀሱም መንገዳቸውን ይሄዳሉ፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
verses.fr: Ils s''informeront du chemin de Sion, Ils tourneront vers elle leurs regards: Venez, attachez-vous à l''Eternel, Par une alliance éternelle qui ne soit jamais oubliée!
verses.am: ፊታቸውንም ወደዚያ አቅንተው። ኑ፥ ከቶ በማይረሳ በዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተጠጉ ብለው ስለ ጽዮን መንገድ ይጠይቃሉ።

verses.en: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.fr: Mon peuple était un troupeau de brebis perdues; Leurs bergers les égaraient, les faisaient errer par les montagnes; Elles allaient des montagnes sur les collines, Oubliant leur bercail.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ የጠፉ በጎች ሆነዋል፤ እረኞቻቸው አሳቱአቸው፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የተቅበዘበዙ አደረጉአቸው፤ ከተራራ ወደ ኮረብታ አለፉ፥ በረታቸውንም ረሱ።

verses.en: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui les trouvaient les dévoraient, Et leurs ennemis disaient: Nous ne sommes point coupables, Puisqu''ils ont péché contre l''Eternel, la demeure de la justice, Contre l''Eternel, l''espérance de leurs pères.
verses.am: ያገኙአቸው ሁሉ በሉአቸው፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም። በጽድቅ ማደሪያ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ፥ በአባቶቻቸው ተስፋ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠሩ እኛ አልበደልንም አሉ።

verses.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.fr: Fuyez de Babylone, sortez du pays des Chaldéens, Et soyez comme des boucs à la tête du troupeau!
verses.am: ከባቢሎን መካከል ሽሹ፥ ከከለዳውያንም ድር ውጡ፥ በመንጎችም ፊት እንደ አውራ ፍየሎች ሁኑ።

verses.en: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.fr: Car voici, je vais susciter et faire monter contre Babylone Une multitude de grandes nations du pays du septentrion; Elles se rangeront en bataille contre elle, et s''en empareront; Leurs flèches sont comme un habile guerrier, Qui ne revient pas à vide.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን ምድር የታላላቅ አሕዛብን ጉባኤ አስነሣለሁ በባቢሎንም ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በእርስዋም ላይ ይሰለፋሉ፥ ከዚያም ትወሰዳለች፤ ፍላጾቻቸውም ባዶውን እንደማይመለስ እንደ ብልህ ጀግና ፍላጻ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Et la Chaldée sera livrée au pillage; Tous ceux qui la pilleront seront rassasiés, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የከላውዴዎንም ምድር ትበዘበዛለች፥ የሚበዘብዙአትም ሁሉ ይጠግባሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.fr: Oui, soyez dans la joie, dans l''allégresse, Vous qui avez pillé mon héritage! Oui, bondissez comme une génisse dans l''herbe, Hennissez comme des chevaux fougueux!
verses.am: ርስቴን የምትበዘብዙ እናንተ ሆይ፥ ደስ ብሎአችኋልና፥ ሐሤትንም አድርጋችኋልና፥ በመስክ ላይም እንዳለች ጊደር ሆናችሁ ተቀናጥታችኋልና፥ እንደ ብርቱዎችም ፈረሶች አሽካክታችኋልና፥

verses.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.fr: Votre mère est couverte de confusion, Celle qui vous a enfantés rougit de honte; Voici, elle est la dernière des nations, C''est un désert, une terre sèche et aride.
verses.am: እናታችሁ እጅግ ታፍራለች፥ የወለደቻችሁም ትጐሰቍላለች፤ እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል ኋለኛይቱ ትሆናለች፤ ምድረ በዳና ደረቅ ምድር በረሀም ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.fr: A cause de la colère de l''Eternel, elle ne sera plus habitée, Elle ne sera plus qu''une solitude. Tous ceux qui passeront près de Babylone Seront dans l''étonnement et siffleront sur toutes ses plaies.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ የተነሣ ባድማ ትሆናለች እንጂ ሰው አይቀመጥባትም፤ በባቢሎንም በኩል የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይደነቃል በመጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጫል።

verses.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.
verses.fr: Rangez-vous en bataille autour de Babylone, vous tous, archers! Tirez contre elle, n''épargnez pas les flèches! Car elle a péché contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: እናንተ ቀስትን የምትገትሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በባቢሎን ላይ በዙሪያዋ ተሰለፉ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርታለችና ወርውሩባት ፍላጾችንም አትንፈጉ።

verses.en: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
verses.fr: Poussez de tous côtés contre elle un cri de guerre! Elle tend les mains; Ses fondements s''écroulent; Ses murs sont renversés. Car c''est la vengeance de l''Eternel. Vengez-vous sur elle! Faites-lui comme elle a fait!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ነውና በዙሪያዋ ጩኹባት፤ እጅዋን ሰጠች፤ ግንቦችዋ ወደቁ ቅጥሮችዋም ፈረሱ፤ እርስዋን ተበቀሉ እንደ ሠራችውም ሥሩባት።

verses.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.fr: Exterminez de Babylone celui qui sème, Et celui qui manie la faucille au temps de la moisson! Devant le glaive destructeur, Que chacun se tourne vers son peuple, Que chacun fuie vers son pays.
verses.am: ዘሪውንና በመከር ጊዜ ማጭድ የሚይዘውን ከባቢሎን አጥፉ፤ ከሚያስጨንቅ ሰይፍ ፊት እያንዳንዱ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል እያንዳንዱም ወደ አገሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.en: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
verses.fr: Israël est une brebis égarée, que les lions ont chassée; Le roi d''Assyrie l''a dévorée le premier; Et ce dernier lui a brisé les os, Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone.
verses.am: እስራኤል የባዘነ በግ ነው፤ አንበሶች አሳደዱት፤ መጀመሪያ የአሦር ንጉሥ በላው፥ በመጨረሻም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር አጥንቱን ቈረጠመው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je châtierai le roi de Babylone et son pays, Comme j''ai châtié le roi d''Assyrie.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦርን ንጉሥ እንደ ቀጣሁ እንዲሁ፥ እነሆ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥና ምድሩን እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.fr: Je ramènerai Israël dans sa demeure; Il aura ses pâturages du Carmel et du Basan, Et son âme se rassasiera sur la montagne d''Ephraïm et dans Galaad.
verses.am: እስራኤልንም ወደ ማሰማርያው እመልሳለሁ፥ በቀርሜሎስና በባሳንም ላይ ይሰማራል፥ ሰውነቱም በኤፍሬም ተራራና በገለዓድ ላይ ትጠግባለች።

verses.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.fr: En ces jours, en ce temps-là, dit l''Eternel, On cherchera l''iniquité d''Israël, et elle n''existera plus, Le péché de Juda, et il ne se trouvera plus; Car je pardonnerai au reste que j''aurai laissé.
verses.am: እነዚህን ያስቀረኋቸውን ይቅር እላቸዋለሁና በዚያን ወራት በዚያም ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል በደል የይሁዳም ኃጢአት ይፈለጋል ምንም አይገኝም።

verses.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the Lord, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.fr: Monte contre le pays doublement rebelle, Contre ses habitants, et châtie-les! Poursuis, massacre, extermine-les! dit l''Eternel, Exécute entièrement mes ordres!
verses.am: በምራታይም ምድር ላይ በፋቁድም በሚኖሩት ላይ ውጣ፤ ግደላቸው ፈጽመህም አጥፋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.fr: Des cris de guerre retentissent dans le pays, Et le désastre est grand.
verses.am: የሰልፍና የታላቅ ጥፋት ውካታ በምድር ላይ አለ።

verses.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
verses.fr: Eh quoi! il est rompu, brisé, le marteau de toute la terre! Babylone est détruite au milieu des nations!
verses.am: የምድር ሁሉ መዶሻ እንዴት ደቀቀ እንዴትስ ተሰበረ! ባቢሎንስ በአሕዛብ መካከል እንዴት ባድማ ሆነች!

verses.en: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the Lord.
verses.fr: Je t''ai tendu un piège, et tu as été prise, Babylone, A l''improviste; Tu as été atteinte, saisie, Parce que tu as lutté contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: ባቢሎን ሆይ፥ አጥምጄብሻለሁ አንቺም ሳታውቂ ተይዘሻል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስለ ተዋጋሽ ተገኝተሻል ተይዘሽማል።

verses.en: The Lord hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord God of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a ouvert son arsenal, Et il en a tiré les armes de sa colère; Car c''est là une oeuvre du Seigneur, de l''Eternel des armées, Dans le pays des Chaldéens.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በከለዳውያን ምድር ይሠራ ዘንድ ሥራ አለውና እግዚአብሔር ዕቃ ቤቱን ከፍቶ የቍጣውን ዕቃ ጦር አውጥቶአል።

verses.en: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.fr: Pénétrez de toutes parts dans Babylone, ouvrez ses greniers, Faites-y des monceaux comme des tas de gerbes, Et détruisez-la! Qu''il ne reste plus rien d''elle!
verses.am: ከየበኩሉ በእርስዋ ላይ ውጡ፥ ጎተራዎችዋንም ክፈቱ፤ እንደ ክምርም አድርጓት ፈጽማችሁም አጥፉአት፥ አንዳችም አታስቀሩላት።

verses.en: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.fr: Tuez tous ses taureaux, qu''on les égorge! Malheur à eux! car leur jour est arrivé, Le temps de leur châtiment.
verses.am: ወይፈኖችዋን ሁሉ እረዱ፥ ወደ መታረድም ይውረዱ፤ ቀናቸው፥ የመጐብኘታቸው ጊዜ፥ ደርሶአልና ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.fr: Ecoutez les cris des fuyards, de ceux qui se sauvent du pays de Babylone Pour annoncer dans Sion la vengeance de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, La vengeance de son temple!
verses.am: የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን በቀል የመቅደሱንም በቀል በጽዮን ይነግሩ ዘንድ ሸሽተው ከባቢሎን አገር ያመለጡት ሰዎች ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Appelez contre Babylone les archers, vous tous qui maniez l''arc! Campez autour d''elle, que personne n''échappe, Rendez-lui selon ses oeuvres, Faites-lui entièrement comme elle a fait! Car elle s''est élevée avec fierté contre l''Eternel, Contre le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: ቀስትን የሚገትሩትን ቀስተኞችን ሁሉ በባቢሎን ላይ ጥሩአቸው፤ በዙሪያዋ ስፈሩባት አንድም አያምልጥ፤ በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርታለችና እንደ ሥራዋ መጠን መልሱላት፥ እንዳደረገችም ሁሉ አድርጉባት።

verses.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ses jeunes gens tomberont dans les rues, Et tous ses hommes de guerre périront en ce jour, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞችዋ ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord God of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
verses.fr: Voici, j''en veux à toi, orgueilleuse! Dit le Seigneur, l''Eternel des armées; Car ton jour est arrivé, Le temps de ton châtiment.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛው ሆይ፥ የመጐብኘትህ ጊዜ፥ ቀንህ ደርሶአልና እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.fr: L''orgueilleuse chancellera et tombera, Et personne ne la relèvera; Je mettrai le feu à ses villes, Et il en dévorera tous les alentours.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛው ተሰናክሎ ይወድቃል የሚያነሣውም የለም፤ በከተሞቹም ውስጥ እሳት አነድዳለሁ፥ በዙሪያውም ያለውን ሁሉ ትበላለች።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Les enfants d''Israël et les enfants de Juda sont ensemble opprimés; Tous ceux qui les ont emmenés captifs les retiennent, Et refusent de les relâcher.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ተገፍተዋል፥ የማረኳቸውም ሁሉ በኃይል ይይዙአቸዋል፥ ይለቅቁአቸውም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል።

verses.en: Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.fr: Mais leur vengeur est puissant, Lui dont l''Eternel des armées est le nom; Il défendra leur cause, Afin de donner le repos au pays, Et de faire trembler les habitants de Babylone.
verses.am: ተቤዢአቸው ብርቱ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርንም ያሳርፍ ዘንድ በባቢሎንም የሚኖሩትን ያውክ ዘንድ ሙግታቸውን ፈጽም ይምዋገታል።

verses.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
