verses.fr: L''épée contre les Chaldéens! dit l''Eternel, Contre les habitants de Babylone, ses chefs et ses sages!
verses.am: ሰይፍ በከለዳውያንና በባቢሎን በሚኖሩ ላይ፥ በአለቆችዋና በጥበበኞችዋ ላይ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.fr: L''épée contre les prophètes de mensonge! qu''ils soient comme des insensés! L''épée contre ses vaillants hommes! qu''ils soient consternés!
verses.am: ሰይፍ በሚጓደዱት ላይ አለ ሰነፎችም ይሆናሉ፥ ሰይፍም በኃያላኖችዋ ላይ አለ እነርሱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.fr: L''épée contre ses chevaux et ses chars! Contre les gens de toute espèce qui sont au milieu d''elle! Qu''ils deviennent semblables à des femmes! L''épée contre ses trésors! qu''ils soient pillés!
verses.am: ሰይፍ በፈረሶቻቸውና በሰረገሎቻቸው ላይ በመካከልዋም ባሉት በልዩ በልዩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ላይ አለ፥ እነርሱም እንደ ሴቶች ይሆናሉ፤ ሰይፍም በመዝገብዋ ላይ አለ ለብዝበዛም ይሆናል።

verses.en: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
verses.fr: La sécheresse contre ses eaux! qu''elles tarissent! Car c''est un pays d''idoles; Ils sont fous de leurs idoles.
verses.am: እርስዋ የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ምድር ናት፥ እነርሱም በጣዖታት ይመካሉና ድርቅ በውኆችዋ ላይ ይሆናል እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ።

verses.en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les animaux du désert s''y établiront avec les chacals, Et les autruches y feront leur demeure; Elle ne sera plus jamais habitée, Elle ne sera plus jamais peuplée.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ከተኵላዎች ጋር ይቀመጡባታል፥ ሰጐኖችም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ሰውም ከዚያ ወዲያ ለዘላለም አይቀመጥባትም፥ እስከ ልጅ ልጅም ድረስ የሚኖርባት የለም።

verses.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.fr: Comme Sodome et Gomorrhe, et les villes voisines, que Dieu détruisit, Dit l''Eternel, Elle ne sera plus habitée, Elle ne sera le séjour d''aucun homme.
verses.am: ሰዶምንና ገሞራን በአጠገባቸውም የነበሩትን ከተምች እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጣቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ ሰው በዚያ አይቀመጥም የሰውም ልጅ አይኖርባትም።

verses.en: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.fr: Voici, un peuple vient du septentrion, Une grande nation et des rois puissants Se lèvent des extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ይመጣል ታላቅ ሕዝብና ብዙ ነገሥታትም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣሉ።

verses.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.fr: Ils portent l''arc et le javelot; Ils sont cruels, sans miséricorde; Leur voix mugit comme la mer; Ils sont montés sur des chevaux, Prêts à combattre comme un seul homme, Contre toi, fille de Babylone!
verses.am: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው ምሕረትም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የባቢሎን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.fr: Le roi de Babylone apprend la nouvelle, Et ses mains s''affaiblissent, L''angoisse le saisit, Comme la douleur d''une femme qui accouche...
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወሬአቸውን ሰምቶአል፥ እጁም ደክማለች፥ ጭንቀትም ይዞታል፥ ምጥ ወላድ ሴትን እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞታል።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.fr: Voici, tel qu''un lion, il monte des rives orgueilleuses du Jourdain Contre la demeure forte; Soudain je les en chasserai, Et j''établirai sur elle celui que j''ai choisi. Car qui est semblable à moi? qui me donnera des ordres? Et quel est le chef qui me résistera?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi écoutez la résolution que l''Eternel a prise contre Babylone, Et les desseins qu''il a conçus contre le pays des Chaldéens! Certainement on les traînera comme de faibles brebis, Certainement on ravagera leur demeure.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በከለዳውያንም ምድር ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትናንሾች ይጎተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.fr: Au bruit de la prise de Babylone la terre tremble, Et un cri se fait entendre parmi les nations.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን መያዝ ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ ጩኸትም በአሕዛብ መካከል ዘንድ ተሰማ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je fais lever contre Babylone, Et contre les habitants de la Chaldée, Un vent destructeur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ላይና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ አጥፊውን ነፋስ አስነሣለሁ።

verses.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.fr: J''envoie contre Babylone des vanneurs qui la vanneront, Qui videront son pays; Ils fondront de toutes parts sur elle, Au jour du malheur.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚያዘሩትን ሰዎች እሰድዳለሁ እነርሱም ያዘሩአታል፥ ምድርዋንም ባዶ ያደርጋሉ፤ በመከራም ቀን በዙሪያዋ ይከብቡአታል።

verses.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.fr: Qu''on tende l''arc contre celui qui tend son arc, Contre celui qui est fier dans sa cuirasse! N''épargnez pas ses jeunes hommes! Exterminez toute son armée!
verses.am: በወርዋሪው ላይ በጥሩርም በሚነሣው ላይ ቀስተኛው ቀስቱን ይገትር፤ ለጐበዛዝትዋ አትዘኑ ሠራዊትዋንም ሁሉ አጥፉ።

verses.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
verses.fr: Qu''ils tombent blessés à mort dans le pays des Chaldéens, Percés de coups dans les rues de Babylone!
verses.am: በከለዳውያንም ምድር ተገድለው፥ በሜዳዋም ላይ ተወግተው ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Car Israël et Juda ne sont point abandonnés de leur Dieu, De l''Eternel des armées, Et le pays des Chaldéens est rempli de crimes Contre le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: ምድራቸው በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በተሠራው በደል ምንም እንኳ የተሞላች ብትሆን፥ እስራኤልም ሆነ ይሁዳ በአምላኩ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አልተጣለም።

verses.en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
verses.fr: Fuyez de Babylone, et que chacun sauve sa vie, De peur que vous ne périssiez dans sa ruine! Car c''est un temps de vengeance pour l''Eternel; Il va lui rendre selon ses oeuvres.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ነፍሳችሁን አድኑ፤ በበደልዋ አትጥፉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ጊዜ ነውና፥ እርሱም ብድራትዋን ይከፍላታልና።

verses.en: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.fr: Babylone était dans la main de l''Eternel une coupe d''or, Qui enivrait toute la terre; Les nations ont bu de son vin: C''est pourquoi les nations ont été comme en délire.
verses.am: ባቢሎን በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ውስጥ ምድርን ሁሉ ያሰከረች የወርቅ ጽዋ ነበረች፥ አሕዛብም ከጠጅዋ ጠጥተዋል፤ ስለዚህ አሕዛብ አብደዋል።

verses.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.fr: Soudain Babylone tombe, elle est brisée! Gémissez sur elle, prenez du baume pour sa plaie: Peut-être guérira-t-elle. -
verses.am: ባቢሎን በድንገት ወድቃ ጠፍታለች፤ አልቅሱላት፥ ትፈወስም እንደ ሆነ ለKWsልዋ መድኃኒት ውሰዱላት።

verses.en: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.fr: Nous avons voulu guérir Babylone, mais elle n''a pas guéri. Abandonnons-la, et allons chacun dans son pays; Car son châtiment atteint jusqu''aux cieux, Et s''élève jusqu''aux nues.
verses.am: ባቢሎንን ፈወስናት፥ እርስዋ ግን አልተፈወሰችም፤ ፍርድዋ እስከ ሰማይ ደርሶአልና፥ እስከ ደመናም ድረስ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ትታችኋት እያንዳንዳችን ወደ አገራችን እንሂድ።

verses.en: The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.
verses.fr: L''Eternel manifeste la justice de notre cause; Venez, et racontons dans Sion L''oeuvre de l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችንን አውጥቶአል፤ ኑ፥ በጽዮን የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንናገር።

verses.en: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.fr: Aiguisez les flèches, saisissez les boucliers! L''Eternel a excité l''esprit des rois de Médie, Parce qu''il veut détruire Babylone; Car c''est la vengeance de l''Eternel, La vengeance de son temple.
verses.am: ፍላጾችን ሳሉ ጋሻዎችንም አዘጋጁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋት ዘንድ አሳቡ በባቢሎን ላይ ነውና የሜዶንን ነገሥታት መንፈስ አስነሥቶአል፤ የእግዚብሔር በቀል የመቅደሱ በቀል ነውና።

verses.en: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.fr: Elevez une bannière contre les murs de Babylone! Fortifiez les postes, placez des gardes, dressez des embuscades! Car l''Eternel a pris une résolution, Et il exécute ce qu''il a prononcé contre les habitants de Babylone.
verses.am: በባቢሎን ቅጥር ዓላማውን አንሡበት፥ ጥበቃን አጽኑ፥ ተመልካቾችን አቁሙ፥ ድብቅ ጦር አዘጋጁ። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን በሚኖሩት ላይ የተናገረውን አስቦአልና፥ አድርጎአልምና።

verses.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
verses.fr: Toi qui habites près des grandes eaux, Et qui as d''immenses trésors, Ta fin est venue, ta cupidité est à son terme!
verses.am: አንቺ በብዙ ውኃ አጠገብ የተቀመጥሽ፥ በመዝገብም የበለጠግሽ ሆይ፥ እንደ ስስትሽ መጠን ፍጻሜሽ ደርሶአል።

verses.en: The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées l''a juré par lui-même: Oui, je te remplirai d''hommes comme de sauterelles, Et ils pousseront contre toi des cris de guerre.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ሲል በራሱ ምሎአል። በእውነት ሰዎችን እንደ አንበጣ እሞላብሻለሁ፥ እነርሱም ጩኸት ያነሡብሻል።

verses.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.fr: Il a crée la terre par sa puissance, Il a fondé le monde par sa sagesse, Il a étendu les cieux par son intelligence.
verses.am: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ፥ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.fr: A sa voix, les eaux mugissent dans les cieux, Il fait monter les nuages des extrémités de la terre, Il produit les éclairs et la pluie, Il tire le vent de ses trésors.
verses.am: ድምጹን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይታወካሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናብም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፍስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.fr: Tout homme devient stupide par sa science, Tout orfèvre est honteux de son image taillée; Car ses idoles ne sont que mensonge, Il n''y a point en elles de souffle.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።

verses.en: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.fr: Elles sont une chose de néant, une oeuvre de tromperie; Elles périront, quand viendra le châtiment.
verses.am: እነርሱም ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.fr: Celui qui est la part de Jacob n''est pas comme elles; Car c''est lui qui a tout formé, Et Israël est la tribu de son héritage. L''Eternel des armées est son nom.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፥ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.fr: Tu as été pour moi un marteau, un instrument de guerre. J''ai brisé par toi des nations, Par toi j''ai détruit des royaumes.
verses.am: አንቺ መዶሻዬና የጦር መሣሪያዬ ነሽ፤ በአንቺ አሕዛብን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ፤

verses.en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.fr: Par toi j''ai brisé le cheval et son cavalier; Par toi j''ai brisé le char et celui qui était dessus.
verses.am: በአንቺ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን እሰባብራለሁ፤

verses.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.fr: Par toi j''ai brisé l''homme et la femme; Par toi j''ai brisé le vieillard et l''enfant; Par toi j''ai brisé le jeune homme et la jeune fille.
verses.am: በአንቺም ሰረገላውንና በላዩ የሚቀመጠውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ወንድንና ሴትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ሽማግሌውንና ብላቴናውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ጐልማሳውንና ቆንጆይቱን እሰባብራለሁ፤

verses.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.fr: Par toi j''ai brisé le berger et son troupeau; Par toi j''ai brisé le laboureur et ses boeufs; Par toi j''ai brisé les gouverneurs et les chefs.
verses.am: በአንቺም እረኛውንና መንጋውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አራሹንና ጥማጁን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አለቆችንና ሹማምቶችን አሰባብራለሁ።

verses.en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je rendrai à Babylone et à tous les habitants de la Chaldée Tout le mal qu''ils ont fait à Sion sous vos yeux, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በጽዮን በዓይናችሁ ፊት ስለሠሩት ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በባቢሎንና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ፍዳቸውን እከፍላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.fr: Voici, j''en veux à toi, montagne de destruction, dit l''Eternel, A toi qui détruisais toute la terre! J''étendrai ma main sur toi, Je te roulerai du haut des rochers, Et je ferai de toi une montagne embrasée.
verses.am: አንተ ምድርን ሁሉ የምታጠፋ አጥፊ ተራራ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እጄንም እዘረጋብሃለሁ፥ ከድንጋዮችም ላይ አንከባልልሃለሁ፥ የተቃጠለም ተራራ አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: On ne tirera de toi ni pierres angulaires, ni pierres pour fondements; Car tu seras à jamais une ruine, dit l''Eternel...
verses.am: ከአንተም ለማዕዘንና ለመሠረት የሚሆን ድንጋይ አይወስዱም፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ ትሆናለህ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.fr: Elevez une bannière dans le pays! Sonnez de la trompette parmi les nations! Préparez les nations contre elle, Appelez contre elle les royaumes d''Ararat, de Minni et d''Aschkenaz! Etablissez contre elle des chefs! Faites avancer des chevaux comme des sauterelles hérissées!
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ዓላማን አንሡ በአሕዛብም መካከል መለከት ንፉ፥ አሕዛብንም አዘጋጁባት፤ የአራራትንና የሚኒን የአስከናዝንም መንግሥታት ሰብስቡባት አለቃንም በላይዋ አቁሙ፤ እንደ ጠgWraም ኩብኩባ ፈረሶችን በላይዋ አውጡ።

verses.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.fr: Préparez contre elle les nations, les rois de Médie, Ses gouverneurs et tous ses chefs, Et tout le pays sous leur domination!
verses.am: አሕዛብን የሚዶንንም ነገሥታት አለቆችንም ሹማምቶችንም ሁሉ የግዛታቸውንም ምድር ሁሉ አዘጋጁባት።

verses.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.fr: La terre s''ébranle, elle tremble; Car le dessein de l''Eternel contre Babylone s''accomplit; Il va faire du pays de Babylone un désert sans habitants.
verses.am: ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት የባቢሎንን ምድር ባድማ ያደርጋት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አሳብ በባቢሎን ላይ ጸንቶአልና ምድር ተናወጣለች ታመመችም።

verses.en: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.fr: Les guerriers de Babylone cessent de combattre, Ils se tiennent dans les forteresses; Leur force est épuisée, ils sont comme des femmes. On met le feu aux habitations, On brise les barres.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ኃያላን መዋጋትን ትተዋል በአምባዎቻቸውም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠፍቶአል እንደ ሴቶችም ሆነዋል፤ ማደሪያዎችዋም ነድደዋል መወርወሪያዎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።

verses.en: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
verses.fr: Les courriers se rencontrent, Les messagers se croisent, Pour annoncer au roi de Babylone Que sa ville est prise par tous les côtés,
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አውድማ እንደ ተረገጠ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የባቢሎን ልጅ ናት፤ ጥቂት ቈይታ የመከር ጊዜ ይደርስባታል።

verses.en: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.fr: Que les passages sont envahis, Les marais embrasés par le feu, Et les hommes de guerre consternés.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አውድማ እንደ ተረገጠ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የባቢሎን ልጅ ናት፤ ጥቂት ቈይታ የመከር ጊዜ ይደርስባታል።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées, le Dieu d''Israël: La fille de Babylone est comme une aire dans le temps où on la foule; Encore un instant, et le moment de la moisson sera venu pour elle.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በላኝ፥ ከፋፈለኝም፥ እንደ ባዶ ዕቃም አደረገኝ፥ እንደ ዘንዶም ዋጠኝ፥ ከሚጣፍጠውም ምግቤ ሆዱን ሞላ፥ እኔንም ጣለኝ።

verses.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
verses.fr: Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, m''a dévorée, m''a détruite; Il a fait de moi un vase vide; Tel un dragon, il m''a engloutie, Il a rempli son ventre de ce que j''avais de précieux; Il m''a chassée.
verses.am: በጽዮን የምትቀመጥ። በእኔና በሥጋዬ የተደረገ ግፍ በባቢሎን ላይ ይሁን ትላለች፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም። ደሜ በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ ይሁን ትላለች።

verses.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
verses.fr: Que la violence envers moi et ma chair déchirée retombent sur Babylone! Dit l''habitante de Sion. Que mon sang retombe sur les habitants de la Chaldée! Dit Jérusalem. -
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እምዋገትልሻለሁ በቀልሽንም እበቀልልሻለሁ፤ ባሕርዋንም ድርቅ አደርገዋለሁ ምንጭዋንም አደርቀዋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je défendrai ta cause, Je te vengerai! Je mettrai à sec la mer de Babylone, Et je ferai tarir sa source.
verses.am: ባቢሎንም የድንጋይ KWlልና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ መደነቂያም ማፍዋጫም ትሆናለች፥ የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው አይገኝም።

verses.en: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.fr: Babylone sera un monceau de ruines, un repaire de chacals, Un objet de désolation et de moquerie; Il n''y aura plus d''habitants.
verses.am: በአንድነትም እንደ አንበሶች ያገሣሉ፥ እንደ አንበሳም ደቦሎች ያጕረመርማሉ።

verses.en: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
verses.fr: Ils rugiront ensemble comme des lions, Ils pousseront des cris comme des lionceaux.
verses.am: በሞቃቸው ጊዜ ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው እንዳይነቁ የመጠጥ ግብዣ አደርግላቸዋለሁ አሰክራቸውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Quand ils seront échauffés, je les ferai boire, Et je les enivrerai, pour qu''ils se livrent à la gaîté, Puis s''endorment d''un sommeil éternel, et ne se réveillent plus, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ ጠቦቶችና እንደ አውራ በጎች እንደ አውራ ፍየሎችም ወደ መታረድ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.fr: Je les ferai descendre comme des agneaux à la tuerie, Comme des béliers et des boucs.
verses.am: ሼሻክ እንዴት ተያዘች! የምድርም ሁሉ ምስጋና እንዴት ተወሰደች! ባቢሎንም በአሕዛብ መካከል መደነቂያ እንዴት ሆነች!

verses.en: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.fr: Eh quoi! Schéschac est prise! Celle dont la gloire remplissait toute la terre est conquise! Eh quoi! Babylone est détruite au milieu des nations!
verses.am: ባሕር በባቢሎን ላይ ወጣ በሞገዱም ብዛት ተከደነች።

verses.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.fr: La mer est montée sur Babylone: Babylone a été couverte par la multitude de ses flots.
verses.am: ከተሞችዋ ባድማና ደረቅ ምድር ምድረ በዳም፥ ሰውም የማይቀመጥበት የሰውም ልጅ የማያልፍበት ምድር ሆኑ።

verses.en: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
verses.fr: Ses villes sont ravagées, La terre est aride et déserte; C''est un pays où personne n''habite, Où ne passe aucun homme.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም ውስጥ ቤልን እቀጣለሁ የዋጠውንም ከአፉ አስተፋዋለሁ፤ አሕዛብም ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ እርሱ አይሰበሰቡም፥ የባቢሎንም ቅጥር ይወድቃል።

verses.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.fr: Je châtierai Bel à Babylone, J''arracherai de sa bouche ce qu''il a englouti, Et les nations n''afflueront plus vers lui. La muraille même de Babylone est tombée!
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ራሳችሁን አድኑ።

verses.en: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.fr: Sortez du milieu d''elle, mon peuple, Et que chacun sauve sa vie, En échappant à la colère ardente de l''Eternel!
verses.am: በምድርም ከሚሰማ ወሬ የተነሣ አትፍሩ ልባችሁም የዛለ አይሁን፤ በአንድ ዓመት ወሬ ይመጣል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በሌላው ዓመት ወሬ፥ በምድርም ላይ ግፍ ይመጣል፥ አለቃም በአለቃ ላይ ይነሣል።

verses.en: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.fr: Que votre coeur ne se trouble point, et ne vous effrayez pas Des bruits qui se répandront dans le pays; Car cette année surviendra un bruit, Et l''année suivante un autre bruit, La violence régnera dans le pays, Et un dominateur s''élèvera contre un autre dominateur.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን የባቢሎን ምስሎች የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ምድርዋም ሁሉ ታፍራለች፤ ተወግተውም የሞቱት ሁሉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent Où je châtierai les idoles de Babylone, Et tout son pays sera couvert de honte; Tous ses morts tomberont au milieu d''elle.
verses.am: አጥፊዎች ከሰሜን ይመጡባታልና ሰማይና ምድር በእነርሱም ያለው ሁሉ ስለ ባቢሎን እልል ይላሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Sur Babylone retentiront les cris de joie des cieux et de la terre, Et de tout ce qu''ils renferment; Car du septentrion les dévastateurs fondront sur elle, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ባቢሎንም ከእስራኤል ተወግተው የሞቱት እንዲወድቁ እንዳደረገች፥ እንዲሁ በባቢሎን ከምድሩ ሁሉ ተወግተው የሞቱት ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.fr: Babylone aussi tombera, ô morts d''Israël, Comme elle a fait tomber les morts de tout le pays.
verses.am: ከሰይፍ ያመለጣችሁ ሆይ፥ ሂዱ፥ አትቁሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከሩቅ አስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በልባችሁ አስቡ።

verses.en: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the Lord afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.fr: Vous qui avez échappé au glaive, partez, ne tardez pas! De la terre lointaine, pensez à l''Eternel, Et que Jérusalem soit présente à vos coeurs! -
verses.am: ስድብን ስለ ሰማን አፍረናል፤ ባዕዳን ሰዎችም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ገብተዋልና ነውር ፊታችንን ከድኖታል።

verses.en: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the Lord's house.
verses.fr: Nous étions confus, quand nous entendions l''insulte; La honte couvrait nos visages, Quand des étrangers sont venus Dans le sanctuaire de la maison de l''Eternel. -
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችዋ የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር በምድርዋም ላይ ሁሉ የተወጉት ያንቋርራሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, les jours viennent, dit l''Eternel, Où je châtierai ses idoles; Et dans tout son pays les blessés gémiront.
verses.am: ባቢሎን ምንም ወደ ሰማይ ብትወጣ፥ የኃይልዋንም ከፍታ ብታጸና፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ አጥፊዎች ይመጡባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Quand Babylone s''élèverait jusqu''aux cieux, Quand elle rendrait inaccessibles ses hautes forteresses, J''enverrai contre elle les dévastateurs, dit l''Eternel...
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ጩኸት፥ ከከለዳውያንም ምድር የታላቅ ጥፋት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.fr: Des cris s''échappent de Babylone, Et le désastre est grand dans le pays des Chaldéens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ባቢሎንን አጥፍቶአታልና፥ ከእርስዋም ታላቁን ድምፅ ዝም አሰኝቶአልና፤ ሞገዳቸውም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምማል፥ የድምፃቸውም ጩኸት ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel ravage Babylone, Il en fait cesser les cris retentissants; Les flots des dévastateurs mugissent comme de grandes eaux, Dont le bruit tumultueux se fait entendre.
verses.am: አጥፊው በባቢሎን ላይ መጥቶባታልና፥ ኃያላኖችዋ ተያዙ፥ ቀስታቸውም ተሰባበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ፍዳን የሚከፍል አምላክ ነውና፥ ፍዳንም በእርግጥ ይከፍላል።

verses.en: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.fr: Oui, le dévastateur fond sur elle, sur Babylone; Les guerriers de Babylone sont pris, Leurs arcs sont brisés. Car l''Eternel est un Dieu qui rend à chacun selon ses oeuvres, Qui paie à chacun son salaire.
verses.am: መሳፍንቶችዋንና ጥበበኞችዋንም፥ አለቆችዋንና ሹማምቶችዋን ኃያላኖችዋንም አሰክራለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው አይነቁም፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተባለው ንጉሥ።

verses.en: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: J''enivrerai ses princes et ses sages, Ses gouverneurs, ses chefs et ses guerriers; Ils s''endormiront d''un sommeil éternel, et ne se réveilleront plus, Dit le roi, dont l''Eternel des armées est le nom.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰፊው የባቢሎን ቅጥር ፈጽሞ ይፈርሳል ረጃጅሞችም በሮችዋ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፤ የወገኖችም ድካም ከንቱ ትሆናለች፥ የአሕዛብም ሥራ ለእሳት ትሆናለች፤ እነርሱም ይደክማሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Les larges murailles de Babylone seront renversées, Ses hautes portes seront brûlées par le feu; Ainsi les peuples auront travaillé en vain, Les nations se seront fatiguées pour le feu.
verses.am: የመሕሤያ ልጅ የኔርያ ልጅ ሠራያ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን በሄደ ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘው ቃል ይህ ነው። ሠራያም የቤት አዛዥ ነበረ።

verses.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
verses.fr: Ordre donné par Jérémie, le prophète, à Seraja, fils de Nérija, fils de Machséja, lorsqu''il se rendit à Babylone avec Sédécias, roi de Juda, la quatrième année du règne de Sédécias. Or, Seraja était premier chambellan.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚመጣውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ስለ ባቢሎን የተጻፈውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ኤርምያስ በመጽሐፍ ላይ ጻፈው።

verses.en: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.fr: Jérémie écrivit dans un livre tous les malheurs qui devaient arriver à Babylone, toutes ces paroles qui sont écrites sur Babylone.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ሠራያን እንዲህ አለው። ወደ ባቢሎን በገባህ ጊዜ እይ ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ አንብብና።

verses.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
verses.fr: Jérémie dit à Seraja: Lorsque tu seras arrivé à Babylone, tu auras soin de lire toutes ces paroles,
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ እንድትሆን ታጠፋት ዘንድ በዚህች ስፍራ ላይ ተናግረሃል በል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou say, O Lord, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.fr: et tu diras: Eternel, c''est toi qui as déclaré que ce lieu serait détruit, et qu''il ne serait plus habité ni par les hommes ni par les bêtes, mais qu''il deviendrait un désert pour toujours.
verses.am: ይህንም መጽሐፍ ማንበብ ከፈጸምህ በኋላ፥ ድንጋይን እሰርበት በኤፍራጥስም ውስጥ ጣለው፤

verses.en: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.fr: Et quand tu auras achevé la lecture de ce livre, tu y attacheras une pierre, et tu le jetteras dans l''Euphrate,
verses.am: አንተም። እኔ ከማመጣባት ክፉ ነገር የተነሣ እንዲሁ ባቢሎን ትሰጥማለች አትነሣምም በል። የኤርምያስ ቃል እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.fr: et tu diras: Ainsi Babylone sera submergée, elle ne se relèvera pas des malheurs que j''amènerai sur elle; ils tomberont épuisés. Jusqu''ici sont les paroles de Jérémie.
verses.am: አንተም። እኔ ከማመጣባት ክፉ ነገር የተነሣ እንዲሁ ባቢሎን ትሰጥማለች አትነሣምም በል። የኤርምያስ ቃል እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.fr: Sédécias avait vingt et un ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Hamuthal, fille de Jérémie, de Libna.
verses.am: ሴዴቅያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም አሚጣል የተባለች የሊብና ሰው የኤርምያስ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, entièrement comme avait fait Jojakim.
verses.am: ኢዮአቄምም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.en: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.fr: Et cela arriva à cause de la colère de l''Eternel contre Jérusalem et contre Juda, qu''il voulait rejeter de devant sa face. Et Sédécias se révolta contre le roi de Babylone.
verses.am: ከፊቱም አውጥቶ እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ላይ ሆኖአልና፤ ሴዴቅያስም በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
verses.fr: La neuvième année du règne de Sédécias, le dixième jour du dixième mois, Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, vint avec toute son armée contre Jérusalem; ils campèrent devant elle, et élevèrent des retranchements tout autour.
verses.am: ሴዴቅያስም በነገሠ በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጥተው ከበቡአት በዙሪያዋም ዕርድ አደረገ።

verses.en: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.fr: La ville fut assiégée jusqu''à la onzième année du roi Sédécias.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም እስከ ንጉሡ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ድረስ ተከብባ ነበር።

verses.en: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.fr: Le neuvième jour du quatrième mois, la famine était forte dans la ville, et il n''y avait pas de pain pour le peuple du pays.
verses.am: በአራተኛውም ወር በዘጠነኛው ቀን በከተማይቱ ራብ ጸንቶ ነበር፥ ለአገሩም ሰዎች እንጀራ ታጣ።

verses.en: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
verses.fr: Alors la brèche fut faite à la ville; et tous les gens de guerre s''enfuirent, et sortirent de la ville pendant la nuit par le chemin de la porte entre les deux murs près du jardin du roi, tandis que les Chaldéens environnaient la ville. Les fuyards prirent le chemin de la plaine.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም ተሰበረች፥ ሰልፈኞችም ሁሉ ሸሹ፥ በሁለቱም ቅጥር መካከል ባለው በር ወደ ንጉሡ አትክልት በሚወስደው መንገድ በሌሊት ከከተማይቱ ወጡ። ከለዳውያንም በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ነበሩ፤ በዓረባም መንገድ ሄዱ።

verses.en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.fr: Mais l''armée des Chaldéens poursuivit le roi, et ils atteignirent Sédécias dans les plaines de Jéricho; et toute son armée se dispersa loin de lui.
verses.am: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ንጉሡን ተከታተሉት፥ በኢያሪኮም ሜዳ ሴዴቅያስን ያዙ፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተበትነው ነበር።

verses.en: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.fr: Ils saisirent le roi, et le firent monter vers le roi de Babylone à Ribla, dans le pays de Hamath; et il prononça contre lui une sentence.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም ይዘው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለባት በሐማት ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሪብላ አመጡት፤ እርሱም ፍርድን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
verses.fr: Le roi de Babylone fit égorger les fils de Sédécias en sa présence; il fit aussi égorger tous les chefs de Juda à Ribla.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የሴዴቅያስን ልጆች በፊቱ ገደላቸው፥ የይሁዳንም አለቆች ሁሉ ደግሞ በሪብላ ገደላቸው።

verses.en: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.fr: Puis il fit crever les yeux à Sédécias, et le fit lier avec des chaînes d''airain; le roi de Babylone l''emmena à Babylone, et il le tint en prison jusqu''au jour de sa mort.
verses.am: የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይኖች አወጣ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሰንሰለት አሰረው ወደ ባቢሎንም ወሰደው፥ እስኪሞትም ድረስ በግዞት ቤት አኖረው።

verses.en: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
verses.fr: Le dixième jour du cinquième mois, -c''était la dix-neuvième année du règne de Nebucadnetsar, roi de Babylone, -Nebuzaradan, chef des gardes, au service du roi de Babylone, vint à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በአሥራ ዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረናው ከን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ፊት የቆመው የዘበኞቹ አለካ ናቡዘረዳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.en: And burned the house of the Lord, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
verses.fr: Il brûla la maison de l''Eternel, la maison du roi, et toutes les maisons de Jérusalem; il livra au feu toutes les maisons de quelque importance.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ ታላላቆችን ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.fr: Toute l''armée des Chaldéens, qui était avec le chef des gardes, démolit toutes les murailles formant l''enceinte de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ከዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጋር የነበረው የከለዳውያን ሠራዊት ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ሁሉ ዙሪያዋን አፈረሱ።

verses.en: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
verses.fr: Nebuzaradan, chef des gardes, emmena captifs une partie des plus pauvres du peuple, ceux du peuple qui étaient demeurés dans la ville, ceux qui s''étaient rendus au roi de Babylone, et le reste de la multitude.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን የሕዝቡን ድኆች፥ በከተማም ውስጥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፥ ሸሽተውም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ የተጠጉትን፥ የሕዝቡንም ቅሬታ አፈለሰ።

verses.en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
verses.fr: Cependant Nebuzaradan, chef des gardes, laissa comme vignerons et comme laboureurs quelques-uns des plus pauvres du pays.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአገሩ ድኆች ወይን ተካዮችና አራሾች እንዲሆኑ አስቀረ።

verses.en: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.fr: Les Chaldéens brisèrent les colonnes d''airain qui étaient dans la maison de l''Eternel, les bases, la mer d''airain qui était dans la maison de l''Eternel, et ils en emportèrent tout l''airain à Babylone.
verses.am: ከለዳውያንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበሩትን የናስ ዓምዶች በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የነበሩትን መቀመጫዎችና የናሱን ኵሬ ሰባበሩ፥ ናሱንም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱ።

verses.en: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.fr: Ils prirent les cendriers, les pelles, les couteaux, les coupes, les tasses, et tous les ustensiles d''airain avec lesquels on faisait le service.
verses.am: ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎችንም መኰስተሪያዎችንና ድስቶችን ጭልፋዎችንም የሚያገለግሉበትንም የናስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
verses.fr: Le chef des gardes prit encore les bassins, les brasiers, les coupes, les cendriers, les chandeliers, les tasses et les calices, ce qui était d''or et ce qui était d''argent.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጽዋዎቹንና ማንደጃዎቹን ድስቶቹንና ምንቸቶችን መቅረዞችንና ጭልፋዎቹን መንቀሎችንም፥ የወርቁን ዕቃ በወርቅ፥ የብሩንም ዕቃ በብር አድርጎ፥ ወሰደ።

verses.en: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.fr: Les deux colonnes, la mer, et les douze boeufs d''airain qui servaient de base, et que le roi Salomon avait faits pour la maison de l''Eternel, tous ces ustensiles d''airain avaient un poids inconnu.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያሠራቸውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች፥ አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከመቀመጫዎቹም በታች የነበሩትን አሥራ ሁለቱን የናስ በሬዎች ወሰደ፤ ለእነዚህ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ናስ ሚዛን አልነበረም።

verses.en: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
verses.fr: La hauteur de l''une des colonnes était de dix-huit coudées, et un cordon de douze coudées l''entourait; elle était creuse, et son épaisseur avait quatre doigts;
verses.am: ዓምዶቹም፥ የአንዱ ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የዙሪያውም መጠን አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውፍረቱም አራት ጣት ያህል ነበረ፥ ባዶም ነበረ።

verses.en: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
verses.fr: il y avait au-dessus un chapiteau d''airain, et la hauteur d''un chapiteau était de cinq coudées; autour du chapiteau il y avait un treillis et des grenades, le tout d''airain; il en était de même pour la seconde colonne avec des grenades.
verses.am: የናሱም ጕልላት በላዩ ነበረ፤ የአንዱም ጉልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በጕልላቱም ላይ በዙሪያው ሁሉ ከናስ የተሠሩ መረበብና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት፤ በሁለተኛውም ዓምድ ደግሞ እንደዚህ ያለ ነገርና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት።

verses.en: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
verses.fr: Il y avait quatre-vingt-seize grenades de chaque côté, et toutes les grenades autour du treillis étaient au nombre de cent.
verses.am: በስተ ውጭም ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ። በመረበቡም ዙሪያ የነበሩ ሮማኖች ሁሉ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.fr: Le chef des gardes prit Seraja, le souverain sacrificateur, Sophonie, le second sacrificateur, et les trois gardiens du seuil.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ታላቁን ካህን ሠራያን ሁለተኛውንም ካህን ሶፎንያስን ሦስቱንም በረኞች ወሰደ፤

verses.en: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
verses.fr: Et dans la ville il prit un eunuque qui avait sous son commandement les gens de guerre, sept hommes qui faisaient partie des conseillers du roi et qui furent trouvés dans la ville, le secrétaire du chef de l''armée qui était chargé d''enrôler le peuple du pays, et soixante hommes du peuple du pays qui se trouvèrent dans la ville.
verses.am: ከከተማይቱም በሰልፈኞች ላይ ተሾመው ከነበሩት አንዱን ጀንደረባ፥ በከተማይቱም ከሚገኙት በንጉሡ ፊት ከሚቆሙት ሰባቱን ሰዎች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ የሚያሰልፈውን የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊ፥ በከተማይቱም ከተገኙት ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.en: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
verses.fr: Nebuzaradan, chef des gardes, les prit, et les conduisit vers le roi de Babylone à Ribla.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወስዶ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለበት ወደ ሪብላ አመጣቸው።

verses.en: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
verses.fr: Le roi de Babylone les frappa et les fit mourir à Ribla, dans le pays de Hamath. Ainsi Juda fut emmené captif loin de son pays.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ መታቸው፥ በሐማትም ምድር ባለችው በሪብላ ገደላቸው። እንዲሁ ይሁዳ ከአገሩ ተማረከ።

verses.en: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
verses.fr: Voici le peuple que Nebucadnetsar emmena en captivité: la septième année, trois mille vingt-trois Juifs;
verses.am: ናቡከደነፆር የማረከው ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ በሰባተኛው ዓመት ሦስት ሺህ ሀያ ሦስት አይሁድ፤

verses.en: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
verses.fr: la dix-huitième année de Nebucadnetsar, il emmena de Jérusalem huit cent trente-deux personnes;
verses.am: ናቡከደነፆርም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ስምንት መቶ ሠላሳ ሁለት ነፍስ ከኢየሩሳሌም ማርኮአል፤

verses.en: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: la vingt-troisième année de Nebucadnetsar, Nebuzaradan, chef des gardes, emmena sept cent quarante-cinq Juifs; en tout quatre mille six cents personnes.
verses.am: በናቡከደነፆር በሀያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአይሁድ ሰባት መቶ አርባ አምስት ነፍስ ማርኮአል፤ ሰዎች ሁሉ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison.
verses.fr: La trente-septième année de la captivité de Jojakin, roi de Juda, le vingt-cinquième jour du douzième mois, Evil-Merodac, roi de Babylone, dans la première année de son règne, releva la tête de Jojakin, roi de Juda, et le fit sortir de prison.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ አምስተኛው ቀን፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴክ በነገሠ በአንደኛው ዓመት የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የዮአኪንን ራስ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ ከወህኒም አወጣው፤

verses.en: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,
verses.fr: Il lui parla avec bonté, et il mit son trône au-dessus du trône des rois qui étaient avec lui à Babylone.
verses.am: በመልካምም ተናገረው፥ ዙፋኑንም ከእርሱ ጋር በባቢሎን ከነበሩት ነገሥታት ዙፋን በላይ አደረገለት።

verses.en: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
verses.fr: Il lui fit changer ses vêtements de prison, et Jojakin mangea toujours à sa table tout le temps de sa vie.
verses.am: በወህኒም ውስጥ ለብሶት የነበረውን ልብስ ለወጠለት፥ ዮአኪንም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ በፊቴ ሁልጊዜ እንጀራ ይበላ ነበር።

verses.en: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
verses.fr: Le roi de Babylone pourvut constamment à son entretien journalier jusqu''au jour de sa mort, tout le temps de sa vie.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ እስኪሞት ድረስ የዘወትር ቀለብ ዕለት ዕለት ይሰጠው ነበር።
